Blind authorship also produced a scope finding: only 17-29% of naturally phrased commitment-trigger pairs defeat embedding similarity, so the term matters on a real minority of cases and must do no harm on the rest, which it does not. We position precomputed commitment linkage as the always-on floor of a layered design whose expansion layer is query-time prospection. Results are preliminary: the evaluation set is author-constructed, and evaluation on TriggerBench proper is committed follow-up work once its data is released.

</details>


### [94] [AI-inferred expressed well-being and collective-action discourse in climate-change campaigns on X](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22096)
*Wentao Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文分析了气候运动期间公众在Twitter/X上发布的帖子中幸福语言与行动语言之间的关系。研究覆盖四个气候运动（地球日、地球一小时、全球气候行动日、世界环境日）在19个发生年的364,118条帖子，使用版本化加权词汇模型评估幸福、希望、集体能力、痛苦和行动语言。核心发现是事件期间幸福语言增加9.02个百分点，而行动语言下降10.75个百分点，呈现出"幸福—行动背离"现象。更幸福的源帖观察到匹配转推级联的几率更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 气候变化传播研究长期关注恐惧与希望的二元对立，但较少关注运动期间公众表达性幸福感语言的变化及其与集体行动语言的关系。现有研究多使用控制实验，样本规模有限；而大规模社交媒体数据虽能揭示聚合模式，但词典方法存在偏差和未充分验证的问题。本研究旨在通过重复事件设计、版本化词汇测量和多层次推断，揭示气候运动期间幸福语言与行动语言是否同步变化。

Method: 数据来源：约1.7亿条气候相关推文（2010.11–2022.11），筛选出364,118条匹配四个运动标签的帖子。设计：30天前事件窗口+事件窗口+30天后事件窗口，共1,008个发生日，19个发生年为单位推断。测量：版本化加权词汇模型估计幸福感（s_ik=Σn_iw·v_wk），主结果为二元信号I_ik=1(s_ik>0)；外部控制使用LIWC正性情感和labMT愉悦度。主模型为发生日线性概率模型，控制星期、日志发帖量、年份；标准误按发生年聚类。用直接解耦指数D=ΔH−ΔA衡量幸福与行动的偏离。稳健性包括19簇Rademacher wild-cluster bootstrap、作者等权、文本去重等。网络分析用hurdle模型分离匹配转推级联观察概率与条件计数。两个独立编码员对451条帖子进行人工标注审计（Krippendorff's α）。

Result: RQ1：事件期幸福流行率较前事件基线增加9.02个百分点（95% CI 1.32–16.73，nominal p=0.0218，BH q=0.1516），后期增加0.69个百分点（不显著）。希望-路径力和集体能力语言描述性上升，痛苦近零。RQ2：事件对比中幸福上升4.94pp，行动语言下降10.75pp，平均背离15.69pp，19个发生年中有16个呈正背离；后期对比中背离17.42pp（17/19年正）。精确符号翻转检验p<0.011。RQ3：更幸福的源帖观察到匹配转推级联的几率更低（OR=0.457，95% CI 0.233–0.896，p=0.0225），但条件级联大小（IRR=0.302，p=0.206）和时间β=0.089（p=0.532）不确定。词汇审计：labMT r=0.412，LIWC r=0.551；Krippendorff's α=0.811（幸福）但次级构造较低（0.321–0.519）。

Conclusion: 气候运动期间出现了幸福语言上升而行动语言下降的"幸福—行动背离"现象，表明积极情感或社会可能性语言增加未必伴随显性行动语言增加。这与区分建设性希望与被动乐观的理论一致：希望可表达对可期未来的想象，但能否促成行动取决于文本中是否命名能动性、路径和集体能力。词汇指标无法恢复完整心理评估，仅能识别大语料库中语义成分的共现或背离。转推网络分析仅反映暴露与级联选择，不构成情绪传染或因果扩散证据。贡献在于方法论：重复运动窗口、配对幸福-行动对比、词汇控制、作者与文本模板敏感性、小簇推断和网络连接审计。局限包括观察性设计、关键词选择偏差、词汇测量未经人类效标验证、转推网络不完整、M3群体推断具系统误差。未来工作需加入独立人工效标验证、非运动对照期、多语言测量和区分情感表达与个人幸福感/行为改变的纵向设计。

Abstract: Climate campaigns are often evaluated through attention and mobilization, but less is known about the well-being language that accompanies them. Whether campaign periods alter positive affect and hope, and whether happiness aligns with action language, remains unresolved. We analysed 364,118 public Twitter/X posts from Earth Day, Earth Hour, Global Climate Action Day and World Environment Day in 19 occurrence-years, using 30-day pre-event, event and post-event windows. A versioned weighted lexical model estimated happiness, future-oriented hope, collective capability, distress and action language. Event-period happiness prevalence was 9.02 percentage points higher than the pre-event baseline , whereas paired occurrence contrasts showed a 10.75-point decline in action language, indicating a happiness--action divergence. The happiness estimate remained positive across composition and text-deduplication checks, but was less precise under a 19-cluster wild bootstrap. Happier source posts had lower odds of an observed matched retweet cascade.

</details>


### [95] [TreeSpark: Calibrated, Load-Adaptive Draft Trees for Semi-Autoregressive Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22098)
*Huapeng Zhou,Huayu Wang,Xinyu Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: TreeSpark提出了一种针对半自回归draft模型（DSpark）的树形推测解码框架。它通过复用drafter的Markov头为每个父节点生成条件分布，校准边接受概率以指导best-first扩展，并通过路径生存阈值θ实现每轮的预算控制和负载自适应服务策略，同时使用无放回抽样保持无损采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有draft tree构建基于per-position marginal分布，忽略了父节点条件性，导致在半自回归drafter上扩展的宽树大多添加了错排序的节点；此外，固定大小的树无法适应不同解码轮次和服务负载下应支持的推测量。

Method: 1) 复用DSpark的rank-r Markov头，在共享backbone logits基础上对每个具体父节点做条件分布计算，无需额外backbone前向；2) 用两参数Platt校准(q₀₀)得到边接受概率p̂，作为路径生存值指导best-first堆扩展和θ停止规则；3) 通过无放回残差抽样和递归拒绝采样保证任意温度下的无损性；4) 构建(batch size, T)的价格阶梯θ*(bs, T)，使服务时根据负载动态调整树大小。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B/8B/14B上的六个基准上，TreeSpark比DSpark链每轮多接受15-25%的draft token，单请求wall-clock加速8-14%；相比DDTree在相同验证预算下τ提升9-16%；校准器ECE低至0.008-0.015；负载增加时控制器平滑收缩树至链形式，最终吞吐比链高+15%。

Conclusion: Draft tree必须使用drafter的条件预测而非边缘预测；两参数校准的(q₀₀)是准确的边接受估计器，只要拟合群体匹配路径生存估计量；由此产生的阈值θ为服务调度器提供每轮价格，使树形成为可控的服务变量。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates language-model inference by letting a cheap drafter propose tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. Recent block drafters make drafting nearly free: a single backbone pass emits an entire block of draft tokens. Draft trees promise a further gain -- several alternative continuations verified in one target forward -- but existing constructions rank candidates by per-position marginals that ignore which parent a candidate extends, so on semi-autoregressive drafters wider trees mostly add mis-ranked nodes; and a tree of fixed size ignores how much speculation each decoding round, and each serving load, can support. We introduce TreeSpark, which reads a parent-conditioned distribution from the drafter's existing Markov head at negligible cost, calibrates it into an edge-acceptance estimate, and lets path survival govern everything else: best-first expansion, per-round stopping, and a load-adaptive serving policy. Sampling siblings without replacement, with matching residuals in recursive rejection, keeps decoding lossless at any temperature. Adaptive trees improve on matched fixed budgets at every temperature; against a tuned chain on the same drafter, TreeSpark accepts 15-25% more draft tokens per round and decodes 8-14% faster in single-request wall-clock, and under rising load it gracefully shrinks the tree back to the chain. Code and artifacts: this https URL

</details>


### [96] [A framework for recipe data structure with applications for culinary and nutritional insights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22099)
*Mansi Goel,Sumit Bhagat,Saloni Srivastava,Malav Patel,Shlok Vinodkumar Mehroliya,Ganesh Bagler*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个菜谱数据结构框架，并实例化为 RecipeDB2——一个包含 128,942 个食谱、35,474 种食材、覆盖 32 个地区和 99 个国家的结构化数据库。该框架通过基于 Transformer 的 NER 模型解析食材短语、利用 BERT 嵌入将食材映射到 USDA 营养数据库、采用随机森林分类器预测 34 个食材类别，并基于确定性规则集分配饮食风格标签，将非结构化的食谱文本转化为可计算的数据资源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的食谱数据集（如 Recipe1M、RecipeNLG、RecipeDB 等）多以自由文本形式存在，缺乏统一的结构化表示，无法将食材组成、地理文化背景与营养信息整合到单一可查询的数据库中。这一"表示鸿沟"阻碍了计算美食学（Computational Gastronomy）领域对烹饪传统与营养健康之间复杂关系的定量研究。

Method: 框架采用多阶段流水线方法：(1) 数据编译——整合 RecipeDB、Archana's Kitchen 和 Awesome Cuisine 三个来源；(2) 地理文化映射——构建从大洲、地区、国家到州/市的五级层次结构；(3) NER 提取——使用 spaCy-transformer 模型提取食材名称、量、单位、状态、尺寸、温度、干/鲜等 7 种烹饪属性；(4) 单位标准化——将非标准单位（93.9%）转换为克（固体）或毫升（液体）；(5) USDA 映射——比较 Jaccard、BERT 和 RoBERTa 三种策略，选择 BERT（余弦相似度 ≥70%）将 25,903 种食材映射到 USDA 数据库；(6) 类别预测——基于 TF-IDF n-gram 特征训练 7 种分类器（RF 最优，准确率 89.12%）预测 34 个食材类别；(7) 饮食风格标注——采用排除式确定性规则集（Vegan、Lacto-Vegetarian、Ovo-Vegetarian、Ovo-Lacto-Vegetarian、Pescetarian），引入"复合菜肴"保护机制以避免错误标签。系统基于 MongoDB + Express + ReactJS + NGINX 构建。

Result: RecipeDB2 成功整合 128,942 个食谱，包含 35,474 种独特食材和 1,163 种测量单位。BERT 映射策略在前 200 种高频食材上达到 F1=87.90%、准确率 79.50%，优于 RoBERTa（F1=71.09%）和 Jaccard（F1=37.38%）。成功映射 128,899 个食谱（43 个完全未映射），平均食谱大小从 9.978 微降至 8.978。营养分析显示平均蛋白质 49.48g、碳水化合物 245.20g、脂肪 102.02g、能量 1989.01 卡路里。随机森林分类器在 34 个类别上达到加权 F1=89.16%。饮食风格标注采用保守的排除式规则，确保标签互斥且穷尽。

Conclusion: RecipeDB2 通过将烹饪传统转化为可计算的数据对象，在规模（食谱数量）、结构化程度（成分解析与映射效率）和注释丰富度（地理文化、饮食风格、营养参数）三个维度上显著超越了 Recipe1M、RecipeNLG 和原版 RecipeDB。其分层流水线设计使得每一阶段的可靠性能够约束下游分析的准确性，确保结果可解释。该资源支持基于营养素的食谱检索、多属性过滤和跨菜系分析，未来计划整合 FoodOn/LanguaL 本体、FooDB/FlavorDB2 化学-风味关系以及基于 LLM 的新型食谱生成与营养预测管线，推动计算美食学的跨学科探索。

Abstract: Cooking is a complex process that transforms raw ingredients into delicious and nutritious dishes, yet the recipes that encode this process remain largely free text; readable by people but not directly computable. Existing recipe collections capture fragments of this information, but no shared representation links a recipe's structured ingredient composition, its geo-cultural provenance, and its nutritional profile within a single queryable schema. We address this representation gap by formalizing a framework for recipe data structure that decomposes each recipe into typed ingredient entities, grounds those entities in a reference nutritional database, and annotates them with geo-cultural and dietary context. We present RecipeDB2, a structured compilation of 128,942 recipes with 35,474 ingredients from 32 regions and 99 countries. Ingredient phrases are parsed into seven culinary attributes using a transformer-based named-entity model; ingredients are linked to the USDA reference tables through a BERT embedding strategy (F1 = 87.90 on a manually adjudicated set of the 200 most frequent ingredients), yielding 148 nutritional parameters per mapped ingredient; a Random Forest classifier propagates 34 ingredient categories across the full vocabulary; and a deterministic, conservative rule set assigns each recipe a dietary style. Through RecipeDB2 ( this https URL ), we demonstrate a scalable framework for making recipes computable, turning culinary heritage (long treated as an artistic rather than a quantitative object) into a data-driven analysis.

</details>


### [97] [DeepInstructor: An Agentic AI Instructor for Experience-Driven Idea Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22104)
*Rongcan Pei,Fang Guo,Qinglin Qi,Qi Zhu,Yun Luo,Jianhao Yan,Minjun Zhu,Qiujie Xie,Dehong Zheng,Yue Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: DeepInstructor 是一个面向科研idea评估的智能体框架，通过从大规模同行评审中构建结构化的"经验图谱"（Experience Graph），并利用ReAct范式的智能体进行维度相关的证据检索与推理，从而实现与人类评审专家更一致的idea评价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型生成科研idea的成本急剧降低，科学发现的瓶颈从"生成"转向"评估"。现有评估方法依赖LLM的参数化知识或无结构检索，缺乏人类评审者所依赖的"经验驱动推理"，导致与人类判断对齐程度不足。

Method: 1) 从58,607篇ICLR同行评审中提取实体与评价关系，构建包含416,330条三元组的Experience Graph；2) 设计两阶段Experience Retriever（先语义匹配实体，再匹配关系边），采用BGE-M3进行嵌入；3) 基于ReAct范式的智能体，自主决定何时检索哪些实体与关系；4) 解耦"评论生成"与"分数预测"，先生成维度相关文本评论，再用few-shot LLM Scorer映射为标量分数；5) 构建DeepInstruct基准数据集，包含基于任务/方法聚类的成对比较。

Result: 在ExpertEval（147个idea的人类标注集）上，DeepInstructor相对基线ChatGPT-4o在Hit@1和Hit@2上分别提升24.4%和29.7%；DeepInstructor-DeepSeek版本在Novelty的Hit@1达到0.649（最佳），在Significance的Hit@2达到0.422（最佳）；在DeepInstruct（398个idea，289对成对比较）上也一致优于RAG和基座LLM；AI-in-the-loop实验中，使用DeepInstructor反馈可使idea在三轮迭代中平均提升+0.203分（ChatGPT-4o生成器），优于通用prompt反馈（+0.068）。

Conclusion: DeepInstructor验证了将学术经验外化为结构化图谱并用于idea评估的有效性，显著提升了与人类判断的对齐程度，表明"经验驱动的推理"可作为科学idea评估的可行范式；但意义性（Significance）评估仍是开放难题，且当前经验图谱仅覆盖计算机领域，未来需扩展至更广泛科学资源。

Abstract: As automated scientific discovery advances, Large Language Models (LLMs) can now generate research ideas at an unprecedented scale, shifting the bottleneck from idea generation to idea evaluation. Existing evaluators mainly rely on parametric LLM knowledge or unstructured retrieval, producing judgments that lack the experience-grounded reasoning used by human instructors. To address this, we propose DeepInstructor, an agentic framework that formulates idea evaluation as reasoning over structured scholarly experience. DeepInstructor constructs an Experience Graph from 58,607 peer reviews and employs a ReAct-based agent to retrieve dimension-specific evidence for traceable evaluation. We further introduce DeepInstruct, a dataset with controlled pairwise comparisons across novelty, significance, and feasibility. Experiments show that DeepInstructor substantially outperforms existing baselines, improving Hit@1 and Hit@2 alignment with human judgments by 24.4% and 29.7%, respectively. Our findings suggest that scientific idea evaluation can be grounded in explicit reasoning over structured scholarly experience

</details>


### [98] [Evaluating Fine-Tuned and Base Language Models in Maternal and Vaccination Healthcare for African Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22110)
*Abdulquddus Ajibade,Oluwaseun Odunsi,Iyinoluwa Animasaun,Chioma Nwakanma-Akanno,Oluwasegun Oguntuase,Oluwafunke Akinbuwa,Abiodun Adereni*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究针对尼日利亚低资源医疗场景，评估了基于 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 进行领域微调的两个模型（MamaBot-Llama 妇产科、Vax-Llama 疫苗）在 200 个医疗问题上的表现。结果显示，妇产科模型显著优于基线模型，而疫苗模型反而出现性能下降，表明数据质量是医疗 LLM 微调成功的关键因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 在低资源医疗场景中具有提升健康信息传递的潜力，但容易产生不准确或文化不适配的建议。需要探索领域特定微调能否有效提升 LLM 在尼日利亚孕产健康和疫苗接种领域的可靠性与安全性。

Method: 构建两个领域微调模型：MamaBot-Llama（基于 36,000+ 妇产科 QA 对）和 Vax-Llama（基于 9,000+ 疫苗 QA 对），均采用 LoRA（Low-Rank Adaptation）技术对 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 进行微调。评估数据集包含 200 个问题（每个领域 100 个，覆盖 5 个子领域）。由 2 名尼日利亚执业医师使用 5 点 Likert 量表独立评分，使用 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验进行配对比较。

Result: MamaBot-Llama：全面优于基线模型，整体提升 4.9%（p<.001），临床可信度提升 7%，医学准确性提升 5%，关键问题减少 50%，78% 情况下被临床医生优先选择。Vax-Llama：整体下降 5.2%（p<.001），关键问题增加 192%，安全性问题增加 400%。

Conclusion: 基于高质量、临床医生整理数据的领域微调可以有效提升医疗 LLM 表现；但数据质量不足时反而会降低模型性能。临床部署前必须进行严格的领域特定验证，且微调效果高度依赖于训练数据的质量与规模。

Abstract: Background: Large language models (LLMs) can improve healthcare information delivery in low-resource settings but may produce inaccurate or culturally inappropriate advice. This study evaluated domain-specific fine-tuning for maternal health and vaccination in Nigeria. Objective: To compare HelpMum's MamaBot-Llama and Vax-Llama with Meta's Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct for accuracy, safety, clarity, contextual appropriateness, and trustworthiness. Methods: We evaluated 200 healthcare questions, 100 each for maternal health and vaccination, across five subdomains per domain. MamaBot-Llama and Vax-Llama were fine-tuned using Low-Rank Adaptation on over 36,000 maternal health and 9,000 vaccination question-answer pairs, respectively. Two Nigerian licensed physicians independently rated responses using a 5-point Likert scale. Paired comparisons used Wilcoxon signed-rank tests. Results: Performance varied by domain. MamaBot-Llama significantly outperformed the base model across all criteria, with a 4.9% overall improvement (p < .001), including gains in clinical trustworthiness (+7%) and medical accuracy (+5%). Critical issues decreased by 50%, and clinicians preferred it in 78% of cases. In contrast, Vax-Llama showed a 5.2% overall decline (p < .001), with critical issues increasing by 192% and safety concerns by 400%. Conclusions: Domain-specific fine-tuning can improve healthcare LLM performance when based on high-quality, clinician-curated data, but may also degrade performance when dataset quality is inadequate. Rigorous domain-specific validation is essential before clinical deployment. Physician evaluators provided informed consent, and chatbot logs were anonymized. Keywords: Large language models; Fine-tuning; Maternal health; Vaccination; Healthcare AI; Low-resource settings; Nigeria; Model evaluation; LoRA; Medical accuracy

</details>


### [99] [Privacy Personalization Trade offs in LLMs: The Impact of Stylometric Signal Reduction on User-Specific Text Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22112)
*Muhammed Nazmul Arefin,Omar Jamal Hammad*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究在LLM个性化文本生成中，减少风格计量（stylometric）可识别信号对个性化效果的影响，揭示隐私与个性化之间的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在个性化文本生成中具有高风格保真度，但个人数据中嵌入的人口、文化、风格标记引发了风格计量重识别隐私担忧。需要探究消除风格信号是否损害个性化能力。

Method: 提出受控框架以分离LLM个性化中的风格计量信号。基于LaMP-7 Twitter基准，采样250名用户，对比两种设置：（1）基于原始用户档案的条件改写；（2）基于匿名化档案（中和人口标识、文化引用、个人细节、非正式语言线索）的条件改写。采用两个独立LLM评判员和补充的人类评估进行成对比较。

Result: 基于原始档案的输出与人类真实文本几乎不可区分，表明现代LLM能高保真地复现作者风格；而基于匿名档案的输出偏好率平均降至13.0%，语义上下文保持率仍高达94.8%。人类评估同样验证了该模式。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了明确的隐私-个性化权衡（privacy-personalization trade-off），强调需要开发在保留语义的同时抑制可识别风格信号的隐私感知个性化方法。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated the ability to generate user-specific text with high stylistic fidelity. However, the personal data that enables such personalization frequently embeds demographic, cultural, and stylistic markers that raises concerns about stylometric re- identification. This paper investigates whether reducing identifiable stylistic signals affects personalization in text generation by LLMs. We introduce a controlled framework to isolate stylometric signals in LLM personalization using the LaMP-7 Twitter benchmark. Experiments on 250 sampled users compare two settings: paraphrasing conditioned on the original profile and paraphrasing conditioned on an anonymized converted profile in which demographic identifiers, cultural references, personal details, and informal linguistic cues have been systematically neutralized. Outputs are assessed by two independent LLM judges and a complementary human evaluation. Our pairwise evaluation shows that outputs conditioned on original profiles are nearly indistinguishable from human-authored ground truth, indicating that modern LLMs can closely reproduce an author's writing style with sufficient fidelity. In contrast, preference for model outputs with anonymized profiles drops to 13.0% on average, while semantic context preservation remains high at 94.8%. A study with human evaluators confirms the same pattern. These findings reveal a clear privacy-personalization trade-off and highlight the need for privacy-aware personalization methods that retain meaning while suppressing identifying stylistic signals.

</details>


### [100] [Balancing Reasoning and Hardware Constraints in RAG Pipelines for Ukrainian Multi-Domain Document Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22124)
*Illya Havrylov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对UNLP 2026多领域文档理解共享任务，提出了一种资源高效的混合检索增强生成（RAG）管道，在严格的9小时Kaggle离线执行限制下处理乌克兰语多领域PDF文档。该系统在15支队伍中排名第10，私有分数为0.8095。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动机是在严格的硬件和时间约束下（9小时离线Kaggle执行环境、双NVIDIA T4 GPU），从包含法律、医疗和体育文档的多领域乌克兰语PDF语料库中提取精确答案、文档ID和页码。核心挑战是扫描文档的OCR处理因单线程执行消耗了5-7小时预算，严重限制了LLM推理时间。

Method: 方法采用三层架构：(1) 文档解析层使用pymupdf4llm提取文本，遇扫描件时调用Tesseract OCR；按250词固定窗口、50词重叠分块。(2) 混合检索层结合BM25稀疏检索和BGE-M3密集检索（各取Top-300），通过倒数秩融合（RRF, k=60）合并为Top-100，再经bge-reranker-v2-m3 Cross-Encoder重排序取Top-7。(3) 生成层使用llama.cpp部署4-bit量化（Q4_K_M）的LapaLLM-12B模型，利用其扩展的西里尔字母词汇表优化乌克兰语分词效率；采用ChatML格式的CoT提示，并将文档ID和页码的引文元数据从LLM生成中解耦，由Cross-Encoder排序结果确定性分配。

Result: 私有测试集得分为0.8095，公共测试集得分为0.7831，在15支参赛队中排名第10。消融实验显示：从MamayLM 7B迁移到LapaLLM 12B有显著提升；DeepSeek R1 Distill 14B因OCR瓶颈超时；自一致性采样（T=0.6, N=10）也超时失败。将上下文从Top-5扩展到Top-7稳步提升了检索质量。解耦元数据提取避免了LLM的"注意力偏移"问题。

Conclusion: 结论表明，在OCR严重消耗预算的极端时间约束下，结合双流混合检索器、词汇优化的量化模型（LapaLLM 12B）以及解耦的引文分配策略，是一种有效的工程解决方案。未来工作包括多线程OCR处理（可节省高达70%时间预算）、自定义MLIR编译器和零分配推理运行时（如Tenzo框架），以在边缘设备上实现低延迟低比特量化推理。

Abstract: This paper describes the system submitted to the UNLP 2026 Shared Task on Multi-Domain Document Understanding. The challenge required extracting precise answers, document IDs, and page numbers from a diverse corpus of Ukrainian PDF documents within a strict 9-hour offline Kaggle execution limit. During evaluation on the hidden private test set, optical character recognition (OCR) of scanned documents emerged as a severe bottleneck, consuming 5-7 hours of the total time budget due to sequential single-threaded execution. This overhead strictly limited the remaining time for Large Language Model (LLM) inference to approximately two hours for 500 questions. To guarantee pipeline completion without timeouts, we developed a resource-efficient Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline utilizing BM25, BGE-M3, and Cross-Encoder reranking. Rather than deploying parameter-heavy reasoning models (e.g., DeepSeek R1) which consistently timed out, we utilized a 4-bit quantized LapaLLM 12B model via this http URL on dual NVIDIA T4 GPUs. Prioritizing pipeline stability over multi-step reasoning, our system achieved a Private Score of 0.8095, placing 10th out of 15 active teams.

</details>


### [101] [Type-Driven Tokenization for Brahmic Scripts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22125)
*Sai Hemanth Kapila,Rakshika Bagavathy*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 标准子词分词器（如BPE/Unigram）在处理婆罗米文字（梵文字母系统）时会产生不符合正字法规则的token。本文从代数结构角度揭示了根本原因：英语正字法构成幺半群（任意两个有效token可自由拼接），而婆罗米正字法构成偏序半群（拼接可能因边界违反转换约束而失败）。作者在Agda中将此区分形式化，定义了有效token转换系统并推导出一个机器验证的fixToken函数，进而实现为SentencePiece补丁和Rust预分词器库。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的频率驱动子词分词器（BPE/Unigram）对书写系统一无所知，在婆罗米文字（天城文、泰卢固文、泰米尔文等）上产生大量畸形token（如将变音符号virama错误地放在token开头），导致LLM输出不可读。这一问题已被经验研究证实（Manodnya and Giri 2023显示印地语建模压缩比提升30%），但缺乏形式化解释和可证明正确的修复方案。

Method: 1）在Agda中以依赖类型定义两种代数结构：Orthography1（全幺半群，任意有效token可拼接）和Orthography2（偏序半群，拼接可能失败）；2）将婆罗米字符分为辅音、独立元音、依赖元音、元音后缀、virama五类，用类型化的转换关系_⊸_编码合法字符转换；3）将有效token定义为转换链ValidChain，并定义ValidBrahmicToken（必须以辅音或独立元音开头）；4）推导fixToken函数：单字符前瞻，若下一字符为依赖字符则将其吸收到当前token，否则停止；5）机器化证明三个性质：有效性保持、余项正确性（开头合法）、完全性（不丢字符）；6）将同样模式应用于越南语（基字符+变音符号+声调）作为第二实例；7）实际实现：SentencePiece训练时过滤依赖字符开头的候选token；Rust库将有效字形簇映射到PUA私有区码点强制不可分割。

Result: 1）在Telugu维基百科语料（75K文章，1210万token）上训练8000词表Unigram和BPE分词器；2）归一化句子长度（NSL）仅小幅上升：Unigram从0.65升至0.71，BPE从0.64升至0.72，均远低于GPT-4o基线1.0；3）困惑度（perplexity）几乎减半：Unigram从166降至85（降49%），BPE从159降至92（降42%）；4）形式化在Agda 2.9.0 + 标准库2.3下以--safe标志通过类型检查；5）消除了泰卢固文、泰米尔文、古吉拉特文、天城文中观察到的所有正字法错误。

Conclusion: 频率驱动分词器在婆罗米和阿拉伯文字语言上的系统性失败具有代数根源：这些正字法构成偏序半群而非半群，为半群设计的分词器必然违反前者的约束。Agda形式化提供了机器验证的正确性保证，并直接转化为可衡量的经验增益（以约10%的token数增加换取约50%的困惑度下降）。该代数模式适用于婆罗米、越南语及任何具有组合/依赖标记的文字系统，是首个关于正字法良构性的依赖类型形式化处理。

Abstract: Standard tokenizers used in large language models produce malformed text when applied to Brahmic scripts. They are a family of abugidas, writing systems whose consonants carry an inherent vowel that dependent marks can modify. They include Devanagari, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, and others. The underlying issue is that these tokenizers violate orthographic constraints that do not arise in alphabetic scripts like English. We observe that while English orthography forms a \emph{semigroup} (any two valid tokens can be freely concatenated), Brahmic orthography forms a \emph{partial semigroup}: not every concatenation yields a valid string. We formalise this distinction in Agda, model valid Brahmic tokens as chains in a transition system, and derive a provably correct \texttt{fixToken} function that extends any candidate token to respect orthographic boundaries. We then show how this formal derivation translates into a practical patch for SentencePiece as well as a standalone Rust-based pre-tokenizer library, eliminating the observed errors across Indic scripts.

</details>


### [102] [Beyond Accuracy and Surface Fluency: Risk-Sensitive Evaluation of LLMs for Legal Clause Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22127)
*Devansh Singh,Sundaraparipurnan Narayanan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种风险敏感的法律LLM评估框架，对四种轻量级模型(Claude Haiku 4.5、Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite、GPT-5.4 Nano、Qwen 3.5 Flash)在22类合同条款和34种法律失败模式上的表现进行了8,956次生成评估，发现尽管模型在语言流畅性方面表现出色，但在合规性、风险分配和法律可执行性方面仍存在显著缺陷，其中GPT-5.4 Nano表现最强，Gemini和Qwen在高风险输出中占比最高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统LLM评估方法（准确性、偏好打分）不适用于法律条款起草：条款可能语言流畅但仍存在重大法律缺陷（如遗漏关键例外条款、风险分配不可执行、适用错误司法管辖区）。作者认为法律AI评估应超越聚合准确性，转向条款特定、失败模式驱动和风险敏感的评估方式。

Method: 方法学采用八阶段实证基准测试流水线：(1) 文献综述；(2) 定义CLAUSE本体（六个维度：合规与司法管辖、法律能力与推理、准确性与可信度、上下文理解、结构化合同处理、伦理与问责）；(3) 定义LENS-CRAFT九维评分量表；(4) 选择22类条款；(5) 按B2B/B2C/B2G生成提示；(6) 运行四个模型；(7) 通过LLM议会（GPT-OSS-120B、Llama-3.3-70B、Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite）进行评分；(8) 对约10%输出进行人工审查。核心创新是引入**最大严重性原则(Max Severity Principle)**，即最终风险等级取所有维度严重性得分的最大值，而非平均，以防止关键法律缺陷被掩盖。

Result: 共评估8,956个条款输出（22条款×34失败模式×3交易场景）。主要发现：(1) GPT-5.4 Nano最强（Level 1占42.6%，Level 4-5占12.8%），Claude Haiku 4.5稳定但保守，Gemini流畅但风险最高（Level 4-5占27.9%），Qwen运营最不稳定。(2) B2C场景最困难（Level 4达27.2%），B2G最强（Level 1达31.9%）。(3) 失败模式集中在责任限制（过度排除）、赔偿（不对称分配）、知识产权（许可范围模糊）、服务中断（SLA弱）和司法管辖（跨境可执行性假设）。(4) 最薄弱维度为测试鲁棒性、合规性、风险分配和表达精确性。(5) 最大严重性原则消融实验验证了其必要性。

Conclusion: 轻量级LLM在合同条款语言风格生成方面表现优异，但在可执行性、完整性、合规性和风险分配方面持续存在缺陷。GPT-5.4 Nano虽表现最佳，但不应被视为AI辅助法律起草的绝对黄金标准。Level 3-5输出仍需人类法律专家审查。该评估框架可作为法律起草工作流中的可靠性层。论文提出了六个局限性（管辖范围广泛、监管分析通用、条款集聚焦AI/技术合同、模型为通用型、框架基于原则、LLM议会无法完全模拟真实法律审查），未来工作应开发特定行业和司法管辖的基准。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to draft contractual language, yet conventional accuracy or preference-based evaluations are poorly matched to legal drafting. A clause may be fluent and stylistically polished while still omitting an essential carve-out, allocating risk in an unenforceable way, assuming an inapplicable jurisdiction, or exposing a party to regulatory liability. This paper presents a empirical study design and framework for evaluating LLM-generated contract clauses. The study evaluates four models - Claude Haiku 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite, GPT 5.4 Nano, and Qwen 3.5 Flash, across 22 contract clause categories and 34 legally-motivated failure modes. We combine two evaluation frameworks: CLAUSE, which classifies prompts by legal function and failure target, and LENS-CRAFT, which scores outputs across nine legal-quality dimensions. Instead of averaging dimension scores, the study applies a Max Severity Principle so that a single legally decisive defect remains visible. The paper provides the evaluation protocol, taxonomy, analysis plan, and a results structure for reporting empirical findings. We argue that legal AI evaluation should move beyond aggregate accuracy toward clause-specific, failure-mode-driven, and risk-sensitive assessment.

</details>


### [103] [Observational Equivalence of LLM and Human Annotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22133)
*Kentaro Nakamura,Jing Ling Tan,George Yean*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过复制14篇政治科学同行评审研究中的文本分类任务，发现近期大语言模型（LLM）与专家编码员的一致性可媲美专家之间的一致性。这种"观察等价性"源于文本和编码规则本身的歧义，而非编码员的系统误差。研究提出应将文本标注的核心挑战从"选择人或机器编码员"转变为"开发最小化歧义的编码规则并处理剩余歧义"，并提出了基于LLM间分歧识别困难案例的方法以及面向下游推理的"歧义感知界"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本标注研究普遍将人类标注视为"金标准"，将LLM与人类标注的分歧视为模型错误。但这一范式存在根本问题：当文本或编码规则本身存在歧义时，专家之间也会产生分歧，LLM与人类的分歧可能反映的是共同的文本歧义而非模型缺陷。本文旨在系统检验LLM与人类标注的观察等价性，并探讨其对文本分析方法的启示。

Method: 研究者从14篇同行评审的政治科学论文中各抽取100个文本，由10个LLM（涵盖开源与闭源模型）、3位专家编码员和165名众包工人使用相同编码手册独立分类。实验设计包括：(1) 比较LLM-专家一致性与专家-专家一致性；(2) 通过"留一专家"分析检验分歧是否集中在同一文本上；(3) 通过澄清Schub(2022)的编码手册检验更清晰的规则是否能减少分歧；(4) 采用Gini不纯度和熵衡量跨模型分歧作为歧义的代理变量；(5) 开发基于设计调整的"歧义感知界"用于下游推理。

Result: 核心结果包括：(1) 除较早较弱的Mistral-7B外，近期LLM与专家的一致率（简单任务0.89-0.91，困难任务0.69-0.76）与专家间一致率（简单0.89，困难0.67）相当；(2) LLM-专家分歧集中在专家之间也产生分歧的同一文本上（简单任务一致文本上LLM-专家一致率约0.91 vs 歧义文本上0.67）；(3) 跨LLM的Gini不纯度在专家分歧文本上显著更高（简单任务从0.067升至0.238）；(4) 澄清编码手册后，专家一致率从0.64升至0.82，多数LLM也获得提升；(5) 众包工人虽表现出相同的歧义相关模式，但与专家一致率（0.65）显著低于LLM（0.74）；(6) 在Arias(2022)气候安全化案例中，歧义感知界比朴素LLM回归和DSL方法更宽，表明部分结论依赖未解决的边界案例判断。

Conclusion: 本文得出三点核心结论：第一，LLM与人类标注在质量上具有观察等价性，单独基于标注质量选择人类编码缺乏经验依据；第二，标注分歧主要源于文本和编码规则的系统性歧义，应通过代码簿开发来最小化歧义而非依赖统计校正；第三，对于剩余歧义，研究者应放弃"每篇文本都有唯一真实标签"的假设，转而使用基于LLM间分歧的"歧义感知界"进行诚实的下游推理，代码簿设计和歧义测量应优先于事后误差校正方法。

Abstract: In this paper, we show that LLM and human coding are observationally equivalent in terms of annotation quality: recent LLMs agree with expert coders at rates comparable to those observed among experts themselves. We demonstrate this through replications of text-classification tasks from 14 peer-reviewed political science studies, in which ten LLMs, three human experts, and 165 crowdsourced workers independently classify the same texts using identical codebooks. We find that this equivalence is driven by ambiguity in the texts and coding rules. When LLMs disagree with experts, experts are also more likely to disagree with one another, and clarifying coding rules reduces disagreement among both experts and sufficiently capable LLMs. Thus, there is little empirical basis for preferring human coding on the basis of annotation quality alone, while LLMs offer substantial advantages in speed and cost. We therefore argue that the central challenge of text annotation is no longer choosing between human and machine coders, but developing coding rules that minimize ambiguity and accounting for the ambiguity that remains. To this end, we propose using disagreement across LLMs to identify difficult cases and refine codebooks, and we develop ambiguity-aware bounds for downstream inference when a unique annotation cannot be defined for every text.

</details>


### [104] [Read-Best Is Not Steer-Best: A Probing--Steering Layer Dissociation in Omni-Modal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22135)
*Yibo Wang,Jisheng Dang,Bimei Wang,Yitao Wu,Wencan Zhang,Hong Peng,Jizhao Liu,Bin Hu,Qi Tian,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文首次在全模态大语言模型（Omni-LLM）中系统检验了"线性探针读取最佳层即激活引导最佳层"的隐含假设，揭示了"探针-引导层解离"现象：在三种独立架构（Qwen2.5-Omni-7B、Phi-4-Multimodal、MiniCPM-o-4.5）上，探针最佳层散布于网络几乎全深度（归一化深度0.29–1.00），而引导最佳层稳定落在归一化深度[0.48, 0.74]的中后段窄带中。在Qwen上探针最佳层单层引导效果与随机方向无异（Δ≈+0.02），而中后段多层引导效果约为其26倍（Δ=+0.55）。Logit-lens分析表明前向过程呈现"因果把手→探针饱和→词表提交"的三阶段排序，并由此提出两因素模型H_thresh解释引导有效性源自表征可读性与下游可塑性的乘积。同时还刻画了由效价-唤醒度组织、以"joy"为跨模型锚点的跨模态情感子空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表征工程（Representation Engineering）与激活引导（Activation Steering）的实践中普遍假设"概念可被线性探针最强读取的层，也最适合注入该方向以实现因果干预"，并据此选取注入层。该假设很少被显式检验。若该假设错误，大量既有工作可能正在因果近乎无效的层上注入，从而严重低估此类方法的真实可控性。

Method: 选取三种独立设计的全模态LLM（Qwen2.5-Omni-7B、Phi-4-Multimodal-Instruct、MiniCPM-o-4.5），以情感为受控载体。构建三模态样本集M3（5情感×3模态×25样本），在每一层提取隐藏态进行：(1) 线性探针——白化后训练情感探针，5折交叉验证测量层间可读性及跨模态迁移精度；(2) 方向提取——在每层独立计算情感-中性对比均值差并正交化去除前两个主成分（raw_cmd_pc_orth_k2）；(3) 多层归一化注入——按层间归一化范数在L10/14/18/22等多层注入；(4) 评估——使用VAD-BERT外部评估器计算Δ_target，并配对同幅度随机方向控制、监控OOD率；用GPT-5.5作为独立法官验证；用logit lens追踪目标情感词元进入top-50的层；提出两因素模型H_thresh(L)∝max(0, probe(L)−θ)×max(0, Lmax−L−τ)；并在WikiText困惑度与GSM8K上验证流畅性与推理能力未被损害。

Result: （1）在Qwen2.5-Omni-7B上，文本迁移探针最佳层为L27，但该层单层引导Δ_joy≈+0.02（95% CI含0，与随机方向不可区分），而中后段多层（L10/14/18/22）注入产生Δ_joy=+0.55（CI [+0.39,+0.69]），约26倍差距；（2）三架构层间峰值距离分别为7、10、9层，均超过预设≥5层阈值；探针最佳层归一化深度1.00/0.81/0.29，引导最佳层稳定在0.74/0.48/0.54；（3）Logit-lens排序：引导峰L19→探针饱和L20→词表提交L23；（4）H_thresh在Qwen上精确预测L20，在Phi-4上误差1层，在MiniCPM上失败（误差9层），提示存在架构相关的"可行动带"下界；（5）三模态条件下joy均显著正向（Δ=+0.33至+0.67，OOD=0），Phi-4上joy可复现（Δ=+0.42），MiniCPM为空；（6）joy是唯一在Qwen与Phi-4上均通过方向专一性阈值（>0.15）的情感；（7）joy引导下WikiText PPL仅由5.62升至8.39，GSM8K准确率不变；（8）情感几何由效价-唤醒度组织，正交化后5类迁移精度跌至0.176（近随机）。

Conclusion: 读取与干预是残差流上的不同操作：探针最佳层仅反映表征饱和，而激活引导真正起作用的层位于稳定的、未提交至词元的中间窗口，即跨架构稳定的"中后段"（归一化深度约0.5–0.75）。以探针精度作为注入层选取依据是一种错误启发式，应代之以跨架构的中后段选取准则，并配合该区域内的多层归一化注入。该解离在三种独立架构上得到验证，与随机方向控制、logit-lens阶段排序、H_thresh模型共同构成系统性证据。同时，全模态LLM内部存在由效价-唤醒度组织、以joy为跨模型锚点的共享情感子空间，为未来跨架构因果干预理论及安全等其它干预任务的层选取提供了基础。

Abstract: Omni-modal large language models integrate text, audio, and image signals into a shared residual stream, where concepts such as emotion can be linearly decoded and causally modified by activation steering. A common but rarely tested assumption is that the layer with the highest probing accuracy is also the best layer for steering, so injection layers are often selected by probe performance. We provide the first causal test of this assumption across three independently developed omni-modal models and find that it fails. Reading and intervention rely on different layers, a phenomenon we call the probing-steering layer dissociation. Using emotion as a controlled testbed, we measure layer-wise readability and steerability across text, audio, and image inputs. Probe-best layers vary widely across architectures, while steering-effective layers consistently fall within a narrow mid-to-late range of normalized depth. Paired random-direction controls show an approximately 26-fold causal gap, ruling out random perturbation and direction quality as explanations. Logit-lens analysis reveals a staged forward process: causal handle, probing saturation, and vocabulary commitment, and motivates a two-factor account in which steering effectiveness depends on both representational readability and downstream plasticity. These results show that probing accuracy is a poor heuristic for selecting intervention layers and suggest a cross-architecture mid-to-late selection criterion. We also identify a cross-modal emotion subspace organized by valence and arousal, with joy acting as a stable anchor across models. Code and data: this https URL .

</details>


### [105] [Is Imagination Derived from Hallucination? A Cross-Taxonomy Evaluation of Imagination and Hallucination in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22152)
*Zixuan Tang,Hongzong Li,Shuxin Zhuang,Dapeng Wu,Zi Liang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了 Whiteboard，这是首个同时评估大型语言模型（LLM）想象力和幻觉的基准测试。它通过共享锚定提示集，在同一生成内容上对七种想象力子类型和十种幻觉子类型进行联合评分，使用确定性原子矩阵（无 LLM 评判器）进行评分。基于 79 个 LLM 和 6,229 个交叉生成结果，研究发现两者之间存在反直觉的负相关——想象力并非源自幻觉，而是其解药。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有创造力基准只衡量输出偏离常见答案的程度，从不检查偏离是否由提示所许可；幻觉评估则在独立流程中针对不同生成进行。因此"想象力与幻觉源自同一生成机制"这一影响深远的说法从未被直接验证过。此外，传统面板基准中每个模型回答不同的题目子集，导致模型质量与题目难度混淆。

Method: 设计灵感源自认知科学中人类想象力的经典评估工具。七种基于机制的想象力子类型与十种支持边界幻觉子类型交叉组合。每道题都先进行支持检查（support check），再通过签名的原子审计矩阵（103 个原子条目）进行确定性评分，主路径不调用 LLM 评判器。所有 79 个模型回答相同的 80 道锚定题（构成配对检验），并提出三个评分视图（原始/门控/残差）和三重 FDR 控制（含共享原子偏控制与能力偏控制）。最终与 13,280 条人类盲评判断进行效度验证。

Result: 189 个候选相关格中仅 23 个通过三重 FDR 控制，其中 22 个为负相关。所有 55 个有效题目均复现负相关（54 个达到 p<0.05，中位数 ρ=-0.63）。最强耦合包括：类比映射对错误迁移（残差视图 ρ=-0.81）、假设生成对引文失配（ρ=-0.69）、接地叙事对无支持细节（ρ=-0.66）。模型与人类评分在两个轴上相关性分别为 ρ=0.72 和 0.69。控制输出长度和发布日期后，关联仍稳定。前沿层与对比层在两轴上均无分化。所有净化系数 π_a 等于 1，表明没有想象力子类型借用幻觉信用。人类标注者以 18.7%-22.8% 的近均匀比率接受无支持内容（Fisher p=0.22），不支持任何"生产性幻觉"假设。

Conclusion: 在亚型分辨率下，想象力并非源自幻觉，而是对抗幻觉的力量。亚型映射显示单边的负相关；每个有效锚定题均独立复现了该耦合；人类标注者并未对任何幻觉亚型给予独特许可；该工具在 ρ=0.72 和 0.69 水平上跟踪人类判断。研究为亚型级耦合提供了可证伪、可审计的检测手段，并预注册了净化总分和公共审计矩阵作为长期检验工具，准备在未来任何模型通过虚构抬高创造力时予以降级。

Abstract: Imagination performs as a high-level function of large language models (LLMs) which determines the potential of how an LLM creates unseen or creative content. While existing works have built a rich family of creativity benchmarks for this ability, they only measure how far an output departs from common answers and never check whether the departure is licensed by the prompt. Moreover, hallucination, the closest neighbor of imagination, is always measured in a separate pipeline on different generations, so the influential claim that imagination and hallucination stem from the same generative mechanism has never been directly testable. In this paper, we propose Whiteboard, the first LLM imagination evaluation benchmark. Its design follows the authoritative cognitive instruments developed to measure human imagination: seven mechanism-grounded imagination subtypes are adapted from classic paradigms, then crossed with ten support-boundary hallucination subtypes and scored jointly on the same generation. Different from previous creativity or hallucination benchmarks, Whiteboard gates every imagination score with an explicit support check and computes both axes deterministically through an auditable atom matrix, with no LLM judge on the primary path. The full Whiteboard item bank contains 1,660 prompts; on its shared 80-item anchor set, we evaluate 79 state-of-the-art LLMs and validate the instrument against 13,280 human judgments. Additionally, we further explore whether imagination derives from the same generative tendency as hallucination and what key factors shape it. Our analysis indicates a counterintuitive correlation between hallucination and imagination: Most of the subtype couplings are negative, every one of the anchor items reproduces the negative coupling on its own.

</details>


### [106] [MechaTerp-TRACE: A Novel Approach for Component Ablation Analysis in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22163)
*Brandon Colelough,Davis Bartels,Madeline Bittner,Dina Demner-Fushman*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 MechaTerp-TRACE，一个统一的组件消融分析框架，通过逐个消融语言模型中的各架构组件并测量在固定答案 token 处的输出分布变化，以统一尺度比较从整个 transformer 块到单个神经元再到输出 logits 等不同类型组件对命名实体生成的因果贡献。在 13 个指令微调的密集解码器模型（共消融 49,656 个组件，48 条医学和 42 条通识提示）上的实验表明，承担最大效应的总是同一组位置固定的组件（生成基底），移除这些组件后，剩余支持在大多数模型中近乎均匀分布，说明此前观察到的实体知识定位现象主要归因于通用生成机制而非实体特异性处理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的机制可解释性方法（如激活补丁、稀疏自编码器、电路发现等）各有局限：只能在特定组件上操作、无法跨组件类型比较贡献、依赖训练额外模型或仅限于形式化定义的任务。研究者需要一种可扩展的统一方法，在同一尺度上比较不同粒度的架构组件对实体知识生成的因果贡献，以检验"实体知识是否可定位"这一基本问题。

Method: 方法包括：(1) 行为设计——构建包含 8 种药物×6 类线索共 48 条医学提示和 42 条 TREC-8 通识提示的数据集，采用续写式提示策略（将提示置于模型助手轮内部），通过教师强制将答案位置固定在已知索引处；(2) 机制设计——将模型组件分为粗结构站点（块、注意力/MLP 分支、残差流、注意力头）、扩展站点（Q/K/V/O 投影、MLP 门控/上/下投影、归一化参数、偏置、位置编码、输出头行/通道/logits）和架构特定站点；(3) 消融效应度量——以答案锚点处完整 logits 向量与消融后向量的余弦距离 Δ 作为主指标；(4) 局部化度量——采用修正的 Herfindahl-Hirschman 指数（HHI）计算局部化指数 LLI 和有效组件数 N_eff；(5) 跨提示重叠——用加权 Jaccard 系数衡量提示间组件重要性分布的相似性；(6) 生成基底检测——通过发生频率、平均占比和四分位变异系数（稳定性）识别位置固定的通用生成组件；(7) 领域公共组件——用调和平均联合医学与通识两域的平均占比进行检测。

Result: 在 13 个模型上的主要结果：(1) 消融前，最高 LLI 普遍集中于前两块和后两块 transformer 块，且该模式与所问实体无关（68–100% 的提示中相同组件占据主导），11 个模型将最大效应放在第一块，2 个 Phi 模型放在最后一块；(2) 生成基底移除后，11 个模型的块级 LLI 中位数降至 0.017–0.035，N_eff/B′ 介于 0.46–0.82，支持近乎均匀分布；(3) 两个例外：MediPhi-Clinical（临床微调导致 LLI=0.354，N_eff=2.7）和 Qwen3-1.7B（LLI=0.170，跨实体 Jaccard 差仅 −0.007，p=0.983）；(4) 跨提示权重 Jaccard 重叠高（域内 0.512–0.906，跨域 0.385–0.875），且几乎不随实体变化，12/13 模型 p<.001 但效应量小；(5) 每模型有 1–7 个生成基底候选组件和 3–15 个领域公共组件，移除基底使 11 个模型 LLI 下降 0.009–0.071。Gemma-3 系列因不遵循短答案指令而未纳入结果。结论：观察到的表观定位现象主要源于通用生成机制而非实体特异性定位，这对假设实体知识"存在于可定位位置"的方法（包括定向知识编辑）提出了挑战。

Conclusion: 在所有受测的指令微调密集解码器模型中，未观察到实体特异性定位。消融前可见的效应集中来自一组位置固定的通用生成组件（生成基底），而非实体知识的存储位置；移除这些组件后，剩余支持近乎均匀分布，且组件使用模式几乎不随命名实体变化。研究者据此指出，任何定位实体知识的方法（包括有针对性的知识编辑）都应首先确认其观察到的集中现象是否实为生成基底效应，而非将其误判为实体知识存储位置。研究的局限性在于：仅衡量单一教师强制位置下单组件消融的必要性，且通识语料基于模型正确性筛选保留。

Abstract: Interpretability research on large language models has produced accounts of factual recall in feed-forward layers and of token relationships in self-attention, but little work offers a unified way to compare the causal contribution of different architecture components to a model's output. We introduce MechaTerp (the Mechanistic Interpretability suite) -TRACE (subset for Teacher-forced Registry of Ablated Component Effects), an architecture and study that measures how much each registered component of a language model supports the production of a named entity. TRACE ablates one component at a time and measures the resulting change in the output distribution at a fixed answer token, so component types from whole transformer blocks down to individual neurons and output logits can be compared on a common scale. We apply it to thirteen instruction-tuned dense decoder models spanning five families and one to thirty billion parameters, ablating 49,656 components across 48 medical and 42 general-knowledge prompts. We find that the components carrying the most effect are the same few, positionally fixed components in every model, regardless of which entity a prompt asks about, and that once these are removed, the remaining support is close to evenly spread in eleven of the thirteen models. Apparent localisation of entity knowledge is therefore largely attributable to generic generation machinery, which has direct consequences for methods that assume entity knowledge sits in a findable place, including targeted knowledge editing.

</details>


### [107] [Monocultural Biases: Correlated biases in large language models lead to unequal systemic exclusion rates in hiring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22169)
*Matthew Bone,Fabian Stephany,Maria del Rio-Chanona*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）在招聘场景中产生的"单一文化偏见"风险，指出由于多个LLM共享训练数据和后训练方法，可能导致劳动力市场中出现跨企业的高度同质化偏见，从而对特定人口群体造成系统性排斥。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM被广泛用于招聘自动化，企业间的担忧扩散模式可能从异质性转向同质化，导致新的系统性排斥风险。已有研究多关注单一模型的偏见，缺乏对模型间决策相关性和系统层面危害的分析。

Method: 基于Burning Glass Institute的劳动力市场数据，构建大规模多选题提示评估套件。每个提示包含一个职位空缺和两个候选人档案，其中一个被扰动以注入种族、性别、年龄信号。对来自10个供应商的20个模型（10个基础版+10个后训练版）进行评估，每个模型执行121,600次调用。使用OLS回归测量偏见，分析偏见变化、模型间相关性（偏差相关性与残差相关性）以及系统性排斥率。

Result: 后训练使模型回调40岁以上申请人的概率降低3.6%（10个模型中8个呈现负面偏移）；后训练模型决策相关性大幅增加，残差相关性平均提升0.377，偏差相关性提升0.092；全球系统性排斥率从5.6%升至17.3%，交叉性排斥率从2.9%-8.3%扩大至12.2%-21.7%；年龄歧视是主要驱动因素，后排斥率（20.1%）显著高于低龄组（14.5%）；基于OLMo检查点的研究显示，监督微调（SFT）是引入年龄偏见并提升人力资本评估能力的主要阶段。

Conclusion: 后训练在提升模型基于人力资本选择最佳申请人的能力时，也引入了系统性层面的新危害，特别是对老年申请人的统一偏见。这揭示了LLM开发中的核心权衡：改善个体决策质量的方法可能将模型层面的扭曲转化为系统层面的危害。对单一模型进行审计不足以理解LLM广泛部署的风险，需要中央监管机构进行标准化审计，企业应通过多样化后训练数据和方法来降低相关决策风险。

Abstract: Employers are increasingly using large language models (LLMs) to automate their hiring process. This paper investigates the risk of monocultural biases, in which the widespread deployment of large language models homogenizes biases across the labor market, leading to greater systemic exclusion for certain demographic groups. For ten LLMs, we measure hiring biases across their base and post-trained versions to identify which stage, pre-training or post-training, lead to monocultural biases. We find that, compared to their base models, post-trained models are 3.6% less likely to callback older applicants. This negative shift occurs in eight of the ten models that we evaluate. Post-trained models have much more correlated decisions than base models which is likely driven by human capital traits like skills or college major. However, greater consensus among models increases global systemic exclusion rates from 5.6% to 17.3% and exacerbates demographic inequalities, with intersectional systemic exclusion rates ranging from 12.2% to 21.7% for post-trained models. We find that this inequality is primarily driven by age-based discrimination that is exacerbated in post-training. These results indicate that while post-training techniques may improve models' abilities to select the best applicants, they may raise systemic inequality risks for those at the margin by uniformly introducing new biases.

</details>


### [108] [SALSA: Semi-Autonomous Literature Summarization Assistant](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22210)
*William Schertzer,Sonakshi Gupta,Rampi Ramprasad*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SALSA是一个开源的、基于人机协同（human-in-the-loop）的软件平台，用于从多模态科学文献中提取结构化数据集。它集成了文档解析、大语言模型、OCR、计算机视觉、图表数字化和用户修正工具，支持从文本、表格、图表和说明文字中恢复结构化信息，主要面向材料科学研究，但也适用于其他学科。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着数字化数据量的爆炸式增长和数据驱动科学发现的需求增加，将人类可读的文献信息转换为机器可用的结构化记录成为瓶颈。现有工具通常仅针对单一数据模态或狭窄应用，缺乏灵活性和可配置性，且缺少图形界面供领域专家进行干预和验证。SALSA旨在通过集成化的人机协同工作流，将专家从重复性劳动中解放出来，同时保留专家判断和数据溯源能力。

Method: SALSA采用模块化架构，包含：基于浏览器的工作流管理界面；支持DOI检索或PDF/图片上传的文档解析模块；基于用户指令的表格/图表相关性过滤；集成ChartDete和LineFormer的图表数字化OCR流程及视觉语言模型备选路线；两阶段的化学组成与样本上下文提取；以及由用户自定义schema驱动的数据集生成。支持OpenAI和本地Ollama模型后端，完整保留配置、中间输出和用户修正以实现可审计性。

Result: 论文展示了两个示例：通用科学文档处理（处理10篇高引Nature文章）和阴离子交换膜降解数据提取（构建包含材料组成、老化时间、电导率、测试条件等字段的ML数据集），验证了平台在不同出版商、布局和领域特定场景下的适用性。

Conclusion: SALSA提供了一套灵活、可审计的数据提取框架，通过自动化重复性任务同时保留专家监督和证据溯源能力，适用于科学机器学习中需要高质量、可追溯数据集的场景。其架构不限于材料科学，可推广至处理多模态异构文档的其他学科领域。作者强调用户需自行确保所有操作符合出版商协议、版权及数据使用政策。

Abstract: SALSA (Semi-Autonomous Literature Summarization Assistant) is an open- source, human-in-the-loop platform for extracting structured scientific datasets from multimodal literature sources. The software combines document parsing, large language models, optical character recognition, computer vision, figure digitization, and user-guided correction tools to recover structured information from text, tables, figures, and captions. Users can configure extraction stages, define dataset schemas, perform interventions on digitized figures, and export verified data for downstream analysis and machine learning. SALSA is designed to automate repetitive literature curation tasks while preserving oversight where expert judgment is required. By supporting customizable extraction workflows across diverse input types, the software provides a flexible framework for scalable, reliable data curation for materials research, and potentially across several disciplines. Users are responsible for ensuring that all inputs, extraction workflows, and downstream uses comply with applicable publisher agreements, copyright and licensing terms, institutional policies, and data-use requirements.

</details>


### [109] [SCoP: Structured Constraint Parsing for Evidence-Space Control in Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22213)
*Xiaokun Guo,Zhen Xu,Dongdong Huo,Yanqiu Zhang,Dongjin Yu,Yu Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SCoP是一个面向时序知识图谱问答(TKGQA)的约束驱动框架，通过在答案推理前外部化结构与时间可接受性条件，将复杂时序问答重构为证据空间控制问题。框架包含事件三元组识别、保守图对齐、可执行时序约束解析与排序四个核心阶段，在MultiTQ和TimelineCronQ-R上均取得最优效果，尤其在约束密集型问题上优势显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TKGQA方法将锚定事件绑定、时序可接受性、序数选择等关键决策隐式地留给模型推理、任务特定训练或相似度驱动检索，导致局部相关但整体无效的事实进入答案上下文。需要将时序决策显式化、确定化，在答案推理前构建紧凑的、可验证的证据空间。

Method: SCoP框架包含五个阶段：(1)离线构建时序图与FAISS检索存储；(2)事件三元组识别，将问题分解为完整锚定三元组集合和至多一个含未知槽的搜索三元组，时序表达式被排除在槽位外；(3)保守图对齐，使用BGE-M3嵌入将提取的三元组通过槽级相似度匹配到规范化TKG实体与关系，避免虚构事实；(4)约束引导证据构建，将时序意图解析为五元组(参考类型、操作符、参考内容、粒度、偏移量)的可执行约束列表κ_i和可选序数排序ρ(q)，在规范化点/区间范围上做确定性过滤；(5)在受控证据上下文上调用LLM生成最终答案。无需任务特定参数更新。

Result: 在MultiTQ上以Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct为骨干取得0.825 Hits@1，超越最强微调基线Temp-R1(+5.8%)和最强策略基线RTQA(+7.8%)；Multiple题型上达到0.653，超Temp-R1(+18.7%)。在TimelineCronQ-R上取得0.761 Hits@1，超最强动态检索基线ReAct(+20.6%)；Medium与Complex题型增益显著(+36.1%和+34.6%)。证据压缩率(ECR)在MultiTQ达98.89%，TimelineCronQ-R达86.54%，且金标准事件/答案保留率均超81%。消融实验显示三组件缺一不可，约束执行与图对齐在MultiTQ上贡献最大(-45.6%和-43.9%)，事件三元组识别在TimelineCronQ-R上贡献最大(-44.8%)。

Conclusion: SCoP验证了显式证据空间控制相对于无约束检索与隐式时序推理的有效性，尤其在约束密集型场景下优势显著。局限性在于依赖现成语言模型进行事件识别、约束解析与图对齐，错误会向下游传播；约束模式尚未覆盖所有歧义或组合性时序现象；多证据联合保留仍是难题。未来工作将扩展约束模式、提升多证据保留能力，并在更广泛时序知识图谱上评估。

Abstract: Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering (TKGQA) requires answer inference from evidence that is both structurally valid and temporally admissible. Existing methods often leave anchor-event binding, temporal admissibility, and ordinal selection implicit in model reasoning, task-specific training, or similarity-driven retrieval, allowing locally relevant but invalid facts to enter the answer context. We formulate complex TKGQA as evidence-space control and propose SCoP (Structured Constraint Parsing), a constraint-centric framework that externalizes temporal decisions before answer inference. Instead of treating retrieved facts as admissible evidence by default, SCoP separates answer-seeking event patterns from temporal anchor events, conservatively grounds them to canonical TKG entities and relations, and translates temporal intent into executable constraints with optional ranking requirements. These constraints operate over normalized point and interval ranges, enabling deterministic filtering of structurally compatible candidates and producing a compact evidence space for generation. Experiments on MultiTQ and TimelineCronQ-R assess SCoP across timestamped point-fact and interval-oriented settings with richer temporal relations and ordering dependencies. Without task-specific parameter updates, SCoP achieves 0.825 Hits@1 on MultiTQ and 0.761 Hits@1 on TimelineCronQ-R, with gains on constraint-intensive question types. These results support explicit evidence-space control over unconstrained retrieval or implicit temporal reasoning.

</details>


### [110] [The Bairong System for MLC-SLM 2026: Dynamic Question-Aware Evidence Routing for Multilingual Conversational Speech Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22214)
*Shangkun Huang,Junchao Hu,Huan Shen,Guoji Wang,Yingao Wang,Shaosai Li,Wei Zou,Yunzhang Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了Bairong系统用于MLC-SLM 2026挑战赛，核心创新是一种动态问题感知证据路由框架（Dynamic Question-Aware Evidence Routing）。该系统针对多语言双人对话口语问答任务，将转写文本作为主干，根据问题类型动态选择四种证据：完整转写上下文、局部音文融合、说话人关联证据和紧凑全局声学采样。Task 1取得tcpMER 25.70%/18.44%，Task 2取得94.84%开发集准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长篇多语言对话口语问答中，不同问题依赖不同形式的证据：有些需要长距离语篇语义，有些需要说话人归属，有些需要韵律/笑声/语速等声学线索。现有的端到端语音大模型和级联系统虽然强大，但固定的"纯文本"或"纯音频"输入策略无法同时兼顾全局语篇上下文和稀疏声学线索，导致了问题条件化证据选择的研究空白。

Method: 系统采用两阶段设计：(1) 说话人归属转写前端——使用FSMN VAD + RedimNet2 + 谱聚类进行VAD和说话人日志化，再使用基于LoRA微调的Qwen3-ASR 1.7B进行转写；(2) 动态证据路由模块——通过Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Captioner分类器对证据类型(e)和上下文范围(s)进行粗粒度估计，再结合确定性的时间戳和说话人线索解析，联合映射为可执行的路由标签。证据类型包括转写语义型、语义-声学型、说话人敏感型和全局声学型四种。上下文范围包括局部窗口、多窗口、说话人链接和全局紧凑四种。

Result: Task 1: tcpMER在开发集25.70%，评估集18.44%（官方基线79.15%）。Task 2: 最终M6系统开发集准确率94.84%，比完整转写基线（M1, 93.16%）高1.68分，比最佳音频中心诊断系统（B2, 92.07%）高2.77分。消融实验表明：局部音文融合带来最大单步增益（+1.53），添加全局音频再加+0.18，混合路由器再加+0.44。纯音频系统即使增加采样预算也低于转写主干系统。

Conclusion: 动态问题感知证据路由是多语言对话口语QA的有效证据分配策略。转写文本应作为主干保留语篇上下文，音频仅在提供补充证据时被激活。混合路由器结合LLM粗粒度估计和确定性线索解析，比静态路由、纯转写和纯音频策略均更优。问题条件化的证据分配比单纯增加音频覆盖更重要。

Abstract: Long multilingual conversational spoken question answering requires systems to balance long-range transcript semantics with sparse acoustic and speaker-sensitive cues. We present the Bairong system for the MLC-SLM 2026 Challenge, where a diarization-ASR front-end produces speaker-attributed transcripts and a dynamic evidence router constructs question-specific inputs for answer prediction. Instead of applying a fixed transcript-only or audio-only policy, the router infers the required evidence type and context scope from the question and answer options, and selects among full transcript context, local audio-text fusion, speaker-linked evidence, and compact global acoustic samples. This transcript-backbone design keeps discourse context available while activating audio only when it provides complementary evidence. Our Task 1 system achieves 25.70% and 18.44% tcpMER on the development and evaluation sets. For Task 2, the final system obtains 94.84% devel?opment accuracy, outperforming the full-transcript baseline by 1.68 points and the best audio-centric diagnostic system by 2.77 points. These results support dynamic question-aware routing as an effective evidence allocation strategy for conversational spoken QA.

</details>


### [111] [EvalMem: An Operation-Level Diagnostic Framework for Long-Term Memory Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22231)
*Zeyu Liu,Jian Zhong,Rongduo Han,Ziyang Wu,Shunye Tang,Chenghao He,Yaxuan Yang,Yihang Qiu,Ailing Wang,Xiao Liang,Guohuan Xie,Xiaokang Xue,Gongchen Li,Haining Zhang,Wei Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: EvalMem提出一种面向长期记忆系统的操作级诊断框架，通过三个并行Examiner（编码、检索、生成）将端到端错误归因到具体操作层，并引入DynaMem-Bench动态评估基准和MemWiki辅助检索结构，证明检索是当前记忆系统的主要故障瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长期记忆系统评估仅报告端到端QA准确率，无法区分错误来源于记忆编码、检索还是生成阶段，限制了诊断和改进能力。同时静态历史回放评估难以反映助手自身对话策略对记忆写入轨迹的影响。

Method: 设计三并行Examiner框架：Encoding Examiner检查目标事实是否存储于记忆库（采用recall-first agentic RAG诊断探针，将LoCoMo上存储观察MISS率从29.8%降至4.4%）；Retrieval Examiner评估原生检索器是否返回可用证据；Generation Examiner在oracle证据下测试模型能否正确作答。Attribution Agent将三者输出融合为11码多标签缺陷集合。构建DynaMem-Bench动态基准（962题、10 persona、固定must-expose调度+策略内交互）以及MemWiki辅助检索结构（基于系统自身记忆导出构建wiki式索引，含factual/tag/query/summary四类辅助记录，30%配额上限）。评估7个记忆系统（TiMem、O-Mem、EverMemOS、MemOS、MemBox、MemoryOS、GAM）在LoCoMo、LongMemEval-S和DynaMem-Bench上的表现，使用gpt-4o-mini、gpt-4.1、Qwen3-30B三种骨干。

Result: 检索是最常被归因的故障层：LoCoMo上检索缺陷22.1% vs 编码7.7%/生成6.5%；LongMemEval-S上18.3% vs 8.5%/5.4%；DynaMem-Bench上25.9% vs 9.7%/5.0%。动态基准相比LoCoMo平均准确率下降7.3pp，回滚子集仅47.3%准确率。MemWiki干预在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上分别提升平均准确率+2.5pp和+2.3pp，检索缺陷率降低3.2pp；6/7系统McNemar检验显著（p<0.05），TiMem因原生L5层级冗余不显著。Top-K敏感分析显示K∈{8,10}为最优点（Hit@K饱和且噪声NOI未急剧上升）。框架具有高诊断稳定性（层标准差≤0.25pp，Fleiss' κ≥0.89）。

Conclusion: EvalMem将端到端评分转化为操作级归因，使长期记忆系统评估从粗粒度走向细粒度。检索是当前长期记忆系统的主要瓶颈，动态状态演化暴露静态回放无法发现的陈旧证据失效问题。MemWiki作为诊断驱动的检索端干预，验证了归因结果的可操作性。该框架支持更严谨的进展衡量，避免基于不透明端到端指标的过度宣称。

Abstract: Long-horizon interactions with LLM-based assistants require memory systems that preserve and update user states, preferences, and interaction histories. Existing evaluations report end-to-end QA accuracy and cannot determine whether errors arise from encoding, retrieval, or generation. We introduce EvalMem, an operation-level diagnostic framework with three parallel Examiners. For each query, the Encoding Examiner checks whether the target fact is stored, the Retrieval Examiner assesses whether the native retriever returns usable evidence, and the Generation Examiner tests whether the model can answer from oracle evidence. Their outputs form fine-grained multi-label defect codes. To improve store-level diagnosis, we adapt agentic RAG with a recall-first strategy that searches using both the query and source evidence, increasing recall of present evidence on LoCoMo from 70.2% to 95.6%. Evaluations of seven memory systems on LoCoMo, LongMemEval-S, and dynamic DynaMem-Bench identify retrieval as the most frequently attributed failure layer; in default LoCoMo, retrieval defects reach 22.1%, compared with 7.7% for encoding and 6.5% for generation. Guided by this diagnosis, MemWiki, a search-friendly auxiliary structure built from each system's memory export, improves mean accuracy by 2.5 and 2.3 percentage points on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S, respectively.

</details>


### [112] [Functional Emotion Without Character: Large Language Models, Aristotelian Disposition, and the Limits of Behavioral Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22362)
*Marzieh Zare*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种介于"行为等价即可"与"必须具有现象意识"之间的结构性进路，将情绪建模为高维表征状态空间中的上下文敏感区域、轨迹与吸引子动力学。论文基于近期机制可解释性证据论证大语言模型（LLM）已具备有限但真实的功能性情绪组织，并通过亚里士多德的"pathē-hexis-mesotēs-phronēsis"概念框架，提出人工情绪性格需要三个额外条件（调节性具身、时间连续性、整合性自我模型），最终将一致性对齐重新定义为持久性倾向的问题而非输出合规问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前关于人工智能系统能否拥有情绪的争论被迫在两种不令人满意的立场之间选择：要么将行为等价视为情绪的充分条件，要么将现象意识作为先决条件使问题变得经验上不可触及。作者认为这种二元对立模糊了重要的区分，行为流畅可以在没有持续情绪主体的情况下产生，而对意识的不确定性并不妨碍对内部状态因果组织的研究。

Method: 1. 将情绪建模为高维表征状态空间中的上下文敏感区域、轨迹与吸引子动力学，并区分现象、功能、机制三个不可混淆的研究层次。2. 将 Herrmann 与 Levstein 提出的表征充分性标准（准确性、一致性、统一性、使用性）应用于情绪表征评估，发现 LLM 满足"使用"条件最强，"一致性"部分满足，"统一性"未确立，"准确性"无直接对应物。3. 提出三层充分性框架：第1层功能性情绪组织；第2层增加调节性具身；第3层再增加时间连续性与整合性自我模型。4. 将亚里士多德的德性伦理翻译为状态空间形式化：hexis=上下文化适应的吸引子家族；mesotēs=环境相关校准区域 V(c)⊂M；phronēsis=从情境到上下文估计 ĉ_t 的映射质量。5. 提出三类介入性测试：基础性测试（grounding test）、扰动释放测试（perturbation-and-release test）、纵向性格测试（longitudinal character test）。

Result: 论文得出四个核心主张：(1) 当前 LLM 表现出有限但真实的功能性情绪组织，满足部分而非全部已发表的表征充分性条件；(2) 功能性组织不应与人工情绪性格混淆，性格需要调节性具身、时间连续性和整合性自我模型三个额外条件；(3) 亚里士多德的情绪与德性理论为理解这些条件所能实现的内容提供了倾向性框架；(4) 该框架将一致性问题重新表述为持久倾向而非输出合规问题。论文指出，Claude Sonnet 4.5 中情绪概念表征的干预会改变奖励黑客、勒索和谄媚的发生率，但这些发现支持因果效力而非主观感受或完整情绪主体性。当前 LLM 在自主性、跨领域一致性和准确性方面存在关键缺口，亟需一套关于情感适当性的规范标准。

Conclusion: 人工情绪研究不应在模拟与意识之间进行二元选择。当前 LLM 为第三类范畴提供了证据：由因果活跃的表征结构实现的功能性情绪组织。亚里士多德的德性伦理阐明了性格的附加价值：情绪不仅被产生，而且被习惯化为稳定的、上下文敏感的倾向。德性并非固定的中间点，而是在变化情境下对适当区域 V(c) 的可靠占据，由实践智慧 phronēsis 引导，实践智慧包括估计情境所需的能力。在状态空间术语中，这成为一项研究纲领：绘制情感表征图谱、识别其基础、测量其吸引子动力学、在匹配对照下测试持续扰动下的恢复、并跟踪其随时间的发展。一致性对齐的启示同样具体：行为一致性本身并不证明系统已学习潜在价值，两者现在已有直接证据可被分离。更强的标准要求适当行为是由在评估者、提示和激励变化时仍能泛化的持久价值敏感动力学所产生的。这是约束下的表现与倾向之间的区别。是否应构建具有完整情绪性格所需架构的人工系统仍是一个伦理问题；理解此类性格的本质是必要的第一步。

Abstract: Debates about whether artificial systems can feel are often forced between two unsatisfactory positions: behavioral equivalence is treated as sufficient for emotion, or phenomenal consciousness is treated as a prerequisite that makes the question empirically inaccessible. This article develops a structural alternative. It models emotions as context-sensitive regions, trajectories and attractor dynamics in high-dimensional representational state spaces. Recent mechanistic interpretability findings support the existence of causally active emotion-concept representations in large language models, but they do not establish subjective feeling or full emotional agency. Assessed against published adequacy standards for representation in language models, intervention provides strong evidence of causal use, while full affective role integration, uniformity across subject domains and coherence remain only partially established; there is no direct analogue of accuracy. These mismatches expose the need for a standard of affective appropriateness, which an account of character must supply. Such an account requires three further conditions: regulatory embodiment that gives valence endogenous stakes, temporal continuity that allows affective episodes to accumulate into a history, and an integrated self-model that binds that history to persistent values. Aristotle's concepts of pathē, hexis, mesotēs and phronēsis are translated into a state-space sketch in which practical wisdom includes competence in estimating normatively salient context, not merely acting on a context description already given. The framework reframes alignment as a problem of durable disposition rather than output conformity, and yields interventional tests with explicit control conditions.

</details>


### [113] [Vox-Infinity: Benchmarking the Limits of Long-Context Spoken Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22452)
*Xize Cheng,Wenxu Jia,Chenyuhao Wen,Dongjie Fu,Zehan Wang,Xinyu Zhang,Tao Jin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了Vox-Infinity，这是首个专门用于评估口语语言模型长上下文理解能力的基准。它沿轮次数和轮次时长两个维度系统扩展音频历史，覆盖多种对话场景，并提供答案溯源标注以实现精确的长度感知评估。在七个口语模型上的评测揭示了明显的"近因效应"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文理解是大语言模型的核心挑战之一，在音频领域更为严峻——音频作为低压缩模态，需要远多于文本的嵌入来表示相同内容。现有的口语基准仅关注扩展输入长度而非分析不同上下文长度下的表现，且缺少答案溯源标注和超长对话场景，难以系统评估口语模型在长对话历史中检索和利用证据的能力。

Method: 构建三阶段数据集：(1) 长上下文口语对话生成——包含超多轮对话（基于SpokenWOZ）、个人独白（基于GigaSpeech）、超语义对话（基于IEMOCAP并用Qwen-TTS合成情感语音以解耦声学情感与语义线索）三种场景；(2) 使用GPT-4生成问答对并标注答案证据所在轮次；(3) 人工核验答案正确性、唯一性和溯源准确性。定义"所需上下文时长"为从最早证据到查询的时间跨度，按此将样本分桶（0-2min、2-4min、4-8min、8min+）以实现长度感知评测。评估七个模型在文本历史和音频历史两种设置下的表现，采用GPT-4o作为评判器。

Result: Vox-Infinity包含1,474个会话、13,516个问答对、127.96小时音频。评测揭示：(1) 明显的近因效应——随着证据距查询越远，模型准确率下降；(2) 在依赖语言内容的任务上文本历史优于音频历史（超多轮对话中71.3% vs 42.6%），但在依赖副语言线索的任务上音频历史更优；(3) 在语义受控的情感识别样本中，音频历史优势更显著（6.6个百分点提升），证实了副语言记忆的必要性；(4) LLM评判器与人类判断的一致性达99.0%。

Conclusion: Vox-Infinity作为诊断性测试平台，揭示了口语语言模型在长上下文场景下的核心局限：难以从长音频历史中检索细粒度语义证据，文本历史虽保留词汇信息但丢失副语言线索。该基准为研究口语模型如何在扩展交互中保留和利用语义与声学信息提供了重要工具。

Abstract: Long-context understanding remains a fundamental challenge for large language models, as excessively long inputs often lead models to forget salient information. This issue is even more pronounced in the speech domain, where audio, as a low-compression modality, requires substantially more embeddings than text to preserve both semantic content and acoustic cues. To address this challenge, we introduce \textbf{Vox-Infinity}, the first benchmark specifically designed to evaluate long-context understanding in spoken language models. Vox-Infinity systematically extends audio history along two dimensions: turn count and turn duration. It covers a diverse range of representative scenarios with varying interaction structures and semantic complexity. Crucially, Vox-Infinity provides explicit answer-provenance annotations and organizes samples according to the amount of historical context required to resolve each query, enabling precise and length-aware evaluation. Extensive evaluations of seven representative spoken language models reveal a clear overall recency effect: models generally achieve higher accuracy when answer-supporting evidence is closer to the query, but struggle to retrieve and use evidence located farther back in the dialogue history. Cases and datasets are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [114] [Apollo Restore: A Foundation LLM for Historical Greek Optimized for Fill-in-the-Middle Restoration of Ancient Greek Texts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22455)
*Hope McGovern,Anna Dolganov,Samuel Belkadi,Guillaume Kunsch,Dimitris Vlitas,David A. Smith*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Apollo Restore是一个240亿参数的古希腊语专用大语言模型，基于Mistral Small通过填空中间（FIM）目标微调而成，用于恢复残缺古希腊文本中缺失的文字段落。该模型无需预先知道缺字长度即可重建缺文，是首个针对历史希腊语以及任何古代地中海语言的大规模解码器模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 古代希腊文献（纸莎草纸、石刻铭文等）多以残缺形式存世，全球超过百万件残片等待修复，专家人工修复耗时巨大。现有AI修复工具（Ithaca、Cullhed）依赖"长度预言机"（必须预先知道缺字字符数），这在纸莎草学中难以满足；同时现有评估协议因偏向短缺口而虚报成绩，掩盖了模型在真正困难的较长缺口上的崩溃。该研究旨在解决这两个核心问题。

Method: 1. **任务重构**：将文本修复重新定义为变长填空中间（FIM）任务，按"后缀-前缀-中间"顺序打包，损失仅在中间片段计算，使模型能从上下文隐式推断缺口长度；2. **数据**：在约6亿词的最大开源希腊语语料库上训练（涵盖公元前至1900年），包括DDB文献纸草、DCLP文学纸草、I.PHI铭文及"开放希腊语料库"（COG）；3. **合成缺口构造**：填补学者的修订重建出干净底本后，重新均匀采样1-25字符的缺口（避免偏短），模型训练中从不见学者修复；4. **长度提示条件**：训练时40%精确提示、40%范围提示、20%无提示，且15%故意错误提示，以实现优雅降级；5. **平衡评估框架**：提出按缺口长度均匀加权指标，纠正短缺口偏差。

Result: 在DDB文献纸草、DCLP文学纸草、IG石刻铭文三大语料上，Apollo Restore的Top-20准确率分别达80.6%/54.6%/61.0%，为最强基线的1.6×/2.6×/1.4×；在均匀加权指标下优势扩大至2.3×/3.5×/1.6×。即便无长度提示，Apollo Restore仍以3.0×优势超越Claude Opus 4.8等前沿闭源模型。20位专家盲测中，Apollo Restore的修复被强烈偏好，并在197个对误案例中有36.7%被判为"至少不逊于"人类编辑。模型还成功应用于赫库兰尼姆火山碳化纸草P.Herc. 1667，提出新的合理修复方案。

Conclusion: Apollo Restore是首个针对古代地中海语言的大语言模型，通过填空中间范式消除对预知缺字长度的依赖，在残缺古希腊文本修复任务上树立了新的技术标杆。其相对优势在更具实际意义的长缺口范围内更大，并获领域专家的强烈偏好。该团队将发布模型权重、数据与评估代码，以推动计算纸草学领域的标准化评估与协作研究。

Abstract: We present Apollo Restore, a 24-billion-parameter large language model for restoring lacunae---physical gaps---in fragmentary Ancient Greek texts. Fine-tuned from Mistral Small with a fill-in-the-middle objective, Apollo Restore reconstructs missing spans without requiring oracle knowledge of their length. To our knowledge, it is the first large-scale decoder model for historical Greek, and the first for any ancient Mediterranean language. Evaluated as in prior work, on short gaps of up to ten characters, Apollo Restore places the correct restoration among its top twenty candidates for 80.6%/54.6%/61.0% of documentary-papyrus, literary-papyrus, and stone-inscription lacunae, exceeding the strongest published models by $1.6\times$/$2.6\times$/$1.4\times$. Prior evaluation protocols, however, inflate scores through a bias toward trivially short gaps; under a length-balanced metric Apollo Restore's advantage over the strongest published models grows to $2.3\times$/$3.5\times$/$1.6\times$ and degrades gracefully, even given incorrect length hints. In a blind study, 20 expert papyrologists, epigraphists, and philologists strongly preferred Apollo Restore to the strongest baseline and judged its performance at least as good as human restorations in 77% of cases. Apollo Restore also improves the published reading of this http URL . 1667---a papyrus roll carbonised in the eruption of Vesuvius in 79 CE and digitally unrolled and edited after Apollo Restore's training data was compiled. Apollo Restore is an output of the Decoding Antiquity initiative to build specialized LLMs for historical languages and manuscripts, led by the Austrian Academy of Sciences.

</details>


### [115] [CultureMINE: Datasets and Methods for Improving the Cultural Capabilities of NLP Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22494)
*Tania Chakraborty,Eylon Caplan,Zhaoqing Wu,Kevin Cushing,Han Qin,Shreya Havaldar,Dan Goldwasser*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对375余篇文化NLP论文进行了系统性综述，提出了文化能力（CCs）的九类分类法、数据集创建方法分类法和系统方法分类法，并发布了一个交互式网页资源CultureMine，以促进该领域的研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文化NLP研究近年快速增长，文献量大且分散，研究者难以全面跟踪方法与数据资源的最新进展，亟需一个系统性的技术视角综述来梳理该领域并识别研究空白。

Method: 采用两阶段文献收集策略（种子收集+广泛抓取），结合LLM辅助筛选和人工标注；通过迭代阅读和共识协议对378篇论文进行手工标注；提出九种文化能力（CCs）、数据集创建方法（含人类来源、自然发生数据、文化研究、合成生成）和系统方法（含提示工程、Agent系统、人在环、训练方法、经典NLP、机制可解释性、多模态）的分类法。

Result: 1）数据集创建明显多于系统改进（尤其在文化知识、文化安全与减害、价值驱动文化对齐方面）；2）数据集创建多采用两种主要流程：源-基础的人工策展和LLM协同创建；3）基于文化研究理论（如WVS、Hofstede）的方法使用频率较低，存在概念严谨性的权衡；4）72.8%论文以语言作为主要文化代理，22.2%使用地理代理，存在英语和中文过度代表、长尾分布的问题；5）82%的系统改进论文仅针对单一文化能力，缺乏多能力联合评估；6）文化教育和多模态文化知识相对未被充分探索。

Conclusion: 本文为文化NLP社区提供了一个全面的技术综述、可浏览的CultureMine资源以及未来研究方向建议：应优先开发针对现有数据集的系统改进方法、复用现有数据生成框架、开发针对隐式文化细微差异的专门评估方法，并开展多种文化能力的联合评估与优化。

Abstract: In recent years, there has been a surge of interest in Cultural NLP, with substantial efforts to create globally inclusive NLP systems. The rapid growth of literature in this field makes it difficult to track trends in methods and data resources. To address this, we analyze over 375 papers to answer three complementary questions: (1) What Cultural Capabilities (CCs) are being targeted in NLP systems? (2) How are cultural data resources being created? and (3) What methods are being used to improve the CCs of those systems? We discuss trends observed across the three questions, and identify relevant research gaps. To facilitate further research in this field, we release our full list of analyzed papers in the form of an interactive web interface, which includes a feature to allow researchers to add their work; we hope this facilitates future research and proves to be a valuable resource for the Cultural NLP community.

</details>


### [116] [When Cosine Similarity Fails to Reflect Linearly Accessible Structure in Dialogue Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22522)
*Yu Sun,Mengyin Lu,Cong Feng,Guangming Lu,Huimin Han*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了余弦相似度在对话条件大语言模型隐藏状态中可能无法反映线性可解码结构的问题。在三个7-8B对话模型上,线性探针AUC(0.73-0.97)远高于余弦kNN AUC(0.56-0.77),但10维监督子空间可恢复大部分差距,而匹配秩的PCA子空间则不能。该现象在SST-5单句情感分类中消失,排除属性基数混淆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 余弦相似度被广泛用于分析Transformer表征(人物向量检索、表示质量评估、引导验证),隐含假设是相似度能反映任务相关结构。本文研究该假设在对话条件LLM中何时失效:表征空间中的相似度何时无法反映线性可解码结构。核心问题在于区分"任务对齐方向"与"方差主导方向"的不一致,而非验证线性探针优于距离方法这一已知事实。

Method: 方法论框架包括:(1) 数据集:30个手工构建的人格角色,跨越4个预定义轴(正式度2类、专业度2类、情感5类、领域5类),配5个跨上下文话题,15轮助手回复,N=4轨迹/单元,在三个模型上共1800轨迹;(2) 探针族:线性探针AUC、原始余弦kNN、监督子空间余弦kNN、PCA子空间余弦kNN;(3) 在每个模型6个深度匹配层提取残余流激活(最后预填充token);(4) 按轨迹分组交叉验证;(5) 累积池锚定子空间V*用于跨轮次稳定性分析;(6) 多重对照:匹配基数控制(SST-5 vs 人格情感5类)、各向异性修正、探测正则化扫描、子空间维度扫描。预注册决策规则涵盖正则差距阈值、轮次不变性、子空间支持与可分性不变性。

Result: 核心结果:(1) 在三个模型最深探查层,线性探针AUC=0.972/0.733/0.804,余弦kNN=0.771/0.556/0.574,差距0.18-0.23;(2) 10维监督子空间kNN提升+0.105至+0.138,监督-PCA差距0.142-0.172,bootstrap 95%CI严格为正;(3) PCA子空间一致低于原始(差距-0.022至-0.037),表明任务对齐是关键而非降维本身;(4) 在SST-5上监督提升接近零或为负,符号反转,与样本量无关;(5) 跨轮次差距不系统性累积,但Llama违反轮次不变性(0.053>0.05);(6) 子空间支持跨轮次绝对不变(max-min≤0.0071),但子空间内AUC对Llama/Mistral违反不变准则(Δ=-0.072/-0.060);(7) 四个预定义属性轴的轮次增量均≤0.07且符号混合,无一致跨架构模式。

Conclusion: 结论:在对话条件多轮人格表征中,余弦相似度可系统性地无法反映线性可访问结构,这是相似度指标读取结构的方式局限,而非表征本身失败。监督子空间投影在4096等环境下捕捉大多数线性可解码信号(10维即可饱和),而匹配秩的PCA投影则不能。该现象是条件性的:在匹配基数的单句情感分类中消失,排除属性基数作为解释。建议四项诊断清单:(i) 线性探针AUC、(ii) 原始余弦kNN AUC、(iii) 监督子空间余弦kNN AUC、(iv) 匹配秩PCA子空间余弦kNN AUC;差距(ii)-(iii)和对比(iii)-(iv)是诊断该结构模式的关键。对人物向量检索、表示质量评估、引导验证等使用原始余弦作为默认几何的方法具有方法论意义。

Abstract: Cosine similarity is widely used to analyze transformer representations, implicitly assuming that similarity reflects task-relevant structure. We study when this assumption fails in dialogue-conditioned large language models. Across three 7-8B chat-tuned models, ambient cosine similarity substantially underestimates linearly decodable persona structure on the same hidden states; numerically, linear probe AUC is in the 0.73-0.97 range while cosine kNN is in the 0.56-0.77 range on a 30-class task. A low-dimensional supervised subspace recovers much of this gap, whereas a matched-rank PCA subspace does not and in some cases degrades performance. This mismatch is regime-dependent: it is absent in single-sentence sentiment classification (SST-5), and a matched-cardinality control rules out attribute cardinality as a confound. The gap does not systematically increase across dialogue turns, and the task-aligned subspace remains stable over time. However, two of three models violate a pre-registered within-subspace separability invariance criterion (|Delta AUC| <= 0.03), and one model violates a pre-registered turn-invariance criterion (|Delta L| <= 0.05). These results show that cosine similarity can fail to reflect task-aligned structure in dialogue representations even when that structure is linearly accessible.

</details>


### [117] [Cross-Dialect NER for Bangla Regional Dialects Using Leave-One-Dialect-Out Cross-Validation and Explainable AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22536)
*Shamim Rahim Refat,Faika Fairuj Preotee,Shuvashis Sarker,Shifat Islam,Bidyarthi Paul,Mohammad Ashraful Hoque*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对孟加拉语五种地区方言（Barishal、Chittagong、Sylhet、Noakhali、Mymensingh）的跨方言命名实体识别（NER）任务，提出基于留一方言交叉验证（LODOCV）的框架，在ANCHOLIK-NER数据集（17,405句，101,817 tokens）上系统评估了八个预训练Transformer模型，并利用LIME进行可解释性分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 孟加拉语作为世界第七大语言存在显著的地区方言差异，但现有NER工作普遍假设语言同质性，忽略了方言多样性带来的词汇、形态和句法差异，导致模型在跨方言场景下泛化能力受限。该问题在低资源方言NER研究中尤为突出。

Method: 1) 使用ANCHOLIK-NER数据集（BIO标注，9类实体）；2) 采用留一方言交叉验证（LODOCV），每次以四种方言训练、剩余一种方言测试，共五折；3) 评估八个预训练Transformer模型（BanglaBERT Base/Large、XLM-RoBERTa Base/Large、MuRIL Base/Large Cased、Multilingual-E5 Base/Large）；4) 采用统一超参数（batch size=16，learning rate=3e-5，10 epochs，weight decay=0.01）；5) 使用LIME对词级预测进行可解释性分析。

Result: Multilingual-E5 Large在所有折上F1值最高：BCMN-S 90.58%、BCMS-N 90.03%、BCNS-M 97.26%、BMNS-C 82.38%、CMNS-B 92.32%。BCNS-M（Mymensingh）表现最佳（97.26%），因其与标准孟加拉语更接近；BMNS-C（Chattogram）表现最低（82.38%），因其词汇和音系特征更具独特性。LIME分析显示模型预测几乎完全依赖目标词的表面形式（贡献度≈0.99），而非上下文语境。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了孟加拉语跨方言NER的基准，证明了基于Transformer的迁移学习在低资源方言场景下的有效性。但LIME分析揭示模型主要通过识别方言特有的词汇表面形式而非深层语境理解来做出预测，这一发现对理解模型行为具有重要意义，并为未来研究指明了方向，包括扩展更多方言、引入实体级和按类别评估指标、量化方言语料库间的词汇重叠以排除数据泄露因素等。

Abstract: Bangla, the seventh most spoken language in the world, exhibits significant regional dialectal diversity, with dialects such as Barishal, Chattogram, Sylhet, Noakhali, and Mymensingh differing in lexical, morphological, and syntactic characteristics. These variations pose substantial challenges for Named Entity Recognition (NER), limiting the generalization of models trained on Standard Bangla or a single regional dialect. This paper presents a cross-dialect Bangla NER framework using the publicly available ANCHOLIK-NER dataset, comprising 17,405 annotated sentences and 101,817 tokens across five major Bangla regional dialects. A Leave-One-Dialect-Out Cross-Validation (LODOCV) strategy is adopted, training models on four dialects and evaluating on the remaining unseen dialect. Eight pretrained transformer-based models, including BanglaBERT, MuRIL, XLM-RoBERTa, and Multilingual-E5, are evaluated under identical experimental settings. Multilingual-E5 Large achieves the highest F1-score in every fold, peaking at 97.26% on Mymensingh and reaching its lowest, 82.38%, on Chattogram, the most challenging target dialect. To improve interpretability, Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) are applied to word-level predictions, revealing that the model's decisions are driven primarily by the surface form of the target entity word itself rather than by surrounding sentence context. These findings establish a benchmark for cross-dialect Bangla NER and demonstrate the effectiveness of transformer-based transfer learning for low-resource regional dialects, while highlighting the surface-form dependence of current models as a direction for future work.

</details>


### [118] [Correct Diagnosis, Better Feedback: A Symbolic-Verifier for Faithful LLM Tutoring Feedback in Logic Proofs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22553)
*Tahreem Yasir,Arnav Mody,Xioayi Tian,Tiffany Barnes*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种基于符号验证器的神经-符号架构，用于在命题逻辑证明辅导中实现忠实的LLM辅导反馈。论文将错误诊断与语言生成分离，通过比较零样本LLM、微调LLM和符号验证器三种诊断器，揭示了看似高质量的反馈可能掩盖上游诊断错误，强调忠实性必须与正确性分开评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM辅导系统在不准确识别学生具体错误方面表现不佳，尤其是在命题逻辑证明中，这会导致反馈质量下降。先前研究表明LLM会系统性地拒绝正确推理、验证错误推理，产生不一致和幻觉反馈。论文旨在通过将形式化推理规则检查与语言生成分离，解决诊断准确性与反馈忠实性的问题。

Method: 论文提出三阶段流水线架构：(1) 检测器分配错误标签（正确、wrong_arity、antecedent_mismatch、wrong_rule），(2) 推理代理解释分配的标签，(3) 反馈代理将推理转化为苏格拉底式指导。比较三种检测器：零样本LLama 3.1 8B (B0)、QLoRA微调版本(B1)、以及基于统一算法的符号验证器（使用Robinson统一算法检查所选语句与点击规则的前件模式是否匹配）。使用600个平衡学生动作进行评估，采用BART-large-MNLI进行推理忠实性评估，GPT-5.1作为反馈评分法官，并与专家判断对比。

Result: 关键结果包括：(1) B0的宏F1仅0.191（低于均匀随机基线0.25），B1提升至0.709但在结构相关类别间保留系统错误，wrong_rule被广泛误分类为antecedent_mismatch或wrong_arity；(2) 推理阶段通常忠实于其输入诊断（F_sys：B0为73.5%、B1为75.8%、验证器为94.3%），表明错误诊断可被忠实传播；(3) 反馈也可忠实于推理且教学上适当，即使针对的是错误；(4) 验证器引导的反馈在所有三个维度（忠实性1.710、教学适当性1.292、诊断正确性1.775）上均排名第一；(5) 人类专家评分与自动评分在非揭示性和诊断正确性上一致性较好，但在教学适当性上分歧明显。

Conclusion: 论文得出三个核心结论：(1) 诊断正确性与反馈质量是不同属性——忠诚、教学适当且非揭示的反馈仍可保留错误的诊断；(2) 当错误类型可局部判定时，符号组件应负责确定错误原因，LLM仅负责传达方式，这构成神经-符号辅导系统的明确分工；(3) 必须独立评估忠实性（是否保留诊断）与正确性（诊断是否正确），并通过多阶段评估使错误传播可见。该方法可推广到任何可局部判定正确性的领域（如代数简化、编程作业评分、数据库查询评估）。

Abstract: Effective LLM tutoring depends on correctly identifying the specific error in a student's reasoning before generating feedback. We study this problem in propositional-logic proof tutoring, where student actions can be checked against formal inference rules. We introduce a verifier-grounded architecture that separates diagnosis from language generation. Using 600 balanced student actions, we compare a zero-shot LLM detector, a fine-tuned detector, and a symbolic verifier. Each diagnosis is processed by shared rationale and feedback agents, isolating the effect of the initial diagnosis. The zero-shot detector achieves a macro-F1 of 0.191; fine-tuning raises this to 0.709 but retains systematic errors between structurally related classes. Rationales generally preserve the diagnosis supplied to them, showing that an incorrect diagnosis can be faithfully propagated through the pipeline. Feedback can likewise remain faithful to its rationale, non-revealing, and pedagogically appropriate while addressing the wrong error. Verifier-grounded feedback achieves the highest diagnostic correctness, and expert ratings largely uneven with the automatic feedback evaluations. These findings show that apparent feedback quality can conceal upstream diagnostic errors and that faithfulness must be evaluated separately from correctness. Our code is publicly available

</details>


### [119] [Pretrained Persona Mixture Models and Tandem Models for Human Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22607)
*Minwoo Kang,Téa Wright,Seun Eisape,Ayush Raj,Suhong Moon,Joseph Suh,Alane Suhr,David M. Chan,John Canny*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"Persona Mixture Models (PMMs)"概念，主张使用预训练基础模型而非指令微调模型进行LLM人类模拟。PMMs通过短对话样本即可"绑定"特定人物，并在分布匹配、语用行为和语言多样性三方面均优于指令微调模型。作者进一步提出"Tandem Models"，将预训练模型作为候选生成器与指令微调模型作为监督选择器相结合，在准确性和多样性上取得最佳综合表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前主流LLM人类模拟实践——通过提示指令微调助手模型进行角色扮演——存在准确性问题并产生刻板化预测（缺乏自然多样性）。研究人员常将指令微调模型的失败归因于LLM本身，而本文认为这些失败主要源于后训练阶段的优化目标偏离了人类模拟的本质需求。

Method: 方法包含三个核心部分：(1) 理论框架：将预训练LLM形式化为Persona Mixture Models (PMMs)，即对隐式说话者状态z的混合分布，通过短对话上下文即可"绑定"特定人物；(2) 评估方法：在5个对话语料库（Reddit、WildChat-1M、LMSYS-Chat-1M、MultiWOZ 2.1、DialOp）上，使用困惑度、MAUVE、对话行为N-gram分布、词义多样性等多维度指标，对比7个模型家族（Llama-3.1、Mistral、Qwen2.5、Qwen3等）的预训练版与指令版；(3) Tandem Models：预训练模型采样N个候选回复，指令微调模型作为监督者从中选择最佳候选（仅选择不改写），以保留生成多样性的同时利用IT模型的判别能力。

Result: 实验结果支持三项核心声明（C1-C3）：(C1) 预训练模型对人类对话的困惑度接近其自采样困惑度（如Mistral-24B-Base在Reddit上PPL-H=10.72，PPL-G=17.24），而指令微调模型严重不匹配（如Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct PPL-H=32.15 vs PPL-G=2.77）；MAUVE分数显示预训练模型接近上限(0.95-0.97)，指令微调模型显著下降；(C2) 在MultiWOZ对话行为分析中，Tandem模型在N=3时的JSD最低(0.280)，优于指令微调及推理模型；(C3) 预训练模型在Self-BLEU、Self-BERT-F1、Vendi分数等多样性指标上均显著优于指令微调版本（如Qwen2.5-14B-Base Self-BLEU=0.0109 vs Instruct=0.2017）。Tandem配置在保留基础模型多样性的同时获得最佳综合性能。

Conclusion: 用户模拟是与对话辅助根本不同的任务。为辅助任务设计的优化（指令微调、RLHF）系统性地损害人类模拟性能。预训练模型本质上是对人类作者分布的估计，是更合适的"Persona Mixture Models"。Tandem模型通过结合预训练模型的生成多样性和指令微调模型的判别能力，实现了准确性与多样性的最佳平衡。用户建模需要独立于辅助训练目标的方法论、失败模式和评估标准，辅助对齐方案不会自动迁移到用户模拟，未来工作应探索GAN式判别器训练、知识边界模拟以及训练数据限制等挑战。

Abstract: We argue here that the current dominant practice in LLM human simulation: prompting instruction-tuned assistant language models to role-play personas, is inaccurate and produces stereotyped predictions (lacking natural diversity). It has previously been shown that LLMs can be bound to personas using naturalistic, freetext dialog avoiding stereotyping. Here we show that binding can also be achieved using short, individual samples of dialog from specific people. Demographics can be added later without negative effects by simply querying the model. We use the term Persona Mixture Models (PMMs) for well-calibrated human models, currently realized as pretrained base models. We show that PMMs produce more accurate predictions than instruction-tuned models and retain more of the lexical, semantic, and pragmatic diversity found in human dialog. We measure realism and diversity of LLMs simulating human interlocutors across a diverse set of corpora spanning open-domain text, human-AI chat, and task-oriented dialogue between human speakers. However, base pretrained models can produce out-of-domain dialog and may lose some of the human's internal state over long contexts. We propose and explore tandem models which combine a pre-trained model with an instruction-tuned supervisor. Tandem models achieve the best overall accuracy and diversity in our experiments.

</details>


### [120] [Beetle: A Bilingual Model Suite for Modelling Second-Language Processing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22633)
*Suchir Salhan,Catherine Arnett,James Michaelov,Paula Buttery*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Beetle是一个双语语言模型预训练框架，通过独立操控分词器、目标语言、训练预算和暴露结构等变量，训练并发布了285个双语模型和45个单语模型（覆盖21种L1），用于系统研究双语习得和第二语言处理。研究发现，分阶段、有时间结构的课程相比平衡双语训练，在预测人类二语阅读时间方面表现更好，尤其在小数据规模和类型学上较接近的语言对上效果最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的双语语言模型研究中，暴露结构、规模和架构等变量通常同时变化，难以将效果归因于单一因素。此外，认知科学和计算心理语言学领域长期偏重英语单语研究，缺少可控的双语模型来研究人类双语处理和二语习得。现有双语模型（如B-GPT）覆盖语言对有限，缺乏细粒度检查点，且没有匹配的单语基线，难以区分真正的跨语言迁移效应与数据差异。

Method: Beetle框架的核心方法包括：(1) 采用PicoDecoder架构（125M参数，LLaMA风格，因果解码器，14层，d_model=768，12头分组查询注意力，RoPE，SwiGLU，RMSNorm）；(2) 使用50K词汇量的BPE分词器，确保两种语言具有相同的压缩率；(3) 设计5种暴露课程B1-B5：B1平衡（50:50恒定混合）、B2同步（L1后sigmoid过渡到50:50）、B3顺序（最终L2主导33:67）、B4课堂式（80:20基础上的周期性突发）、B5晚期（80%训练后才引入L2）；(4) 训练数据包括BabyBabelLM（100M人类规模）和FineWeb-2（100M/2B/24B规模）；(5) 使用对数间隔检查点策略，每模型约30个检查点；(6) 评估方法包括MECO眼动阅读时间预测（混合效应回归，ΔlogL指标）、FLORES-200句子级NLL、BLiMP/MultiBLiMP语法判断、BLiSS三联错误区分、跨语言结构启动、CEFR分级教学任务。

Result: (1) 课程结构效应：分阶段课程（B2/B3/B5）在MECO阅读时间对齐上持续优于平衡双语训练（B1），尤其在类型学上较接近的语言对（荷兰语、德语、俄语）上效果最强；中文（类型学距离较远）的课程收益较弱。(2) 语法判断效应：100M规模下B1在英语BLiMP上表现最佳（平均61.6，跨15种L1），所有双语课程均优于L1单语对照（52.9）；B1也是15种L1中9种的最优课程。(3) 训练动态：FLORES-200显示引入英语导致L1句子级NLL突然上升（与课程L2起始点对齐），随后部分恢复，支持"容量竞争"假设。(4) 结构启动：B1-B5课程在荷兰语-英语跨语言结构启动上均显示显著效应。(5) 课程效应不跨任务一致转移：BLiSS和MECO的课程排序呈负相关（Spearman ρ=-0.47, p<0.001），B1在教学任务（CLOTH、Cambridge完形填空、JFLEG）上表现最佳。(6) 规模效应：24B规模模型在MECO对齐上优于小规模模型，与先前单语阅读时间研究中约2B后下降的发现形成对比。(7) 人类规模数据：BabyBabelLM（儿童导向数据）在荷兰语和德语L1上比FineWeb 100M提供更高的MECO对齐。

Conclusion: Beetle框架证明：(1) 控制暴露结构是影响语言模型模拟人类二语阅读行为的关键决定因素，独立于架构、规模和分词器；(2) 不同课程产生可测量的不同语言和认知行为，时间结构化暴露更好地捕捉增量式双语处理，而平衡暴露在语法泛化上更强；(3) 精心设计的双语课程可使小模型（125M）在认知导向评估上匹配或超越大得多的大规模多语言系统；(4) 课程效应不跨评估任务一致转移，表明需要根据研究目标选择课程；(5) 通过发布可复现框架和开放双语模型，Beetle降低了NLP、心理语言学和认知科学交叉研究的门槛，推动计算心理语言学超越单语、英语中心的局限。论文也指出了局限：仅L2-英语方向、单一随机种子配置、未涵盖神经信号对齐（如N400/P600），以及课程是对暴露历史的受控计算类比而非全面的双语习得模型。

Abstract: Bilingual language models (LMs) offer a controlled setting for studying how training conditions shape second-language (L2) behaviour, but prior work typically varies exposure structure, scale, and architecture at once, making it difficult to attribute effects to any single factor. We introduce Beetle, a controlled language model pretraining framework in which tokeniser, target language, training budget, and exposure structure are each independently manipulable, enabling systematic and comparable experimentation of training conditions. Using Beetle, we train and release 285 bilingual and 45 monolingual open-source LMs with rich checkpoints across a range of exposure schedules, data scales and first languages (L1s) to study multilingual pretraining and computational modelling of bilingualism and second language learning. Evaluating models on human bilingual and second language reading-time prediction and grammaticality judgement tasks, we find that staged and temporally structured curricula consistently improve alignment with language learner reading time compared to balanced bilingual training, with the largest gains at smaller data scales and for typologically closer language pairs. The Beetle models are well suited tools to help move computational psycholinguistics beyond its prevailing monolingual, English-centric focus toward models of human bilingual processing, to study cross-lingual learning dynamics, while supporting community-based development of controlled model families.

</details>


### [121] [COT-TTS: Audio Context-Aware Text-to-Speech with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22697)
*Weizhen Bian,Sitong Cheng,Rongxiu Zhong,Jiahao Pan,Liumeng Xue,Boyi Kang,Shilei Zhang,Jinglei Liu,Yue Wang,Junlan Feng,Bei Liu,Wei Xue*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了COT-TTS任务——一种音频上下文感知的推理式文本到语音合成系统。该系统根据历史对话音频、目标文本和参考语音，自主推理目标话语应采用的说话方式（情感、节奏、韵律等），并合成具有指定音色的目标语音。作者构建了包含900万训练样本（含100万高质量子集）的双语对话语音数据集，以及800个人工验证的源分离基准测试集，并开发了0.6B和1.7B参数的端到端自回归模型。实验表明，该模型以显著更少的参数达到了与大规模级联基线系统相当的性能，并在时长一致性和情感一致性方面表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TTS系统虽然能通过自然语言提示或参考语音控制说话风格，但仍依赖用户为每句话手动指定说话方式。然而在自然对话、影视配音、虚拟角色等场景中，说话风格应当从对话历史中自动推断，而非逐句指定。这一能力对于情感支持对话、影视配音等应用尤为重要，但当前缺乏匹配该任务设定的大规模数据和统一框架。

Method: 方法包含三部分：(1) 数据构建——从约100K小时中英文对话音视频中，通过说话人日志、场景分割、多维标注（含五维CoT推理：言语行为、场景语义、认知动机、预期交际效果、情感轨迹）和质量过滤，构建900万训练样本和800样本基准集；(2) 模型设计——基于Qwen3骨干（0.6B/1.7B），采用BiCodec语音编码（全局token+语义token），将历史音频、目标文本、参考语音统一为自回归序列，顺序生成情感标记转录、CoT推理和目标语音token；(3) 三阶段训练——模态对齐（ASR+TTS）→ 多任务主训练（含辅助任务如说话人日志、情感识别等）→ 高质量数据精调，并支持推理时CoT编辑以控制说话方式。

Result: 在英中基准上，0.6B/1.7B模型以远少于级联基线（34-39B）的参数，取得了与大规模系统相当的综合性能。具体而言：时长误差约为1秒（远低于基线的5秒以上）；情感一致性达0.95左右；WER/CER较低；人类MOS评分在两种语言上均优于多数级联基线。消融实验验证了三阶段训练和辅助任务的必要性，并表明数据质量过滤比引入质量分数条件更有效。可编辑CoT能有效控制时长、节奏和情感强度，且在中文基准上获得最高的LLM综合评分。
