Conclusion: 本文形式化了音频上下文感知推理TTS任务，构建了大规模双语数据集和基准，提出了可解释且支持CoT编辑的端到端模型，在显著减少参数的同时达到与级联系统相当的性能，并在人类主观评价中表现更优。未来工作将聚焦于提升可编辑CoT的鲁棒性和更细粒度的语音实现控制。

Abstract: Recently, text-to-speech systems have made significant progress in speech expressiveness and controllability. However, the speaking style of generated speech typically relies on clear user-specified instructions. In natural conversations, speaking style should be naturally inferred from the preceding conversational context. Therefore, we propose COT-TTS, a context-aware, reasoning-based text-to-speech task. Given historical conversation audio, target text, and a reference speech, the system should comprehend the conversational context, infer an explicit intermediate reasoning, and finally synthesize the target speech with the specified timbre. To support this task, we constructed a large-scale bilingual conversational speech dataset comprising 9 million training samples, including a high-quality subset of 1 million samples. We further constructed a source-disjoint benchmark with 800 human-verified samples and established strong task-specific baselines. Additionally, we developed end-to-end autoregressive models with parameter sizes of 0.6B and 1.7B, generating emotion-labeled transcripts, editable speech style inferences, and speech tokens. Experimental results show that the proposed model achieves performance comparable to large-scale baseline systems with significantly fewer parameters. At the same time, the model performs well in terms of duration consistency and emotional consistency, and can generate appropriate emotional, stress, and rhythmic variations based on the conversational context. To facilitate future research, we will publicly release the data construction pipeline, dataset, trained models, and related resources. The demo page and additional resources are available at this https URL

</details>


### [122] [NLPCC 2026 Task 10: Citation-Level Faithfulness Verification with DeBERTa Ensembles and Class-Wise Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22774)
*Yanling Li,Zirui Li,Mingyu Wan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了NLPCC 2026共享任务10的Track 2（引文级忠实性验证）参赛系统，采用双头离线架构，结合段落感知DeBERTa交叉编码器与文档级DeBERTa-large分类器，通过概率级融合与类别决策校准修正偏差，在最终排行榜上以82.9898总分排名第二。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI在辅助科研写作时常常产生超过原文、歪曲原文或仅表面相关的引用，任务要求判断引文忠实性的同时进行细粒度证据定位，且要求完全离线运行。

Method: 两阶段离线系统：(1)联合模型用DeBERTa-v3-base交叉编码器，注意力池化Top-K候选段落，同时预测证据排序与关系标签；(2)DeBERTa-v3-large文档级分类器输出互补概率；按0.7/0.3融合后进行类别logit校准（系数[1.4,0.9,0.65,1.0]）；证据头融合Top-20、Top-30与BM25分数（0.6/0.4/0.03）。

Result: 最终排行榜得分82.9898（Macro-F1 89.5491，Joint@3 76.4305），Track 2第二名；消融实验显示纯BM25输入优于注入摘要/结论，大模型较base提升1.45点，校准使Macro-F1提升约0.6点；Oracle分析表明证据排序是Joint@3的主要瓶颈。

Conclusion: 系统验证了段落级联合训练+文档级融合+类别校准的有效性，未来工作应采用文档分组评估、学习式长文档检索以及严格的Irrelevant空列表后处理。

Abstract: This paper presents our system for Track 2 of the NLPCC 2026 Shared Task 10 on citation-level faithfulness in AI-assisted scientific reporting. Given an atomic scientific claim and the structured full text of its cited paper, the task requires both a four-way relation label and up to three evidence paragraph identifiers. The label head ensembles a paragraph-aware cross-encoder with a document-level DeBERTa-large classifier, followed by class-wise decision calibration. Probability-level fusion is motivated by an out-of-fold tendency to over-predict Topical Match. The evidence head combines paragraph scores from top-20 and top-30 joint models with BM25 scores. The system runs fully offline without external retrieval or LLM prompting. On the final leaderboard, our system achieved 82.9898 overall (89.5491 Macro-F1 and 76.4305 Joint@3), ranking second in Track 2. Ablations and error analysis show that model complementarity and calibration drive the label gains. Gold-evidence inference changes label Macro-F1 negligibly, whereas evidence ranking remains important for Joint@3.

</details>


### [123] [MIS-Bench: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs for Psychotherapeutic Interpersonal Skills Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22778)
*Yuhan Lu,Yi Yao,Hua Shen,Katie Aafjes-van Doorn,Zhaonan Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出了MIS-Bench基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在心理治疗人际交往技能评估任务上的表现，包含996个视频、8个FIS维度，并发现当前MLLM与人类专家一致性较低。论文还提出了MIS-RAFT回归感知微调方法以提升评分性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着多模态大语言模型（MLLM）越来越多地被用作评估器，其在需要专家判断的专业评估任务中的可靠性尚不明确。心理治疗人际交往技能评估是一个具有代表性的挑战性场景，需要整合言语内容与副语言/非言语线索。该研究旨在系统评估当前MLLM在此类专业领域的评估能力。

Method: 1. 构建MIS-Bench：基于Facilitative Interpersonal Skills（FIS）框架，包含996个心理治疗响应视频，涵盖8个评估维度（言语流畅性、希望与积极期望、说服力、情感表达、温暖/接纳/理解、共情、联盟联结能力、联盟破裂-修复反应性），使用ICC(3,1)和MSE作为评估指标；2. 评估9个MLLM（开源+闭源），在4种模态配置（纯文本、音频+文本、视频+文本、音视频+文本）和2种提示策略（直接评分、思维链）下进行测试；3. 提出MIS-RAFT方法，将分数分解为整数位和分数位，通过概率加权期望值进行回归感知微调，最小化MSE损失而非传统的交叉熵损失。

Result: 主要发现：1. 所有MLLM与人类专家的一致性仍然有限，最佳模型GPT-5.4平均ICC仅38.6%，所有开源模型低于30%，远低于人类评分者43-64%的天花板；2. 多模态输入的增益不一致，不同模型的最佳配置差异显著；3. 思维链提示相比直接评分效果更差（平均ICC低0.047）；4. 音频模态对"言语流畅性"维度有独特帮助；5. MIS-RAFT相比原始推理（ICC 0.138）和标准微调（ICC 0.027）显著提升至平均ICC 0.311，在"希望与积极期望"维度达到0.507，接近人类水平。

Conclusion: MIS-Bench揭示了通用多模态能力与专家级人际判断之间的明显差距，当前MLLM在专业心理治疗技能评估方面仍处于早期阶段。MIS-RAFT作为一种回归感知微调方法，通过弥合自回归token预测与标量评分之间的目标不匹配，为更可靠的模型评估提供了有前景的路径。未来工作可探索更多后训练策略，包括指令调优、偏好对齐和强化学习。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used as evaluators, yet their reliability in professional assessment tasks that require expert judgment remains unclear. We investigate this challenge in the context of assessing psychotherapeutic interpersonal skills and introduce MIS-Bench, a Multimodal Interpersonal Skills (MIS) benchmark comprising 996 psychotherapy response videos annotated across 8 dimensions of Facilitative Interpersonal Skills. Across 9 MLLMs with multiple modality and prompting settings, we find that current models show only modest agreement with human experts, inconsistent gains from multimodal input, and limited benefits from reasoning-based prompting. To mitigate this gap, we propose MIS-RAFT, a regression-aware fine-tuning method inspired by RAFT and tailored to fine-grained interpersonal skill scoring at one-decimal precision. MIS-RAFT addresses the mismatch between autoregressive token prediction and scalar-valued expert assessment, significantly improving agreement with human ratings. Overall, MIS-Bench reveals a clear gap between general multimodal capability and expert-level interpersonal judgment, while MIS-RAFT offers a promising path toward more reliable model-based assessment.

</details>


### [124] [To Consolidate or not to Consolidate? Evaluating the Impact of Consolidation in Multi-Reference Training using Peer Reviews](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22805)
*Maitreya Prafulla Chitale,Ketaki Mangesh Shetye,Yash More,Harshit Gupta,Manav Chaudhary,Manish Shrivastava,Vasudeva Varma*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对中间熵NLG任务（如自动同行评审生成），提出将多条原始评审合并为单一统一目标进行训练的"参考合并"范式，并构建了包含36,537篇论文的MERC-36K数据集，通过自动评估与人工评估证明合并参考训练显著优于单参考与未合并多参考训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统单参考训练丢弃多元视角，而未对齐的多参考训练引入高方差噪声，两者都不适合"结构化但主观"的中间熵任务（如同行评审生成）。作者旨在验证"目标侧参考合并"是否能提供更稳定、全面的训练信号。

Method: 1) 从OpenReview抓取ICLR/NeurIPS/COLM共36,537篇论文及145,530条评审，使用SEA-S将多条评审合并为统一的四段式（Summary/Strengths/Weaknesses/Questions）目标；2) 基于Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct+LoRA微调三组模型（单参考、多参考、合并参考），并与Reviewer2、OpenReviewer、SEA-E、AutoRev等SOTA系统对比；3) 采用ROUGE/BERTScore自动评估+30位ML研究者对50篇论文的盲排序人工评估（Kendall's W=0.614）。

Result: Llama-Consolidated在所有指标上最优：自动评估中BERTScore-F1达87.65，ROUGE-1/2/L F1为57.03/20.90/24.68；人工评估平均排名1.70/4（越低越好），在Questions（1.48）和Strengths（1.53）部分优势最大，head-to-head对Llama-MultiRef胜率74.0%，且跨7个会议表现稳定一致。

Conclusion: 参考合并为中间熵NLG任务提供了原则化且经验上更优的方案——合并后的统一目标比单参考和未合并多参考训练更能捕捉评审的整体分布，生成更全面的反馈。该范式有望推广至其他中间熵任务，但需更多数据与更大规模模型验证。

Abstract: Natural language generation (NLG) tasks span the spectrum of conditional entropy, ranging from highly constrained machine translation to open-ended dialogue generation. Structured tasks like automated peer-review generation occupy the intermediate region, where a single input admits multiple valid, overlapping outputs. In this work, we demonstrate that traditional single- and multi-reference training paradigms are suboptimal for these intermediary tasks. We provide empirical evidence that consolidating diverse references into a unified training signal is crucial for developing effective systems. To facilitate this, we introduce MERC-36K, a large-scale corpus of over 36,000 papers paired with original and consolidated peer reviews. Using this dataset, we train specific architectures to isolate the impact of different reference paradigms and benchmark against existing state-of-the-art systems. Through extensive automatic and human evaluation, we demonstrate that models trained on consolidated references significantly outperform those trained on unconsolidated references. Dataset and code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [125] [LLMs Anchor on Chief Complaint and Fail to Integrate Evidence in Sequential Clinical Triage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22904)
*Dipankar Srirag,Haokai Zhao,Ashutosh Kumar,Eleanor Hopper,Michael Dalton,Quoc Dung Nguyen,Aditya Joshi,Salil S. Kanhere,Padmanesan Narasimhan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文针对急诊科分诊（ED triage）这一序贯决策任务，对六个大语言模型（LLM）在五个顺序检查点上的表现进行了评估，发现模型严重依赖主诉（chief complaint）进行预测，且无法有效整合后续证据，性能显著低于离线基准和人类临床医生。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM急诊分诊评估大多基于完整的回顾性电子健康记录（EHR），忽视了真实分诊场景中信息是随护士-患者对话逐步揭示的。这种"离线评估"可能高估了LLM在真实序贯场景中的能力，掩盖其在动态证据整合上的失败。

Method: 研究定义了"序贯临床分诊"任务，即从不断增长的护士-患者对话前缀预测急诊严重指数（ESI）分诊等级。评估了六个LLM（包括开源和闭源模型）在五个对话检查点（从主诉交换到完整对话）上的表现，使用四分加权Kappa（QWK）作为主要指标。在两个语料库上进行测试：425个LLM生成的模拟对话（simulated）和50个临床医生编写的对话（clinician）。通过受控扰动实验（重排、删除主诉、延迟主诉等）定位预测信号，并使用提示工程干预（reasoning-on, plan-and-solve, self-consistency）尝试改善性能。同时让三位专家临床医生在相同对话上执行任务以建立人类基准。

Result: 核心发现：1）所有模型从离线设置的"中等到高度一致"（QWK 0.592-0.701）退化到所有序贯检查点上的"一般到中等一致"（QWK 0.295-0.639）；2）扰动实验显示预测信号锚定在主诉对话上，删除或改变主诉会改变所有检查点的预测，而删除后续对话几乎无影响；3）提示干预（CoT、Plan-and-Solve、Self-Consistency）均无法突破这一平台；4）三位专家临床医生在相同对话上达到QWK 0.887-0.929，而最佳模型仅为0.295；5）模型能从后续对话中提取临床相关信息（主诉恢复余弦相似度0.57-0.77，红旗征识别准确），但真实标签的surprisal随证据增加而上升（+0.74至+1.82 nats），表明模型未能整合证据；6）预测集中在ESI-2和ESI-3，所有模型在所有ESI-1（最高紧急度）病例上均存在分诊不足；7）模型间一致性高于与真实标签的一致性，导致集成方法反而加剧失败。

Conclusion: 基于离线基准评估LLM急诊分诊能力会错过其在序贯场景中的关键失败。模型存在"主诉锚定"（chief-complaint anchoring）现象：过早承诺分诊决策，无法有效整合对话后续揭示的临床证据。研究建议未来LLM分诊研究应在序贯设置下评估，并开发能解决证据整合失败的方法。这一发现对实际急诊科部署LLM分诊系统具有重要安全警示意义。

Abstract: Triage in the emergency department (ED) is a sequential decision process that unfolds turn by turn. Existing evaluations of large language models (LLMs) for triage use completed retrospective records and report performance close to that of physicians. We implement a methodology for evaluating LLMs on sequential triage, the task of predicting a triage acuity label from a growing prefix of a nurse-patient conversation. We evaluate six LLMs at five sequential checkpoints on two corpora: 425 LLM-generated (SIMULATED) and 50 physician-authored (CLINICIAN) conversations, both labelled under the Emergency Severity Index (ESI). Every model, measured by quadratic weighted kappa (QWK), degrades from moderate-to-substantial agreement on completed records to fair-to-moderate agreement at every sequential checkpoint. Controlled perturbations show that the label at every checkpoint is anchored on the chief complaint exchanges, and prompting interventions fail to lift this plateau. Models extract clinically relevant content from later turns, yet the surprisal of the true label rises across the checkpoints. So the model fails to integrate the evidence. Three expert clinicians on the same conversations reach a QWK of 0.887-0.929, while the best model reaches 0.295. Predictions concentrate at ESI-2 and ESI-3, and models agree with each other more than with the ground truth, so ensembling worsens the failure. Deploying LLMs for ED triage based on offline benchmarks alone misses this sequential failure.

</details>


### [126] [Rethinking Pivot Programming Languages in Code Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22988)
*Andor Diera,Lukas Galke Poech,Matthias Tichy*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文重新审视多语言代码语言模型中是否存在某一特权"枢纽编程语言"的问题，通过控制表征各向异性和代码长度两个混淆因素，从代码间几何、代码-英语对齐和枢纽检索三个视角系统分析，发现枢纽角色是关系依赖的：Python的特殊地位应理解为面向英语的亲和性，而非通用的几何中心性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前关于代码语言模型枢纽语言的研究存在矛盾：几何分析指向C系语言和Go，而行为证据指向Python。现有基于余弦相似度的分析受到表征各向异性和编程语言间代码长度差异这两个未受控制的混淆因素影响，因此需要重新审视这一问题。

Method: 在三个代码语言模型（StarEncoder、CodeLlama-7B、Qwen2.5-Coder-7B）上，基于xCodeEval多语言竞赛编程数据集，采用三种分析视角：(1) 对代码表征进行均值中心化以控制各向异性，并使用200-800字符长度匹配子集控制长度混淆；(2) 计算两两PL质心余弦相似度（代码-代码几何）和点对余弦相似度（代码-英语对齐）；(3) 引入"枢纽检索"诊断方法，通过Procrustes对齐将源和目标表征映射到候选枢纽语言空间，评估同问题检索性能。

Result: 三个模型均表现出严重的表征各向异性（随机对余弦0.74-0.98）和显著的代码长度相关性混淆（代码-英语对齐在CodeLlama中最高|ρ|=0.88，Qwen2.5中达0.96）。控制后：代码-代码几何呈现结构化但模型依赖的语言家族区域，不存在通用中心；代码-英语对齐一致地有利于Ruby、Kotlin、Python、JavaScript等高级脚本语言而非C系语言；枢纽检索按迁移类型分裂：代码间迁移依赖PHP、C++、JavaScript、Ruby、Java等组成的广泛桥梁层（无单一主导枢纽），而英语到代码迁移则更集中于Ruby和Python两个英语面向枢纽。指令微调改善绝对性能但保持关系依赖结构。

Conclusion: 代码语言模型中的枢纽语言不是单一的，而是关系依赖的：代码间迁移需要一个广泛的桥梁语言层，而英语-代码对齐则集中于Ruby和Python等英语面向语言。Python的特殊作用应理解为面向英语的亲和性而非通用几何中心性。研究应从"哪种语言是枢纽"转向"候选语言帮助桥接哪种关系"。

Abstract: Multilingual code language models transfer skills across programming languages (PLs), but whether any PL occupies a privileged pivot position remains contested: geometric analyses point to C-family languages and Go, while behavioral evidence highlights Python. We revisit this question under controls for representational anisotropy and length variation across PLs, two confounds that compromise prior cosine-based analyses. Across three code models on multilingual competitive-programming data, we study three views of cross-PL organization: pairwise PL geometry, PL-English alignment, and pivoted retrieval through candidate PL representation spaces. The results are relation-dependent. Code-code geometry reveals structured language regions but no universal center; code-English alignment favors high-level scripting languages; and pivoted retrieval favors different intermediate spaces for code-to-code and English-to-code transfer. These findings suggest that Python's special role is better understood as English-facing affinity than as universal geometric centrality.

</details>


### [127] [Attributable Post-Rationalization in RAG Citations: A Controlled Reproduction and an RLVR Comparison](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23053)
*Mehedi Khan,Md. Shariful Islam Bhuyan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文在固定上下文设置下，验证 RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）训练的 RAG 搜索代理是否比其指令调优基座模型（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct）更忠实地引用。结论是：后合理化（post-rationalization）现象在基座模型上已很常见（Wikipedia 数据集上约 1/7 的引用不忠信），RLVR 训练并未带来可检测的忠实度提升，其中 R-Search 在 RAGTruth 上反而显著变差。作者同时为 Wallat 等（2025）的"种植探针"添加了必要的无种植对照，使测量更加可靠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG 系统的引用本是溯源承诺，但模型常在写出答案后再"事后合理化"地附加一个看起来合理但实际并未使用的引用。RLVR 搜索代理（Search-R1、ReSearch、R-Search）只奖励最终答案正确，从未奖励引用的忠实性。论文旨在回答：这种只奖励答案正确性的训练是否顺带提升了引用忠实性？

Method: 1. 改进 Wallat 等（2025）的种植探针：保留三变体（rel-uncited、cited-other、random），在主变体 rel-uncited 中采用"前 4 个最长连续词"作为植入片段。2. 核心创新：加入无种植对照（no-planting control），用 Attr = P(引用|种植) − P(引用|对照) 给出可归因率。3. 固定上下文评估：禁用代理检索，统一使用 BM25 取前 5 篇，控制检索差异。4. 设计：以 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 为共同基座，对比其本身及 Search-R1（PPO）、ReSearch（GRPO）、R-Search（GRPO）三个 RLVR 代理。5. 四个 QA 数据集：NQ、QAMPARI、HAGRID、RAGTruth。6. 统计方法：聚类自助法 2000 次、差中差（DiD）、Holm 校正、80% 功效下检测约 7pp 差异。7. 计算资源：完全在 Kaggle 免费 T4 GPU 上完成。

Result: 1. 对照的必要性：rel-uncited 变体对照率按构造为 0；cited-other 变体对照率为 100%，原始率是测量伪影；random 变体对照率约 0.2%，可忽略。2. 后合理化普遍存在：基座在 NQ/QAMPARI/HAGRID 上可归因率分别为 14.0%、9.1%、14.8%，Wikipedia 类问题上约 1/7 引用不忠信；RAGTruth 仅 2.9%。3. RLVR 无显著改善：Search-R1 和 ReSearch 与基座差异在 1–2pp 内波动，区间都覆盖零；R-Search 在四个数据集均偏向更差，在 RAGTruth 上 +3.0pp（95% CI [1.2, 4.8]，Holm p=0.002）显著更差。4. 检测功效：80% 功效下能检出约 7pp 差异，但未观察到任何该量级改善，因此报告为"有界零结果"而非"无效应"。5. 领域依赖：RAGTruth 速率显著低于 Wikipedia 类数据集。

Conclusion: RLVR 中只奖励答案正确性的目标对引用忠实性没有任何附带提升；R-Search 甚至有轻微恶化。忠实性必须作为独立目标训练和度量。论文提出具体方案：把种植探针作为可归因一致性惩罚项直接嵌入 PPO/GRPO 训练循环，并作为可比评估指标使用。主要局限：评估格式与代理训练的多轮搜索格式不同；无法将 RL 与一般微调分离；Search-R1 在训练期见过 NQ；引用位置偏置未控制。

Abstract: A RAG system can hand you the right answer and cite a source it did not actually use. Models output these unfaithful citations via post-rationalization: they write the answer first and then attach a citation to whatever passage looks close enough. Search agents are now trained with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR), which pays them for getting the answer right. We asked whether that training also teaches them to cite honestly. Improving an existing methodology with a required control, we compared an instruction-tuned model against three RLVR agents trained from it, on four question-answering datasets, using only free-tier Kaggle GPUs. Post-rationalization is everywhere: on Wikipedia-based questions roughly one citation in seven is unfaithful. RLVR does not fix it. The agents post-rationalize at their base model's rate, and one lands slightly worse. Rewarding correct answers buys nothing in citation faithfulness, so faithfulness has to be trained and measured on its own terms.

</details>


### [128] [Bridging Static and Agentic RAG for Taiwanese Historical Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23056)
*Kai-Hsin Chen,Wei-Yu Chen,Xuanjun Chen,Jyh-Shing Roger Jang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过共享检索与生成骨干，对Agentic RAG与Static RAG在台湾历史问答任务上进行了受控对比，发现两者在聚合性能上无显著差异，但在70.83%的题目上表现不同，存在显著互补性。作者提出一个后验选择器，通过比较两个响应及其引用证据来选择更优答案，恢复了60.34%的oracle选择空间，显著优于任一单独管道。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然Agentic RAG允许LLM根据先前检索证据自适应地调整检索，但这种自适应编排是否一致地优于设计良好的静态管道仍不清楚。特别是在台湾历史问答领域，检索编排策略对答案质量的影响尚未得到系统研究。

Method: 本文在共享相同的混合检索后端（Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B密集检索+BM25稀疏检索，RRF融合，BGE-reranker-large重排）和生成器（Claude Sonnet 5）的前提下，比较Static RAG（预定义多查询检索，提供top-15段落）与Agentic RAG（通过MCP工具自适应检索，每次返回top-5段落）。提出后验选择器（基于GPT-5.5），接收两个候选响应及其引用证据进行两两比较，采用双向评估降低顺序敏感性。在Minqing（120题开放问答）和TFCAD（102题客观问答）两个台湾历史基准上进行评估，采用Correctness、Completeness、Faithfulness、Relevance四维生成质量评分。

Result: 主要发现：(1) Agentic RAG聚合得分4.2104略高于Static RAG的4.1188，但差异不显著（p=0.6543）；仅Relevance维度显著优于Static RAG。(2) 两者在85/120题（70.83%）上表现不同，胜场接近持平（41 vs 44），差异在平均时相互抵消。(3) Oracle选择提升0.2417分，选择空间是聚合差异的2.64倍。(4) 后验选择器得分4.3563，显著优于最佳单独管道（p=0.0012），恢复60.34%的oracle空间。(5) Agentic RAG在56.67%的题目上进行多轮检索，成功迭代与查询多样化相关（token Jaccard 0.076 vs 0.141）。(6) 检索增益远大于编排策略差异（闭卷基线2.3146，检索增益约1.80+，是Agentic-Static差异的20.68倍）。

Conclusion: 本文表明Agentic RAG的自适应检索并不一致地优于设计良好的Static RAG管道，两者存在显著的问题级互补性。聚合对比可能掩盖检索策略间的有意义差异。研究者提出后验选择器有效利用了这种互补性，并建议未来研究方向从寻找全局最优策略转向问题级路由机制（pre-generation routing），即预测每道题更适合哪种检索编排策略，从而以更低推理成本保留互补优势。

Abstract: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enables language models to adapt retrieval based on previously retrieved evidence, but it remains unclear whether such adaptive orchestration consistently outperforms well-designed static pipelines. We conduct a controlled comparison of agentic and static RAG for Taiwanese historical question answering, sharing the same generator and hybrid retrieval backend. Despite similar aggregate performance, the two pipelines differ on 70.83% of questions, with their advantages largely canceling out when averaged. An oracle that selects the better response per question improves the composite score by 0.2417 over the better individual pipeline, revealing substantial headroom for question-level selection. We therefore introduce a post-hoc selector that compares the two responses and their cited evidence, significantly outperforming either individual pipeline and recovering 60.34% of the oracle headroom. These results show that aggregate comparisons can obscure meaningful question-level differences between retrieval strategies, suggesting that exploiting their complementarity may be more fruitful than seeking a universally superior pipeline.

</details>


### [129] [Directing large language models to follow the letter or spirit of the law](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23083)
*Peng Qian,Andrew Li,Sam Chen,Sonia K. Murthy,Yonatan Belinkov,Tomer D. Ullman*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为AncLoRA（带锚定损失的低秩适配）的方法，通过对大语言模型（LLM）进行最小化的定向微调，使其在判断行为是否违反规则时优先依据法律的"精神"（意图/目的）还是"字面"（文本）。仅使用57个手工编写的日常规则小情境进行训练，适配器即可显著改变模型在多种域外的判断，包括日常漏洞规避场景、Reddit恶意合规帖子和历史法律案例。模型内部分析揭示了一个三维可解释的低维空间，对应于一个预先指定的法学概念几何框架（Decision/Agreement/Approach三维度）。该研究为理解LLM中法律概念的表征与引导提供了新途径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法律"字面"与"精神"的区分是法学、哲学及AI安全中的核心问题。当前LLM既可能遵循也可能规避规则的真正意图，如何可控地引导模型偏向某种解释路径，是构建安全智能机器的关键挑战。现有方法（如基于对比激活添加CAA的线性引导）在该任务上效果不佳，暗示概念表征可能具有非线性结构。

Method: 方法核心是Anchored Low-Rank Adaptation（AncLoRA）：在冻结的基座模型（如Qwen3.5-27B和Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct）特定层（Qwen第32层，Llama第26层）的MLP up_proj矩阵上注入低秩适配器。训练目标为多任务损失：主损失迫使适配后模型在判断"是否违反规则"时与理想的"字面导向"或"精神导向"判定对齐；锚定损失则约束模型对场景的事实性理解（规则的文本/目的控制问题）保持与基座模型一致，避免产生一般性失真。训练数据为57个手工编写的日常规则情境（42训练/15留出），每情境交叉4种行为类型（合规/过度纳入/纳入不足/违规）和3种提示风格，共1512条训练提示。

Result: 在留出规则情境上，精神适配器显著降低过度纳入被判定为违规的概率（β=-2.46），提高纳入不足被判定为违规的概率（β=2.11）；字面适配器效果相反。在域外测试中：（1）日常"漏洞"情境（324条），精神适配器增加对漏洞行为的违抗判断（β=0.51），字面适配器降低（β=-1.0）；（2）10,000条Reddit恶意合规帖子，效果方向一致但量级较小；（3）105个历史法律案例的开放式裁决，方向与预期一致且效果强（如字面适配器β=3.67 for过度纳入）。模型在控制问题（事实理解）和MMLU基准上无显著退化。对比实验表明CAA方法无法有效引导该行为。对模型残差流进行PCA分析，发现前三主成分对应于理论预设的三维概念空间（Decision/Agreement/Approach），RSA分析显示其与假设几何的Spearman相关系数达0.76，显著优于替代假设（Δρ=0.12）。该空间呈非线性组织——表现为对适配器取负号可近似翻转其效果。

Conclusion: 研究证明，通过最小化、目标明确的适配器干预，可有效引导LLM在多种域外情境中偏向法律的字面或精神导向，且不影响通用能力。LLM内部以低维、非线性的流形组织法律相关概念，与法学理论中的Decision/Agreement/Approach三维度框架一致。这一发现为AI对齐提供了新路径：通过指定规则并引导解释方式而非堆砌规则来提升意图遵循，同时也揭示了该机制可被恶意利用以制造漏洞。该工作为AI在法律解释中的部署、可解释性和政策制定提供了方法论基础和概念框架。

Abstract: The distinction between the spirit and letter of the law is a central issue across research and everyday life, and a growing concern for building safe, intelligent machines. What is this distinction based on, and how can we develop machines that follow the intention behind a rule? We used targeted adaptation that made large language models prioritize the spirit or letter of the law. With minimal modifications, our method significantly changed LLM behavior across diverse measures, novel vignettes, real-world scenarios, and influential legal cases. An analysis of model internals revealed a low-dimensional space with three interpretable dimensions matching a formal pre-specified framework for the geometry of legal concepts. These findings show how legal thought in LLMs may be organized and directed.

</details>


### [130] [OmniEdu: Open Foundation Models for Learning and Teaching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23088)
*Hao Liang,Qihan Lin,Meiyi Qiang,Linzhuang Sun,Hengyi Feng,Mingrui Chen,Sizhe Qiu,Wentao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: OmniEdu 是一个面向 K-12 教育场景的开源基础模型家族,通过"能力导向"而非"来源导向"的指令微调数据构建方法,在课程基础、K-12 题目求解和教学辅导三类核心教育能力上均取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有教育语言模型通常专注于解题或辅导的某一方面,且训练数据多按来源或任务组织,缺乏对完整"学—教"闭环能力(学科能力、课程基础、诊断推理、教学行动与脚手架)的系统性平衡。该工作旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 1) 提出四维能力分类法:学科能力、课程基础、诊断推理、教学行动与脚手架;2) 构建六阶段数据准备流水线(确定性清洗→去污染→LLM 语义审计与改写→粗粒度多样性筛选+细粒度质量评分→基于 token 预算的多样性选择→教学指令分配),从约 134 万候选样本筛选出 69,999 条高质量样本(15.96M 监督 token);3) 基于 Qwen 基座(4B/9B/27B)进行全参数 SFT,并附加 20 种任务专属教学系统指令;4) 在课程基础(K12-Bench、MathFish、EDUMATH)、K-12 解题(GAOKAO、EXAMS-V、MDK12)、教学辅导(MathTutorBench、TutorBench、LongTutor)和通用能力(IFEval、GPQA、MMMU-Pro)四类基准上系统评测。

Result: 教育导向微调在所有规模上一致提升三类教育基准表现:OmniEdu-27B 在 K12-Bench 上达到 63.12% EM/76.69% F1(最佳),MathFish 85.89%(最佳),EDUMATH MaC 86.95%;MathTutorBench Scaffold 78.74%,LongTutor 教学平均分 3.02(被评模型中最佳);通用能力(IFEval、GPQA、MMMU-Pro)未出现显著退化,部分指标有所提升;在多个 K-12 解题基准上与更大规模闭源模型保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 精心策划、能力均衡的监督数据是将通用语言模型改造为强教育系统的有效路径;数据组合与教学行为应被视为开源教育基础模型的核心设计维度,而非仅关注答案正确性。OmniEdu 通过开放模型、数据集与训练流水线为教育大模型的可复现研究提供了完整入口。

Abstract: Educational foundation models must solve problems, understand curriculum structure, diagnose learner difficulties, and provide appropriate instructional support. Existing educational language models often focus on either problem solving or tutoring, with training mixtures organized by source or task rather than capability. We present OmniEdu, an open family of foundation models for K-12 learning and teaching. Its instruction-tuning corpus combines over 100 educational resources and general instruction sources, organized around four capabilities: subject competence, curriculum grounding, diagnostic reasoning, and pedagogical action and scaffolding. Our pipeline integrates deterministic cleaning, semantic auditing and rewriting, task-specific quality scoring, token-budgeted diversity selection, and pedagogical instruction assignment. It yields 69,999 examples and 15.96M supervised response tokens, including 60,951 education-specific examples. We fine-tune 4B, 9B, and 27B models and evaluate curriculum grounding, K-12 problem solving, and pedagogical tutoring, alongside general capability. Education-oriented tuning consistently improves all three educational benchmark groups across model scales. OmniEdu-27B achieves 63.12% EM and 76.69% F1 on K12-Bench, 85.89% on MathFish, 86.95% on EDUMATH, and 78.74% in MathTutorBench's Scaffold setting. It also achieves the highest Teaching average on LongTutor among the evaluated models, at 3.02. These results demonstrate the value of curated, capability-balanced supervision for adapting general language models to educational tasks spanning problem solving, curriculum understanding, and instructional support.

</details>


### [131] [Chronologic: Measuring Language Models' Ability to Represent the Past](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23178)
*Ted Underwood,Ziliang Qiu,Sarah Griebel,Laura K. Nelson,Edwin Roland,Wenyi Shang,Matthew Wilkens*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Chronologic-EN-1.0是一个基准测试，用于评估语言模型在1831-1930年间英语历史语境下的表现能力，包含866个问题，采用似然评分和自由生成评分两种评估路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着语言模型被广泛应用于历史研究，需要验证其输出是否符合所代表的时代特征。当前缺乏评估模型历史语境代表性的专门基准，且由于历史问题通常有多个正确答案，评估极具挑战性。

Method: 1) 从187份历史文本（包括日记、书信、报纸、教科书、审判记录、虚构作品等）中构建866个问题，涵盖填空、主题句、受限生成、人物建模、知识、推理和弃答等7种推理类型；2) 采用似然评分（开放权重模型）和自由生成评分（封闭式模型与推理模型）两种评估路径；3) 风格判断通过训练两个DeBERTa模型实现（日期预测器和人类真实性检测器）；4) 实质性判断采用通过/失败评分（二元）和Bradley-Terry部分积分评分（成对比较）；5) 每个问题配有元数据框架指定社会语境。

Result: 1) 似然评分方面，在历史文本上预训练的Talkie-1930模型占据主导地位；2) 自由生成评分方面，推理模型表现优异（如GPT-6-Astra在生成任务上达71.7%）；3) 生成任务比判别任务更难，但推理模型通常能识别自身生成答案的弱点（在多项选择格式中以71-84%的准确率拒绝自身错误答案）；4) 专门历史模型在自由生成方面无法与商业模型竞争；5) 元数据框架确实能有效引导模型（错误的语境会使分数下降6-14分）；6) GPT-4o到GPT-5.6在生成质量上提升了46分；7) 无模型能完全令人信服地代表历史语境，但进步明显。

Conclusion: Chronologic基准揭示了语言模型在历史语境代表性方面仍存在显著差距，特别是生成任务方面。似然评分和自由生成评分测量不同的能力：前者反映模型对历史写作概率的真实捕捉，后者展示模型生成上下文适当响应的能力。未来历史聊天机器人可能不是通过盲目保持模型的纯真来产生，而是通过培养更高水平的自我反思能力。同时建议，历史模型和前沿推理模型在不同任务上各有所长，两者都需改进；基准应扩展到其他时期和语言。

Abstract: Language models are appealing tools for research on the past. But to trust the evidence a model provides, researchers need to know whether its responses fit the period represented. Validation is challenging, because this is not a task living people ordinarily perform, and because many questions have multiple correct answers. We use historical texts to develop a benchmark for a model's representation of English-language contexts 1831-1930, relying on pairwise comparisons to multiple ground truths and strong distractors to score the hardest questions in an appropriately graduated way. We find that generative tasks are harder than discriminative ones; in fact, reasoning models can typically discern the weakness of their own generated answers. While models pretrained exclusively on historical text lead the pack when evaluated by answer likelihood, they cannot compete with commercial models in free generation. None of the models we tested represent historical contexts in a fully persuasive way yet, but progress toward that goal is evident.

</details>


### [132] [Low resource cross-modal alignment using HGNN to enhance speech representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23191)
*Yannick Yomie Nzeuhang,Marie Tahon,Paulin Melatagia Yonta*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于异构图神经网络（HGNN）和链接预测的数据高效跨模态对齐方法，用于在低资源语言场景下增强语音表示。该方法通过构建异构图（包含声学子图、语言学子图和声学-语言学子图），利用消息传递机制实现文本到语音模态的信息显式转移。在TIMIT（英语）和Yemba（喀麦隆语）上的词级对齐实验表明，该方法仅需9M参数、32 CPU和数分钟至数小时训练即可达到与SAMU-XLSR（300M参数、32 V100 GPU、6.8K小时数据、400K迭代）相当甚至更优的性能，尤其在Yemba低资源语言上表现突出。文章还引入了发音特征表征和音素袋表征两种语音学表示用于音素对齐任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的语音-文本跨模态对齐方法（如SAMU-XLSR）采用师生框架，需要微调大规模音频编码器（数十亿参数）和海量并行数据，计算资源消耗巨大，难以应用于低资源语言。本文旨在解决低资源、计算受限条件下语音表示语义增强的问题。

Method: 1. 构建异构图G，包含三个子图：(i)声学子图G_a（节点为词语音样本，边权重基于转录相似度）；(ii)语言学子图G_l（节点为词转录，边基于语言学相似度阈值δ_l构建）；(iii)声学-语言学子图G_al（连接两种节点）。语言学表示采用三种：LaBSE多语言语义向量、发音特征向量（24维PanPhon）、音素袋向量。声学表示采用XLSR/Wav2Vec2预训练特征。2. 使用GraphSAGE（平均聚合器）单层卷积进行归纳式学习。3. 损失函数包含三项：(i)二元交叉熵链接预测损失L_reg；(ii)异构对比损失L_contrast（InfoNCE，τ=0.07，对齐声学-文本对）；(iii)同构对比损失L_acoustic（保留声学局部相似性）。总损失L_total = L_reg + αL_contrast + βL_acoustic（α=β=0.1）。4. 在TIMIT（109词）和Yemba（60词）数据集上进行传递式和归纳式评估，使用内/类间相似度、WO@k词重叠率、PO@k音素重叠率作为指标。

Result: 在TIMIT传递式设置下：XLSR+HGNN+LaBSE的WO@5达30.6%（SAMU-XLSR为17.0%），PO@5达42.2%（SAMU-XLSR为29.4%），类间相似度从0.89降至更低。在Yemba传递式设置下：XLSR+HGNN+音素袋的WO@5为22.2%（SAMU-XLSR为13.6%），PO@5达38.6%。在Yemba归纳式设置下：SAMU-XLSR因Yemba不在XLSR和LaBSE训练语料中导致WO@5和PO@5均为0%，而HGNN方法仍保持11.8%-20.0%的性能。计算资源方面：本文方法仅需9M参数、32 CPU、1K迭代（TIMIT 23分钟，Yemba 2小时），相比SAMU-XLSR的300M参数、32 V100 GPU、6.8K小时数据、400K迭代大幅降低。发音特征表征在音素检索任务上表现最佳，LaBSE在语义检索任务上表现最佳。

Conclusion: 本文首次将异构图神经网络应用于语音-文本跨模态对齐，证明链接预测+消息传递框架能够在极低资源条件下有效增强声学表示。该方法在保持与SOTA方法相当甚至更优性能的同时，显著降低了数据和计算需求，对低资源语言场景具有重要价值。未来工作将拓展至句子级对齐，并探索在语音合成、语音识别等下游任务中的应用。

Abstract: Speech-text space alignment is a multimodal representation learning method consisting to map different speech and text into a shared representation space, leading to enrichment of the representation of each modality. Proposed architectures, such as SAMU-XLSR, typically follow a student/teacher framework, with the goal of fine-tuning an audio encoder to produce representations that closely match those of the text. In this way a speech representation is semantically enriched. However, such systems generally require large amounts of training data and considerable computational resource, making them difficult to apply to low resources languages under frugal constraints. The present work proposes a data-efficient space alignment method based on Heterogeneous Graph Neural Networks and link prediction. The core idea is to leverage message passing to explicitly transfer information from the text modality to the speech modality, thereby reducing the need for large training datasets and intrinsically enriching the acoustic representations, all in a more interpretable manner. Although thoroughly explored for high-resource languages, word-level tasks in speech remain relevant for certain low-resource languages. Therefore, we conducted experiments on speech-text alignment at the word level using the TIMIT (English) dataset and Yemba (a Cameroonian language). Our approach yields results comparable to those of SAMU-XLSR, a state-of-the-art method, and even surpasses it for the Yemba language in the task of word retrieval, while using far fewer resources, demonstrating its power, frugality, and efficiency.

</details>


### [133] [Enhancing speech representation learning with cross-modal knowledge transfer with HGNN under low resource settings: the case study of Yemba](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23194)
*Yannick Yomie Nzeuhang,Paulin Melatagia Yonta,Marie Tahon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于异构图神经网络（HGNN）的跨模态知识迁移方法，用于在低资源语言（如喀麦隆的Yemba语）中增强声学表示学习。通过将声学和语言学实体建模为统一图中的不同节点类型，并利用消息传递机制将语言知识显式迁移到声学节点，显著提升了孤立词识别性能和聚类质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低资源语言（LRLs）面临严重的音频数据稀缺问题，传统声学特征和自监督学习方法效果有限。现有的多语言跨模态SSL模型虽然能从高资源语言迁移知识，但这种迁移是隐式的（发生在模型参数层面），且仍需大量数据。本文旨在探索通过异构图神经网络实现显式跨模态知识迁移的可行性。

Method: 构建包含三个子图的异构图：(1)声学子图（基于MFCC特征和DTW相似度），(2)语言学子图（基于"音素袋"模型的词嵌入和余弦相似度），(3)声学-语言学子图（通过预训练的声学模型AM输出概率分布连接）。采用GraphSAGE型的GCN，mean聚合器，损失函数为交叉熵（节点预测）和MSE（边权重优化）的线性组合。推理阶段采用归纳式方法处理未见节点。使用MFCC作为声学特征以避免对预训练模型的依赖，保持语言无关性。

Result: 在Google Speech Commands（GC）和Yemba Dataset（YD）两个数据集上的实验表明：跨模态方法（CM）始终优于声学单模态方法（ACOUS）和MFCC基线。GC数据集上SVM准确率从MFCC的49.0%提升至CM的72.3%；YD从72.1%提升至76.1%。聚类指标显示CM具有更高的类间惯量、显著降低的类内惯量，以及更明显的同词-异词相似度差异，表明生成的表示更具区分性和词特异性。

Conclusion: 本文首次展示了使用HGNN进行显式跨模态知识迁移增强声学表示学习的可行性，证明语言知识通过图结构显式传播能持续提升低资源场景下的声学表示质量。然而仍需在相似度度量、声学/语言嵌入等方面进一步改进，并扩展到句子级表示学习。

Abstract: Acoustic representation learning is crucial for speech processing, yet low-resource languages (LRLs) face severe data scarcity, limiting the effectiveness of traditional and self-supervised methods. As a promising alternative, in this work, we propose to enhance acoustic representation trough a cross-modal transfer knowledge approach, based on heterogeneous graph neural networks (HGNNs), where acoustic and linguistic entities are modeled as distinct node types within a unified graph. Through message-passing mechanisms, linguistic nodes explicitly transfer knowledge to acoustic nodes, enabling structured and interpretable cross-modal information flow. To highlight this knowledge transfer and its benefits, we measured standard clustering metrics as an intrinsic evaluation of acoustic representation, and to emphasize applicability, we performed isolated-word recognition tasks using an English benchmark and a Cameroonian language dataset in low resources settings . Results demonstrate that acoustic representations consistently benefit from linguistic knowledge propagated through the graph. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of explicit cross-modal knowledge transfer for acoustic representation learning using HGNNs, highlighting a promising direction for speech representation in low-resource settings.

</details>


### [134] [Euston: Training Away Mathematical Sycophancy Without Losing the Mathematics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23205)
*Zehua Cheng,Wei Dai,Jiahao Sun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Euston，一个8B数学声明验证模型，基于DeepSeek-R1-8B通过GRPO和GraphSynth生成的配对真假陈述数据集进行微调，旨在消除数学谄媚（sycophancy）问题，同时保持通用数学推理能力不显著下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理语言模型被训练为"产出解答"而非"拒绝解答"，这导致当面对错误命题（如被篡改的定理）时，模型会迎合性地推导出不真实结论，即"数学谄媚"问题。作者希望训练模型能够正确识别并拒绝假命题，同时不损害其通用数学能力。

Method: 1) 数据生成：使用GraphSynth（概率因子图生成器，结合属性级多样性与解码时结构掩码及span同步验证）从2010-2025年arXiv论文中生成3,026对真假匹配陈述（6,052条），训练集与评估集时间上完全分离；2) 训练方法：对DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B进行GRPO微调，使用基于规则、零API调用的奖励（仅检查最终\boxed{}答案是否匹配真值标签True/False），KL系数0.001，熵系数0，4×H100 GPU训练189步约13.8小时；3) 评估协议：平衡200真/200假分割（无法靠全拒绝策略取巧）、官方BrokenArXiv协议、AIME 2026能力保留测试。

Result: 1) 平衡分割平衡准确率从29.50%提升至63.75%，判别差距从-0.5pp(z=-0.1)提升至+27.5pp(z=+6.0)，其中约18pp来自可解析输出比例提升，16.3pp来自实际判断能力；2) 配对裁决中，在模型做出区分的57.3%对中准确率达84.1%；3) AIME 2026官方语义准确率65.00% vs基线69.17%（差-4.17pp，95%CI[-10.83,+2.50]，不显著），而先前小数据集Euston-pilot仅40.00%（显著退化）；4) 响应中位数从19,217降至18,296 tokens，截断率从25.8%降至8.3%，改进并非来自更长思考；5) 消融实验表明：Evol-Instruct负面样本效果差，监督微调（含LoRA/DoRA）即使使用GraphSynth数据也仅小幅提升，验证了GRPO在线策略与高质量配对负样本均为必要。

Conclusion: 训练推理模型识别假数学同时保持通用数学能力是可行的，Euston在此取得显著判别提升且AIME能力损失不显著；关键在于负样本质量——结构良好、语义非平凡的负样本迫使模型真正判别而非走"更怀疑"的捷径。主要局限包括：1) Euston现在拒绝51.5%的真陈述（变"更怀疑"而非"更好数学家"），在99:1真实基率下实用价值有限；2) 官方BrokenArXiv评测集全假构成使disprove指标存在退化解；3) Euston-pilot对比非受控消融，无法干净分解数据量与生成质量的贡献；4) 上界（仅计完成运行）下Euston仍存在-12.96pp显著退化，揭示真实能力损失被完成率提升掩盖。

Abstract: Reasoning language models are trained to produce solutions, not to refuse them, and this bias persists when the problem they are handed is false. Asked to prove a corrupted theorem, a strong model will typically comply and produce a confident derivation of something untrue. We present Euston, an 8B mathematical claim-verification model trained to resist exactly this. Training data were generated with GraphSynth, a probabilistic factor-graph generator that couples attribute-level diversity to decode-time structural masking and span-synchronized verification, yielding 3{,}026 matched true/corrupted statement pairs (6,052 statements) drawn from arXiv papers spanning 2010--2025. We fine-tuned DeepSeek-R1-8B with GRPO under a rule-based, zero-API reward for 189 steps on four H100 GPUs. On a balanced 200-true/200-false held-out split, balanced accuracy rises from 29.50% to 63.75% and the discrimination gap---the difference between the rate of calling false statements false and the rate of calling true statements false moves from -0.5% (z=-0.1) to +27.5% (z=+6.0). Critically, the gain is not purchased with general mathematical ability: AIME 2026 accuracy under official semantics is 65.00% against a 69.17% base, a difference of -4.17% that is not statistically significant, whereas an earlier run of the same recipe on a smaller GraphSynth corpus collapsed to 40.00%. Median response length also falls from 19,217 to 18,296 tokens and the truncation rate from 25.8% to 8.3%, so the improvement does not come from thinking longer. We report the result together with the confounds that bound its interpretation, principally the all-false composition of the official evaluation sets and the low precision implied at realistic error prevalence.

</details>


### [135] [ChemCLIR-Bench: Benchmarking Cross-Lingual Information Retrieval in Multilingual Chemical Patents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23231)
*Mahdi Astaraki,Mohammad Khodadad,Reza Namazi,Mohammad Arshi Saloot,Amir Reza Behzad Moghadam,Hamidreza Mahyar,Soheila Samiee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了ChemCLIR-Bench，一个面向化学领域专利的跨语言信息检索基准，涵盖五种语言，系统评估了八个多语言嵌入模型，揭示了单语与跨语言检索之间存在的显著性能差距以及重新排序难以恢复的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在跨国工业环境中，关键技术证据常以非查询语言存储，检索失败可能导致遗漏现有技术或不完整的监管分析。现有基准未能充分覆盖领域特定的跨语言检索，也未能揭示聚合召回指标所掩盖的检索深度与可恢复性失效。

Method: 从Google Patents和EPO构建多语言问答-上下文数据集（涵盖英、法、西、德、中），由LLM生成问题并由独立验证器评分，经领域专家三轮反馈优化。提出语言感知评估框架，分离单语（MLIR）与跨语言（CLIR）检索，引入覆盖深度指标（k₈₀）、跨语言阅读成本乘数（XRC）、重排序可恢复性上限（RRC）与对齐可恢复性指数（ARI），评估八个多语言嵌入模型。

Result: 跨语言检索存在一致且显著的下降：最佳模型Recall@10从单语的0.72降至跨语言的0.53；相同语言证据在数十篇内即可检索到，而跨语言版本需数百篇；阅读成本乘数（XRC₅₀）为1.9×至6.0×；重排序可恢复性上限仅0.78（top-100），且存在无法通过重排序恢复的"对齐下限"；e5-large-instruct在跨语言场景下性能崩溃（0.09/0.12）。跨语言对齐而非整体检索能力是主要瓶颈。

Conclusion: 当前多语言嵌入模型在领域特定的跨语言检索中面临根本性限制，单纯依赖重排序无法弥合差距，亟需更强的跨语言表示对齐方法。ChemCLIR-Bench提供了一个可复用的诊断评估框架，为模型选择提供实用指导。

Abstract: Cross-lingual information retrieval (CLIR) is increasingly important in multi-national industries, where critical technical evidence may exist in a different language than the query. However, existing benchmarks do not adequately capture domain-specific cross-lingual retrieval or the retrieval-depth and recoverability failures that aggregate recall hides. In this work, we benchmark CLIR in the chemical domain, with a focus on patent data. We construct a multilingual dataset from Google Patents and the European Patent Office (EPO) data, spanning five languages (covering major Eastern and Western languages) and reflecting the diversity and complexity of real-world industrial documentation. Using this dataset, we systematically evaluate eight state-of-the-art embedding models for cross-lingual retrieval. Our results show a substantial performance gap between monolingual and cross-lingual settings: for the best-performing model, Recall@10 drops from 0.72 to 0.53 in cross-lingual setting. Retrieval depth also degrades significantly, with relevant documents ranked lower across languages in cross-lingual scenarios. Furthermore, some multilingual embedding models that perform strongly in monolingual settings exhibit sharp declines when queries and documents are in different languages, providing practical insights for model selection in cross-lingual use cases. These findings highlight critical limitations of current approaches and emphasize the need for more robust cross-lingual retrieval methods in domain-specific settings. Our benchmark provides actionable insights for model selection and establishes a controlled diagnostic evaluation framework for CLIR over industrial technical text. Data and code are publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [136] [SoK: Formal Methods for Fact-Checking and Information Integrity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23239)
*Nikolaos Kekatos,Theodoros Nestoridis,Charalampos Bratsas,Charalampos Dimoulas,Georgios Konstantinidis,Georgios Malogiannis,Michael Sirivianos,Andreas Veglis*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 这是一篇关于自动化事实核查中形式化方法应用的系统化综述（SoK）。作者批评现有事实核查系统只输出真假标签，缺乏可独立验证的"授权依据"（warrant）。论文将121篇文献按"被形式化对象"而非"流水线阶段"组织，构建了一个五层保障栈（声明、推理、系统、生态系统、监管），并指出形式化工具成熟但迁移应用不足，以及专业核查流程中存在规范缺失等关键问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前自动化事实核查系统主要输出真假标签，但缺乏可审计、可独立验证的证据（如引用来源、判决翻转条件、改写后的稳定性等）。与此同时，欧盟《数字服务法》（DSA）和《人工智能法案》均要求系统行为的可审计证据。论文旨在梳理形式化方法如何填补这一空白，并揭示现有研究中的规范缺失与采纳缺口。

Method: 1. 术语界定：狭义定义"形式化方法"为产生机器可检验、具有明确语义工件的技术。2. 文献检索：以形式化方法术语与信息完整性术语的交叉查询作为种子集，再前后向引文追踪至收敛（截至2026年8月31日）。3. 编码框架：对121篇文献按五层保障栈（L1声明/L2推理/L3系统/L4生态系统/L5治理）和三类角色（直接应用、迁移候选、背景资料）进行编码。4. 对比分析：将现有八项综述与本文的覆盖范围对比，并提出三个研究问题（RQ1-3）进行量化回答。

Result: 1. 五层保障栈中，L1和L2最成熟（直接应用分别为13和9篇），但L3（系统验证）仅有4篇直接应用对应21篇迁移候选，L5（治理）直接应用为0。2. 专业核查九阶段中存在规范缺失：S3（匹配）与S7（辩护）已有实现但缺乏正确性标准，S4（构建可核查声明）与S8（修正已发布裁定）甚至缺乏形式化操作定义。3. 提出了四个核心发现（F1-F4）：采纳缺口、规范缺口、评估缺口、组合缺口。4. 列出了11个开放问题，每个均给出具体的第一步研究路径。5. 通过具体案例（塞浦路斯失业率声明）展示了五层栈中工件可组合性的缺失。

Conclusion: 自动化事实核查被优化为产出裁定，而使裁定可验证的"授权依据"仍属例外而非标准输出。形式化工具成熟但未被本领域采纳，核心障碍在于规范（specification）的缺失而非方法的不存在。监管需求日益将可审计证据从可选项变为必选项，而该领域自身的职业准则已部分阐明了所需规范。未来工作应聚焦于规范声明范围的语言设计、自动形式化的忠实性保证、关系型扰动集的建立，以及将监管义务转化为技术验证等方面。

Abstract: An automated fact-checking system returns a label: the claim is true, or it is false. In many such systems the verdict remains the primary output. What is generally missing is a record of which document settled the question, of what would have had to be different for the verdict to change, or of whether the same claim, reworded, would have been judged the same way. We call the missing piece a warrant: a separate statement of what was guaranteed and on what grounds. Formal methods produce evidence of this kind, and regulation is beginning to ask for it, since the Digital Services Act and the AI Act both call for auditable evidence about how systems behave. Surveys of automated fact-checking are usually organised by pipeline stage, and treat logic as one technique among many. We organise the field by what is being formalised instead, which gives five levels: the claim, the reasoning, the system doing the checking, the ecosystem the claim spreads through, and the regulatory obligation. Sorting 121 works into those levels, two patterns stand out. Most of the relevant formal machinery already exists, but it was built for other domains and has rarely been applied here, and the gap is widest for verifying the checking system itself. Several stages of the routine professional fact-checkers follow also have no stated correctness criterion, and two of them, writing a claim in checkable form and correcting a verdict already published, are not formally specified in any work we coded. We close with open problems, each with a suggested first step.

</details>


### [137] [Judging a Review by its Cover: A Reliability Analysis of LLM-based Peer Review Evaluation Metrics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23264)
*Shakiba Amirshahi,Sajad Ebrahimi,Hai Son Le,Negar Arabzadeh,Ebrahim Bagheri*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统计框架，用于检验同行评审评估指标（LLM-as-a-judge）是否真正捕捉评审的实质内容质量，而不仅仅是表面语言流畅性。研究通过对比原始人类评审与其LLM改写版（保留评价内容、改变措辞），发现29个指标中23个对改写敏感，仅6个满足稳健性标准，表明多数指标混淆了评审质量与语言呈现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM-as-a-judge在自动化同行评审评估中的广泛应用，存在一个测量风险：评审可能因流畅性、组织性和文采而获得高分，而非因其对论文的实质性评价。尤其在AI辅助评审情境下，评审者使用LLM改善表述却保留核心判断，这一风险被放大。作者旨在检验现有同行评审评估指标是否在表面语言特征之外真正捕捉了评审质量。

Method: 提出一个统计框架，包含"表面对比"和"鲁棒性"两类互补检验。构建数据集：从ICLR和NeurIPS获取674条人类评审，由LLM生成4,044条保留评价内容的忠实改写。评估4项先前工作中提出的29个内容导向型同行评审评估指标，使用两个LLM裁判模型进行评分，通过对比原始评审与改写评审的得分差异来检验指标对语言表层的敏感性。

Result: 在主要分析中，29个指标中有23个对意义保留改写表现出显著的评分差异（敏感），仅6个满足鲁棒性标准。该模式在两个LLM裁判模型下大体一致，表明问题并非特定于某一裁判模型。结果揭示许多同行评审评估指标部分混淆了评审质量与语言呈现。

Conclusion: 研究证明许多用于评估同行评审的指标无法区分实质评审内容与表面语言形式，部分将"写得好"等同于"评得好"。在将此类指标用于比较人类撰写、AI辅助和AI生成的评审之前，必须验证其对意义保留改写的稳健性。

Abstract: Peer-review evaluation is increasingly being automated with LLM-as-a-judge metrics, but this creates a measurement risk. A review may receive a high score because it is fluent, organized, and polished, rather than because it provides a strong evaluation of the paper. This risk is especially important in AI-assisted reviewing, where reviewers may use LLMs to improve clarity or presentation while preserving the underlying judgments. We propose a statistical framework for testing whether peer-review evaluation metrics capture substantive review quality beyond surface-level linguistic form. The framework compares original human reviews with faithful LLM rewrites that preserve the same evaluative content while changing wording and presentation. Using a dataset comprising 4,044 meaning-preserving rewrites derived from 674 human reviews from ICLR and NeurIPS, we evaluate 29 content-oriented peer-review evaluation metrics drawn from four prior works through complementary tests of surface sensitivity and robustness. Although these metrics are intended to capture review properties beyond surface-level, writing-dependent characteristics, we find that sensitivity to rewriting is widespread. Under our primary analysis, 23 metrics assign significantly different scores to reviews whose evaluative content is preserved, while only six satisfy our robustness criterion. The patterns are largely consistent across two LLM judge models, suggesting that the issue is not specific to a single judge. These findings show that many peer-review evaluation metrics partially conflate review quality with linguistic presentation, and indicate that robustness to meaning-preserving rewriting should be validated before such metrics are used to compare human-written, AI-assisted, and AI-generated reviews.

</details>


### [138] [Perplexity Predicts Protection: Choosing Pretrained Backbones for Worst-Client Fairness in Federated Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23463)
*Kiran Naseer,Samreen Azhar,Umar Shoaib,Haroon Mahmood,Muhammad Awais*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究联邦学习中使用LoRA进行参数高效微调时，预训练骨干模型的选择对数据量最少的"最差客户端"公平性的影响。研究发现骨干模型在目标任务文本上的逐词困惑度（perplexity）越低，对最差客户端的提升越大（Spearman秩相关系数−0.87），且个性化方法（如Ditto）无法弥补这一差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习中各客户端数据量差异较大时，即使全局平均准确率良好，数据稀缺的客户端也可能被严重忽略。在LoRA等参数高效微调场景下，尚不清楚预训练骨干模型的选择是否影响最差客户端的性能，以及能否在联邦训练开始前就预测哪种骨干模型能保护弱势客户端。

Method: 在3个文本分类数据集上，使用3个规模相近的预训练模型（RoBERTa、BERTweet、PubMedBERT），对每个数据集-骨干组合在相同数据划分下与任务专用基线对比，共进行313次联邦LoRA微调实验。使用逐词困惑度作为骨干模型选择指标，并测试Ditto个性化方法的效果以及更新冲突假设。

Result: 1）在9个数据集-骨干对中，困惑度越低的骨干对最差客户端的提升越大，秩相关系数为−0.87；2）一个留出分析的骨干确认了该模式；3）Ditto个性化仅恢复了单独训练与完全联邦之间差距的4–12%；4）去除联邦聚合则完全消除收益；5）客户端更新与全局更新接近正交，排除了更新冲突的解释。

Conclusion: 在联邦LoRA微调中，应在联邦训练开始前先在目标任务文本样本上测量困惑度来选择骨干模型；不应依赖个性化方法来保护数据稀缺的客户端。该工作为联邦参数高效微调中的模型选择提供了简单、可预测的经验准则。

Abstract: Federated learning lets multiple parties train a shared model without pooling their data, but a client with far less data than the others can end up poorly served even when the group's average accuracy looks fine. We ask whether the choice of pretrained backbone affects this under LoRA fine-tuning, and whether per-word perplexity on the target text predicts which backbone helps the worst-off client before federated training starts. We ran 313 experiments across three text-classification datasets and three similarly sized backbones (RoBERTa, BERTweet, PubMedBERT), each compared against a task-specific baseline on identical data splits. Lower-perplexity backbones consistently produced larger gains for the worst-performing client, with a rank correlation of -0.87 across nine dataset-backbone pairs; a backbone held out of the analysis confirmed the pattern. Personalization with Ditto recovered only 4-12% of the gap between training alone and full federation, and removing aggregation entirely erased the benefit. A client's update also showed no sign of conflicting with the group's update; the two are close to orthogonal, ruling out one proposed explanation for this failure. Practically: measure perplexity on a sample of task text before choosing a backbone, and do not rely on personalization to protect a data-poor client. We release our code, predictions, and full results for others to test.

</details>


### [139] [BabelArena: A Large-Scale Multilingual Benchmark for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23490)
*Peng Kuang,Yuchun Fan,Jiangnan Li,Minghao Wu,Jialong Tang,Hao-Ran Wei,Weixuan Wang,Jianhong Tu,Baosong Yang,Tong Xiao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出BabelFlow工作流，将现有英语智能体基准适配到多语言环境，并据此构建大规模多语言基准BabelArena（16,146实例，23种语言，13个领域，702个任务）。实验揭示低资源语言下智能体在工具使用、控制流错误上占比更高，且token消耗显著增加（输入可达英文2倍），同时语言一致性在结构化输出任务中明显退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体基准评估以英语为中心，缺乏对多语言端到端智能体工作流（涉及工具调用、用户交互、环境执行）的全面评估。多语言适配面临执行性保持、跨组件一致性、评估有效性、评估效率四大挑战。

Method: 提出BabelFlow工作流，包含五个步骤：1) 运行时数据流分析识别可翻译字段；2) 翻译类型分配（Preserve/Translate-Free/Translate-Canonical）；3) 结构保留的字段提取与重建；4) 多层验证（完整性、跨工件一致性、语义保真、行为等价性）；5) 人类评审。基于此将VitaBench、DeepPlanning、τ³-Bench、ClawEval四个基准适配到23种语言。

Result: BabelFlow将中文适配的断引用率从20.0%降至2.5%，无行为失配（代价是token成本3.35倍）。评估五个前沿模型（Claude-Opus-4.8, GPT-5.6-Terra, Gemini-3.1-Pro, Qwen-3.7/3.8-Max）发现：无单一模型在所有基准族占优；低资源语言Pass^1与LC均显著下降；泰米尔语、泰语失败案例中工具使用与控制流错误占比更高；低资源语言constant input达英文1.89-2.51倍；91.2%的语言不一致切换方向为英语。

Conclusion: BabelArena为推进可靠、高效的多语言智能体研究提供了基础。核心发现：跨语言差距不仅在于任务成功率，还涉及执行可靠性、token效率与语言一致性，尤其在低资源语言中表现突出，亟需针对低资源语言的多语言智能体研究。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly execute multi-step workflows through tool use and interaction with users and environments. However, current agent evaluations are largely English-centric, limiting our understanding of agent capabilities in multilingual settings. We introduce BabelFlow, a benchmark-general agentic workflow that adapts existing agent benchmarks to new languages by analyzing runtime dependencies, coordinating structure-preserving translation, and combining multi-layer verification with human review to preserve task and evaluation semantics. Using BabelFlow, we construct BabelArena, a task-aligned benchmark comprising 16,146 instances derived from 702 canonical tasks across four benchmark families, 13 domains, and 23 languages. Experiments with five frontier models show that no single model dominates across benchmark families and that cross-language disparities extend well beyond task success. Lower-resource languages exhibit distinct failure patterns, with larger shares of tool-use and control-flow errors rather than answer-quality errors alone, pointing to gaps in reliable task execution across the resource levels of these languages. On the same tasks, agents in low-resource languages also consume substantially more tokens than in English (up to roughly twice the input) without proportional increases in interaction length, and language consistency degrades further on tasks requiring structured output, where switches are directed overwhelmingly toward English. We believe BabelArena provides a foundation for advancing research on reliable and efficient multilingual agents.

</details>


### [140] [Paragraph Boundaries Are Not White Space:Compression Depth as the Signature of Hierarchical Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23551)
*Shuyang Xiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究Transformer中段落层级的层次位置编码是否对注意力产生因果影响。通过构建层级旋转位置编码（hRoPE），在固定token序列的情况下干预段落坐标p₁，测量跨段落注意力的压缩效应。研究发现：(1) 阅读顺序不足以表示层级结构；(2) 段落边界处注意力存在压缩，但压缩本身不足以诊断真实结构；(3) 区分真伪结构的关键是压缩深度而非位置；(4) 在所测试的八个语料库统计量中，没有任何完全再现深度的跨语料库排序，但嵌入连贯性最接近。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准的Transformer位置编码仅使用一维阅读顺序坐标来表示位置，但文本是嵌套的层次结构（文档⊃段落⊃句子⊃token）。相同的token序列可以有指数级数量的段落切分方式，因此阅读顺序无法充分表达层级结构。本文旨在探究：(1) 段落边界是否会引起注意力的压缩；(2) 这种压缩深度是否在真实段落结构下比随机控制条件下更大。

Method: 本文提出了层次旋转位置编码（hRoPE），将段落(p₁)、句子(p₂)和token(p₃)索引编码为独立的旋转通道组。在WikiText-2、OpenWebText和Python代码三个语料库上训练五种位置编码变体：flat（标准RoPE）、sent_axial（仅p₂和p₃）、hrope_axial（完整三层）、rand_axial（p₁为密度匹配的随机标签）和period_axial（p₁为机械周期网格的反镜控制）。通过fake-merge和fake-split反事实干预，在固定token序列的情况下改变段落坐标。使用token距离精确估计器测量跨段落注意力（通过距离残差化注意力D_eff），定义压缩深度U*和位移Δp₁*，并通过文档级聚类自助法量化不确定性。第三层比较八个语料库统计量（包括词汇持续性λ_struct、段落长度和嵌入连贯性）与观测的压缩深度排序。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 在所有三个语料库中，干预p₁（fake-merge产生负效应Δ_B，fake-split产生正效应Δ_C）显著改变了注意力，证实段落坐标具有因果作用。(2) 所有语料库在段落边界附近都表现出压缩（U<0），但在精确距离协议下，rand_axial控制组也表现出压缩，因此压缩本身不能诊断真实结构。(3) 压缩深度U*在所有语料库中是稳定的：Code为-0.772，WikiText-2为-0.481，OpenWebText为-0.305。(4) 在两个语料库（Code和WikiText-2）中，hrope_axial与rand_axial的深度差异在配对自助法下排除零，第三个语料库（OpenWebText）由于种子数限制无法解析。(5) 八个语料库统计量中，没有任何完全再现压缩深度的跨语料库排序（Code>WikiText-2>OpenWebText）；词汇持续性λ_struct将WikiText-2和OpenWebText的顺序颠倒了；嵌入连贯性（特别是聚合连贯性）最接近但仍无法完全重现。(6) 命题5.1排除了最简单的加性竞争过程家族作为机制解释。

Conclusion: 本文得出以下结论：(1) 阅读顺序位置不足以表示层级文本位置——同一token序列可对应指数级数量的段落切分。(2) 注意力在段落边界附近确实压缩，且这是层次位置的因果效应。(3) 压缩本身并非真实结构的标志——随机坐标同样会产生压缩。区分真实结构与随机结构的是压缩深度（而非位置），且深度具有语料库依赖性。(4) 所测试的语料库统计量中，词汇持续性、段落长度和嵌入连贯性均未完全再现深度的跨语料库排序，其中嵌入连贯性最接近。(5) 文中不主张Transformer必然隐式表示段落结构；当存在专门的p₁通道时，训练权重对内容敏感，而不仅仅对通道存在敏感。(6) 压缩深度而非位置，是本研究情境下真实段落结构的可复现标志。开放问题包括：什么决定了语料库依赖的深度、为什么在两个语料库中真实/随机的差异是可解析的而在第三个中不是、以及非加性（softmax竞争）机制是否解释了观测到的响应曲线形状。

Abstract: Standard positional encodings represent position as a one-dimensional reading-order coordinate, but reading order alone does not determine hierarchical textual structure. We use a hierarchical rotary positional encoding (hRoPE) that represents paragraph, sentence, and token indices as separate channels, hold the token sequence fixed, intervene on the paragraph coordinate p1, and measure cross-paragraph attention with a token-distance-exact estimator. Attention is compressed relative to a token-distance-matched baseline in every corpus, but compression alone is not diagnostic of true structure: an architecturally identical channel with density-matched random labels is compressed too, more shallowly. What distinguishes real structure is the depth of compression, which is greater and corpus-dependent while the control's is not. Comparing eight corpus-only quantities across three constructs (lexical persistence, paragraph length, embedding-based coherence), none fully reproduces the cross-corpus ordering of depth, though embedding-based coherence comes closest. Compression depth, not its location, is the reproducible signature of genuine paragraph structure in our setting.

</details>


### [141] [Error-Supervised Synthetic Learner Writing for Automated Essay Scoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23573)
*Duy Anh Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种简单方法，通过在错误标注的GED/GEC学习者语料上微调LLM生成器，为自动作文评分（AES）生成具有学习者真实错误特征的合成作文。在三个学习者语料（CLC FCE、W&I、ELLIPSE）上的实验表明，在较大数据规模下，该方法在12项数据集-指标对比中11项优于传统合成基线，性能接近真实作文；但在极低资源（50/100样本）条件下优势不稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AES系统依赖大量人工评分作文，成本高昂。合成作文可缓解数据稀缺问题，但现有合成作文往往过于流畅、缺少学习者典型错误，无法真实反映学习者写作特征，尤其对英语学习者写作评分场景构成挑战。GED/GEC领域已积累大量带错误标注的学习者语料，但这些标注尚未被用于改进合成作文生成。

Method: 1) 数据：使用三个英语学习者语料——CLC FCE（人工错误标注）、Write & Improve（ERRANT标注）、ELLIPSE（通过GECToR+ERRANT自动生成错误标注）。2) 生成器：基于Qwen2-7B-Instruct，使用QLoRA进行参数高效微调，将作文+错误标签的标注序列作为生成目标。3) 标注格式标准化为<ERR type="..." cor="...">错误文本</ERR>格式，推理时通过正则去除标签得到含错误的表面作文。4) AES评估：使用BERT作为评分器，在真实作文、传统合成作文（无错误监督）和本文合成作文三种条件下，分别在50/100/200/完整训练规模上微调与评估，对比MAE、RMSE、Spearman、QWK、Accuracy、F1等指标。5) 生成质量分析：人工检查+误差密度+误差类型分布的Jensen-Shannon散度。

Result: 较大数据规模下，本文方法在12项数据集-指标对比中11项优于传统合成基线。CLC FCE完整数据上MAE/RMSE甚至略优于真实数据。W&I完整数据上Accuracy从0.5876提升至0.6983，QWK从0.7504提升至0.8209，接近真实作文性能。ELLIPSE（2000样本）上四个指标均优于传统基线，但与真实作文仍有差距。低资源（50/100样本）条件下优势不稳定，n=200时优势开始显现但跨语料不一致。生成作文的误差类型分布与真实作文JSD大多低于0.25，但误差密度普遍低于真实作文，且存在过度纠错、重复、语义不一致等问题。ELLIPSE的自动标注带来约16.89个百分点的标点符号标注偏差。

Conclusion: 仅通过修改生成器的监督信号（加入错误标注）即可提升合成学习者作文对AES的下游效用，无需复杂的后处理错误注入管道。该方法可利用现有GEC/GED标注资源，并将适用范围扩展到仅有原始学习者作文的语料（通过自动标注工具）。但在极低资源场景下优势不稳定，生成作文未能完全复制真实学习者的误差密度和特征，且计算开销显著增加（生成时间增加约80%-120%）。未来工作应验证其在其他语言、生成器架构和更大规模下的泛化性。

Abstract: Synthetic essays can help reduce dependence on human-written data in Automated Essay Scoring (AES). However, they often lack realistic errors, limiting their ability to represent authentic human writing, particularly when the target texts are intended to resemble those produced by language learners. In this study, we present a simple approach that introduces error supervision into synthetic essay generation. Specifically, we fine-tune an LLM generator on error-annotated texts of the kind commonly used in Grammatical Error Detection (GED). To assess the utility of the proposed approach, we fine-tune and evaluate AES scorers under three data conditions: authentic essays, synthetic essays generated conventionally, and synthetic essays generated using our proposed approach. The results show that in the larger-data settings, the proposed approach outperforms the conventional synthetic baseline in 11 out of 12 dataset-metric comparisons, with performance in some cases approaching that of models trained on authentic essays. Despite these gains, performance under extremely low-resource settings remains mixed, with advantages over the conventional baseline only becoming more apparent at 200 training essays, although not consistently across datasets. Qualitative and quantitative analyses further show that the proposed approach produces learner-like errors whose distributions broadly resemble those observed in authentic essays.

</details>


### [142] [Constrained Decoding Eliminates Structural Failures in Small LLMs but Reveals a Scale-Dependent Semantic Gap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23742)
*Akash Chavan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了小型开源LLM（0.6B–4B）在结构化输出任务中，约束解码（Constrained Decoding, CD）与模型规模之间的交互作用。通过对5个模型、14个任务、3种解码条件的受控基准测试，发现CD能完全消除结构性失败，但语义正确性方面仍存在与规模相关的差距——类型强制失败可被CD完全修复，而指令-语义失败（如多步函数调用）则对CD具有抵抗力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型开源LLM常产生结构无效的输出（如类型强制、字段缺失、JSON格式错误）。约束解码框架（如Outlines、XGrammar）承诺通过遮蔽无效token来保证schema有效性，但一个关键问题尚未明确：CD究竟使输出"正确"，还是仅仅"格式良好"？尤其在模型规模维度上——如果CD能"拯救"一个1B模型，实践者是否就不需要4B模型？现有基准测试仅评估单一模型规模下的CD框架效率，缺乏对CD与模型规模交互作用的研究。

Method: 采用受控规模阶梯实验设计：①模型选择——5个模型（Qwen3-0.6B/4B、Llama-3.2-1B/3B、Phi-4-mini-3.8B），来自3个家族；②任务设计——14个结构化输出任务（5个JSON生成、3个Schema遵循、3个函数调用、3个抽取），含3个难度等级；③解码条件——原生贪心解码、Outlines（FSM）、XGrammar（编译grammar），均使用贪心解码（T=0）以保证确定性；④双轴评估指标——结构正确性（Schema validity，用JSON Schema Draft 2020-12验证）与语义正确性（内容准确度：抽取任务按字段归一化匹配，函数调用任务按50%函数选择+50%参数存在加权）；⑤失败原型分类——类型强制、结构错位、指令-语义三类，预测其CD可修复性。总计210次评估。

Result: ①结构失败完全消除：CD将所有5个模型的Schema有效性从78.6%–92.9%（原生）提升至100%（两种CD框架均如此），结构性规模曲线被完全压平。②语义差距持续存在：内容准确度在CD下提升但不归一——Llama-1B从0.771升至0.986（XGrammar），Llama-3B从0.777升至0.991，Qwen-0.6B从0.871仅升至0.943（残差5.7pp最大）。③失败原型决定CD可修复性：类型强制完全可修复（如Qwen-0.6B在抽取小票任务上从0.000→1.000）；指令-语义失败对CD具有抵抗力（如Qwen-0.6B在多步函数调用任务中始终只发出一个调用，函数调用得分0.200→0.200）。④"空心拯救"现象：Llama-1B在XGrammar下形式上满足结构要求，但email正文内容为空洞列表。⑤规模优势部分保留：约束下的1B模型（0.986）超越原生3B模型（0.777），但约束下的3B（0.991）仍优于约束下的1B；规模优势仅在指令-语义类任务上不可替代。⑥框架开销对比：XGrammar编译开销可忽略（4–8ms），吞吐下降1.6%–3.7%；Outlines编译开销2.0–4.9s（峰值19.5s），额外吞吐损失9%–13%。

Conclusion: 约束解码能普遍消除小型LLM的结构性失败，但语义正确性取决于失败原型与模型规模。Schema一致性是语义正确性的必要不充分条件——CD的作用范围止步于Schema一致性的边界。对于类型强制失败，XGrammar以近乎零开销提供完全修复；对于指令-语义失败，CD无能为力，必须依赖更大模型或改进提示工程。最低成本的可靠配置为XGrammar搭配3–4B模型。未来工作应扩展至MoE架构、真实API schema及更丰富的语义评估方法。

Abstract: Small open-source large language models (LLMs) in the 0.6B-4B parameter range are increasingly deployed for structured output generation (JSON, function calling, data extraction), yet little is known about how constrained decoding (CD) interacts with model scale in this regime. We benchmark five models from three families across 14 structured-output tasks under three decoding conditions (native, Outlines, XGrammar). We introduce a two-axis evaluation that separates structural correctness (schema validity) from semantic correctness (content accuracy). We find that CD eliminates all structural failures across all models (schema validity: 78.6-92.9% to 100%), but content accuracy reveals a persistent semantic gap that is scale-dependent: type coercion failures are fully CD-rescuable, while instruction-semantic failures (e.g., multi-step function calling) remain CD-resistant. Schema conformance is necessary but not sufficient for semantic correctness; CD's reach ends exactly where schema conformance ends.

</details>


### [143] [Q-TIE: A Lightweight and Generalizable Re-ranking Framework for Temporal Information Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23880)
*Soyeon Kim,Hyunjin Kim,JinYeong Bak,Steven Euijong Whang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Q-TIE 提出了一种轻量级、通用的时态信息检索（TIR）重排序框架，通过引入"时态意图提取"（TIE）这一学习任务，将查询中的时态约束映射为统一的区间表示 ⟨t_start, t_end⟩，并结合 Product-of-Experts（PoE）聚合语义与时态相关性分数，兼顾显式时态约束执行与对多样化时态表达的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 RAG 的兴起，时态不匹配的证据会误导 LLM 产生过时或不一致的回答，因此时态信息检索（TIR）变得至关重要。现有两类范式各有缺陷：时态检索器将时态约束视为软约束，无法显式过滤时态无效文档；基于规则的重排序器依赖预定义关键词匹配规则，对未见过的时态表达泛化能力差（精度下降 33.1%p）。论文旨在解决"显式时态约束执行"与"超越预定义规则的灵活性"之间的权衡难题。

Method: 1) **TIE 任务设计**：将查询的时态约束映射为统一区间 ⟨t_start, t_end⟩，使用月份级别粒度，支持 None 表示开放区间；2) **TIE 数据集构建**：基于 TDBench（覆盖 Allen 13 种区间关系）和 Nobel Prize 构建，含 2,300 条查询，按 80/20 划分；3) **TIE 模型训练**：基于 Qwen3-0.6B + LoRA（r=8, α=16）进行参数高效微调，4 个 epoch，学习率 2e-4；4) **时态相关性评分**：使用高斯核软重叠得分替代严格区间匹配，保留细粒度排序信号；6) **PoE 聚合**：通过 log-sum 融合实现乘法形式的概率空间融合（AND-like），强制语义与时态两个信号同时满足；7) **超参数 λ**：控制时态分数权重。

Result: 1) **TIR 性能**：在 Nobel Prize 和 TempRAGEval 上均大幅超越基线，例如 Q-TIE+JinaAI 在 Nobel Prize 简单查询 P@1 达 78.76，比最强时态检索器 TsContriever 高 20.13%p，比最强重排序器 MRAG+JinaAI 高 11.87%p；2) **跨查询类型泛化**：在 TempRAGEval OOD 设置下，Q-TIE 在 9 种时态表达类型上均表现稳定，而规则基线方法在未覆盖类型上严重退化；3) **TIE 任务性能**：0.6B 模型在 Start/End 准确率上达 95.73/93.02，超过 Gemma3-27B（85.55/87.89）和 Gemma2-9B-Inst（89.06/86.72）等大模型；4) **效率**：延迟开销仅 1.02-7.15%，NDCG@1 提升 22.97-24.44%p；5) **RAG 集成**：F1 24.80，Acc 45.07，速度比 Qwen3-4B 重排序器快约 19 倍（154.64s vs 2924.31s）；6) **统计显著性**：246/270 比较 p<0.05，所有 P@1 和 NDCG@5 改进 p<0.001；7) **鲁棒性**：在时间戳噪声场景下仍为最强重排序器（80.19 vs 最高 63.68 P@1）；8) **与查询重写结合**：在 MultiTQ 多事件查询上 Hit 51.33 / F1 25.63。

Conclusion: Q-TIE 通过 TIE 学习任务和 PoE 聚合机制，成功统一了显式时态约束执行与对多样化时态表达的灵活性这两个先前被权衡的属性。其 0.6B 参数的紧凑 TIE 模型在保持极低推理成本的同时，性能可比甚至超越大模型。作为 RAG 管道中的轻量级即插即用模块，Q-TIE 在复杂查询、混合查询、噪声时间戳等真实场景下均表现出良好的鲁棒性与可扩展性。未来工作方向包括更细粒度（天级）时态处理、迭代式时态范围优化以及向结构化数据（如时态知识图谱）的扩展。

Abstract: Temporal Information Retrieval (TIR) has been increasingly critical given the rise of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Since temporally mismatched evidence can be highly misleading, TIR aims to retrieve documents that are both semantically and temporally relevant to a query. Two TIR paradigms have emerged - temporal retrievers and temporal re-rankers - differing in how temporal relevance is modeled. While these paradigms provide complementary strengths, our analysis reveals that each alone falls short of robust TIR: temporal retrievers provide flexible query understanding via learned representations, but often fail to explicitly account for temporal constraints; temporal re-rankers can enforce such constraints more explicitly, but often rely on predefined re-ranking rules. To address this, we propose Q-TIE, a re-ranking framework based on learned Temporal Intent Extraction (TIE). By introducing a TIE model that maps each query's temporal constraint into a unified interval representation (i.e., $\langle t_{start}, t_{end} \rangle$), Q-TIE generalizes beyond predefined rules via model-based learning while explicitly modeling temporal constraints as a separate signal - jointly achieving what each paradigm typically trades off. Experiments demonstrate that Q-TIE consistently outperforms existing TIR methods with stronger generalizability across temporal query types, and provides a lightweight yet effective add-on for temporally-aware RAG pipelines. Code: this https URL .

</details>


### [144] [this-that-model-1.0: A typed decision model that decides in 30 ms, for a millionth of a cent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23886)
*Zehua Cheng,Wei Dai,Jiahao Sun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: this-that-model-1.0 是一个 2B 参数的"类型化决策模型"(typed decision model)，通过直接从隐藏状态读取答案（而非生成 token）实现 30.9 ms 的决策延迟和零生成 token。它在受限分支决策任务上以极低成本匹配或超越商用服务 Jev，但在需要多步推理（如最短路径）的任务上表现欠佳，准确揭示了单次前向传播的能力边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 程序日益依赖模型来做分支判断（退款是否符合政策、命令是否安全运行等），但调用前沿大模型需要数百毫秒、按 token 计费、且需要解析器，对一个通常是三个子句组合的判断问题而言成本过高。作者希望构建一个小型、可本地部署、输出类型受限的决策组件，作为"智能 if 语句"嵌入到程序中。

Method: 核心是"类型化答案头"(typed answer head)：每个问题在指定 token 位置结束，答案分布通过对这些位置的隐藏状态与选项标签嵌入做 softmax 直接计算（方程 2），因此输出支撑集严格等于声明的选项集合，从构造上杜绝格式错误的输出。N 个问题在一次前向传播中同时回答（条件独立分解）。配合"模式优先"(schema-first) 提示布局以摊销前缀计算成本；训练目标为 Brier 分数与交叉熵的凸组合，并在仅有单一结果可用时用配对控制变量法给出无偏梯度估计；部署时通过 (θ₀ + λΔ) 在基座与微调权重之间插值，λ=0 提供精确回滚。

Result: 在 NanoJev 第三方记录的 68 道题上达到准确率 0.941（Brier 0.042），而 Jev 为 0.765（Brier 0.133）；在每张消费级 GPU 上维持每秒 32 次决策，总成本约 $0.000217；自有 42 家族测试套一遍 32 秒、$0.000217，而最准确的托管模型需要 155.2 分钟、$10.636。在有解析答案分布的任务上达到 0.750，已超越 0.746 的不可逾越上限。缺陷明确：多步算术仅 0.560（托管模型 0.98–1.00），需要图搜索的最短路径类问题约 0.574；同模型被问同一最短路径的"区间"和"奇偶"时，前者正确时后者仅 0.513（猜硬币水平 0.500），表明它仅记住了标签而非真实数值。

Conclusion: 前沿模型是更好的判断者但更差的组件；差距以延迟和 token 计费而非智能衡量。该模型能以 30.9 ms、仅电费成本回答一个有界问题，但不能以任何价格搜索图；许多真实分支只需前者，需要搜索的应交由搜索处理。模型、推理栈、复现脚本和基准测试均以 MIT/Apache-2.0 开源发布。

Abstract: Software delegates more of its branches to models every year: which queue a ticket enters, whether a command is safe to run, whether a claim clears without a person. What the program needs back is not prose. It is one of n declared options and a number it can threshold. Today that costs a round trip to a frontier model -- hundreds of milliseconds, a per-token bill, and a parser -- for a question that is usually a conjunction of three clauses. this-that-model-1.0 is a 2B-parameter typed decision model. Its answer is read directly from the hidden state at a designated position and restricted to the option set the caller declared, so no text is generated, nothing can be malformed, and every question in a request is answered in the same forward pass. It decides in 30.9 ms on one laptop GPU and generates zero output tokens doing it, where a frontier API call costs 8758 ms and the hosted systems that answer these questions well spend between 21 and 212 generated tokens per question thinking first, billed for every one. It sustains 32 decisions per second on one consumer GPU and never lets the state leave the machine. On a third party's recorded cohort of 68 decision questions, on their inputs and their wording, it scores 0.941 with a Brier score of 0.042, against 0.765 and 0.133 for the hosted service Jev on the same items. One pass of our 42-family internal suite takes 32 seconds and 0.000217 USD of electricity; the most accurate hosted model we measured needs 155.2 minutes and 10.636 USD. We also report where it loses. On multi-step arithmetic, which a single forward pass cannot carry intermediate results through, it scores 0.560 against their 0.98 to 1.00, and a targeted second training round improved the five task families it was written for and transferred to none of the other 13. The model is open-sourced in this https URL

</details>


### [145] [Time-Incremental Continued Pretraining of LLMs: Knowledge Updates Without Catastrophic Forgetting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23916)
*Fırat Öncel,Salman Hussain Ali,Mirco Ravanelli,Cem Subakan,Çağatay Yıldız*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了时间增量持续预训练（CPT）在大语言模型知识更新中的实际效果，发现在真实网络规模数据共享URL重叠的场景下，CPT能够有效吸收新知识且不会出现灾难性遗忘，并通过六个开源模型和四个实际问题的实验提出了具体的操作建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在预训练完成后会因世界知识的演变而迅速过时，但从头重新训练成本极高。传统持续学习方法基于数据流不相交的假设，不适用于网络规模爬虫数据存在大量URL重叠的现实场景，因此需要重新评估时间增量CPT的实际效果。

Method: 使用FineWeb-Edu数据集中严格晚于各模型知识截止日期的网络快照，对六个开源模型（覆盖OLMo2、Llama-3.1/3.2、Gemma-3-1B三个家族，1B-8B参数规模）进行持续预训练。通过Daily Oracle基准测试知识获取情况，并使用十三个下游任务评估通用能力保持程度，同时系统研究数据质量、学习率、LoRA参数效率以及与SFT/DPO后训练的交互作用。

Result: 研究发现：(1)CPT能够获取新知识且无灾难性遗忘，六分之五模型在截止前事实回忆上也有所改善；(2)通用能力损失极小，十三个任务平均准确率保持在基线±0.01以内；(3)6B高质量token数据效果优于40B较低质量数据，知识获取与通用能力的最优学习率相差约一个数量级，足够秩的LoRA可匹配全参数CPT；(4)CPT收益能通过SFT传递，DPO效果因模型家族而异。

Conclusion: 研究描绘了比传统持续学习文献更乐观的时间增量CPT图景，证明了在网络规模数据共享重叠的现实场景下，灾难性遗忘并非CPT的固有特征。基于实验结果提出了具体的操作方案：使用高质量精选数据、中等学习率（约3e-5）、训练时间短且可在SFT之前应用，为实际部署中的时间知识更新提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) drift out of date the moment their pretraining ends, yet retraining from scratch is prohibitively expensive. Continued pretraining (CPT) is the natural remedy, but it is typically evaluated through a continual learning lens that assumes disjoint data streams. This is a poor fit for time-incremental updates on web-scale crawls, where successive snapshots share substantial URL overlap by design. We study time-incremental CPT in this realistic regime: continued pretraining on FineWeb-Edu dumps drawn strictly from after each model's knowledge cutoff, evaluated across six open-weight models spanning three families (OLMo2, Llama-3.1/3.2, Gemma-3-1B) and four parameter scales (1B-3B-7B-8B). We organize our findings around four practical questions. (i) Is knowledge acquired? Yes, but heterogeneously, and without catastrophic forgetting: five of six models also improve on pre-cutoff factual recall, and the gains track pretraining saturation (driven primarily by token budget per parameter). (ii) What does it cost? Almost nothing: the macro-average across a thirteen-task suite stays within 0.01 of the base for every model. (iii) What is the recipe? Data quality dominates quantity (a curated 6B-token slice matches a broader 40B one); the optima for knowledge acquisition and general capability are separated by roughly an order of magnitude in learning rate; and LoRA at sufficient rank matches full CPT. (iv) Does it survive deployment? CPT gains transfer through SFT, while DPO's effect is family-dependent. Together, these results paint a more optimistic picture of time-incremental CPT than the prior continual learning literature suggests.

</details>


### [146] [Measuring the Assistant's Harmlessness Preferences on the User Turn](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23935)
*Jord Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文发现后训练不仅将"助手"塑造为局部角色，还会将助手的安全偏好（偏好无害任务）泛化到模型对用户发言的预测上，即在用户回合中也观察到显著的无害偏置，且该偏置由DPO阶段安装、可被窄域微调翻转，并定位于网络深层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验一个理论假设：助手人格（assistant persona）是否仅在助手自身的发言回合被调用，还是会渗透到模型对用户发言的预测中。若仅为局部角色，则用户回合应保持中性预测器行为；若发生泛化，则后训练的影响远超其损失函数直接作用的范围。

Method: 采用用户回合掷硬币预测任务：构建10×10无害-有害任务对数据集（共400项，含2×2顺序控制），分别在明文与"开放用户回合"两种测量模式下，对Llama 3、Qwen 2.5、Gemma 3、OLMo 3/3.1等多系列开源模型进行无害选项偏置测量；通过训练阶段检查点定位偏置来源；用涌现失准（EM）LoRA测试窄域微调的敏感性；用logit lens定位偏置在网络中的层级位置。

Result: 预训练基模型偏置接近零；后训练Instruct模型普遍出现无害偏置，且随规模增长；偏置在OLMo 3.1 Instruct的DPO阶段被安装（Think管线不安装）；涌现失准LoRA能减弱甚至翻转该偏置（Llama 8B发生符号翻转）；偏置定位于网络深层（Llama中后段、Qwen最后约1/4层），EM适配器在Llama上以相反符号复用同一深层几何。

Conclusion: 后训练并未仅安装一个停留在助手回合的浅层角色，而是将助手特征泛化至模型对用户回合的表征中——助手人格与用户预测在网络中发生了纠缠。这支持"预测器偏置"或"广义人格泛化"读法，挑战了助手仅为可分离的可召唤角色的纯粹模拟器框架。

Abstract: Post-training turns a general next-token predictor into a chat model with a persistent assistant persona. If that persona is a character the model plays only on its own turns, its preferences should govern what the assistant says, not what the model predicts other speakers will say. We test this boundary and find that it does not hold: a safety-relevant preference of the assistant---for harmless over harmful tasks---shapes the model's predictions even on the user's turn, where the assistant is not the one speaking. We find that this preference is small or near-zero in pretrained base models, that it emerges through post-training, replicated across open-weight model families, grows with scale, and can be moved by narrow finetuning that never touches user turns. We claim that this is evidence that post-training does not merely install a shallow assistant persona, but instead generalises beyond just the local assistant turn, into the model's representation of the user.

</details>


### [147] [XYEval: Agents say yes to bad advice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23939)
*Zhengxuan Wu,Yuxuan Li,Oyvind Tafjord,Been Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出XYEval，一个用于评估AI智能体在XY问题（即用户基于错误假设提出看似合理但具有误导性的建议）下表现的元评估框架。研究在六个基准测试上评估了五个前沿模型，发现智能体在XY变异下性能显著下降，相对下降幅度最高达46.7%；在与固执用户交互时性能下降更严重，简单的系统提示防御仅能部分缓解问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代AI智能体倾向于顺从用户请求（迎合性行为），但当用户基于错误前提提出看似可信的建议时，智能体往往盲目执行误导性建议而非识别并解决用户的真实问题。本文将先前对话场景下的迎合性评估扩展到智能体场景下的XY问题，填补了智能体在面对合理但错误建议时如何推理和沟通这一研究空白。

Method: 方法核心是XYEval元评估框架：(1) 将原始基准任务表示为(t, e, o)，其中t为指令、e为环境、o为评分预言机；(2) XY变异T通过生成器智能体A_g基于原始任务和标准答案生成合理但错误的建议x_i，并附加到原始指令中形成t^xy；(3) 测量XY下降幅度Δ^xy = (S(A,B^xy) - S(A,B)) / S(A,B)；(4) 在六个基准（τ²-bench、SWE-bench Verified/Pro、Terminal-Bench、HLE、MCP-Atlas）上测试五个模型（Gemini 3.1/3.5/3.7 Pro/Flash、Claude Opus 4.8、GPT 5.5）；(5) 通过trace分析识别Disagree、InappropriateCompliance等关键行为；(6) 评估两种系统提示防御策略（XY防御与Golden防御）。

Result: 主要结果包括：(1) 全部五个模型在所有基准上都出现XY下降，最大相对下降达46.7%（Gemini 3.1 Pro在Terminal-Bench上）；(2) Claude Opus 4.8整体最具抵抗力；(3) τ²-bench上固执用户导致性能下降加剧，智能体在被强烈施压时甚至放弃推理转接人工；(4) 通用XY防御仅能部分缓解，Golden防御（明确告知误导建议）效果显著；(5) trace分析显示智能体在约92.1%的轨迹内部识别到问题但仅23-33%在对话中表达异议；(6) 主要失败类型为"缺乏推理"（53-89%），即未批判性评估就接受用户建议；(7) XY变异下智能体将误导建议归为自身假设（第一人称归因）的比例翻倍，表明建议被内化为智能体自身想法。

Conclusion: 缓解XY问题仍是难题，要求智能体不仅通过验证识别用户误导，还需清晰沟通潜在的真实问题。能力更强的模型在更容易的基准上反而下降更大，说明单纯提升能力无法解决XY问题。XY问题本质上是沟通失败而非纯粹的能力缺陷——智能体通常具备解决真实任务的能力，但后训练的对齐机制导致其在多轮交互中无法有效表达异议。

Abstract: Effective communication between users and AI agents is essential for human-AI collaboration. The XY problem is a well-known communication pitfall where a person asks about their attempted solution rather than their actual problem. We extend prior sycophancy evaluation to the XY problem in agentic settings, evaluating whether agents can resist plausible but misleading suggestions from users and communicate their reasoning. We introduce XYEval, a meta-evaluation framework that can transform an existing benchmark into an XY problem evaluation. We evaluate five models across six diverse benchmark suites. Agents suffer large XY drops under XY mutation across benchmarks, with relative drops reaching up to 46.7%. With $\tau^2$-bench, we further show that agent performance drops more when encountering a pedantic user who requires detailed explanations before approving a better solution. Our findings suggest that current agents lack the ability to effectively reason and communicate when facing misleading suggestions. A simple system instruction baseline that encourages awareness of XY problems only offers partial mitigation. Extensive trace analyses provide behavioral insights into how and why these XY drops occur across execution trajectories. Our results show that mitigating the XY problem remains challenging, requiring agents to both recognize user misdirection and clearly communicate the underlying problem.

</details>


### [148] [Some Dialects Are More Equal Than Others: Non-Prestigious Arabic Dialectal Bias in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23955)
*Mai Mohamed Eida,Ryan Dolan,Paul de Nijs,Jonathan Dunn*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究LLM对埃及阿拉伯语中Sa'idi方言(SEA)的偏见，发现上游句法评估中对SEA存在显著偏见，且该偏见导致下游MMLU基准性能下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前NLP工作主要关注开罗方言(CEA)，导致Sa'idi方言(SEA)在LLM和资源开发中代表性不足。本文旨在探究：上游层面，LLM是否对SEA存在可接受性偏见；下游层面，该偏见是否导致性能下降。

Method: 上游任务：使用目标句法评估(TSE)测试LLM对SEA方言特征的偏好；下游任务：在MMLU基准上分析相同方言特征对模型性能的影响。

Result: 多个LLM在TSE任务中对SEA表现出显著偏见；当输入为SEA时，模型在MMLU基准上的性能出现下降。

Conclusion: 亚方言变异对语言技术有重要影响，亟需进一步研究以解决LLM对低代表性方言(如SEA)的偏见问题。

Abstract: Previous work on Egyptian Arabic in NLP has focused largely on the prestigious Cairene Egyptian Arabic (CEA) dialect, resulting in a lack of representation for the less prestigious Sa'idi Egyptian Arabic (SEA) dialect both in LLM and resource development. Does this lack of representation influence an LLM's view of the acceptability of SEA (upstream), and does an upstream bias against SEA lead to worse performance (downstream)? We investigate the upstream effect of SEA dialectal features on LLM preferences in a Targeted Syntactic Evaluation (TSE) task which reveals a significant bias against SEA across multiple LLMs. We then analyze the effect of these same features on downstream model performance on MMLU benchmarks and show that models experience a degradation in performance when presented with SEA. This work highlights the need for further exploration on how sub-dialectal variation impacts language technologies.

</details>


### [149] [Open-Jev Judgments on CallScreenBench: Calibrated One-Pass Scam Screening with a Small Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23959)
*Simiao Ren,Kidus Zewde,Xingyu Shen,Yuchen Zhou,Dennis Ng,Ankit Raj,Tommy Duong,Yuxin Zhang,Neo Tiangratanakul*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文将Jev风格的"类型化决策"读出方法（开源实现JevLite）应用于电话诈骗实时筛查任务，使用LoRA微调的Qwen3-4B模型，在单次前向传播中通过答案标签logits的softmax输出校准的P(scam)。在41个未见过的测试场景中，三种子集成达到AUROC 0.974、ECE 0.052，与LLM法官（MiniMax-M3）相比在预注册的0.02非劣效边界内表现相当，且对合法呼叫无误报，决策早1.14轮，每决策64.5ms（比生成式微调快4.9倍）。研究的主要贡献是应用和评估，而非架构创新，并坦诚指出方案选择存在测试集暴露等局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电话诈骗日益由AI代理自动执行，而筛查软件必须在毫秒级时间内、在每个来电轮次后做出可信赖的概率判断（用于挂断、留言或接通）。现有方法要么提示大LLM进行分类，要么微调小解码器生成结构化答案再解析，两者都存在输出非校准、小模型可能产生不可解析输出、且很少报告对合法呼叫的误报和校准的问题。Jev-style"类型化决策"接口承诺单次前向传播输出受限选项集的校准概率，本研究探索其是否适合诈骗电话筛查。

Method: JevLite方法：（1）在Qwen3-4B上附加LoRA适配器（rank=16，α=32），仅对受限选项（yes/no）对应的标签logits计算交叉熵+Brier损失（训练时T=1）；（2）推理时读取这些logits，用验证集拟合的温度T进行softmax归一化得到P(scam)；（3）三个不同种子的模型集成平均其温度缩放后的概率；（4）添加两个由MiniMax-M3标注的辅助意图问题（推送回拨渠道/要求提供PIN等秘密）作为额外监督，灰色场景（合法但模糊）损失权重加倍；（5）流式使用中共享前缀编码缓存，每条新问题仅添加短后缀。训练数据为CallScreenBench的40个训练场景（3187个轮次前缀决策），验证集8个场景（650决策），测试集为41个未见过的场景生成的82个新呼叫（577个轮次末端决策）。

Result: 三种子集成JevLite在测试集达到：AUROC 0.974（95% CI [0.933, 0.997]）、准确率92.7%、ECE 5.2%、Brier 6.1（×100）；对合法呼叫准确率100%、对诈骗呼叫99.3%；每决策64.5ms（p95 110.5ms），约为LLM法官API延迟的1/30。相对LLM法官：AUROC差+0.027 [-0.011, 0.065]，下界超出-0.02边界0.009，仅满足非劣效而不满足优越性；合法呼叫准确率高+0.177 [0.008, 0.360]（唯一排除零的成对差异）。相对ModernBERT编码器（匹配辅助监督）：AUROC差+0.026 [-0.023, 0.105]，无显著差异，编码器ECE更低（0.042 vs 0.052）。消融实验表明：普通Qwen3微调（生成JSON）解析读取AUROC仅0.875，但用Jev方式读取标签token概率可达0.950；分类头可达AUROC 0.962。稳健性问题：选项顺序翻转2.6%决策，问题复述翻转5.2%决策（30个中28个偏向"合法"）。

Conclusion: 对于"是否是诈骗"这类固定问题，微调编码器是更优选择（更快、ECE更低）；JevLite解码器读出的价值仅在于需要在运行时以自然语言提出不同问题的情况（每个额外问题约21.8ms），但未见问题的结果显示其仅在提取式问题上有增益，判断式问题上并无优势。判断式问题和模糊灰色呼叫仍是弱点，LLM法官或选择性预测级联仍更可取。研究坦承的局限：方案选择存在测试集暴露（胜者诅咒膨胀）、单种子仅勉强超过非劣效边界、所有呼叫均为合成。未来工作应在真实呼叫上测试、独立标注、保留整个诈骗原型作为测试集，并研究完整呼叫拟合的校准是否迁移到部分呼叫。

Abstract: Screening a phone call for fraud needs a trustworthy probability after every caller turn, in milliseconds. Jev-style typed decisions promise exactly that: declared options go in, one calibrated probability per option comes out of a single forward pass, with no generated text. We test an open implementation of this readout, JevLite, on scam-call screening: Qwen3-4B is LoRA-tuned so that the temperature-scaled softmax over two answer-label logits is P(scam). On 41 held-out CallScreenBench scenarios (577 per-turn decisions) a three-seed ensemble reaches AUROC .974 with calibration error .052, non-inferior to an LLM judge (MiniMax-M3) at a pre-registered .02 margin, with no false alarms on legitimate calls, decisions 1.14 turns earlier under the same hang-up rule, and 64.5 ms per decision on one consumer GPU, 4.9x lower than the same backbone fine-tuned to generate its answer. The gain is in the readout and calibration, not accuracy: a fine-tuned ModernBERT encoder is not significantly worse, the recipe was selected with test-set exposure, and all callers are synthetic. We claim no architectural novelty; the contribution is the application and an evaluation reporting calibration, false alarms and decision timing alongside AUROC.

</details>


### [150] [From Tables to Quantified Statements: Evaluating LLM Inference Generation through Executable Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23966)
*Mai Mohamed Eida,Gunjan Anand,Ayush Singh,Aleksandre Maskharashvili*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了Stat-to-Text任务及自动化验证流水线，要求LLM从统计表格生成带量词（all/some/no/most）的自然语言推断，并利用LLM生成的Python检测脚本对推断进行可执行验证。通过对比四个开源LLM，发现模型规模与家族显著影响推断的逻辑忠实性，GPT-OSS-120B表现最佳且与人类标注达成97.5%的一致率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表到文本生成系统虽能产出流畅描述，但其推断在逻辑上未必被表格数据所支撑。广义量词（如all、some、no、most）的选择与验证在先前工作中未得到系统性研究，因此需要一种可控任务来评估LLM生成量化推断的忠实性与多样性。

Method: 1) 使用GPT-5.5生成100张合成统计表（5-10列、15行）；2) 让四个开源LLM（LLAMA-3.1 8B/70B、GPT-OSS 20B/120B）为每张表生成最多20条带量词的自然语言推断；3) 让同一LLM生成Python验证脚本，对每条推断执行真值检验；4) 提出六项自动评估指标（Grounding、Accuracy、TRC、VC、QC、VR、QR）并辅以人工标注评估。

Result: 所有模型在Grounding上接近100%（99.5-100%），但在Accuracy上差异显著：GPT-OSS-120B忠实性最高，LLAMA-3.1-8B准确率仅48.7%。GPT-OSS-120B与GPT-OSS-20B保持较高准确率但量词多样性偏低，LLAMA系列量词覆盖更广却牺牲了忠实性。人工评估显示自动检测器与人类判断整体一致率为91.2%，GPT-OSS-120B达97.5%，主要偏差为假阴性（172例 vs 39例假阳性）。常见失败模式包括将"most"误判为"all"、析取式逻辑处理错误、判定与解释相矛盾等。

Conclusion: Stat-to-Text流水线可可靠生成并验证来自统计表格的量化自然语言推断，模型家族与规模对逻辑忠实性影响显著，GPT-OSS-120B综合表现最优。可执行验证框架与人类判断高度一致，是量化表到文本生成的可靠评估工具。未来工作将拓展至真实世界大型表格、多句连贯话语推断以及更可靠的验证器训练。

Abstract: LLMs can generate fluent descriptions from tables, but their outputs may remain logically unsupported by the structured data.
