We introduce an end-to-end benchmark that standardizes downstream training and charges selection and training to the same auditable wall-clock budget, spanning 4 datasets from CIFAR-10 to ImageNet-1K, 11 selectors, 5 fractions, and 3 seeds, with over 1,500 released runs. Repeated-sampling work has shown that budget-aware evaluation already favors random strategies. Our two budget studies test whether that verdict survives when every selector is granted its most favorable operating point. Across eight wall-clock budget anchors on each of CIFAR-10 and Tiny ImageNet, no anchor is won by a sophisticated selector: every winner is class-balanced random sampling, repeated random sampling, or full-data training. In fixed-budget duels on ImageNet-1K, training on all data for fewer epochs beats every selection strategy we probe while also costing the least. A per-dataset cost audit shows that selection cost is dominated at every scale by a fixed full-dataset scan, so it cannot be amortized away by selecting a smaller fraction, and its absolute size does not extrapolate from one dataset to another. We further quantify when selection does pay back through subset reuse, and document 9 correctness fixes to a widely used codebase, one of which shifts a standard Herding baseline by nearly 6 points. Selection time is not free preprocessing, and an evaluation that ignores it measures the wrong quantity.

</details>


### [369] [Interpretable Multi-Hypersphere Deep Anomaly Detection for Open-set Supervised Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23008)
*Zhiji Yang,Fangyong Wang,Yue Li,Xianli Pan,Jianhua Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为IMHD-AD的可解释多超球深度异常检测方法,用于开放集监督异常检测。该方法在共享特征空间中为每个已知正常类构建独立超球,通过类内紧凑性和类间边界约束联合优化特征表示与超球参数,在30个对比实验中的28个上取得了最高的AUC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多类或开放集异常检测方法存在三个主要局限:(1)单超球方法(如DeepSVDD)无法显式表示多个异构正常子分布的类特定位置和接受范围;(2)现有的多超球或多类方法(如DMSVDD、DeepMAD)未能完全整合类间边界约束、可学习的接受范围和可解释决策;(3)需要一种只利用类标签正常样本(无需标注异常)就能同时实现紧凑性、分离性和可解释性的方法。

Method: IMHD-AD采用一对多(one-vs-rest)公式,为每个已知正常类构建独立超球(中心C_k,半径R_k)。训练目标包括四项:超球体积控制项、目标样本在球外的铰链损失、非目标样本在球内的铰链损失和权重正则化项。核心创新是将超球几何参数嵌入神经网络最后一层:权重w_k = -2C_k,偏置b_k = ||C_k||² - R_k²,加上单位范数约束||w_k||²=4和b_k≤1确保几何有效性。通过拉格朗日乘数法(α_k, β_k)将约束纳入,采用原始-对偶优化,主参数梯度下降、对偶变量梯度上升。决策基于最小有符号边界分数f(x) = min_k s_k(x),负值接受为正常,非负拒绝为异常。

Result: 在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和CIFAR-10的两种开放集协议下进行评估:第一种协议(2个已知正常类+8个未知异常类),IMHD-AD在15个对比中的13个取得最高AUC;第二种协议(3个已知正常类+7个未知异常类),IMHD-AD在全部15个对比中均取得最高AUC。综合30个对比中,在CIFAR-10上提升最为显著(从约70%提升到90%左右)。二维合成实验揭示了网络复杂度的影响:线性网络保持原始几何结构(异常检测AUC较高),深度网络过度压缩正常类,将未知异常"折叠"进超球内,导致异常检测AUC从较高水平降至0.5780,而分类准确率达0.9742。

Conclusion: IMHD-AD通过将多超球几何直接嵌入神经网络参数,实现了特征学习、边界学习和可解释性的统一,在开放集异常检测任务中显著优于MC-SVDD、DeepSVDD、DMSVDD和DeepMAD。该方法仅使用类标签正常样本进行训练,无需任何标注异常。二维可视化分析表明,模型架构必须在已知正常类的紧凑性和未知异常的分离性之间取得平衡。未来工作将探索半监督扩展,引入少量标注异常样本以进一步细化正常-异常边界。

Abstract: Multi-class open-set anomaly detection requires a model to characterize the normal acceptance domain formed by multiple heterogeneous subdistributions using only class-labeled samples from known normal classes, and to identify previously unseen anomalies at test time. Existing single-hypersphere methods cannot explicitly represent class-specific locations and acceptance ranges, while current multi-hypersphere or multi-class approaches do not fully integrate inter-class boundary constraints, learnable acceptance ranges, and interpretable decisions. To address these limitations, we propose Interpretable Multi-Hypersphere Deep Anomaly Detection (IMHD-AD). IMHD-AD constructs an independent hypersphere for each known normal class in a shared feature space. With target-inside and non-target-outside constraints, IMHD-AD embeds the class-specific hypersphere centers and radii directly into the final network layer and jointly optimizes them with the shared representation. The minimum signed boundary score across hyperspheres simultaneously determines open-set acceptance or rejection and provides a faithful geometric explanation of each decision. On MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10, IMHD-AD achieves the highest AUC in 28 of 30 open-set comparisons. A two-dimensional synthetic study further shows that model architecture must balance the compactness of known normal classes against the separability of unknown anomalies.

</details>


### [370] [MolSC: Leveraging Substituent Contributions to Enhance Fine-grained Molecular Understanding in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23073)
*Hyuntae Park,Sooyeon Kim,Jiwon Park,SangKeun Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 MolSC 数据集与 MolSC-Bench 评测基准,通过显式建模取代基(scaffold+substituent)对分子性质的贡献,提升分子大语言模型(LLM)的结构-性质细粒度理解能力。仅使用 1D SMILES/SELFIES 表示即可在分子反应预测与性质预测等下游任务上超越依赖 2D 图编码器的大模型基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分子 LLM 在分子级标签上训练,无法显式捕捉局部结构修饰对性质的影响,即"取代基贡献"。本文试图将取代基对性质的有符号贡献作为直接监督信号,弥补分子级抽象的不足。

Method: 1) 基于 ChEMBL,使用 Hussain-Rea 片段化算法将分子拆分为 scaffold 与 substituent,在三大性质轴上(结构警示 liability、靶点生物活性、理化描述符)计算取代基的有符号贡献 ΔP = P(M)−P(S);2) 经过去冗余 scaffold 与过简单 substituent 过滤后保留 181,098 条贡献;3) 构建多轮指令对话,采用前向(scaffold→M)与后向(M→scaffold+substituent)双视图(SMILES+SELFIES)模板,使用 LoRA 在 Llama-3.2-1B/3B 上微调;4) 同时发布 MolSC-Bench(1,541 条样本),在 scaffold、substituent、molecule 三层级与训练集不相交。

Result: 在 MolSC-Bench Task 2(取代基贡献预测)上,3B 模型的方向准确率达到 0.923,显著优于 GPT-5.2(0.706)与 Gemini-3-Flash(0.722);在反应预测任务上,1B 模型的 Exact Match 在前向反应(0.927)、逆合成(0.674)与试剂预测(0.235)上超越使用 1D+2D 模态的 7B 基线 KnowMol 与同 backbone 的 Omni-Mol;在 FGBench 官能团级推理上 1B 模型达到 0.785/0.780/0.776,优于 GPT-4o 与 o3-mini;消融实验表明 SC 监督对取代基贡献与反应任务关键,双视图表示对整体性质任务关键。

Conclusion: 取代基贡献学习是分子 LLM 细粒度结构-性质理解的关键组成部分。显式建模取代基对分子性质的有符号贡献,可显著提升模型对局部结构修饰的推理能力,并有效迁移至反应预测、性质预测等下游任务,同时仅依赖 1D 表示即可超越依赖 2D 图编码器的更大模型。

Abstract: Recent advances in natural language processing have led to molecular Large Language Models (LLMs) with strong performance across diverse chemistry tasks. However, they still struggle to capture fine-grained structure-property relationships, particularly how small, localized modifications alter a molecule's behavior. To address this limitation, we introduce MolSC, a dataset of substituent contributions, defined as property changes induced by attaching specific substituents to molecular scaffolds. Curated from manually annotated bioactivity records, MolSC spans structural-alert liability, target-specific bioactivity, and physicochemical descriptors, and contains 181K substituent-level examples for training. We further propose MolSC-Bench, a held-out evaluation benchmark of 1,541 examples disjoint from MolSC at the scaffold, substituent, and molecule levels. Our experiments show that existing molecular LLMs and strong proprietary models such as GPT-5.2 and Gemini-3-Flash show limited reliability in substituent contribution prediction. In contrast, training on MolSC substantially improves this ability and achieves strong performance across diverse downstream molecular tasks. These results highlight substituent contribution learning as a key component of fine-grained molecular understanding.

</details>


### [371] [Neural Spectral Capacity: Measuring and Designing Architectures from Network Specification Alone](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23087)
*Chenyu Zhu,Ruoyu Zhao,Zhichao Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Neural Spectral Capacity (NSC)，一种仅基于架构规格即可计算的封闭形式标量指标，用于衡量神经网络的"结构容量"。基于 Marchenko–Pastur 定律，NSC 无需实例化模型、数据或梯度即可评估架构质量。其可加性进一步支持 NSC-DP 动态规划求解器，可在资源约束下全局最优地设计架构。实验证明 NSC 在架构排序、Transformer-XL 架构搜索及 LLaMA-7B 结构化剪枝上均优于参数/FLOPs 和现有免训练代理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代 Transformer 的设计与压缩本质上是在预算约束下分配容量的问题。现有标量工具（#Params 和 #FLOPs）仅反映大小和计算量，无法捕捉架构结构（如深度-宽度、注意力头、FFN 分配等）的差异。已有的免训练代理（training-free proxies）需要实例化模型并依赖输入数据，且只能通过黑盒搜索得到"已访问"的最优架构，无法保证全局最优。因此需要一个能够直接从架构规格计算、反映结构信息且支持精确优化的标量指标。

Method: 1. 将每个权重矩阵视为线性高斯信道，定义光谱容量 ψ(W) = ln det(I + W⊤W)，即 Telatar 公式的 log-determinant。2. 利用 Marchenko–Pastur 定律，在标准随机初始化下，将 ψ(W)/N 收敛到 Shannon 变换 ℐ(γ, Ms²)，得到封闭形式 ψ_MP(m, n, s)，仅依赖矩阵维度和初始化方差。3. 网络级 NSC 为各层各矩阵光谱容量之和（层间可加），多头注意力按头分解。4. 基于可加性，将资源约束下的 NSC 最大化问题建模为多层背包问题（DP），通过 NSC-DP 算法在外层枚举网络级配置 g，内层精确求解每层选择 x_l，实现全局最优。5. 在 LoNAS-LLaMA 上利用 DP 回溯一次性读出完整 Pareto 前沿。

Result: NSC 在 7 个架构族（FlexiBERT、GPT-2、AutoFormer-Tiny/Small/Base、NATS-Bench-SSS、MobileNetV3、LoNAS-LLaMA）的排序上显著优于 #Params、#FLOPs 及免训练代理（W-PCA、ZeroLM、SNIP、GradNorm）。在 FlexiBERT 上，NSC 的 Kendall τ = 0.695，#Params 为 0.485；在 10% 参数窗口控制下 NSC 保持 τ = 0.505 而 #Params 崩溃至 0.082。NSC-DP 在 Transformer-XL（WikiText-103）2 秒内找到 PPL 23.087 的架构（优于人工设计基线 23.279），比免训练代理快 400× 以上。在 LLaMA-7B 剪枝到 5.7B 上无需校准数据，0.46 秒完成搜索，Avg₈ 达 65.47（比最强基线 W-PCA 高 1.64 pp），比 W-PCA 快约 5900×，并产出完整 Pareto 前沿。NSC_MP 与基于训练权重 SVD 的 ψ_W 在 129 个 Pareto 子网上 Kendall τ = Spearman ρ = 1.0000，SVD-oracle regret 均值 0.039%。

Conclusion: NSC 是首个仅依赖架构规格、封闭形式、可加且能精确优化的架构容量标量，统一了架构排序、设计与压缩三个任务。其优势在于：(i) 无需实例化、数据或梯度即可计算；(ii) 对结构性变化（深度、头数、FFN 比）敏感而 #Params/FLOPs 不可见；(iii) 层间可加性支持精确动态规划全局最优，弥补了黑盒搜索的局限。NSC 可自然扩展到 GQA/MQA 分组评分以及 MoE 每层专家分配评估，有望成为资源约束下 Transformer 架构选择的通用定量工具。

Abstract: Modern Transformer design and compression both reduce to allocating capacity under a budget. The standard scalars for these decisions, #Params and #FLOPs, capture size and compute but not architectural structure: two architectures with identical parameter budgets but different depth-width, head, or FFN allocations receive identical scores yet behave differently. We propose Neural Spectral Capacity (NSC), a closed-form scalar grounded in the singular-value spectrum of each weight matrix. Under standard random initialization, the Marchenko-Pastur law renders NSC computable from the architectural specification alone, with no model instantiation, data, or gradients. Its layer-wise additive structure admits NSC-DP, an exact dynamic-programming solver returning the architecture globally maximizing NSC under resource constraints in seconds on a CPU -- a guarantee that black-box search over existing training-free proxies cannot provide. Empirically, NSC outperforms #Params, #FLOPs, and representative training-free proxies in ranking across seven Transformer and CNN families (on FlexiBERT, $\tau = 0.505$ on pairs differing in #Params by less than 10%, where #Params collapses to 0.082); NSC-DP discovers a Transformer-XL architecture on WikiText-103 that beats the human-designed baseline in 2 seconds; and prunes LLaMA-7B to the best 5.7B model across eight commonsense reasoning tasks without any calibration data, about 5900x faster than the strongest training-free proxy baseline.

</details>


### [372] [Whitening Inverts the Hierarchy: What the Norm of a Whitened Embedding Measures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23117)
*Mohammed Ahnouch,Lotfi Elaachak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文挑战了"白化嵌入的平方范数可作为免训练似然代理"这一被广泛使用的实践，通过严格的统计分析和六个编码器的实验，证明白化坐标近似标准正态这一观察不能推断联合高斯性，并揭示白化反转编码器谱层次结构的机制，最终将平方白化范数重新解读为语义非典型性的马氏度量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期研究（如Levi和Gilboa, 2025; Betser等人）观察到白化坐标近似标准正态，据此将白化嵌入的平方范数作为免训练的似然代理，广泛用于OOD评分、字幕质量评估和生成图像/视频检测。然而，该推论的统计基础未经严格检验——坐标边缘正态并不意味联合高态，且实践中Gaussian阈值校准严重失效（错误达10³¹量级）。本文旨在厘清白化范数真正度量的是什么。

Method: 1) 复现Betser等(2025)的协议，在5000个MS-COCO val2017图文对上用CLIP ViT-L/14编码，复现10/12个已发布统计量至5%以内；2) 构建协方差匹配的高斯克隆和球面克隆进行对照实验，使用半样本白化避免in-sample偏差；3) 极坐标分解分析，测试6个编码器（CLIP、CLIP变体、SigLIP、DINOv2）；4) 推导解析公式：白化反转谱层次的命题（Prop. 4）、对比损失无法确定径向律的定理（Thm. 5）、Anderson-Darling检验功效的展开（Prop. 2）；5) 提出两时刻识别单输入尺度参数(V, ρ_s)的模型，并通过预测不相交谱半段相关性进行无自由参数验证。

Result: 1) 已发布的经验-理论范数统计量吻合是in-sample白化对任意分布施加的代数恒等式，非高态性证据；真正χ_768预测下偏差达5.57×和8.09×，均偏离协议零假设62σ和126σ；2) 联合律既非高斯也非球面——对六个编码器在所有三种训练目标下，whitened半径相对于协方差匹配克隆均过度离散5.90×至7.55×（8σ至64σ显著）；3) 机制：白化反转编码器谱层次，前k个方向的范数贡献从66-69%降至k/d=9-27%，范数被推向近退化方向；4) 识别单输入尺度s(x)（变异系数约1/3），两参数(V, ρ_s)从过离散度和半段相关联合确定，可无自由参数预测不相交谱半段依赖；5) 平方白化范数实为语义非典型性的马氏度量，与20-NN余弦密度估计ρ=0.80一致，跨编码器ρ=0.62，与非参密度估计一致；6) Theorem 5证明基于余弦相似度的对比损失无法确定径向律——Gaussian性是参考测度的产物而非损失的产物；7) 一维再校准（Prop. 6）可将所有标称尾概率恢复准确。

Conclusion: 白化基础模型嵌入所做的远不止高斯化：它反转编码器的层次结构，使平方白化范数量度的是输入在编码器语义子空间之外放置的能量，即非典型性的马氏度量。该度量在排序上与非参密度估计及跨编码器一致（ρ≈0.80和0.62），解释了检测的有效性；但其径向律是语料库的非典型性分布而非χ_d，导致Gaussian阈值偏差达10³¹量级。方法论启示：关于学习表示的分布声明只能在共享表示协方差的零假设下检验，否则恒等式可伪装为预测，因子六的偏离可读作一致。对比损失本身对径向律不可见，因此选择不同目标不会改变径向行为。

Abstract: Whitening a foundation-model embedding and using its squared norm as a training-free likelihood surrogate is motivated by the observation that whitened coordinates often appear approximately standard normal. We show that this observation follows from the projection central limit theorem and therefore does not imply a Gaussian joint distribution. Across multiple encoders and three training objectives, we find systematic over-dispersion of the whitened radius relative to the Gaussian reference, including against distributional clones with identical mean and covariance. We further show that the commonly reported agreement between empirical and theoretical norm statistics is an algebraic consequence of in-sample whitening and does not constitute evidence for Gaussianity. We identify the mechanism behind this behavior: whitening reverses the encoder's spectral hierarchy, shifting the contribution to the squared norm toward near-degenerate directions that encode predominantly noise. In these directions, the dominant variability is governed by a single input-dependent scale. We estimate this scale from two moments and use it to predict, without additional free parameters, the cross-dependence between disjoint spectral halves. These results indicate that the squared whitened norm is better interpreted as a Mahalanobis measure of semantic atypicality than as a log-likelihood. This interpretation explains both its practical effectiveness and its calibration failures: the statistic can rank and detect atypical samples consistently with nonparametric density estimates and across encoders trained with different objectives, while Gaussian tail thresholds can be inaccurate by orders of magnitude. etc.

</details>


### [373] [Triggers and Diagnostics for LLM-Based Interpretability Failures in Active Inference Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23215)
*Param Raval,Rohit Shenoy,Archana Vaidheeswaran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文审计了LLM解释器作为自主代理运行时监督层的安全风险:在基于主动推理的德国电网代理上测试GPT-4o、Claude-3-Opus、Gemini三种后端,通过观测注入、谄媚触发、元数据注入三种黑盒攻击证明所有解释器均产生流畅但错误的叙述,论证解释器审计应纳入任何代理部署审计流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM解释器被附加到自主代理作为运行时监督,但该层未经审计。若解释器可被触发产生自信的错误叙述(为错误行为辩护、遗漏对抗性篡改、执行注入指令),则监督形同虚设。论文核心论点是:仅审计代理而遗漏解释层,等同于遗漏运维人员实际阅读的那一层。

Method: 构建LLM解释器+主动推理(AIF)代理系统,在德国电网需求数据上评估。三种黑盒触发-诊断对:(1)600 MW/步观测注入导致490 MW后验漂移,30条解释中0条告警;(2)20个客观错误动作案例,80-95%产生流畅辩护(n=20/后端);(3)观测元数据字段注入,数据窃取在三个后端全部成功。

Result: 三种故障模式均产生"流畅且错误"输出:(1)漂移失明——严格评分下零告警;(2)谄媚合理化——GPT-4o/Claude 80%,Gemini 95%(但Wilson区间重叠,排序不成立);(3)跨提供商注入——数据窃取全成功,其他类攻击呈提供商依赖。三种故障被分类为感知/认识论/信任边界失败,但独立性未经验证。

Conclusion: 解释器在所有观察到的故障中均未检查自身叙事的真实性,无架构机制在运维行动前验证解释——因此测试解释器应纳入任何代理部署审计。论文价值在于确立问题而非提供解决方案;缓解方案全部仅提议未评估,作者明确列出多项待办实验(剂量-反应曲线、基线检测器对照、n≥100复现、跨模式统一性测试、人工运维者研究)为首要未来工作。

Abstract: LLM explainers are increasingly attached to autonomous agents as runtime oversight, with operators reading a generated account of the agent's beliefs and actions rather than its internal state. We audit the account itself, pairing an Active Inference (AIF) agent that tracks German grid demand and adjusts generation with an LLM explainer on three backends (GPT-4o, Claude-3-Opus, Gemini), and probing the pair with three black-box triggers. Corrupting the observation stream by 600 MW per step moves the agent's posterior by 490 MW, roughly 0.9% of grid capacity. None of the 30 explanations produced during the injection flag anything under a stated rubric, and each narrates the corrupted belief fluently. On timesteps where the agent takes an objectively wrong action, all three explainers produce a sycophantic rationalization 80-95% of the time (n = 20 per backend). Attacker-controlled text in the observation metadata field steers the explainer, with susceptibility differing by provider and data exfiltration succeeding on all three. We propose mitigations for each failure but do not evaluate them. In every failure we observed, the explanation was fluent and wrong. Moreover, nothing in the explainer architecture checks whether an explanation is true before an operator acts on it. Testing the explainer therefore belongs in any audit of an agentic deployment.

</details>


### [374] [Why Ghost Outputs Teach: A Kernel-Based Understanding of Subliminal Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23260)
*Zhe Li,Bicheng Ying,Chaosheng Dong,Haibo Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从学习动力学角度提出"链式跨任务核"（chained cross-task kernel），统一解释了Subliminal Learning（SL）中三个核心经验谜题——为何共享初始化下的ghost-output监督能对齐真实任务目标、ghost维度为何构成迁移瓶颈、以及高熵合成输入为何优于结构化数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SL研究多关注"信号藏在哪里"（token纠缠、激活表示、罕见分歧token等），但缺乏对"优化机制如何通过这些看似无关的信号产生真实任务改进"的机理理解。具体而言存在三个未解问题：Q1 为何ghost匹配能让学生学到下游任务；Q2 ghost输出维度如何影响SL；Q3 为何高斯噪声比真实数据更有效。

Method: 基于学习动力学与神经切线核（NTK）框架，推导一阶Taylor展开下的logit更新方程，揭示跨任务经验NTK结构 $\mathcal{K}_{zh}(x_o, x_u) = W_z \mathcal{K}_g(x_o,x_u) W_h^\top$。在共享初始化假设下分解为三项：PSD自对齐基态、时间漂移扰动、跨样本干扰；并扩展到多步场景。关键代数分解表明传递算子具有 $MM^\top$ 形式的PSD结构，瓶颈由 $W_h^\top W_h$ 的秩（即 $|h|$）控制，特征核 $\mathcal{K}_g$ 的非退化性由输入熵保证。

Result: 在单隐层MLP（MNIST）和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上的实验验证了三个理论预测：(1) 共享初始化是SL的必要条件（无共享初始化→9.52% vs 共享→75.16%）；(2) 迁移仅通过共享backbone发生（冻结backbone→8.37% chance level）；(3) ghost维度 $|h|$ 在5–10处饱和（远低于 $d_{L-1}=100$），全秩噪声（Uniform/Gaussian）显著优于真实MNIST图像；在LLM上偏好迁移率高达91.1%（随机k码数序列），且仅需2–5维隐藏状态匹配即可保留50–63%的偏见迁移。

Conclusion: 链式跨任务核为SL提供了首个基于学习动力学的统一理论解释：PSD结构→无需标签的任务对齐保证；$W_h^\top W_h$ 秩瓶颈→ghost维度调控特征迁移带宽；宽带探测输入→保持特征核非退化性。多步消除表明PSD基态在每步迭代中持续存在，漂移项作为零均值噪声被平均掉，解释了为何瞬时对齐信号弱但长期迁移可持续。在词表规模 $V \gg d_{L-1}$ 的现代LLM中，$W_{\text{vocab}}^\top W_{\text{vocab}}$ 近似为缩放单位阵，因此ghost瓶颈被彻底击穿。

Abstract: Subliminal Learning (SL) is a recently identified phenomenon in which a student model acquires downstream task capabilities by matching seemingly unrelated auxiliary outputs from a teacher, despite never observing task labels, task-specific outputs, or the original training data. While recent studies have identified where subliminal signals may reside, the optimization mechanism underlying this phenomenon remains poorly understood. In this work, we provide a mechanistic understanding of SL through the lens of learning dynamics. Specifically, we derive a chained cross-task kernel that explicitly links ghost-output supervision to changes in task predictions through shared backbone representations. Our unified analytical framework provides a rigorous mathematical explanation for three central empirical puzzles in SL: (i) under shared initialization, the transfer operator forms a strictly Positive Semi-Definite (PSD) structure, guaranteeing that ghost-output optimization aligns the student with the teacher's true task objective without explicit label exposure; (ii) the ghost-output dimensionality acts as an explicit rank bottleneck governing the transfer of task-relevant features; and (iii) synthetic, high-entropy inputs function as broadband probes that maximize cross-task kernel overlap, explaining why random noise consistently outperforms structured data for subliminal transfer. Experiments on the canonical ghost-output setting validate all three theoretical predictions, providing the first learning-dynamics-based theoretical explanation of how ghost-output supervision gives rise to subliminal learning.

</details>


### [375] [ValueDiff: Value-Geometric KV Cache Eviction for Sink-Suppressed LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23314)
*Junyoung Park,Jungwook Choi,Mingu Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ValueDiff是一种针对"sink抑制"LLM的KV缓存逐出策略，通过计算value向量与缓存均值的距离来评估token重要性，在长上下文推理场景下优于传统注意力分数和key几何方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代LLM（如采用QK归一化、门控注意力、学习注意力sink或logit软封顶的架构）表现出较弱的持久注意力sink现象，导致依赖key侧信号的现有KV缓存逐出方法失效。论文观察到此类模型中value向量相对于key向量具有更大的离散度，暗示value几何可作为更可靠的查询无关逐出信号。

Method: ValueDiff定义token的逐出分数为该token的value向量与缓存value均值的L2距离：s_j = ‖v_j - v̄‖，其中v̄为缓存均值。低分token被视为近似冗余优先逐出，高分token则被保留。文章还提出两个消融变体：ValueDiff-Dir（仅保留方向信息，1-cos(v_j, v̄)）和ValueDiff-Norm（仅保留幅度信息，‖v_j‖）。理论上，该分数可从最大熵假设下最小化注意力输出扰动的推导中得出（Proposition 3.1）：在均匀未来注意力分布下，ValueDiff即是最小扰动逐出规则。

Result: 在RULER基准的2k严格缓存预算下，ValueDiff在7个sink抑制模型中的6个上保留88-99%的密集性能；在LongBench的4k预算下，sink抑制模型平均保留92%对比最强基线的83%；在MATH-500的25%缓存预算下，ValueDiff在所有测试的sink抑制模型上都是最优非密集方法，在门控注意力模型上超越先前方法高达约20分。文章提出二维几何图像（σ_V/σ_K与BOS余弦相似度）解释模型在不同架构下的逐出信号偏好：sink抑制模型倾向于value主导几何，标准模型如Llama系则保持key主导（σ_V/σ_K<0.5）。峰值GPU内存方面，在Qwen3.5-4B的128k上下文设置下从15.0 GB降至8.6 GB（-43%）。

Conclusion: ValueDiff证明value几何作为查询无关逐出信号在sink抑制LLM中比key几何或注意力分数更为可靠。该方法在sink抑制模型上获得最佳性能，同时在混合几何和key主导模型上仍具竞争力。Qwen2.5由于每层几何异质性高（sink率和σ_V/σ_K在层间剧烈波动）且GQA压缩比高（8:1），成为唯一所有逐出方法都表现退化的模型。未来研究方向包括自适应组合key侧和value侧几何的混合逐出分数。

Abstract: Modern LLMs with QK-normalization, gated attention, learned attention sinks, or logit softcapping exhibit weaker persistent attention sinks, on which existing KV cache eviction methods primarily rely. We observe that across these models, weaker sinks co-occur with greater value-vector dispersion relative to key-vector dispersion. Motivated by this value-side dispersion, we present ValueDiff, a value-geometric eviction that ranks tokens by the L2 deviation of their value vectors from the cache mean. The same score arises as the minimal-disturbance eviction under a max-entropy assumption about future attention. We evaluate under fixed cache budgets, with eviction at every block boundary during prefill and at every decoding step during generation. On RULER at a tight 2k token budget, ValueDiff retains 88--99\% of dense across seven sink-suppressed models (best on 6 out of 7). On LongBench at the 4k budget, ValueDiff averages 92\% retention across sink-suppressed models versus 83\% for the strongest prior baseline. On MATH-500, ValueDiff is the strongest non-dense method on every sink-suppressed model tested at the 25\% cache budget, outperforming prior methods by up to $\sim$20 points on gated-attention models. Across all three benchmarks, value geometry emerges as the more reliable query-invariant eviction signal for sink-suppressed models.

</details>


### [376] [A Patient World Model for Early Forecasting of Digital Health Campaign Outcomes: Capabilities and Limits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23333)
*Yunlong Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向数字直接面向消费者(DTC)健康营销的"患者世界模型"(Patient World Model)，通过GRU序列模块、生存风险头和转移头联合训练，实现对罕见新品牌处方(NBRx)量的早期精准预测。在第4周截断处预测52周处方量的相对误差仅2.9%，远超现有基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字健康营销活动通常在事后进行效果归因，而飞行中(in-flight)预测需要为每个截止周和预测视野单独训练分类器，导致累积转化曲线可能出现下降（违反单调性），且无法模拟干预场景下的未来轨迹。作者将这一任务建模为动态系统问题，构建干预条件下的患者世界模型来弥补这一缺陷。

Method: 模型架构由三部分组成：(1)序列状态模块（采用两层GRU，隐藏维度128，约20万参数）；(2)风险头（hazard head）：从隐状态输出每周转化风险；(3)转移头（transition head）：预测下一周的曝光向量，作为辅助监督信号。训练目标结合离散时间生存似然和下一曝光预测的MSE损失（λ=0.3）。推理时通过递归展开生存公式 $F_i(k|\tau)=1-\prod_{m=\tau+1}^{k}(1-h_{i,m})$ 生成单调一致的累积发生率曲线。理论上证明了滚动预测误差为加性传播、总体量预测的Bernstein集中界，以及Fisher信息论证密集转移监督在罕见事件中的必要性。

Result: 在147,173名患者、520万人周风险数据上：(1) NBRx（处方）罕见终点：第4周截断相对误差2.9%，第8-26周截断0.8-2.6%，达到甚至低于统计采样下界；最强非递推基线（合并风险GBM）误差13.6-33.1%；常规逐(τ,H)分类器误差2582-18390%；(2) 诊断(dx)常见终点：世界模型与合并风险GBM均处于个位数误差带内，性能相当；(3) 消融实验：去掉转移监督(λ=0)使处方量误差增加2-14倍，对诊断结局无明显影响；(4) 场景模拟：关闭所有未来曝光(α=0)使预测转化率从0.31逆转为0.89，揭示观测数据中的选择偏差导致因果解释失效。

Conclusion: 干预条件下的患者世界模型为飞行中营销测量提供了结构化解决方案，对罕见终点（NBRx）实现了统计上接近最优的预测精度，性能优势源于罕见事件下密集转移监督提供的编码器曲率信息。模型同时支持场景模拟，但其输出不能直接解读为因果效应，必须配合实验设计或显式去混杂方法。该方法可推广至依从性项目、疫苗接种活动及公共卫生传播等领域。

Abstract: Digital direct-to-consumer (DTC) health campaigns are usually measured after the fact. In-flight forecasting commonly relies on a separate classifier for every cutoff and horizon. We treat this task as a dynamic-system problem and build a compact patient world model. The architecture maintains a latent state per patient, learns exposure-conditioned state dynamics jointly with a weekly conversion hazard, and rolls forward into future conversion curves. We evaluate it on a US campaign dataset with 147{,}173 patients and 5.2 million at-risk person-weeks. In a retrospective evaluation conditioned on recorded future exposures, the model forecasts the remaining new-to-brand prescription volume through week 52 with a relative error of 2.9\% from a week-4 cutoff and 0.8--2.6\% from cutoffs at weeks 8--26. The strongest non-recurrent baseline, a pooled-hazard gradient boosting model given the same survival rollout and information, has relative errors of 13.6--33.1\%. Per-horizon classifiers perform substantially worse. A Fisher-information analysis motivates dense next-exposure supervision when conversions are rare. Removing this auxiliary objective increases prescription-volume error by approximately $2$--$14\times$, while providing no consistent disadvantage on the more common specialist-visit outcome. We also evaluate scenario simulation. Switching all future exposure off raises predicted conversion from 0.31 to 0.89, a pattern consistent with selection effects in observational exposure data. This result highlights the limits of interpreting exposure-conditioned rollouts causally.

</details>


### [377] [Discovering Physical Representation Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23381)
*Linzhe Zhang,Changming Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"物理表示语言发现"问题,旨在从匿名受控实验中恢复物理系统隐藏的本体论(载体、秩、类型、对偶、规约对称性)。给出了可识别性理论、多项式时间构造算法、两阶段测量样本复杂度的端到端上下界及匹配的极小极大速率,并通过盲Maxwell恢复实验、非结构化RLC电路、稀疏求解器扩展以及多个外部数据审计(FIDTD、PROTECT-90、Grid2Op)进行了广泛验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的科学机器学习方法(方程发现、对称发现、离散外微积分学习)都假定已提供坐标系、状态向量或胞腔复合形等表示语言,但物理定律必须建立在这种语言之上才能被表达。本文动机是将科学ML从"在人类提供的语言中学习定律"推进到"发现定律可被表达的语言本身",确立观测可识别性的精确理论极限。

Method: 方法核心是:(1)将材料干扰表征为交换子(commutant),两个非交换几何探针将其坍缩为标量;(2)利用分离指纹D与边界观测B重构载体偏序集与秩;(3)通过非可逆精化(summation vs 测度加权平均)区分广延量与强度量;(4)通过两探针交织(相对对偶)与极分解恢复配对Pk和边界感知相对对偶;(5)三阶段过程:载体与传输恢复→对偶与几何→匿名物理定律→商空间与证书提取;给出多项式时间算法O(n³+Mn²),并提供稀疏局部Hodge子类。理论工具包括DEC、可识别性定理、有限样本引理、极小极大匹配界。

Result: 主要结果:(1)定理1:受限载体谱与两探针条件下匿名本体可识别(载体、秩、类型、扭向、Maxwell图、规范类);(2)定理2:无边界有限恢复不可能(光滑非线性、无界因果记忆、未知图局部性、无源可逆块四类均存在不可区分的2-律先验,minimax误差≥1/2);(3)定理3:两阶段端到端商空间样本复杂度,匹配极小极大阶Θ(1+σ²/(α₀²ε²)[n²+log(1/δ)]);(4)实验:盲Maxwell在195-1347细胞上达100%完整恢复(独立读出后),66,052细胞稀疏求解0.213秒;RLC完整恢复达275细胞;Maxwell残差~10⁻¹⁵;0.3%联合噪声单次失败,四次重复恢复20/20;外部FDTD审计证实匿名旋度支撑恢复至100%RMS噪声,PROTECT-90类型/共定位100%恢复,Grid2Op 118子站图语言恢复。

Conclusion: 结论:受控匿名实验可在命名方程提供之前识别物理表示语言。理论明确指定恢复内容与不可恢复内容;实验展示完整盲Maxwell与RLC恢复、极小极大阶稀疏局部子类,以及在记忆、非线性、非局部性、滞后、双各向异性受控扩展。匹配的不可能性界识别了基本信息论极限,刻画了物理表示学习需要结构化实验干预的边界。框架将科学发现从人类表示中的曲线拟合推进到底层几何结构的自主发现。

Abstract: Before a machine can discover a physical law, it must discover what its measurements are: which observations live on cells, which are intensive or extensive, which sectors are dual, and which distinctions are merely gauge. We introduce physical representation-language discovery, the problem of recovering this hidden ontology directly from anonymous controlled experiments. We give an identifiability theory and constructive polynomial-time procedure that recovers a carrier and differential sequence, measurement types and orientation twist, noninvertible refinement semantics, primal-dual Maxwell diagrams, and the residual equivalences that no permitted experiment can break. The theory turns material nuisance into a commutant, uses refinement to separate quantities from coordinates, and selects physics only after its representation has been recovered. For a certified finite experiment family, we prove an end-to-end two-stage measurement bound and a matching minimax rate in dimension, accuracy, and confidence. Blind Maxwell experiments recover complete primal/relative-dual ontologies on regular and unstructured carriers under jointly corrupted observations; an independent unstructured RLC system demonstrates that the result is not specific to Maxwell. The framework scales to tens of thousands of cells per carrier, while stress audits demonstrate robustness across severe physical regimes - including non-Markovian memory, nonlinearities, nonlocality, and complex constitutive hysteresis. A public FDTD audit demonstrates the emergence of anonymous curl structure from incomplete field data, while characterizing the informational prerequisites for complete recovery. The goal is to move scientific ML from learning laws in a human-supplied language to discovering the language in which laws become expressible, establishing exact theoretical limits on observational identifiability.

</details>


### [378] [Blind Thermodynamic Ontology Discovery from Anonymous Experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23387)
*Linzhe Zhang,Changming Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种从匿名控制实验中盲发现热力学本体论（ontology）的理论框架与算法。当传感器仅暴露于广延量和强度量的未知线性混合时，被动观测无法区分物理量与坐标伪影。作者建立了操作可识别性理论，并给出多项式时间算法，通过复制对比（replication contrast）、热接触与互易性（cotangent pairing）、离散循环凹性检验（discrete cyclic concavity）和储库耦合（reservoir coupling）四种物理干预，逐步将观测对称群从 GL(2d) 约化到精确的热力学规范 (x, λ) ~ (Ax, aA^{-T}λ + β)。在 van der Waals 流体、Curie-Weiss 磁体及 NIST WebBook 六种真实流体上得到验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学机器学习通常假设温度、体积、化学势等热力学坐标标签是先验已知的，但这回避了一个根本问题：自主观测者能否从匿名的、未校准的实验中直接发现热力学坐标系？被动观测数据无法分解热力学的深层结构（Euler齐次性、接触几何、Legendre对偶、凸稳定性），存在无监督不可识别的障碍。

Method: 1) **T1 复制对比（Scaling Invariance）**：利用 Euler 齐次性区分广延量和强度量子空间，构造线性对比向量，秩-d SVD 提取子空间投影；2) **T2 热接触与对偶配对（Cotangent Duality）**：通过热接触端口的互易性（Maxwell reciprocity）和单调校准，恢复 cotangent 配对，将 GL(d)×GL(d) 规范约化为 contragredient 规范 (A, aA^{-T})；3) **T3 完整性与离散循环凹性（Integrability and Concavity）**：通过保持闭环积分（holonomy 检验）和离散循环凹性条件验证全局单值凹势的存在，自动识别 Maxwell tie-line 并排除非平衡/亚稳态分支（Floyd-Warshall 算法）；4) **T4 集合体流形与稳定 Matroid（Ensemble Manifolds）**：通过储库耦合构建响应矩阵 G 的主子式，导出在残余规范下不变的稳定 ensemble matroid。证明残余观测等价严格为 (x, λ) ~ (Ax, aA^{-T}λ + β)，是 Lie 群齐次接触自同构的精确表征。

Result: 1) 解析仿真：在 100 个随机混合矩阵（M 条件数 κ=10，噪声 σ=0.3%）下，vdW 流体规则态严格恢复成功率 0.97-1.00，Curie-Weiss 磁体 0.99-1.00；亚稳/临界点处成功率仍达 0.89/0.99；非平衡延拓 100% 被拒绝。2) 基线对比：PCA 与 FastICA 即使在 oracle 3+3 划分下也完全失败（角度误差 45°-70°），深度 MLP 预测精度 R²=0.9968 但零本体论恢复。3) 必要性消融：移除任一物理干预均留下不可消除的歧义（无复制导致任意子空间划分 77.9° 误差；无互易性导致 Jacobian 偏斜 0.235；无准静态环导致 annulus period 1.2566 等错误接受）。4) 真实流体验证：在 NIST WebBook 六种真实物质（H₂O、CO₂、CH₄、N₂、NH₃、C₃H₈）共 600 次盲试验中，正确接受 94.5% 真实共存 tie-line、拒绝 98.5% 温度不匹配负对照，独立 Clapeyron 审计精度 0.0088%-0.231%。5) Curie-Weiss 系统在临界点附近通过 χ⁻¹→0 自然地展示 matroid 的 rank drop。

Conclusion: 热力学状态空间可被自主发现，无需先验假设坐标系。通过复制、接触、准静态环和储库耦合四种物理可操作的干预，自主观测者将 GL(2d) 混合对称性逐步约化为精确的热力学规范 (x, λ) ~ (Ax, aA^{-T}λ + β)。发现的工作微分 λ^T dx 和 Hessian 惯性在残余规范下严格不变，因此后续符号回归（SINDy 等）发现的状态方程代表真正的物理定律而非观测者依赖的参数化。该框架为自驱动实验室（SDL）中机器人实验设计提供了原则化的决策策略，并将为多组分反应体系（d=k+2）、信息几何与 Fisher 度量桥接以及凸神经网络在未校准硬件上的部署提供基础。被动档案数据缺乏必要的干预结构，无法进行本体论发现，凸显了主动操作干预在未来自主实验室中的必要性。

Abstract: Before a machine learning model can learn a thermodynamic equation of state, it must discover what its measurements represent: which channels scale with system size, which are intensive conjugates, how sectors pair through contact, and which potential governs stability. When sensors expose only an unknown linear mixture of extensive states and intensive responses, passive observations cannot disentangle physical quantities from coordinate artifacts. We formulate the problem of discovering this hidden thermodynamic ontology directly from anonymous controlled experiments. We present an operational identifiability theory and a constructive polynomial-time algorithm that extracts extensive and intensive scaling sectors from replication contrasts, recovers their dual cotangent pairing from thermal contact and reciprocity, verifies a globally admissible concave potential via discrete cyclic concavity, and determines an invariant matroid of reservoir ensembles. We prove that the residual observational equivalence is strictly (x, lambda) ~ (A x, a A^{-T} lambda + beta), establishing the sharp observational limit that no permitted experiment can break. Blind evaluations on van der Waals fluids and Curie-Weiss magnets confirm robust recovery under ill-conditioned mixing, correctly resolving anonymous Maxwell tie-lines while rejecting non-equilibrium continuations. External validation across six real fluids from the NIST WebBook demonstrates that operational ontology discovery transfers across real physical substances without coordinate leakage.

</details>


### [379] [RLVR$^{2}$: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rubric-based Ranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23457)
*Hao Li,Zhengkun Zhang,Gangqiang Hu,Zhen Zhang,Yude Gao,Dai Dai,Jing Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RLVR$^2$ 提出了一种基于排序的强化学习范式，将多维度评分标准的聚合从标量打分改为组内序数比较：通过Bradley-Terry模型从每个标准的组内胜负矩阵中恢复潜在效用，避免了异构评分标准之间的尺度校准问题，并支持将推理长度和格式等辅助属性作为协变量进行目标保持式的调整，在三个模型规模和16个基准上优于现有基于标量的聚合方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR正在从具有明确正确性信号的任务（如数学和代码）扩展到需要多维评分标准的开放式任务。现有的奖励聚合方法通常对每个评分标准的得分进行标准化后线性组合，这隐含假设不同标准的基数差异可直接比较且可相互补偿——当评分标准语义异构时，这一假设不可靠。此外，增加更多评分标准会引入可被利用的奖励变化（如冗长和格式偏好），而缺乏控制非目标性奖励变化的机制。

Method: RLVR$^2$采用基于排序的可验证范式：(1) 对每个评分标准，将组内多个rollout的得分转换为组内胜负/平局结果，丢弃原始得分幅度；(2) 用Bradley-Terry模型从组内比较矩阵中恢复每个标准的潜在效用，按权重融合并归一化得到训练信号；(3) 通过目标保持式属性调整，将推理效率、格式等辅助属性作为协变量纳入比较矩阵，联合估计质量效用与属性系数，从而在控制这些属性的同时不改变训练目标；(5) 通过硬质门槛和软惩罚实现质量层级的硬性约束。

Result: 在Qwen3.5-4B、Qwen3.5-9B和GLM-4.5-Air 106B三种模型规模及16个基准测试上，RLVR$^2$在大多数基准上达到最佳表现，尤其在指令跟随维度提升显著（如106B下SysBench达到73.20，AdvancedIF达到67.32）；对顺序保留的得分变换保持完全不变性（符号一致性100%，Spearman相关系数1.0）；推理效率控制可在不同衰减率λ下调节思维长度而不损失能力；格式控制可减少训练后期Markdown标记密度而不需将其设为评分标准；与Focal奖励组合可进一步提升表现。

Conclusion: RLVR$^2$是一种用于异构评分标准的可验证排序训练框架，通过组内序数融合解决了跨标准的尺度校准问题，并通过协变量式的属性调整控制非目标性奖励变化，在多模型规模下实现了一致的领先表现，且与饱和度感知的评分标准重加权方法互补。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is expanding from tasks with well-defined correctness signals, such as mathematics and code, toward multifaceted quality requirements specified by multi-dimensional rubrics. Since policy optimization consumes one scalar per rollout, rubric-based pipelines must map multiple criterion scores into a scalar reward. This aggregation is often treated as score scaling, but it implicitly determines how quality dimensions trade off during training. The prevailing practice, normalizing each criterion and taking a linear combination, assumes that cardinal score differences are comparable across criteria and that gains on one criterion compensate for failures on another; both assumptions are unreliable when criteria are semantically heterogeneous. We propose Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rubric-based Ranking (RLVR$^2$), a verifiable ranking paradigm for rubric-based RLVR. For each criterion, RLVR$^2$ converts rubric scores into criterion-specific within-group ordinal outcomes, recovers a latent utility from the resulting comparison matrix, and merges these utilities into one training signal. By retaining only within-group ordering and discarding raw score magnitudes, RLVR$^2$ avoids calibrating heterogeneous rubric scales. It further supports objective-preserving attribute adjustment: auxiliary attributes that correlate with observed rankings but are not training objectives can enter the estimation without expanding the rubric or rewarding them directly. Across three model scales and 16 benchmarks, RLVR$^2$ consistently outperforms representative rubric-based baselines, achieving the best overall performance on most benchmarks at every scale. Analysis shows it controls systematic effects tied to reasoning efficiency and response formatting while preserving the quality objective.

</details>


### [380] [Predicting Out-of-Distribution Generalization of Neural Operators via Observable Spectral Error Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23529)
*Hang-Cheng Dong,Pengcheng Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于谱滤波参数化的结构保持框架，将神经算子学习为椭圆算子的Green算子的谱滤波器h_θ(λ)，通过Chebyshev多项式展开实现并以弱形式目标训练。该框架推导出精确的能范数误差分解为模型相关谱逼近项和输入相关谱权重项，并据此定义三个可观测诊断量（ε_sup、ε_rms、ε_eff(f)）。在四组受控实验（ID、带内偏移、带外尾部、复合偏移）中验证了样本依赖的有效指标ε_eff(f)·‖f‖能一致预测能范数误差，而全局指标可能被系统性误导。该工作将神经算子的OOD泛化评估从黑盒基准测试转向算子结构诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经算子在参数化PDE求解中表现出强大性能，但在分布外（OOD）偏移下可靠性不足。当前OOD泛化方法多为经验性的黑盒方法：仅报告聚合误差指标，无法说明误差产生原因或预测何时增长。PDE代理模型的失败模式具有特殊结构——输入是函数，偏移表现为其谱内容的重加权。这表明若学习算子在算子的特征基下参数化，OOD行为应当是可分析的。

Method: 1. 问题设置：在固定无边界紧致Riemann流形上的Poisson方程Δ_g u = f，平均值为零约束。2. 参数化：将学习算子限制为Δ_g的函数演算形式Ĝ_θ = h_θ(Δ_g)，其中h_θ:[0,∞)→R是可学习标量函数，通过Chebyshev多项式展开p_θ,K(λ) = Σ a_k(θ)T_k(λ̃)实现。3. 训练目标：使用弱形式残差损失L_weak(θ) = E[|∫⟨∇û,∇φ⟩ - ∫fφ|²]，配合规范化正则化（包括无穷范数、导数L2范数、严格正定性惩罚）。4. 误差分解理论：推导出精确的能量范数误差恒等式‖∇(u-û)‖² = Σᵢ λᵢ(λᵢ⁻¹ - h_θ(λᵢ))²|fᵢ|²，分离为模型相关项λᵢ^{1/2}(λᵢ⁻¹ - h_θ(λᵢ))和数据相关项|fᵢ|²。6. 三个诊断量：ε_sup(Λ) = supλ∈[λ₁,Λ] λ^{1/2}|h_θ(λ)-λ⁻¹|（保守带内上确界），ε_rms(Λ) = 带内RMS代理，ε_eff(f) = 样本依赖有效度量（用测试输入的|fᵢ|²重加权谱失配）。

Result: 实验A（ID）：能误差5.45×10⁻⁵，‖∇e‖与ε_sup‖f‖相关性0.980。实验B（带外尾部）：带内项相关性仅0.314，尾部能量相关性0.940，组合预测器0.942。实验C（带内偏移）：ε_eff(f)对ID/LOW/HIGH相关性达1.000，全局指标较弱。实验D（复合偏移）：组合预测器相关性0.921-0.999，谱重心相关性近零（-0.100至0.016）。ε_eff(f)·‖f‖在所有四种偏移下均能一致预测能量误差，而全局度量（ε_rm或ε_sup）在带内重新分布或复合偏移下可产生系统误导。

Conclusion: 本文提出了一种谱滤波参数化的结构保持框架，通过Chebyshev展开实现谱滤波器h_θ(λ)并以弱形式目标训练。所提出的精确能范数误差分解从数学上保证了两个分量的可观测性。实证表明ε_eff(f)·‖f‖是可靠预测器，ε_rm可能过度乐观，ε_sup保守但安全。该框架建立了实用审计工作流：测量h_θ的谱失配，评估测试输入如何加权该失配，预测OOD性能——将泛化评估从黑盒测试转向算子结构诊断。

Abstract: Neural operators have emerged as powerful surrogates for solving partial differential equations (PDEs), yet their reliability under distribution shift remains a critical barrier to deployment. Existing approaches to out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization in operator learning are largely empirical and black-box: they report aggregate error metrics without explaining why errors arise or when they will grow. We propose a structure-preserving framework that makes OOD generalization predictable and auditable. Our key idea is to parameterize the learned solution operator as a spectral filter $h_\theta(\lambda)$ acting on the eigenvalues of the underlying elliptic operator, implemented via Chebyshev polynomial expansions and trained with a weak-form objective. This parameterization admits an exact decomposition of the energy-norm error into two observable components: a model-dependent spectral approximation term and a distribution-dependent spectral weighting term induced by the input. From this decomposition we derive three diagnostics: a conservative in-band supremum $\vareps_{\mathrm{sup}}$, a global RMS proxy $\vareps_{\mathrm{rms}}$, and a sample-dependent effective metric $\vareps_{\mathrm{eff}}(f)$. These diagnostics can be computed without access to ground-truth solutions. Through four controlled experiments, we show that $\vareps_{\mathrm{eff}}(f)\|f\|$ consistently predicts energy error under in-distribution, in-band spectral shift, out-of-band tail, and compound shifts, whereas global metrics can be systematically misleading. Our framework shifts OOD assessment of neural operators from black-box benchmarking to operator-structure diagnostics, providing a practical route to auditable scientific machine learning.

</details>


### [381] [Physics-residual machine learning predicts oxygen-evolution catalyst activity beyond the training range from sparse polarization measurements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23549)
*Yong-Woon Kim,Jihyeok Lee,Sungtae Park,Sooseok Choi,Yung-Cheol Byun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出物理-残差机器学习方法，通过Tafel方程外推候选催化剂自身测量值至目标电位，并叠加经特征空间距离衰减的学习残差，从而以极少的测量点（每个候选仅需1-17个电流测量点）准确预测析氧反应（OER）催化剂活性，特别适用于活性超出训练范围的新候选物。在独立的322候选物库中，282个候选物的活性超出训练最大值，该方法将端点预测的平均绝对误差从纯数据驱动模型的1.330 mA cm⁻²降至0.203 mA cm⁻²，并可在仅35个标注催化剂条件下拟合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在组合材料库中筛选析氧反应（OER）催化剂时，需要决定哪些候选物应继续接受测量。决策所依据的活性值位于每个候选物测量电位窗口之外，且通常高于拟合过程中记录的所有活性值。本研究旨在解决三个同时存在的条件：1）电位外推（目标电流密度在测量窗口之上）；2）活性外推（新候选物活性高于训练标签范围）；3）测量稀疏（每个候选物测量点少，拟合标签也少）。

Method: 物理-残差机器学习构造：1）Tafel方程：从候选物自身在最高观测电位处的测量电流出发，利用候选物在最高观测电位上的局部斜率（结合开发库完整响应的中位数全局斜率先验），将响应外推至工作电位（1.70 V vs RHE）；2）学习残差：Ridge回归（或其他估计器）学习测量端点与Tafel外推之间的差值，残差乘以一个随特征空间标准化距离超出拟合分位数而指数衰减的因子（β·exp[−λ·max(0, d(x)−dq)]）；3）适用域评分dAD：基于数据驱动与物理-残差预测的分歧以及物理-残差预测超出校准活动中心90%区间的距离，在测量前识别超出训练范围的预测。模型设置通过留一库交叉验证在开发库中选择，单一设置用于所有观测预算。

Result: 主实验：在322候选物的Ni–Pd–Pt–Ru OER库（282个超出训练最大值）中，两个响应测量给出MAE 0.203 mA cm⁻²（对比纯数据驱动Ridge回归的1.330 mA cm⁻²），高位移亚组（144个候选物超出训练最大值两个IQR以上）MAE 0.191对比2.486 mA cm⁻²。Spearman相关性达0.984–0.992，20%晋升比例下精度0.892–0.931，遗憾0.012–0.017 mA cm⁻²。35个标注催化剂即可拟合，Ridge回归用全部1685个标签在两/三点测量下误差是物理-残差模型用35个标签的6.3/4.8倍。FastCat和DASH独立数据集：η10的MAE降低29–52%，MAE距五个比较模型中最低值不超过0.3 mV。适用域评分在两点测量下正确标记143/144个高位移候选物和40个范围内候选物中的0个及7-12库2019个候选物中的0.2%。

Conclusion: 物理-残差机器学习通过将每个候选物自身测量值输入Tafel外推（而非依赖训练标签），使超出训练范围的活性预测可用于组合筛选活动，物理项保证候选排序，学习残差修正幅度。物理项和学习项消除不同误差分量——Tafel外推提供排序，残差提供幅度校正。这使得每个候选物的测量可缩短至响应的早期部分，仍能有效排序和筛选最具活性的成分；该构造适用于不同实验室和测量协议的独立OER数据集，可推广到时间分辨瞬态和稳定性耐久性端点预测。

Abstract: Screening oxygen-evolution catalysts on combinatorial libraries requires deciding which candidates receive the remaining measurements. The deciding activity lies beyond each candidate's measured potential window and often above every activity recorded during fitting. We predict it by physics-residual machine learning: the Tafel equation extrapolates the candidate's own measured current and slope, a learned residual attenuated with feature-space distance corrects the magnitude, and an applicability-domain score identifies predictions above the training range before measurement. In a separately fabricated 322-candidate library, 282 above the training maximum, two measurements per candidate gave a mean absolute error of 0.203 mA cm$^{-2}$ against 1.330 for the selected data-driven machine-learning model. Errors inside the training range remained comparable, and 35 labelled catalysts were enough to fit it. In two independent datasets the same construction lowered the overpotential error by 29 to 52%. Campaigns can therefore shorten each measurement and still rank the most active compositions.

</details>


### [382] [Cost-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Action Masking and Projection for Battery Energy Storage Dispatch under Suppressed-Spread Market Shifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23590)
*Kuanlin Chen,Chen-Wei Kuo,Cheng-En Ou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在价差压缩市场环境下，基于PPO的电池储能调度方法，通过将预选物理动作掩码与紧急投影层与因果经济建议层分离，在统一核算与因果预测条件下进行机制级评估。核心结论是：PPO在两个测试窗口下均低于代理成本MPC参考，但掩码+投影层有效防止不可行请求，而经济建议仅在T2价差压缩窗口（5–10 USD/MWh区间）带来有限改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在COVID-19导致的价差压缩市场条件下，BESS套利空间被严重压缩；同时大多数DRL调度研究仅在分布内测试，缺乏在真实分布外（distributional shift）下对物理可行性机制与经济决策之间关系的机制级证据。本文旨在回答：在统一因果信息与核算下，分层物理可行性接口（动作掩码+投影）与独立经济建议各自起什么作用？RL是否在该场景下优于MPC参考？

Method: 1) MDP建模：60维状态（12标量特征+48预测特征），21离散动作表示[-1.0, +1.0]倍率充放电；奖励包含价差收益、清洁能源信用、固定吞吐量代理成本（10 USD/MWh）与温度惩罚。2) 分层接口：预选物理动作掩码（SoC/SoH/ramp约束）→ softmax前logit置-∞；紧急投影作为下游回退；经济建议基于因果24步预测施加软偏好。3) 简化物理环境：Thevenin等效电路+Arrhenius热老化+双模冷却+碳强度诊断（非验证型数字孪生）。4) 训练：clipped PPO+三阶段课程（2018–2019历史+5%轻微压力+10%扰动），2020年1月验证集选择检查点。5) 评估：5个PPO种子×7个机制消融变体（M0–M6），在T1（正常）与T2（价差压缩）两段共20个336小时窗口上评估，辅以168小时不重叠块的预测敏感性测试。6) 基线：Price MPC、Proxy-cost MPC、Rule-based、Hold。

Result: 主要数值结果（T1/T2每336小时窗口净利润，美元）：Hold 0/0；Rule-based −244.98/−258.60；Price MPC −400.11/−685.51；Proxy-cost MPC 36.77/22.94；PPO advice off 30.59/16.45；PPO advice on 30.59/18.04。关键发现：(1) PPO始终低于Proxy-cost MPC，但T2差距（4.89美元）小于种子均值标准差（10.33美元）；(2) 经济建议仅在T2有效（16.45→18.04美元），同时降低吞吐量（2.36→2.18 MWh），T1无效；(3) T2所有185次干预均落在5–10 USD/MWh区间且均将动作改为idle，低SoC净效应+0.49、中SoC −1.67美元/步；(4) 消融M2移除掩码后产生2258.6次T2不可行请求；M5同时移除两层物理保护后出现23.4次ramp违规；M0/M3无违规；(5) PPO在日/周/混合季节预测下稳定（17.74–18.12美元/块），但在持续性预测下降至8.91美元，MPC始终更高（22.74/16.71）。

Conclusion: 在统一因果信息与核算下，五种子的PPO始终低于代理成本MPC参考，但差距在种子离散度范围内。经济建议仅在T2压缩价差下提升利润并降低吞吐量，所有干预集中于5–10 USD/MWh且呈混合SoC依赖效应。M0–M6消融证实：(a) 经济筛选与物理可行性执行可被清晰分离；(b) 移除两层物理保护会暴露ramp违规；(c) 掩码单独即可拦截数千次不可行请求，投影仅作为回退。本文明确否认做出RL优越性、课程因果性、形式化安全保证或生命周期经济最优的声明，相关结论受限于简化物理、未验证老化代理、确定性预测结构及短视距设置。

Abstract: Battery energy storage system (BESS) dispatch must preserve operational feasibility while declining price spreads reduce the margin available to pay for cycling. We study a proximal policy optimization (PPO) controller whose pre-selection physical action mask and emergency projection are separated from a causal, forecast-informed economic advisory. All forecast-dependent methods receive the same causal 24-step forecast and grid-side settlement. Across five PPO seeds, advice-on net profit is 30.59 and 18.04 USD per 336-hour T1 and T2 window, versus 36.77 and 22.94 USD for proxy-cost MPC; PPO remains below this reference in both periods. Advice raises T2 profit from 16.45 to 18.04 USD while reducing throughput, but is immaterial in T1. On disjoint weekly blocks, PPO is stable under daily, weekly, and blended seasonal forecasts, weakens under persistence, and remains below proxy-cost MPC. Paired diagnostics localize changes to the observed 5-10 USD/MWh regime with mixed SoC-dependent effects. An M0-M6 ablation shows that mask removal sends thousands of infeasible requests to projection, while removing both physical layers exposes ramp violations. The evidence separates economic screening from feasibility enforcement without claiming formal safety, lifecycle-optimal aging, or RL dominance.

</details>


### [383] [A multi-temporal dataset for mapping burned areas in the Brazilian Cerrado using time series of remote sensing imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23687)
*Alisson Cleiton de Oliveira,Thales Sehn Körting*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文构建了基于 CBERS-4A、CBERS-4 和 AMAZONIA-1 卫星 WFI 传感器数据的多时相表格数据集，用于巴西Chapada dos Veadeiros国家公园2020-2022年火烧迹地制图，比较了二元与三类分类方案在多种后处理组合下的精度，并与MCD64A1产品进行了对比评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 巴西塞拉多地区火灾频繁，但现有全球火烧迹地产品（如MCD64A1）在该区域存在较大不确定性。WFI传感器具有中高分辨率与高频次重访能力，但尚未充分用于火迹制图。本研究旨在探索利用未经星间辐射定标的WFI多光谱数据与光谱指数，结合机器学习方法绘制火灾迹地，并评估其相对于现有产品的精度。

Method: 1. 数据来源：CBERS-4A/CBERS-4/AMAZONIA-1的WFI传感器蓝、绿、红、近红外波段及BAI、EVI、GEMI、NDVI、NDWI等光谱指数，构建2020-2022年多时相规则网格表格数据集；2. 标签：完全燃烧(TB)、部分燃烧(PB)、未燃烧(NB)三类；3. 分类器：随机森林；4. 两种分类方案：二元(燃烧/未燃烧)和三类(TB/PB/NB)；5. 七种后分类组合验证方案；6. 精度评价指标：总体精度、精确率、召回率与IoU；7. 与MODIS MCD64A1产品进行年度精度对比。

Result: 当TB、PB、NB作为独立类别训练，TB被重分类为燃烧区(BA)、PB与NB合并为非燃烧区时，IoU最高。与MCD64A1比较，漏分误差在2020、2021、2022年分别为22%、28%、59%，错分误差分别为46%、43%、46%。研究发现WFI传感器在未进行跨卫星光谱定标的情况下仍可用于火烧迹地制图。

Conclusion: 本研究证实了WFI传感器多光谱数据及光谱指数在无星间辐射归一化条件下用于火迹制图的可行性；最佳策略为多类分类后再合并；与MCD64A1相比仍存在较高漏分和错分误差；建议未来采用其他机器学习算法进一步挖掘该数据集潜力与适用边界。

Abstract: This paper introduces a multi-temporal tabular dataset derived from satellite images to map burned areas in the Chapada dos Veadeiros National Park, in Goiás, Brazil, covering the years 2020 to 2022. The dataset contains blue, green, red, and near-infrared bands, as well as the BAI, EVI, GEMI, NDVI, and NDWI spectral indices from the WFI sensor on the CBERS-4A, CBERS-4, and AMAZONIA-1 satellites, organized into a regular grid. We applied the Random Forest classifier to develop and validate models based on samples labeled as totally burned, partially burned, and non-burned. Two classification approaches were tested: one combining burned and non-burned areas into binary classes and another distinguishing between totally burned (TB), partially burned (PB), and non-burned (NB) classes. Seven validation approaches assessed different post-classification combinations, focusing on accuracy, precision, recall, and intersection over union (IoU) metrics. Results showed higher IoU when TB, PB, and NB were used as individual classes and TB was reclassified as burned area (BA) while PB and NB were grouped as non-burned. Comparing the annual results of this approach to the MCD64A1 product, the errors of omission for the BA class were 22% in 2020, 28% in 2021 and 59% in 2022, while the errors of commission were 46%, 43% and 46%, respectively. The study highlights the utility of the WFI sensor for burned area mapping without inter-satellite spectral calibration and suggests further exploration with other machine learning algorithms to evaluate the dataset potential and limitations.

</details>


### [384] [Tail-Weight Control and Localized Generalization in Nearly Low-Rank Adversarial Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23688)
*Kunyu Wang,Dehan Wang,Wenjun Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究欧几里得对抗扰动下范数约束线性分类器在全空间训练时对低维信号主轴外噪声尾部(spatial band)的权重控制问题。在一个高斯混合模型中，信号位于低秩主子空间、尾部为独立噪声。论文证明了：基于有界ramp损失，主空间witness的存在迫使近最优预测器的尾部权重必须很小；通过路径积分密度界得到了允许尾部方差为零的常数；在各向同性主空间上证明了唯一总体最小值与联合局部增长模型，并利用边界归一化消除掉centered margin的公共攻击惩罚，从而获得由主维数与总尾部能量支配的局部化有限样本保证。实验以20次配对重复验证了多余风险与尾部权重随样本量的下降，以及固定总能量下尾部维数增大时的近似不变性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在对抗训练中，许多观测坐标可能几乎不含标签信息，全空间学习器仍可能拟合有限样本并将其用于最坏情形margin。作者关心的问题是：(1) 全空间训练能否控制与独立、无信息尾部对应的权重；(2) 这种结构性控制如何影响泛化。传统观点认为删除噪声系数未必改善非凸有界代理函数，本文旨在通过主空间witness与路径密度界回答上述问题。

Method: 1. 建立高斯模型：X=(Z,τG)，Z=Yμ+ξ含r维主子空间信号，τG为k维独立噪声尾部。损失使用有界ramp损失ϕ_γ，欧几里得ℓ₂对抗扰动ε。2. 提出主空间witness假设(R(w₀)≤1/2−2Δ)；利用沿尾部删除路径的密度下界κ，证明Tail-Weight Localization定理，得出∥b∥²₂≤ℰ(w)/c_b，且常数为零尾部方差定义。3. 在主空间各向同性条件下，证明唯一总体最小值w*=(Bu*,0)及联合局部增长不等式：ℰ(w)≥c_a∥a−Bu*∥²+c_b∥b∥²。4. 引入边界归一化S_B(w)=Bw/∥w∥₂，消除公共攻击惩罚εB，得到球面集中界U_n^∂。5. 基于椭球局部集构造局部Rademacher复杂度K、方差上界V，使用(log-grid + 最优局部化)缩放技术得到均匀局部偏差界。6. 给出Theorem 5.1有限样本后验定界，Corollary 2以较弱的常数消除入口条件。7. 实验部分以SLSQP优化，对比全空间ramp、主空间oracle ramp、普通ramp、归一化鲁棒logistic以及归一化符号均值初始化，进行样本量、固定τ、固定能量、信号、训练攻击、主维数等多组扫描；并提供τ=0零尾部方差对照与纯噪声控制。

Result: 1. 理论：在主空间witness条件下，任何近最优预测器尾部权重的平方∥b∥²被多余风险ℰ按常数c_b线性控制；特别允许τ=0的零方差尾部。每当优化间隙ρ+2U_n^∂≤Δ时，尾部权重以概率1−η收敛到零。2. 各向同性主空间下证明w*=(Bu*,0)是唯一总体最小值，给出联合二次局部增长椭球下界。3. 归一化使球面与球的总体/经验最小值相同，同时将U_n的T+ε依赖降为√T；ε不再出现于margin集中项。4. 局部化定理给出两族有限样本多余风险上界：原始带入口检查版本(常数更好)，与全局化无入口检查版本(常数较弱)。样本量扫描中风险阶为O((r+τ²k+log n)/n)。5. 实验：归一化鲁棒ramp在n=128/512/2048/8192下，多余风险约从0.0033降至0.00005，尾部权重平方从0.038降至0.0006，约每增长4倍样本量下降4倍。固定τ=0.15时，增加尾部维数k从8到512会导致尾部能量上升与多余风险上升；但固定总能量kτ²=0.72时，多余风险与尾部权重几乎不变（约0.00083、0.010）。τ=0控制实验中尾部权重始终为0，多余风险也始终为0；n=8192满足入口条件2U_n^∂=0.138<Δ=0.193。纯噪声实验证实无witness时尾部删除会降低风险，证据witness是必要的。

Conclusion: 主空间witness + 路径密度界能强制控制全空间训练的尾部使用，从而给出由主维数与总尾部能量控制的局部化有限样本保证；归一化将攻击惩罚从margin集中中剥离，使快速率成立。局部常数在球面理性模型上是合理的，而结构性转换常数c_b,tail比统计风险上界紧得多：实证ℰ̄/c_b,tail ≈ 0.00077 vs 观测∥b∥²̄=0.00063。理论局限：常数仍偏保守；未处理一般各向异性主空间增长；未给出全局非凸求解保证；未建立最小下界；未对零攻击、信息尾部或非欧几里得几何建模；仅针对ramp多余风险，未将鲁棒分类剩余风险定量转换。实验揭示：经验拟合会激励使用尾部噪声，但简单符号均值初始化在此网格下泛化更好；论文刻画的是全空间经验拟合而非声称其优越。

Abstract: We study norm-constrained linear classification under Eu clidean adversarial perturbations in a Gaussian model with a low-dimen sional informative subspace and an independent noise tail. For bounded ramp loss, we prove that a principal-space witness with risk below one half forces every near-optimal predictor to have small tail weight. A path-specific density bound yields constants without requiring positive tail variance. Under isotropic principal covariance, we establish a unique population minimizer and joint local growth. Boundary normalization then removes the common attack penalty from centered margins, giving localized finite-sample guarantees governed by principal dimension and total tail energy. Globalized growth removes the entrance condition at weaker constants; a model-aware comparison retains local guarantees. Experiments with twenty paired repetitions show decreasing excess risk and tail use with sample size, and nearly unchanged behavior when tail dimension grows at fixed total energy. Pure-noise controls and optimizer diagnostics clarify the scope and limitations of these conclusions.

</details>


### [385] [Belted Engression: Sufficient Dimension Reduction for Generative Distributional Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23789)
*Wenxi Tan,Bing Li,Lingzhou Xue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Belted Engression，将充分降维（SDR）瓶颈融入Engression的生成架构，建立端到端的"压缩-后生成"框架。理论上证明了SDR条件等价于保律生成分解，并通过局部Bernstein型分析获得了更精细的有限样本收敛率。在统计效率和参数效率方面均优于无结构Engression基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代条件生成模型在学习复杂协变量依赖时面临挑战。现有方法直接在高维协变量X∈ℝᵖ上训练，导致收敛率随输入维度恶化。虽然充分降维（SDR）提供了原则性的依赖压缩方法，但传统SDR框架并非为条件生成而设计，且与生成模型中的潜变量噪声难以整合。因此需要设计一个统一的、端到端的框架来同时实现降维与条件分布生成。

Method: 1. 框架设计：将Engression的生成器g(X,η)分解为复合生成器h(s(X),η)，其中s:ℝᵖ→ℝᵈ作为充分预测器（"belt"），h:ℝᵈ×ℝᵠ→ℝʳ作为约简生成器。
2. 理论证明：通过命题1证明SDR条件与保律生成分解的等价性；通过命题2证明(s*,h*)是总体能量损失最小化器。
3. 有限样本分析：利用局部化Bernstein型不等式控制能量分数损失的经验过程，在标准Hölder光滑性条件下推导收敛率。
4. 架构参数化：belt和generator分别用ReLU神经网络参数化，通过经验风险最小化联合训练。

Result: 1. 理论结果：定理1给出Belted Engression的统一收敛率n⁻ᵝʰ/(ᵝʰ+ᵈ⁺ᵠ)（当s*任意光滑时）；定理2证明其收敛率严格快于Engression基线；定理3证明其架构参数随n→∞相对基线以渐近消失的速度增长。
2. 仿真结果：在100维均匀分布协变量、三种数据设置（Sin、Std、Cubic）下，Belted Engression在MSE、ED²和经验覆盖率上均显著优于Engression基线，且以更少的参数达到目标性能阈值。
3. SDR恢复：在距离相关性指标上，Belted Engression在Sin设置中表现稳健，在Std设置中匹配GSIR并在较大样本下优于BENN，在Cubic设置中对n≥1000严格超越两个基线。
4. 真实应用：社区犯罪率数据集（102个特征）上以更少参数获得更优的MSE和ED²；MNIST图像补全任务（28×28像素分辨率）生成的样本具有更好的视觉一致性和结构保真度，且学到的10维SDR瓶颈能按形状特征组织手写数字。

Conclusion: Belted Engression成功地将充分降维瓶颈融入条件生成架构，在统计效率、架构效率和SDR恢复能力三个维度均优于无结构Engression基线。其"压缩-后生成"范式为处理具有低维内在结构的复杂高维条件分布学习问题提供了一种统一原则性的解决方案，且对SDR维度的过度指定具有鲁棒性。

Abstract: Modern conditional generative models face significant challenges when learning complex covariate dependencies. While sufficient dimension reduction (SDR) provides a principled approach to compress these dependencies, traditional SDR frameworks were not formulated for conditional generation. To bridge this gap, we propose Belted Engression, a unified and architecturally parameter-efficient framework for generative distributional regression. Our approach establishes an end-to-end compress-then-generate paradigm driven by sufficient representation learning, embedding a structural bottleneck into the generative architecture. Theoretically, we prove that the standard SDR condition is equivalent to a law-preserving generative factorization, which is achieved at the global optimum of the population Belted Engression objective. Furthermore, by uncovering a localized Bernstein-type control for the energy-score loss, we establish finite-sample convergence rates that are sharper than those of existing results. We also prove that this belted architecture is strictly smaller, operating with an asymptotically vanishing parameter count relative to the unstructured baseline. Extensive simulations and real-world applications demonstrate that Belted Engression achieves superior distributional prediction and SDR recovery with fewer trainable parameters.

</details>


### [386] [VISTA: An Attention-Based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Architecture for Space Situational Awareness Sensor Tasking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23875)
*Miguel Leiva-Vélez,Adalberto Claudio Quiros,Nicolas Gaston Rozado,Hodei Urrutxua,Víctor Rodríguez-Fernández*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: VISTA是一种基于注意力机制的多智能体强化学习架构，用于大规模空间态势感知(SSA)传感器调度。其核心创新是通过物理与任务驱动的top-K检索、实体中心注意力、循环记忆和指针式动作解码，使观测和动作空间与编目规模解耦，实现了对可变目标数量和异构传感器网络的可扩展任务调度。在30个目标场景下恢复速度快31.2%，在大规模(12传感器、2000 RSOs)场景下5小时不确定性比最强经典基线降低97.5%，并在零样本测试中展现了对20,000个目标的近线性扩展能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着空间目标(RSOs)数量快速增长，SSA传感器调度面临日益复杂的组合优化问题。经典方法（协方差削减、信息增益、动态规划等）依赖预设结构和简化的在线搜索，难以处理大规模、动态目录和分布式异构传感器网络。现有深度强化学习方法受限于固定维度的状态和动作表示，无法扩展到大规模动态编目和多传感器协作场景，亟需一种能够解耦网络规模与编目规模的表示方法。

Method: VISTA采用参数共享的分布式Dec-POMDP框架，基于PPO训练。核心架构包括：(1)两阶段候选构造——先做可行性过滤，再按物理与任务评分(主要为不确定性和观测年龄)进行top-K检索；(2)类型特定编码器将ego传感器、队友传感器和候选RSO编码为统一潜在空间的实体标记；(3)多头自注意力建模实体间几何、信息与协作关系；(4)LSTM维护时序记忆；(5)指针式解码器通过查询-键匹配对当前候选集进行打分，并包含一个hold动作的logit。奖励采用目录级团队奖励，单传感器场景使用尾部感知的"坏度"函数，大规模场景使用均值级别相对奖励，异构场景增加协作项。

Result: 在三个实验阶段均表现优异：阶段I(单传感器、30 RSOs)恢复时间比EIG和扁平LSTM基线分别快29.3%和31.2%；阶段II(12传感器、2000 RSOs)5小时均值不确定性降至0.0846 km，比EIG降低97.5%，比扁平LSTM降低99.3%；零样本测试至20,000 RSOs时恢复时间与N_RSO/N_sensors呈近线性关系(拟合R²=0.882)；阶段III(4个异构传感器、240 RSOs)展现出与传感器能力互补的分配模式(平均非重复率98.27%，有效覆盖率85.76%)，模态嵌入消融验证了传感器类型信息被有效利用。注意力诊断显示策略关注不确定性与观测年龄，并在密集感知场中更强调几何slew成本。

Conclusion: VISTA通过实体中心注意力与指针选择解决了SSA任务中固定维度表示的可扩展性瓶颈，证明同一共享策略可跨可变编目规模与传感器配置工作。实验揭示了编目负载、传感器数量与恢复时长的近线性经验关系，为网络规模设计提供了依据。然而，结果基于受控仿真抽象(无摄动轨道、简化协方差传播、完美通信)，绝对不确定性值不能预测运行级精度。未来工作应集成更高保真度的轨道动力学、传感估计、不完美信息交换和更广泛的几何变化，并通过受控消融研究各组件贡献。该工作为可扩展的SSA学习型调度提供了可复现的架构基础。

Abstract: The rapid growth of resident space objects is increasing the complexity of space situational awareness sensor tasking, challenging classical optimization methods as they allocate finite, heterogeneous, and distributed sensing resources across ever-larger catalogues. Existing deep reinforcement learning approaches show promise in reduced settings, but fixed-dimensional state and action representations limit their ability to scale to large, dynamic catalogues and distributed sensing networks. We introduce VISTA (Variable-Entity Intelligent Sensor Tasking Architecture), a scalable deep reinforcement learning architecture for persistent uncertainty-driven catalogue maintenance across variable object populations and sensor configurations. VISTA combines physics- and mission-informed top-K retrieval with entity-centric attention, recurrent memory, and pointer-based action decoding, thereby keeping each agent's observation and action spaces independent of catalogue size. We evaluate VISTA across different scenarios, from fixed-size single-sensor benchmarks to large-scale space-based tasking and heterogeneous cooperative sensing. With 30 orbiting targets, VISTA recovers the catalogue 31.2% faster than the fixed-dimensional recurrent baseline. In the large-scale regime, VISTA reduces five-hour uncertainty by 97.5% relative to the strongest classical reference and by 99.3% relative to the recurrent learner. Zero-shot tests up to 20,000 objects reveal near-linear relations between sensing capacity, catalogue size, and recovery horizon. Learned policies also exhibit sensor modality adaptation and generalization to population and initial-uncertainty shifts. Together, these results demonstrate that VISTA provides a scalable framework for adaptive space situational awareness sensor tasking across large, distributed networks of heterogeneous ground- and space-based sensors.

</details>


### [387] [GLR-MM: Graph-Based Global-Local Reconstruction for Robust Multimodal Chest X-ray and EHR Representation Learning under Missing Modalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23876)
*Surbhi Sharma,Nikhil Manali,Devesh Maheshwari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GLR-MM框架，通过局部（患者内跨模态）与全局（基于仅观测模态构建的患者图注意力）双分支重建缺失模态嵌入，并自适应融合后用于ICU早期死亡预测。在9,620例MIMIC队列上，50%缺失率时GLR-MM优于MUSE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有临床多模态模型在模态缺失时，要么仅对齐观测表示、要么建模缺失机制、要么进行跨模态重建，但未能联合利用患者内部证据与临床相似的患者间证据。

Method: 将5种CXR-EHR模态映射到共享128维空间；局部分支从患者其他观测模态注意力预测缺失嵌入；全局分支在仅由观测嵌入构成的图上对拥有目标模态的邻居做注意力聚合；门控自适应融合两路估计，再用两层GAT在同图上细化患者表示完成预测；损失为类别加权BCE + 加权重建MSE + InfoNCE对比。

Result: 在MIMIC衍生的9,620例ICU入住上，MCAR 10/30/50%缺失下，GLR-MM的AUROC为0.859–0.876、AUPRC为0.480–0.566；50%匹配缺失率时GLR-MM比MUSE在AUROC/AUPRC上分别高0.0088/0.0249，10%/30%时MUSE更优；消融显示两分支AUROC几乎相同，融合主要在AUPRC上带来增益。

Conclusion: 显式全局-局部重建在严重模态缺失（50%）下最有价值，而轻中度缺失时直接图表示学习（MUSE）更优；应按部署缺失分布选择模型，而非依据完整输入性能。

Abstract: Clinical multimodal models must often predict before all chest X-ray (CXR) and electronic health record (EHR) inputs are available. Existing approaches align observed representations, model missingness, or reconstruct across modalities, but do not jointly exploit within-patient and clinically similar inter-patient evidence. We propose GLR-MM, a Graph-Based Global-Local Reconstruction framework for early ICU mortality prediction. It maps five CXR-EHR modalities to a shared space, reconstructs missing embeddings through complementary local cross-modal and global graph-attention branches, adaptively fuses their estimates, and optimizes class-balanced prediction, reconstruction, and contrastive objectives. On 9,620 MIMIC-derived ICU stays, we evaluate 10%, 30%, and 50% random modality missingness with shared deterministic masks. MUSE performs better under mild and moderate missingness, whereas GLR-MM achieves higher AUROC and AUPRC at 50% by 0.0088 and 0.0249, respectively. These results indicate that graph-guided reconstruction is most useful when inputs are severely incomplete.

</details>


### [388] [Circuit-Diff: Factual Edit-based Intervention Method for Localizing Knowledge in Attribution Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23892)
*Edward G. Friedman,Xiangchen Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Circuit-Diff，一种基于事实编辑干预的方法，用于在 Cross-Layer Transcoder (CLT) 生成的属性归因图 (attribution graph) 中定位承载特定事实知识的特征节点。方法核心是对模型施加 MEMIT 低秩事实编辑，比较编辑前后两个模型的属性归因图（使用同一冻结的 CLT），将图中角色发生变化的特征节点视为与编辑知识相关的特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Cross-Layer Transcoder (CLT) 虽然能近似神经网络的电路，但其属性归因图中的特征节点是无标签的，需要大量人工标注才能理解。研究动机是：1) 单个神经元是多义的（polysemantic），需要稀疏字典来近似特征；2) 现有自动化解释方法（如 LLM 生成描述）已被证明在干预下因果上不忠实；3) 随着 CLTs 跨域应用日益广泛，亟需更自动化、易用的电路发现工具。

Method: 方法分五步：1) 使用 MEMIT 对模型施加事实编辑 (s, r, o → o*)，得到编辑后模型 Me；2) 用同一冻结 CLT T0 计算编辑前后的属性归因图 A=G(M0, T0, p) 和 B=G(Me, T0, p)；3) 计算每个节点 n 的 δ_n（归一化激活变化）和 ΔI_n（影响力变化），将 δ_n=1 标记为"appeared"，δ_n=-1 标记为"disappeared"；4) 用邻域 prompt 生成的分布作为 null calibration，对节点进行过滤；5) 使用启发式评分 φ^(a)_n = |δ_n|^α · |ΔI_n| 对两侧节点分别排序。另发布多提示聚合工具和基于规则的超节点标注工具。

Result: 在 Gemma-2-2B 模型和 426k 特征的 CLT 上的实验表明：1) 单次 MEMIT 编辑确实会损坏冻结 CLT（替换分数在编辑提示上下降约 0.3，完备性分数下降约 0.06）；2) 未经筛选时，"appeared"侧覆盖了图 96.2% 的节点，经 null floor 过滤后降至 14.0%；3) 24 个 CounterFact 编辑的因果验证显示，方法选择的节点集合在注入侧显著优于全图影响力排名（q=5% 时，9.98 vs 5.90 centering logits），但在抑制侧优势较小；4) 案例研究（巴黎→罗马）显示，标记的特征不仅是对象标记检测器，还包括承载历史、地理、关联等周围知识的特征（如罗马神话、教皇、法国大革命等特征）；5) 跨编辑复发计数可作为区分知识承载特征与机制跟踪特征的廉价过滤器。

Conclusion: Circuit-Diff 为定位承载特定事实的特征提供了一种基于权重级因果干预（而非输入级对比或 LLM 生成描述）的简单方法。尽管存在依赖编辑成功和 CLT 保持可用等局限，但案例研究中被标记的特征在仪表板上确实呈现为围绕对象的知识而非仅仅是名称。该方法已作为开源工具发布，构建于 circuit-tracer 包之上，可供研究者尝试自己的编辑和 CLTs。

Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability defines features as the fundamental units of a neural network and circuits as the weighted subgraphs that carry out its computation. Because individual neurons are polysemantic, Cross-Layer Transcoders (CLTs) were introduced as a way to approximate a model's circuits by generating an attribution graph. The nodes of that graph, however, are unlabeled features: reading a graph means pruning it and then working out by hand what each surviving node means. To make CLTs easier to use for circuit discovery, we introduce Circuit-Diff, which intervenes on the model itself with a low-rank factual edit and takes the features whose role in the attribution graph changes under that edit as related to the edited knowledge. On the edits we examine, the flagged nodes are not only detectors of the object token: read off the CLT's released feature dashboards, they include features for the history, geography and associations surrounding the old and new objects. We formalize the method, measure how reliable a frozen CLT remains after a factual edit, test the selected nodes causally by patching them on up to 24 CounterFact edits, give a case study, and release an open-source implementation built on the circuit-tracer package, together with two further tools (multi-prompt aggregation and rule-based supernode labeling).

</details>


### [389] [Misaligned Clinical Risk Classification and Cost Asymmetry in Open-Weight Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23999)
*Star S.D. Liu,Xiyu Ding,Robert B. Barrett,Alberto Santamaria-Pang,Nic Dobbins,Harold P. Lehmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究了四个开源大语言模型（Qwen-2.5-7B/32B和Llama-3.1-8B/70B）在糖尿病风险预测任务中如何内部编码并整合假阴性（FN）与假阳性（FP）之间的代价非对称性。研究发现，虽然所有模型都能线性地恢复患者风险信息和代价方向，但代价信息并未被可靠地整合到最终的决策输出中：12个模型-措辞组合中仅2个在行为层面表现出成本正确的镜像响应；表征层面也未发现预期的镜面对称编码结构。论文强调，临床评估应纳入代价权衡测试、措辞敏感性分析和默认操作点分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学诊断本质上是一个概率估计与价值判断相结合的问题。在临床场景中，假阴性（漏诊）和假阳性（误诊）的代价通常不等同——漏诊往往被视为更严重的后果。然而，大语言模型在临床决策支持系统中的评估多集中于输出结果（如准确率、AUC），而忽略了模型内部是否真正整合了代价非对称性这一决策论核心要素。若LLM仅"表征"了代价信息却未"使用"它用于决策，则其临床部署存在安全隐患。已有研究显示其在急诊分诊中存在高达52%的漏诊率，这凸显了理解代价整合机制的重要性。

Method: 研究采用Pima Indians Diabetes数据集（768名患者），将每位患者的8项临床特征序列化为自然语言描述。实验设计为4×3×11的析因设计，包含4个开源LLM模型（Qwen-2.5-7B/32B, Llama-3.1-8B/70B）、3种代价提示条件（无代价、仅代价、代价+提示）和11个FN:FP代价比率（从1:20到20:1）。代价描述使用3种语义等价的措辞变体。方法论包括：(1) 行为提取——从最后一个token位置获取HIGH/LOW的下一个token概率；(2) 残差流激活提取——在每个解码器块后提取激活向量；(3) 线性探针——使用均值差探针检测风险和代价方向的线性可恢复性；(4) 每患者投影分析——检验表征变化与行为变化的相关性；(5) 镜像测试——检验增大FN或FP代价是否使决策向正确方向移动；(6) 一致性测试——使用Kendall τ_b检验每个患者在FN侧和FP侧是否存在成本正确的排序。所有推理使用贪心解码（temperature=0），在H100 GPU上运行。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 风险可恢复性——所有模型在残差流中线性可恢复糖尿病真实标签，AUROC峰值约0.81-0.83，与传统监督学习分类器相当；(2) 代价方向可恢复性——在所有模型中，FN-heavy与FP-heavy的提示在线性探针下可完美分类（Llama-3.1-70B前30层AUROC=1.00），但该探针在"悬崖层"急剧下降，而风险和模型自身输出探针恰在该层达到峰值；(3) 行为镜像——仅Llama-3.1-70B-原始措辞和Qwen-2.5-32B-原始措辞（12个组合中的2个）同时满足FN侧正向、FP侧负向的成本正确响应；其余10个组合的响应与方向无关；(4) 表征镜像——在一侧拟合的方向转移到另一侧时并未反转，68%-94%的幅度响应是方向无关的；(5) 一致性测试——Llama-3.1-70B和Qwen-2.5-32B在原始措辞下表现出两侧正向的τ_b，但其他模型-措辞组合表现各异；(6) 默认操作点——所有模型在无代价提示下均偏向HIGH预测（TPR 0.88-0.98，FPR 0.51-0.72），表明存在隐含的高灵敏度偏好。

Conclusion: 四个开源大语言模型均在线性可恢复的表征中编码了患者风险和临床代价权衡信息，但关键缺陷在于价值整合环节：表征存在但并未可靠地用于成本正确的决策输出。镜像对称编码结构——即增大FN和FP代价应使决策阈值反向移动——未被观察到，且代价幅度响应在多数模型-措辞组合中呈方向无关。"表征非使用"这一发现扩展了LLM可解释性领域的已有认知。临床意义在于：标准基准测试仅评估预测性能，无法检测模型是否整合了代价结构，因此临床部署评估必须纳入代价条件测试、隐含操作点报告和措辞敏感性分析，否则在高风险场景中存在自动化偏差和患者安全隐患。该研究为后续通过激活修补等因果干预方法理解代价表征与决策输出之间的电路机制奠定了基础。

Abstract: How large language models (LLMs) integrate patient risk with clinical cost tradeoffs remains poorly understood. We investigated how four open-weight LLMs (Qwen-2.5-7B/32B and Llama-3.1-8B/70B) internally represent cost tradeoffs, how these representations relate to clinical predictions, and whether decisions shift as predicted by the specified cost direction and magnitude. Using a public diabetes dataset, we varied 11 false-negative (FN) to false-positive (FP) cost ratios across three phrasings and examined representations and behavioral outputs. Patient risk was linearly recoverable on par with conventional classifiers (AUC $\approx 0.83$), and cost direction was recoverable in every model. However, representational shifts in cost direction tracked output changes only in the two larger models, and responses to cost magnitude were predominantly direction-agnostic. Only 2 of 12 model-phrasings showed both opposing responses to increasing FN versus FP costs and cost-correct ordering. Representationally, a direction fitted on one cost side did not invert when transferred to the other, as expected under mirror-symmetric encoding. These findings suggest that LLMs encode risk and cost information but do not reliably integrate them into cost-correct decisions. Clinical evaluations should therefore include tradeoff tests, phrasing sensitivity, and default operating points alongside predictive performance.

</details>


### [390] [FlashBoB: I/O-Efficient Exact Backward-over-Backward for Softmax Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24089)
*Anthony Givans,Michael Crawshaw,Mingrui Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FlashBoB 提出了一种精确且 I/O 高效的二阶反向（backward-over-backward, BoB）softmax attention 算法，通过发掘 softmax 双重反向中的分层仿射结构，将计算组织为两次流式扫描（一次行主序、一次列主序），在 A100 80GB GPU 上将精确 BoB 扩展到 N=262K，并比 PyTorch/GradMem/FlashBack 等基线实现显著更快且更省内存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FlashAttention 仅优化了 softmax attention 的前向和一阶反向，但对于二阶优化、测试时训练、基于梯度的记忆和元学习等需要"对反向再求导"（BoB）的场景，现有实现要么物化 N×N 中间张量、要么很快耗尽显存，无法在长序列下运行。

Method: 核心观察是 softmax 双重反向中两个行级标量 α_i、E_i 通过仿射方式影响所有 BoB 输出。由此提出"仿射融合"（Proposition 4.1），将原本自然的四遍扫描压缩为两遍：Pass 1（行主序）累加六个行累加器并用 α、E 一次性修正 d̃(Q)、d̃(dO)；Pass 2（列主序）利用已保存的 α、E 完成 d̃(K)、d̃(V)。该调度保持 FlashAttention 的执行模型，不产生 N×N HBM 中间张量，HBM 流量为 Θ(N²d²/M)，并在标准 score-recomputation 模型下匹配大缓存下界（Theorem 4.3、4.5）。

Result: 在 A100 80GB 上，FlashBoB 将精确 attention BoB 扩展至 N=262,144（PyTorch 在 N=8,192 即 OOM，GradMem 派生 HVP 在 N=16,384 OOM），速度比 FlashBack 快最多 6.3×，峰值显存降低最多 28×；在 GPT-2 Small/Medium/Large 端到端二阶梯度步骤上比 PyTorch math 快 1.8–2.1×、峰值显存低 3.3–4.4×；在 1B token FineWeb GPT-2 Small Sophia-H 训练中，Hessian 估计加速 2.45×、总训练墙钟时间加速 2.17×、单卡峰值显存从 ~30 GB 降至 ~14 GB，且最终损失与参考 Sophia-H 几乎完全一致。

Conclusion: FlashBoB 首次使精确的二阶 softmax attention 在长序列下既可行又高效，统一了二阶优化、测试时训练、梯度记忆与元学习等方法中共享的 BoB 原语，把"对反向求导"提升到与 FlashAttention 同样的精确、流式、I/O 高效层级；当前局限在于仅以通用 Triton 实现，尚未针对 Hopper warp 专业化、FP8、FlashAttention-3/4 流水线、d=256 等做架构级特化。

Abstract: Transformer models built on the attention mechanism have become a central building block in modern deep learning, yet softmax attention remains a major bottleneck for long-context workloads. While FlashAttention makes the forward and first backward passes I/O-efficient, it does not support backward-over-backward (BoB), which enables exact differentiation through the backward pass for applications such as second-order optimization, test-time training, gradient-based memory, and meta-learning. Existing BoB implementations either materialize large intermediate tensors or exhaust GPU memory at long sequence lengths. We present FlashBoB, an exact, I/O-efficient algorithm for BoB in softmax attention that keeps computation within on-chip tiles and avoids all $N \times N$ intermediate tensors, where $N$ is the sequence length. The key insight is a hierarchical affine structure in the softmax double backward: two row-wise scalars determine all outputs through affine transformations. This yields a two-pass schedule with bounded on-chip static random-access memory (SRAM) usage and minimal off-chip high-bandwidth memory (HBM) traffic. FlashBoB achieves $\Theta(N^2 d^2/M)$ HBM traffic ($d$ is the head dimension and $M$ is the memory size) and, within the standard FlashAttention-style score-recomputation model, matches the inherited large-cache lower bound for exact forward attention. Empirically, it scales exact attention BoB to $N=262\text{K}$ on a single A100 80GB GPU, where prior PyTorch exact baselines fail by $N=16\text{K}$, and is up to $6.3\times$ faster than FlashBack. These results make exact second-order attention practical at long-context sequence lengths where prior implementations cannot run efficiently.

</details>


### [391] [Reinforcement Learning under State and Outcome Uncertainty: A Foundational Distributional Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24103)
*Larry Preuett,Qiuyi Zhang,Muhammad Aurangzeb Ahmad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次将分布式强化学习（DistRL）扩展到部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）领域，提出了部分可观察分布Bellman算子、ψ-向量有限表示以及DPBVI算法，为风险敏感控制奠定了理论基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的强化学习方法通常最大化期望回报，将未来奖励视为标量，无法捕捉回报分布的不确定性信息。在部分可观察环境中，状态不确定性与结果不确定性同时存在，且许多实际场景（如医疗、自动驾驶）需要风险敏感规划来管理罕见但影响重大的事件。因此，需要将DistRL扩展到POMDP领域，为风险敏感决策提供理论基础。

Method: 1. 定义部分可观察分布Bellman算子 $\widetilde{\mathcal{T}}_{PO}^{\pi}$ 和最优性算子 $\widetilde{\mathcal{T}}_{PO}^{*}$，证明其在supremum p-Wasserstein度量下是γ-收缩映射；2. 引入$\psi$-向量作为α向量$\omega$-向量的分布式类比，每个向量存储每个状态的回报分布而非标量期望，证明风险中性情形下有限$\psi$-向量可表示最优分布值函数并保持Wasserstein空间中的PWLC性质；3. 设计DPBVI算法，将PBVI的点基备份过程扩展到分布设置，使用categorical分布参数化与4步备份（动作-观察投影、categorical投影、信念最大化、候选$\psi$-向量选择）。

Result: 理论结果：(1) $\widetilde{\mathcal{T}}_{PO}^{\pi}$ 和 $\widetilde{\mathcal{T}}_{PO}^{*}$ 在supremum p-Wasserstein度量下是γ-收缩（1≤p<∞, 0≤γ<1），在唯一最优策略假设下收敛到唯一不动点；(2) 有限$\psi$-向量集合即可表示POMDP的最优分布值函数（风险中性）。实验结果：在MiniGrid DoorKey (5×5)和Two-State Noisy-Sensor两个小型环境中，DPBVI与PBVI收敛到相同的策略和值函数，但DPBVI因处理分布而耗时显著增加（如DoorKey中0.015s vs 54.8s）；两者的最大相对误差很小（量级约1e-7至3e-4），且误差来源于Categorical投影、浮点精度和bootstrap，而非理论缺陷。

Conclusion: 本文是POMDP领域中DistRL的首次系统研究，建立了部分可观察分布Bellman算子的收敛性理论，引入了$\psi$-向量作为α向量元素的自然分布式推广，提出了DPBVI算法。实验验证了算法正确性，但存在以下局限：仅在风险中性设置下验证、未涉及大规模问题、未正式处理风险敏感目标。未来工作应探索DPBVI在高维问题中的可扩展性以及风险敏感准则的扩展。

Abstract: In many real-world planning tasks, agents must tackle uncertainty about the environment's state and variability in the outcomes of any chosen policy. We address both forms of uncertainty as a first step toward safer algorithms in partially observable settings. Specifically, we extend Distributional Reinforcement Learning (DistRL)-which models the entire return distribution for fully observable domains-to Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (POMDPs), allowing an agent to learn the distribution of returns for each conditional plan. Concretely, we introduce new distributional Bellman operators for partial observability and prove their convergence under the supremum p-Wasserstein metric. We also propose a finite representation of these return distributions via psi-vectors, generalizing the classical alpha-vectors in POMDP solvers. Building on this, we develop Distributional Point-Based Value Iteration (DPBVI), which integrates psi-vectors into a standard point-based backup procedure-bridging DistRL and POMDP planning. By tracking return distributions, DPBVI lays the foundation for future risk-sensitive control in domains where rare, high-impact events must be carefully managed. We provide source code to foster further research in robust decision-making under partial observability.

</details>


### [392] [Opinion Leader Dynamics: How Sparse Attention Shapes Token Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24202)
*Jingkun Liu,Yue Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了"意见领袖动力学"(Opinion Leader Dynamics)框架,将token在单位球面上建模为粒子,分析了稀疏注意力如何通过受限交互实现组内对齐与组间分离。框架包含显式模型(固定代表点诱导势能的局部最大值)和隐式模型(稀疏图连通分量内涌现共识),两者均被构建为反向Wasserstein梯度流,并在几何分离与优势条件下证明了指数收敛。实验在Kimi-K3、MiniMax-M3、DeepSeek-V4-Flash三个稀疏注意力LLM上观察到比密集注意力GLM-4.7-Flash更清晰的聚类结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏注意力机制虽然有效降低了计算成本,但其受限的交互结构如何影响token表示的演化与聚类缺乏理论分析,这限制了对其工作机制的理解和进一步的架构设计。

Method: 将token在单位球面上建模为粒子,提出两种机制:显式模型基于固定代表点诱导势能,推导其反向Wasserstein梯度流表达并证明指数收敛;隐式模型基于稀疏图的连通分量分解,在度加权乘积Wasserstein空间下建立分析框架,收敛速率依赖图谱隙。通过UMAP/HDBSCAN分析三个稀疏注意力LLM(Kimi-K3、MiniMax-M3、DeepSeek-V4-Flash)与一个密集注意力LLM(GLM-4.7-Flash)的token演化轨迹。

Result: 理论方面:显式模型在几何分离与优势条件下,各组指数收敛到势能的不同局部最大值;隐式模型在各连通分量内实现指数共识,速率与归一化Laplacian谱隙相关。实验方面:在四个基准测试(HumanEval、HellaSwag、ARC-Easy、MATH)上,三个稀疏注意力LLM的最终层余弦轮廓分数为0.64-0.87,显著高于密集注意力模型的0.24-0.35,且与高斯参考的差距更大。

Conclusion: 意见领袖动力学框架将稀疏注意力的受限交互与token表示的聚类结构联系起来,解释了稀疏注意力为何能在保持组间分离的同时支持组内对齐。该理论框架与前沿稀疏注意力LLM中观察到的多组聚类现象一致,但因果掩码、动态代表点演化等扩展仍需进一步研究。

Abstract: Sparse attention reduces the quadratic cost of global self-attention while retaining strong empirical performance, but how its restricted interactions shape the evolution of token representations remains theoretically underexplored. Modeling tokens as particles on the unit sphere, we introduce opinion leader dynamics, a framework that identifies two mechanisms through which token groups converge internally while maintaining distinct limiting directions. In the explicit model, fixed representatives induce a potential that attracts tokens toward distinct local maxima. In the implicit model, disconnected interaction groups evolve toward separate consensus directions. We formulate both models as reverse Wasserstein gradient flows and establish exponential convergence under suitable conditions. We further connect these theoretical predictions to token evolution in frontier sparse-attention LLMs that motivate our framework. Across four benchmarks, Kimi-K3, MiniMax-M3, and DeepSeek-V4-Flash consistently exhibit clearer cluster separation and higher clustering scores than the dense-attention model GLM-4.7-Flash in projected token representations. These observations support the relevance of the predicted multiple-group structure to trained frontier LLMs, while finite-particle simulations illustrate the theoretical convergence behavior. Together, our results connect restricted token interactions to distinct group-level attractors, providing a dynamical account of how sparse attention can support alignment within groups while preserving separation between them.

</details>


### [393] [Hessian Rank Constraint for Learning Structure of Nonlinear Latent Variable Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24241)
*Zijian Li,Ruichu Cai,Feng Xie,Xinshuai Dong,Haoyue Dai,Yuewen Sun,Yujia Zheng,Guangyi Chen,Yingyao Hu,Kun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出交叉Hessian秩约束(HRC)作为非线性潜变量因果发现的原始秩工具，通过观测数据对数密度的交叉Hessian秩来刻画潜变量d分离条件，并应用于纯一因子测量模型中的潜变量定位与因果结构恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有潜变量因果发现方法依赖线性关系或可逆混合函数等限制性假设，难以处理实际中普遍存在的非线性混合过程，因此需要一种更原始的工具来在一般非线性混合条件下实现潜变量因果发现。

Method: 1. 提出交叉Hessian秩约束(HRC)：当两组观测变量被低维潜变量集d分离时，在仿射导数假设和非退化条件下，观测边际对数密度的交叉Hessian秩等于最小潜变量分离集的基数。2. 在线性高斯情况下，HRC退化为经典的Tetrad秩约束。3. 通过核密度估计(KDE)估计交叉Hessian，并使用bootstrap方法校准数值秩恢复阈值。4. 将HRC嵌入FOFC框架进行潜变量定位（聚类），并设计HRC-PC算法通过条件独立性测试恢复潜变量间的因果结构至Markov等价类。

Result: 1. 理论证明：在仿射导数假设和非退化条件下，rank(H_{A,B}) = d*（最小潜变量分离集的维度）。2. 鲁棒性分析：当仿射导数条件近似成立时，定量刻画了交叉Hessian偏离低秩形式的误差界。3. 合成实验：在sin、sinh、tanh、softplus及混合非线性函数下，HRC的平均F1为0.974，平均SHD为0.156，显著优于所有基线方法（包括Prashant et al. 2025、Kong et al. 2023、Silva et al. 2006、Kummerfeld and Ramsey 2016）。4. 真实数据：在FRED-MD宏观经济数据集上，HRC成功恢复了利率、信用、汇率、股票/波动率四个经济可解释的潜因子及其间的因果关系。5. 敏感性分析表明，低噪声水平和较窄的潜变量取值范围有助于提升性能。

Conclusion: HRC是将经典协方差秩约束推广到非线性测量模型的有效工具，通过交叉Hessian秩直接刻画潜变量分离。它可无缝集成到现有的FOFC聚类和PC风格因果发现框架中，在合成和真实数据上均显著优于现有方法。但该方法目前限于纯一因子测量模型，且依赖仿射导数假设和非退化条件，bootstrap秩校准的一致性尚未获得理论证明。

Abstract: Uncovering latent variables and their causal relations from observed data is a fundamental yet challenging problem. Existing methods often rely on restrictive assumptions, such as linear relations or invertible mixing functions. To better address this problem under general nonlinear mixing procedures, we propose a condition called the cross-Hessian Rank Constraint (HRC), which serves as a primitive rank-based tool for nonlinear latent causal discovery. In particular, we show that a rank-based property arises from the cross-Hessian of the observed-data log-density in the nonlinear case, revealing information about the latent variables, and reduces to the Tetrad constraints in the linear Gaussian case. More specifically, when two groups of observed variables are d-separated by a set of lower-dimensional latent variables, the rank of this cross-Hessian is equal to the dimension of the latent variables, under a mild affine derivative assumption on the conditional log-density derivatives. This assumption can be naturally satisfied when the noise level is low or the relevant nonlinearity is moderate. As a downstream application, we instantiate HRC in the pure one-factor measurement setting for locating latent variables and recovering their causal structure up to Markov equivalence. Experimental results on synthetic and real-world datasets support the theoretical claims.

</details>


### [394] [MemCalib: Benchmarking and Optimizing Memory Use in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24259)
*Ruike Cao,Fanyu Zhao,Fugen Yao,Liang Dong,Jian Xu,Guanjun Jiang,Yifei Zhao,Han Zhang,Li Xiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 MemCalib 基准和 MemCalib-RL 算法，用于评估和优化 LLM 智能体对记忆中每条原子命题施加适当影响的能力，解决模型过度使用或不足使用记忆的问题，并通过有序双向反事实信用分配算法在多个模型上取得最佳性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体中记忆的有效性取决于模型是否能为上下文中的每条记忆赋予适当的影响程度，但这一能力长期被忽视。现有前沿模型经常过度使用或不足使用记忆，且 GRPO、OPSD 等常见后训练算法存在"校准跷跷板"现象，即改善一个方向的错误会导致另一个方向恶化。

Method: MemCalib 是一个包含 15,000 例子（涵盖健康、通用辅助、编程）的基准，将记忆块分解为原子命题，每个命题标注理想使用级别（Ignore/Bound/Control）。MemCalib-RL 是有序双向反事实信用分配 RL 算法：将理想-实际使用级别组合分解为 9 个奖励通道，通过精确原子消融计算反事实对数似然差来定位信用到响应 token，在保持响应级平均优势的前提下进行通道特定的 token 级优势重分配。

Result: 在 MemCalib 测试集上，前沿开源和闭源模型均存在显著的方向性偏斜（如 GPT-5.6-SOL 过度使用，Qwen3-8B 不足使用）。MemCalib-RL 在 Qwen3-8B、Ministral-3-8B-Instruct、Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 三个模型上均取得最高 SCS 和 Exact 分数（较最佳基线 SCS 提升 1.73-7.29 分），是唯一在所有模型上同时减少过度使用和不足使用的方法，且无需额外训练即可在外部 RPEval 基准上取得最佳性能。消融实验验证了 token 级有序双向定位设计的有效性（η=0.75 最佳）。

Conclusion: MemCalib 揭示了 LLM 在智能体记忆中适当使用每条命题这一被忽视的能力缺陷。MemCalib-RL 通过双向反事实信用定位和优势重分配，能同时平衡过度使用和不足使用两个方向，在多个模型系列和规模上一致取得最优整体性能，且能泛化到外部基准。未来工作需要开发更精确的 token 级归因方法。

Abstract: The effectiveness of agent memory ultimately depends on whether the underlying LLM gives each memory in context an appropriate degree of influence over its response. Yet this capability has remained largely overlooked. To assess this capability, we introduce MemCalib, a benchmark grounded in realistic memory-system scenarios for evaluating memory use and advancing optimization algorithms. Results on the MemCalib test set reveal that frontier open- and closed-source models struggle to use memory appropriately. They frequently over-use or under-use memory rather than matching each proposition's actual use to its target level, leading to biased, low-quality responses. Experiments with common post-training algorithms, including group relative policy optimization and on-policy self-distillation, further reveal a clear directional skew: trained models improve in one direction while deteriorating in the other. We therefore propose MemCalib-RL, an ordered bidirectional counterfactual credit-assignment algorithm that separates over- and under-use signals and localizes their credit to response tokens through exact atom ablation. Results across model families and scales (Qwen3-8B, Ministral-3-8B-Instruct, and Qwen3.5-35B-A3B) show that MemCalib-RL achieves the best overall performance while better balancing over-use and under-use, with gains generalizing beyond MemCalib in external benchmark evaluation. Further experiments support its design choices and robustness and provide insight into its training dynamics.

</details>


### [395] [TTSE: A Two-Track Online Self-Evolution Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24289)
