*Ruimin Pei,Yongkang Wu,Shangyi Zheng,Yaqing Zhang,Deyang Li,Jianjun Tao,Xinyu Zhang,Xiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TTSE是一个双轨在线自演化框架，将LLM代理的经验知识分为FACT（环境事实）和TIP（条件化执行程序）两条独立演化轨道，并提供决策论形式的误差分解证明，在五个基准测试上验证了双轨设计的有效性和兼容性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM代理自演化方法（如Reflexion、Voyager、ExpeL、Bayesian-Agent等）主要优化执行技能，将环境知识视为外部静态输入而非可演化对象。这导致代理仅学习技能时会产生依赖于过时假设的行为，跨环境条件变化时出现错误迁移。论文主张长期自主代理需同时解决两个互补问题：学习如何行动，以及学习环境中哪些规律在当前交互证据下具有稳定有效性。

Method: TTSE采用双轨知识表示：(1) FACT轨道用自然语言规则描述环境声明性属性（如"封闭容器内物体不可见"），通过基于计数的证据追踪持续验证可靠性；(2) TIP轨道用"under <condition>: <action>"格式的条件化程序知识描述条件行为策略。分类通过提示模板中的主语测试（环境vs代理自身）和必要性测试（违反是否导致直接任务失败）双重判断实现，不确定时默认归类为TIP以防止FACT污染。在线演化管道采用分块增量循环，每个chunk执行四个有序阶段：Blame（归因失败到具体规则）→ Retire（移除被归因规则至退役池）→ Contradict/Synthesize（从退役池矛盾规则中合成条件化TIP，显式揭示隐藏条件）→ Induce（通过compare和success-only两阶段对现有规则库进行增量更新）。冷启动chunk不注入任何规则。理论上，从决策论角度将代理超额风险精确分解为FACT表示遗憾和TIP执行遗憾两部分，并推导环境条件化策略严格优于条件无关策略的条件及FACT识别误差与跨条件失配成本共同界定的下游风险上界。

Result: 五个基准测试结果：(1) GDPevo消融实验中双轨（FACT+TIP）三跑均值0.2616，比zero-shot基线（0.0947）提升约2.8倍，比TIP-only（0.2380）和FACT-only（0.1918）分别高+2.4pp和+7.0pp；(2) ALFWorld上DeepSeek-V3.2和GLM-5分别达到97.8%和98.51%成功率，超过GraSP报告的83.6%和94.9%；(3) ScienceWorld上macro reward从0.7204提升至0.8534（+0.1330），原生成功率从53.08%提升至73.46%（+20.38pp）；(4) SOPBench与Bayesian-Agent融合后892任务×3重复=2676次评估中，双轨融合（94.58%）相比单轨消融（91.59%）获得+2.99pp整体提升（95% CI [+2.34pp, +3.65pp]，置换检验p<10⁻⁴），其中warehouse_package_inspection域贡献78%增益（+14.44pp），双轨规则平均比单轨短18%（137 vs 167字符）；(5) PinchBench真实端到端任务（147任务×3独立运行）通过检索式注入集成到OpenClaw框架，三跑全部超越基线，平均+3.83pp，运行间波动范围从3.33pp降至1.61pp。所有实验均经三次独立重复验证。

Conclusion: TTSE将交互衍生知识自然分离为声明性环境事实（FACT）和条件化执行程序（TIP），混淆两者会导致知识冲突和虚假规则。理论分析表明环境表示与条件执行对应两种可精确分离的决策误差源，FACT/TIP分离应理解为模块化归纳偏置而非通用表达力优势。双轨设计在不同证据追踪机制（启发式计数和贝叶斯后验）、不同LLM骨干（GLM-5、DeepSeek-V3.2、DeepSeek v4-flash）和多样化任务域（企业API审计、具身交互、科学推理、SOP执行、开放式工具调用）中均稳定有效。对主流代理框架的设计启示：应将环境事实视为与技能共同演化的第一类知识，建立独立维护的environment.md与现有skill.md并行的架构。

Abstract: As Large Language Model (LLM) agents are applied in continuously interactive environments, driving the evolution of their own capabilities becomes a core problem for achieving long-term autonomy. Currently, environmental knowledge is typically treated as an external fixed input rather than as part of the agent's ongoing evolution. Reinforcement learning methods usually optimize policies through environmental interaction but tend to adapt only to fixed task distributions or single environments. This paper proposes TTSE (Two-Track Self-Evolution), a dual-track online self-evolution framework that separates evolving knowledge into FACT (environmental facts, whose reliability is continuously verified through interaction evidence) and TIP (task-conditioned implementation procedures). From a decision-theoretic perspective, we decompose the agent's excess risk into environment-representation regret and conditional-execution regret, characterize the conditions under which environment-conditioned policies strictly outperform condition-agnostic policies, and bound the downstream risk in terms of FACT identification error and cross-condition mismatch cost. In practice, TTSE's ablation experiments on GDPevo validate the advantage of dual-track evolution. On the classic agent task benchmarks ALFWorld and ScienceWorld, TTSE further demonstrates superior task adaptation. Moreover, TTSE is broadly compatible with existing skill self-evolution methods; combined with the Bayesian-Agent algorithm, a single-track ablation validates the dual-track advantage, substantially improving the aggregate score across the five major domains of SOPBench over three independent repetitions. Finally, on the real end-to-end task benchmark PinchBench, TTSE is integrated into a general agent framework via retrieval-based injection and stably outperforms the baseline across three independent runs.

</details>


### [396] [KV-COBRA: KV Cache Compression via Co-Optimized Bit-Rank Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24298)
*Sihyeon Ha,Jaeho Lee,Yo-Seb Jeon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KV-COBRA 提出了一种在每个注意力头上联合优化 SVD 截断秩 r 与标量量化位宽 b 的位预算分配方法，用信息论中的"注水"思想替代所有头统一分配，显著改善 0.5–2 bpd 极低比特率下的 KV 缓存压缩性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 KV 缓存压缩方法对所有注意力头统一施加秩与位宽，忽略了不同头谱结构差异巨大这一事实，导致低比特率下精度急剧下降。本文主张压缩的瓶颈不在压缩核本身，而在跨头的位预算分配。

Method: 两层级分配器：内层 C1 通过一维离散优化在每个头上平衡截断损失与量化损失（$\Delta f(r)$ 的离散一阶条件），外层 C2 通过阻尼比例更新在所有头上均衡边际失真（"注水"思想）。通过 Hadamard 旋转均衡通道方差，并以 query-key 协方差积 $\sigma_{Q,i}^2\sigma_{K,i}^2$ 对 SVD 基进行重要性重排序，使分配器 query-aware。

Result: 在 LLaMA-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B-v0.3、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 三种模型上，KV-COBRA 在 0.5–2 bpd 区间内的 Wikitext-2/PTB/C4 困惑度、零样本推理和 LongBench F1 上均匹配或优于 KIVI、KVQuant、GEAR、TurboQuant、SVDq、KQ-SVD；联合 K+V 压缩同样有效，且在 70B 模型和 RULER 长上下文检索上均验证有效，KV-COBRA 注意力原语相比 FP16-SDPA 提速 1.79–1.89×。

Conclusion: 低比特率 KV 压缩的瓶颈是位预算在头之间的分配，而非压缩核本身。基于信息论分配的最优性条件，可获得优雅的亚 1 bpd 压缩而无需新核，并能扩展至 K+V 联合压缩与不对称 K/V 预算情形。

Abstract: What limits KV-cache compression at extreme bit-rates? We argue that it is not the choice of compression scheme, but how its budget is allocated across attention heads. Existing methods apply rank and bit-width uniformly, ignoring that each head has a different optimal mix of rank truncation and quantization. We show that co-optimizing rank and bit-width per head, using only standard low-rank projection and scalar quantization, dominates uniform allocation, with the largest gains at low bit-rates. Our method, KV-COBRA (Co-Optimized Bit-Rank Allocation), formalizes this as a resource-allocation problem: it balances rank-truncation loss against quantization loss within each head, then redistributes budget across heads to minimize total distortion. A fused Hadamard rotation equalizes per-channel variance, and reordering the SVD basis by attention-KL importance makes the solver query-aware. The same allocator extends to joint $K{+}V$ compression. On perplexity, zero-shot, and long-context benchmarks from $0.5$ to $4$ bits per dimension (bpd), KV-COBRA shows the smallest accuracy degradation among evaluated methods at low bpd, with no per-token overhead.

</details>


### [397] [The Undetected Damage of Quantization on Retrieval and How to Fix It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24322)
*Luca Zhou,Alessandro Zirilli,Daniele Solombrino,Roberto Dessì,Emanuele Rodolà*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了后训练量化(PTQ)在保持分类精度的同时会严重破坏检索排序的现象：4-bit量化可改变33%-46%的检索top-1结果，而仅改变3%-6%的分类结果。文章将这一失败归因于"得分间隔"(top-1与top-2得分之差)与量化扰动大小的关系，并基于此提出了任务自适应的修复策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型量化在部署中广泛使用，但现有评估主要依赖分类精度或聚合检索指标（如nDCG@10），这些指标会严重低估量化对检索排序的实际损害。理解并修复这种"隐蔽损害"对可靠部署至关重要。

Method: 1) 理论分析：证明top-1结果在量化下保持不变当且仅当top-1/top-2得分间隔g₂超过最大舍入误差的2倍(2ε)。2) 稳定性检查：基于分离比g₂/(2ε)和分裂保形预测，校准无需标签的阈值来检测每个输入是否可信。3) 检索修复方案（全局）：测量每层量化对得分间隔的敏感度，将更多位宽分配给最敏感的层（gap sensitivity分配准则）。4) 分类修复方案（自适应）：将少量低间隔输入路由到全精度模型。5) 在3个骨干网络（ViT-B/16、ViT-L/16、Qwen3-Embedding 0.6B-8B）、5个量化器（RTN、GPTQ、AWQ、HQQ、AdaRound）、2种模态上进行验证。

Result: 1) 检索的top-1变化率是分类的4.8-14.3倍；2) 分类的间隔均值(g₂/2ε≈5.73)远高于检索(≈0.081)；3) 分离比与top-1变化率的Spearman相关系数为-0.88（跨越2118种配置）；4) gap sensitivity分配在3.5-bit预算下捕获了额外1-bit收益的60%-73%，优于所有基线准则；5) 分类中路由25%的低间隔输入可恢复85%-93%的精度损失，成本仅占全精度的47%。

Conclusion: 量化损害的核心机制是得分间隔与扰动大小之比：分类的交叉熵损失鼓励大间隔，使大多数top-1稳定；检索的对比损失不强制top-1与top-2分离，导致广泛失败。这一无需标签的间隔量同时提供了预测能力（哪些模型会失败）、部署时验证能力（哪些答案可信）和任务自适应修复方案。文章倡导评估应关注系统返回内容本身，并提出训练目标是否应主动鼓励适应部署需求的间隔这一开放问题。

Abstract: We show that a quantized model that keeps its classification accuracy still changes $14$ to $46\%$ of its top-1 retrieval results, and that aggregate ranking metrics reveal only part of this damage. We tie this failure to the gap between the two highest scores and use that gap to decide when a quantized answer can be trusted and where additional precision should be spent. We show that the top-1 result is guaranteed to survive quantization only when this gap exceeds twice the largest rounding error. In classification, scores are the logits, and the loss function pushes the correct class away from other classes, encouraging this gap. In retrieval, scores are query-document scores, and nothing separates the top-1 item from the second. This gap can be measured without labels. Before deployment, it predicts which models will break under quantization, and at deployment time it tells, per input, whether the quantized answer still matches the full-precision answer. Most classification inputs have a gap wide enough to trust the quantized answer, but few retrieval queries do. That gap motivates a different fix in each task. In retrieval, spending extra bit-width on the layers whose quantization moves the gap most recovers up to three-quarters of an extra bit's benefit for half its cost. In classification, routing the few low-gap inputs to full precision recovers most of the lost accuracy at a fraction of the cost.

</details>


### [398] [Information-Time Proximal Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24380)
*Yongcheng Zeng,Xinyu Cui,Yan Song,Guoqing Liu,Hongsheng Xin,Kaike Zhang,Cheng Deng,Kun Zhan,Jian Ying,Jian Zhao,Haifeng Zhang,Jun Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出InfoPPO，通过用信息密度重新参数化时间步进替代原始token计数，解决LLM强化学习中token-by-token生成导致的非均匀信息流与长视野折扣困境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RLVR方法将MDP的时间进展参数化为逐token生成，但自回归轨迹上信息流高度非均匀；token距离与信息距离不匹配，导致长视野推理中非平凡折扣会使终端监督过度衰减，移除折扣又丧失有效视野控制。

Method: 构建Information-Time MDP，将时间增量重参数化为状态信息密度ρ(s)（用旧策略的归一化预测熵作为代理）；推导信息时间下的性能差引理与策略改进下界（要求策略散度受ρ(s)约束）；实现自适应裁剪，按ρ_t对数缩放裁剪范围；GAE的折扣与迹衰减均基于信息时间累积。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B/8B/14B基座模型的五个竞赛数学推理基准（AMC23、AIME24/25/26、BeyondAIME）上一致优于PPO、DAPO和DAPO-FT基线；在非平凡折扣设置下保持稳定准确率与响应长度，避免token-time PPO的性能退化；响应长度得到有效控制，实现更优的精度-长度权衡；理论建立策略改进下界与跨迭代信息时钟稳定性保证。

Conclusion: InfoPPO通过信息时间参数化为长视野LLM强化学习提供了统一的时间信用传播与策略更新调节框架；预测熵作为信息密度的实用代理连接了理论与算法；未来方向包括探索信息密度的替代实例化以及在策略优化中显式调控预测熵以稳定信息时钟。

Abstract: RLVR has substantially improved the reasoning capabilities of LLMs. However, existing methods typically parameterize temporal progression in the Markov Decision Process by token-by-token generation, despite the highly non-uniform information flow along autoregressive trajectories. In this paper, we propose InfoPPO, which reparameterizes temporal progression using information density rather than raw token count. This reparameterization induces a common state-dependent structure for both temporal credit propagation and policy updates. InfoPPO restores the effectiveness of non-trivial discounting in long-horizon reasoning, retaining effective-horizon contraction while avoiding excessive attenuation of terminal supervision over long token sequences. Moreover, the information-time policy-improvement analysis naturally leads to a state-dependent update constraint, which we implement through adaptive clipping. By adapting the clipping threshold at each token position to the information density of its corresponding state, this mechanism enables more targeted policy updates while preserving proximal control. Theoretically, we extend performance-difference and policy-improvement analyses to the information-time MDP, deriving a policy-improvement lower bound when policy changes are regulated by information density. We further connect the general information-time analysis to practical LLM policy optimization by relating state-wise information density to local policy movement, while also providing theoretical grounding for the adaptive update mechanism. Experiments on Qwen3 models demonstrate consistent gains over competitive baselines across five challenging competition-style mathematical reasoning benchmarks. InfoPPO also maintains stable accuracy and response length across non-trivial discount settings under which token-time PPO deteriorates.

</details>


### [399] [Artificial Structure Function Search: Preserving Artificial Functional Connectivity for Structured Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24401)
*Mindula Illeperuma,Rafael Pina,Charuka Herath,Sharmarke A. Gabayre,Varuna De Silva*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种受神经科学启发的结构化剪枝框架 ASF-S（Artificial Structure Function Search），通过引入"人工功能连接性"（AFC）和"主梯度重要性"（PGI）作为剪枝候选选择准则，在70%参数稀疏度下无需微调被剪枝层即可恢复基线精度，并在CNN和Transformer架构上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有结构化剪枝方法依赖不透明的启发式规则或基于权重的标准，无法揭示网络中的结构依赖关系，导致剪枝后必须对整个模型进行再训练才能恢复精度。作者受神经科学中"结构-功能耦合"（SFC）理论的启发，试图通过保留人工神经网络中的结构-功能关系来识别可直接使用的稀疏子网络。

Method: 核心方法包含三个组件：(1) 人工功能连接性（AFC）：通过计算各层单元间的余弦相似度构建功能连接矩阵，再利用扩散映射嵌入提取第一主梯度（PG1）作为输出层的拓扑组织表征；(2) 主梯度重要性（PGI）：对每个类别计算正确与错误分类的PG1对比向量，经PCA提取类别共享的判别方向，再将其与输出层权重结合对各层单元进行投影打分；(3) ASF-S框架：利用PGI分数进行后训练结构化剪枝，每层通过网格搜索阈值选择被剪枝单元，并理论证明了当特征表示偏移小于分类间隔时无需再训练被剪枝层即可保持预测正确性。

Result: 在MNIST和CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100数据集上的LeNet300_100、Conv2Net、Conv6Net以及VGG-16等模型实验中，ASF-S在70%稀疏度下仅微调输出层即可将精度下降控制在0-20.46%以内（多数模型<10%），且FLOPs减少33-94%；PGI选择准则显著优于L1、L2、Top-K和随机剪枝（同等稀疏度下精度提升5-25%）。在BERT-base + AG News的Transformer实验中，PG引导的FFN剪枝在70-90%稀疏度下也优于随机剪枝并与L1/L2具有竞争力，同时保持了良好的校准性能（ECE）。

Conclusion: ASF-S验证了"保留人工功能连接性即可在结构化剪枝后无需微调被剪枝层"的假设，提供了比传统基于权重标准更具可解释性的稀疏子网络识别方法；其局限性包括：未在大规模数据集（如ImageNet）上验证、不兼容残差架构、仅做单次剪枝（未探索迭代式剪枝）、以及存储逐类别激活带来的磁盘开销过大。

Abstract: Structured pruning is a model compression technique that is used to reduce the computational cost of deploying deep neural networks on resource-constrained devices. Popular methods of pruning rely on opaque heuristics or weight-based criteria that give no indication as to the structural dependencies in the network. To address these limitations we present Artificial Structure Function Search (ASF-S): a novel structured pruning framework. ASF-S utilizes Principle Gradient Importance (PGI): a novel prune-candidate selection criteria that is inspired by structure-function relationships in the brain. By ensuring the pruned structure of the model respects topographical organization of the output layer, we define Artificial Functional Connectivity (AFC) for artificial neural networks. AFC provides evidence to demonstrate that accurate smaller networks can be found using careful prune candidate selection criteria. We present results for PGI as a selection criterion and for ASF-S as a pruning framework against recent benchmarks, demonstrating that our method yields model variants with 70\% parameter reduction, that can recover baseline accuracy without re-training the pruned layers.

</details>


### [400] [ARM: Attention with Routed-Memory for Learnable Sparse Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24417)
*Qiuhao Zeng,Jerry Huang,Peng Lu,Ruiyi Fang,Gezheng Xu,Zihao Jing,Yufei Cui,Charles Ling,Gang Niu,Boyu Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ARM提出了一种基于分层路由器的固定大小KV缓存结构，通过Gumbel-Softmax选择内存槽位并使用sigmoid门控实现软更新，避免硬驱逐造成的信息丢失；同时引入基于MDP的自适应检索策略动态调整检索桶数量。实验表明ARM在长上下文任务中实现了性能与效率的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM在长上下文推理中受限于KV缓存线性增长的问题。传统方法（量化、剪枝、卸载）各有局限：量化仍需增长缓存，剪枝策略（如FIFO、滑动窗口）通过硬驱逐会丢失核心信息，卸载方法存在层级间传输延迟。因此需要一种既能保持固定内存预算、又能避免硬性信息丢弃的KV缓存管理方案。

Method: ARM采用分层路由器组织的固定大小内存系统，包含三个核心组件：(1) 分层路由内存——固定多层级树结构（4层、每节点4子节点，共256个叶桶），通过自监督平衡损失训练路由器将语义相似 token 路由到相同桶中；(2) 可微分写入选择——使用Gumbel-Softmax选择内存槽位，通过sigmoid门控软混合新旧信息（公式6），避免硬驱逐；通过重参数化门控（公式8）实现预填充阶段的并行前缀扫描；(3) 自适应Top-M检索——将检索桶数选择建模为MDP，使用LSTM策略迭代决定增加或停止检索宽度，并通过软级联插值（公式14）实现端到端可微训练。此外，论文从信息论角度证明，在未来访问不确定时，门控写入是贝叶斯最优策略，其权重w*=π按预期使用强度分配内存容量。

Result: 在Llama-3.1-8B上以256内存槽进行实验：(1) 常识推理任务（表1）中性能与全注意力基线相当；(2) 短上下文回忆任务（表2）平均得分25.40，略优于全注意力的25.31；(3) LongBench长上下文任务（表3）平均得分18.02，优于全注意力(17.09)、量化(16.98)和卸载(16.68)；(4) RULER基准（表4）在4K到128K长度上获得15.12平均分，远超其他方法（量化8.01、流式4.88）；(5) 推理延迟和内存使用与滑动窗口方法持平，远优于缓存卸载（10倍延迟差距）；(6) 消融实验（表9）证明门控写入和自适应稀疏性均为必要组件。

Conclusion: ARM成功将树结构KV缓存转化为完全可微分且可自适应学习的系统，通过Gumbel-Softmax写入和可微分MDP读取机制实现端到端优化的内存管理。实验证明该方法在长上下文任务中实现了性能、内存效率和生成延迟的平衡，展示了通过更好的结构设计实现可扩展推理的潜力。未来可探索无限上下文设置或次线性内存增长。

Abstract: Despite advances in long-context inference, large language models (LLMs) remain fundamentally limited by the key-value (KV) caching mechanisms that are necessary for stable computation. Techniques such as selective token eviction and pruning have vastly mitigated these issues, but often discard core information to manage the growing cache. In this paper, we propose Attention with Routed Memory (ARM) a novel KV caching structure that introduces a fully differentiable, fixed-size memory system organized as a hierarchical router. Via a Gumbel-Softmax, ARM learns to select memory slots and perform sigmoid-gated updates that softly combine new and stored information, avoiding hard eviction and reducing information loss. By further training a policy to dynamically select varying amounts of memory at inference, ARM adapts its accesses for both simple contexts and inputs that require deeper reasoning, enabling more scalable and effective retrieval on both short- and long-contexts. Experimental results on standard commonsense and long-context reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that ARM achieves superior performance and efficiency compared to fixed KV-caching approaches, while remaining efficient and scalable in terms of both memory and generation latency.

</details>


### [401] [WPBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Wind Power Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24444)
*Yuhan Zhu,Jilin Hu,Xinying Cai,Yingshan Li,Li Ma,Xiangfei Qiu Linsen Li,Kai Zhang,Yao Fu,Weihao Jiang,Bin Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: WPBench is a comprehensive, fair, and extensible benchmark for wind power forecasting that integrates 26 public datasets across four structural categories (single/multi-turbine × univariate/multivariate), evaluates 19 representative models spanning five families (statistical/ML, deep temporal, time-series foundation, deep spatio-temporal, spatio-temporal foundation) under unified protocols, and provides structure-aware diagnostics from temporal, variable-dependency, and spatial-dependency perspectives, along with multi-dimensional evaluation including point-wise errors, forecast-curve fidelity (DTW-based), and computational efficiency.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Wind power forecasting is a critical, deployment-oriented task with unique data structures (weather-driven stochasticity, SCADA/NWP covariates, multi-turbine spatial dependencies) that cannot be properly evaluated by general-purpose time series benchmarks. Existing wind forecasting benchmarks suffer from four key gaps: limited coverage of wind power scenarios across structural diversity; incomplete coverage of model families (especially foundation models and spatio-temporal models); evaluation metrics misaligned with operational requirements (point-wise errors alone miss curve fidelity and efficiency); and limited structure-aware diagnostics beyond individual temporal patterns.

Method: WPBench is built along four pillars: (1) Dataset Organization — 26 public datasets organized by turbine scale (single/multi) and variable composition (univariate/multivariate) into four task types (1T1V, 1TMV, MT1V, MTMV), with unified preprocessing into turbine-time-channel representation; (2) Model Coverage — 19 models from 5 families evaluated under unified training/evaluation protocols with Optuna-tuned hyperparameters on validation splits; (3) Multi-dimensional Evaluation — 6 error metrics (MAE, MSE, nMAE, nMSE, nRMSE, nMBE) + 4 shape-aware metrics (DTW, nDTW, nDDTW, EDF) + computational efficiency (parameters, inference latency), using fixed-window multi-step protocol with L=576 look-back and H∈{12,24,72,144} horizons, plus GIFT-style SeasonalNaive-normalized leaderboards; (4) Structure-aware Diagnostics — dataset characterization metrics across three perspectives: temporal patterns (seasonality, shifting, short/long-term JSD via STL decomposition), variable dependencies (VarCorr, Var-TGV, Var-GSD using dynamic target-covariate graphs), and spatial dependencies (SpatialCorr, Spatial-TGV, Spatial-GSD using dynamic turbine interaction graphs with cosine similarity and Laplacian spectral analysis), plus LowQ/HighQ group comparisons and CI/CD model pair analysis.

Result: Key findings from WPBench experiments: (1) Under nMAE, foundation models (TOTO, FactoST-UTP, TTM) achieve the best normalized scores; under nDTW, TOTO and FactoST-UTP remain competitive while larger spatio-temporal models (STDN, OpenCity) improve; (3) Temporal periodicity (seasonality) generally reduces forecasting error, while distributional drift increases error; (4) High VarCorr reduces error for several models, but dynamic variable relationships (Var-GSD) make this benefit less stable — channel-dependent models (iTransformer) outperform CI counterparts under static VarCorr but weaken under Var-TGV/Var-GSD; (5) Spatial dependency does not monotonically improve performance — spatial models (OpenCity, FactoST-STA, STDN, BigST) are more sensitive to spatial dynamics and can amplify errors when learned spatial priors are unstable; (6) Models optimizing numerical accuracy and forecast-curve fidelity are not the same — DLinear achieves lower nMAE but overly smooth curves missing ramps, while FactoST-UTP better preserves temporal shape; (7) Foundation model adaptation gains are largest for SEMPO, FactoST-UTP, Timer; TTM/TOTO improve little from zero-shot; few-shot gains often comparable to full-shot; (8) Efficiency trade-off exists — lightweight models (DLinear, XLinear, STID, TTM) offer low inference cost with competitive nRMSE, but TOTO and STDN achieve stronger curve fidelity at much higher latency.

Conclusion: WPBench provides a reproducible evaluation framework that clarifies which model families are reliable under different wind data organizations rather than simply ranking methods. It demonstrates that model performance is strongly affected by wind-specific data organization, variable dependency patterns, and spatial structure dynamics. The benchmark supports future research with extensible datasets, models, metrics, and diagnostic protocols, and offers guidance for developing more robust wind-specific forecasting methods that balance numerical accuracy, forecast-curve fidelity, and computational efficiency for operational deployment.

Abstract: Accurate, reliable, and deployable wind power forecasting is critical for power system dispatch, renewable energy integration, and electricity market operations. Progress in this field hinges on the ability to empirically and comprehensively benchmark forecasting methods. Yet existing benchmarks fall short of supporting systematic evaluation in four key aspects: 1) limited coverage of wind power scenarios across turbine scale, variable composition, and spatial structure; 2) incomplete coverage of forecasting model families; 3) evaluation metrics misaligned with wind power requirements; and 4) limited structure-aware diagnostics beyond individual temporal patterns. To address these limitations, we propose WPBench, a comprehensive, fair, and extensible benchmark for wind power forecasting. WPBench integrates 26 public datasets organized by turbine scale and variable composition, spanning single-turbine, multi-turbine, univariate, and multivariate settings. Under unified processing, training, and evaluation protocols, it benchmarks 19 representative models covering traditional methods, deep temporal models, spatio-temporal models, and foundation models. Beyond point-wise errors, WPBench assesses forecast-curve fidelity and computational efficiency, and delivers structure-aware diagnostics across temporal, variable-dependency, and spatial-dependency perspectives. Together, these capabilities enable systematic model comparison across diverse wind scenarios and provide a reusable platform for future research.

</details>


### [402] [Lifted Bellman Linear Programming for Offline Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24489)
*Hyukjun Yang,Jongchan Park,Narim Jeong,Donghwan Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LBLP(提升Bellman线性规划)用于离线强化学习，通过在(Q,V)联合空间施加不等式约束代替对自举目标的回归。提出ALBUM算法实现该约束的hinge松弛，使用单critic+高斯策略，无需目标网络或EMA更新，在OGBench上以最少的参数量和显存匹配FQL性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线RL中传统的critic回归方法依赖目标网络和EMA更新来稳定自举目标，且多步目标需要离策略修正。能否完全通过数据集状态-动作对上的不等式约束来施加样本内Bellman最优性，使critic成为约束规划的解而非回归目标？

Method: 1) 将Bellman最优性的LP表征提升到(Q,V)联合空间，通过epigraph变量消除对下一动作的评估；2) 沿K步轨迹段的约束保持解不变；3) 通过hinge惩罚松弛约束得到ALBUM算法，使用stop_gradient分离K步展开目标；4) 推导系数条件保证更新有界；5) 策略提取使用DDPG+BC目标。

Result: 在OGBench基准上，ALBUM使用单Q、单V网络加高斯策略，平均性能匹配FQL(43.4% vs 43.6%)，在四个长视野任务上取得最佳；参数量仅2.43M(最少)，峰值显存78 MiB(最低)；违反系数条件会导致值函数发散至-10^6量级。

Conclusion: 不等式约束可以替代回归来实现样本内Bellman最优性，LBLP的对偶松弛在表格情况下精确恢复解，ALBUM无需目标网络即可稳定训练。理论结果在确定性动力学假设下成立，扩展到随机转移是未来工作。

Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) typically trains a critic by minimizing a regression loss against bootstrapped value targets stabilized by target networks with exponential moving average (EMA) updates. Multi-step targets incorporate behavior-policy actions and therefore require off-policy correction. We instead impose in-sample Bellman optimality on the critic through inequality constraints. We formulate the Lifted Bellman Linear Program (LBLP), which lifts the linear programming characterization of Bellman optimality to the joint $(Q,V)$ space so that every constraint involves only state-action pairs in the dataset. Its unique minimizer is the in-sample optimal pair, and constraints along $K$-step segments of dataset trajectories leave this minimizer unchanged for any rollout policy and horizon. Under deterministic dynamics, this minimizer lies between the best dataset return and the optimal value. Relaxing the constraints into hinge penalties recovers the same solution above a finite penalty coefficient in the tabular case. Approximate Lifted Bellman Unconstrained Minimization (ALBUM) implements this relaxation with neural networks and detaches the $K$-step rollout targets by stop gradient. Its objective contains no squared regression onto bootstrapped targets, so it can be trained without target networks or EMA updates. Under deterministic dynamics, the LBLP solution is a stationary point of the detached update under a coefficient condition independent of $\gamma$ and $K$, and the inequality constraints allow discounted returns along dataset trajectories to serve as lower bounds without off-policy correction or action chunking. On OGBench, ALBUM uses a single critic with a Gaussian policy, matches the average performance of FQL, and is comparable to recent action-chunking methods, while using the fewest parameters and the least peak GPU memory among all compared methods.

</details>


### [403] [On Emergent Capabilities and Model Merging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24504)
*Luca Zhou,Emanuele Rodolà*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究了模型合并操作对涌现能力的影响。在两个独立测试平台（激活预言机和涌现错位模型）和三个模型家族上的实验表明：涌现能力的存续取决于其他合并成分是否携带该能力——双方共有时保留，超加性时不可创造，单方独有时优先被稀释。合并后的涌现行为与训练目标行为的可组合性不同，这对模型审计和安全部署具有重要实践意义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公开仓库中包含大量微调模型及LoRA适配器，模型合并（权重空间的算术运算）是组合这些产物最常用的方式。已有研究关注合并对训练任务能力的影响，但合并对涌现能力（artifact携带但未被显式训练的行为，如涌现错位、激活预言机的审计能力）的影响尚未被系统研究。这些涌现能力对安全和可解释性至关重要，因此需要理解合并操作如何影响它们，以及这对实际部署路径意味着什么。

Method: 研究在两个独立的测试平台上进行：(1) 激活预言机平台，使用Qwen3-8B和Gemma-2-9B-IT，比较单任务训练预言机（分类和latentqa）与联合训练预言机在禁忌秘词提取（涌现能力）上的差异；(2) 涌现错位模型平台，使用Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上的bad-medical和risky-financial LoRA适配器。方法是在LoRA空间进行权重合并，使用线性任务算术、TIES、DARE等多种合并规则，并系统扫描混合权重λ。同时引入"保留率"指标（floor-corrected retention），以处理不同能力的基线差异。使用delta-method计算95%置信区间。还通过量值剪枝实验、随机稀释对照、不同善意稀释器实验和法官阈值检查等进一步验证。

Result: 研究得到三个关键结果：(1) 双方共享时保留：在涌现错位测试平台上，合并两个都携带广域错位的检查点（不同训练领域但相同涌现行为），在Qwen2.5-14B上保留83%-96%的涌现行为，在Llama-3.1-8B上保留83%-92%，远超与善意适配器合并的结果（1%-0%）。(2) 超加性时不可创造：在激活预言机平台上，涌现能力是超加性的（两个单任务父模型均不超过9.5%的禁忌准确率，联合训练预言机达23.7%）；两个父模型近正交（cos=0.08/0.04），只能捕捉联合增量30%-37%的平方范数；任何加权合并都不能达到联合预言机的涌现能力。(3) 单方独有时优先稀释：当一个合并父模型缺乏涌现能力时（善意稀释器），涌现保留率始终低于训练能力保留率，差距在28个测试格中的22个中显著，从未反向。量值剪枝实验表明涌现能力由大权重承载（保留最大25%时保留74%涌现能力vs保留86%训练能力），差异源于能力的方向编码而非大小。

Conclusion: 涌现能力是否在合并中存续，取决于其他成分是否已携带该能力。论文建立了三部分规律：共享时保留、超加性时不可达、缺失时优先稀释。这与权值平均的代数性质并非完全同构——涌现和训练能力虽以同一缩放因子被稀释，但以不同速率衰减，这种差异源于二者编码方式的不同。对实践的影响是：审计单个产物不能直接推断合并结果——将可疑适配器与善意适配器混合会先消除广域涌现错位（审计信号），而窄域训练危害仍然存在，使合并模型看起来比实际更安全；反之，期望的涌现能力无法从各自缺乏的部分拼装。线性合并和DARE方法最温和，而TIES等抗干扰方法对两种能力都最具破坏性。研究呼吁将涌现能力作为神经产物的头等属性来测量。

Abstract: Fine-tuned checkpoints and adapters now fill public repositories, and the most common operation applied to these artifacts is model merging: arithmetic on their weights that assembles capabilities cheaply. We ask what this operation does to emergent capabilities: behaviors an artifact carries that were never an explicit training target. Studying two independent testbeds (activation oracles and emergent-misaligned models) across three model families, we find that the answer is threefold. First, merging preserves an emergent capability that both parents carry: merging two misaligned checkpoints retains most of their broad misalignment across the whole mixing range. Second, merging cannot create an emergent capability that is superadditive in its parents: no weighted merge of two single-task oracles reaches the jointly-trained oracle's auditing ability. Third, when only one parent carries the capability, merging dilutes it faster than the trained capability that accompanies it: the gap is significant in most settings. In short, emergent behaviors of an artifact do not compose the way its trained capability does.

</details>


### [404] [$t_0$: A Time-Series Foundation Model for Forecasting with Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24559)
*Lucas Meyer,Claudio Sole,Huikan Xiang,Nicolas Li,Lucas Franceschino,Arnau Quera-Bofarull,Maarten P. Scholl,Joachim Fainberg,Geoffrey Négiar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍了 t0 系列开放权重的多变量时序预测基础模型，发布 t0-alpha（102M）和 t0-beta（256M）两个版本，采用时间与变量交替的 Transformer 架构，支持概率分位数预测，在 GIFT-Eval 和 fev-bench 等零样本基准上接近最优 TSFM，并在已知未来协变量处理、长视野滚动、缺失数据鲁棒性方面表现突出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型（TSFM）在零样本泛化、协变量利用和开放权重发布方面仍有不足，论文旨在构建一个支持多变量上下文条件、可在无任务特定微调下处理历史协变量与已知未来协变量、并产生概率预测的开放权重预测基础模型。

Method: 采用交替沿时间维度与跨变量维度进行注意力计算的 Transformer 层结构；输入包括目标变量历史、过去协变量与已知未来协变量；输出为概率分位数预测；预训练结合精选公开数据与含协变量到目标依赖关系的合成生成器族；并设计滚动策略以适应长视野预测，模型对缺失数据具有鲁棒性。

Result: t0-alpha 在 GIFT-Eval 上聚合 CRPS 为 0.4941；t0-beta 聚合 CRPS 为 0.4738，MASE 为 0.6865，两项均位列第三，零样本表现距最优 TSFM 不足 4.0%。在 fev-bench 上技能分分别为 42.2 与 46.7，后者再次位列第三，距榜首仅差 2.0 分。已知未来协变量在 30 个任务上为 t0-alpha 带来 6.3 个百分点的技能提升；在 Victoria 电力需求基准上，t0-beta 在近一年上下文条件下达到最高精度；在 ERCOT 29 个月小时价格独立 Macrocosm 评估中，两模型相对滞后价格基线将 MAE 削减 38%。

Conclusion: t0 系列验证了基于交替时间-变量注意力 Transformer 与合成生成器预训练的多变量时序预测基础模型在零样本场景下具有竞争力；已知未来协变量对模型技能提升显著，长视野滚动与缺失数据鲁棒性增强其实用性；开放权重发布有助于推动时序预测社区的进一步研究。

Abstract: We present $t_0$, a family of open-weights foundation models for forecasting with multivariate context. We release its first two members: $\texttt{t0-alpha}$ and $\texttt{t0-beta}$, respectively 102M and 256M parameters. Both condition their forecasts on target history, past covariates, and known-future covariates, without task-specific retraining. Their transformer layers alternate attention along time and across variates. They produce probabilistic forecasts through quantile predictions. Pretraining combines curated public data with synthetic generator families constructed to contain covariate-to-target dependencies. On GIFT-Eval, $\texttt{t0-alpha}$ reaches an aggregate CRPS of 0.4941, and $\texttt{t0-beta}$ a CRPS of 0.4738 and a MASE of 0.6865, third on both and within 4.0% of the best zero-shot TSFM. On fev-bench they score 42.2 and 46.7 in skill, the latter third again and 2.0 points behind the leader. We analyze $\texttt{t0-alpha}$ in depth. Known-future covariates raise its skill by 6.3 percentage points across 30 tasks. The report also examines its calibration, its rollout strategy on long horizons, and its robustness to missing data. On the Victoria electricity-demand benchmark, $\texttt{t0-beta}$ is among the most accurate models with a context of nearly a year. In an independent Macrocosm evaluation of hourly ERCOT prices over 29 months, both cut the MAE of the lagged-price baseline by 38%.

</details>


### [405] [Overlay\_dx - Automating forecasting evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24586)
*Long Ngo,Mohammed Amine Chamli,Jonathan Rivalan,Thomas Jaillon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为overlay_dx的视觉化评估指标，用于衡量时间序列预测模型的性能，通过计算落在置信区间内的预测百分比，并结合覆盖率-阈值曲线下的面积，提供统一的可视化与数值评估框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的时间序列预测评估指标仅提供数值结果，缺乏可理解性，难以有效区分不同模型的性能表现。

Method: overlay_dx是一种可视化评估指标，衡量落在真实值置信区间内的预测比例；通过绘制覆盖率随阈值变化的曲线，并计算该曲线下面积（AUC），得到一个综合的对齐度量，从而将可视化与数值评估统一在一个框架中。

Result: 通过大量实验证明，该方法提供了一个统一的评估框架，结合了视觉与数值两种评估方式，能更好地支持模型对比，并为时间序列预测的后续研究与优化提供有价值的洞察。

Conclusion: overlay_dx作为一种融合视觉与数值的评估指标，能够改进时间序列预测模型的比较方式，并为该领域的研究与优化提供新的分析视角。

Abstract: Traditional evaluation metrics provides numerical values but often lack comprehensibility, hindering effective differentiation of model performances. Our work addresses this challenge by introducing overlay\_dx, a novel evaluation metric measuring the performance of time series prediction models. Overlay\_dx is a visual metric that represents the percentage of predictions falling within a confidence interval around actual values. Additionally, once evaluation results are plotted, overlay\_dx computes the area under the overlay curve, providing a quantitative measure of alignment between predicted and actual values across different thresholds and predictions. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that our approach offers a unified evaluation framework that combines both visual and numerical assessments, enabling improved model comparison and providing valuable insights for further research and optimization efforts in time series prediction.

</details>


### [406] [GraphToolbox: A Configurable Python Framework for Graph Neural Network Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24609)
*Eloi Campagne,Yvenn Amara-Ouali,Yannig Goude,Argyris Kalogeratos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GraphToolbox是一个基于PyTorch Geometric的开源Python框架，通过配置驱动的统一流水线整合电力预测中GNN实验的全部环节（数据驱动图构建、51种卷积层即时训练、在线专家聚合、可解释性、显著性检验），并在法国区域负荷与净负荷两个案例中验证了其系统化架构评估能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电力预测涉及区域、变电站、馈线等空间相关信号，GNN虽适合建模此类关系，但图构建、模型选择、训练、聚合与解释等环节分散在不同工具中，构建完整的GNN预测实验流程繁琐且难以系统化对比不同架构。

Method: 提出GraphToolbox框架，核心包括：(1)数据驱动的图构建；(2)适配器可实例化并训练PyTorch Geometric中65种卷积中的51种，结合PyTorch Geometric Temporal的循环单元；(3)在线专家聚合机制；(4)预测可解释性模块；(5)对缓存预测进行显著性检验。基于配置驱动的统一流水线，覆盖端到端实验流程。

Result: 法国区域负荷案例中：48种卷积完整预测扫描的误差区间为1.14%–1.60%，在线聚合将其降至0.98%，图模型优于经典加性模型与梯度提升基线。净负荷案例中：直接图模型精度低于经典加性模型；分别预测各物理分量可改善但不弥合差距。两种对比均使用相同的实验接口。

Conclusion: GraphToolbox通过统一实验接口实现了系统化的架构评估，验证了图模型在区域负荷预测中的优势，同时揭示了净负荷预测中直接图建模的局限性，为电力预测领域的GNN架构选择与基准比较提供了标准化工具。

Abstract: Electricity forecasting often involves spatially related signals observed over regions, substations, and feeders, and Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) provide a natural way to represent these relations. Building a complete GNN forecasting experiment is nonetheless laborious, because graph construction, model selection, training, aggregation, and interpretation sit in incompatible tools. We present GraphToolbox, an open-source Python framework that unifies these stages in one configurationdriven pipeline built on PyTorch Geometric. It offers data-driven graph construction, an adapter that instantiates and trains 51 of the 65 PyTorch Geometric convolutions together with the recurrent cells of PyTorch Geometric Temporal, online expert aggregation, forecasting interpretability, and significance testing on cached forecasts. We evaluate the pipeline in two case studies. On French regional load, the 48 convolutions included in the complete forecasting sweep fall in a band from 1.14% to 1.60% error, online aggregation lowers this to 0.98%, and the graph models improve on classical additive and boosting baselines. On net-load, direct graph models are less accurate than a classical additive model, while forecasting each physical component separately improves them without closing that gap. Both comparisons use the same experimental interface, illustrating the role of GraphToolbox in systematic architectural evaluation.

</details>


### [407] [Augmented Hypothesis Testing with Persona-Based LLM Simulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24629)
*Ziyad Benomar,Aymen Al Marjani,Paul Missault,Saab Mansour*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种学习增强的假设检验框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）基于角色的模拟预测来减少A/B测试所需样本量，同时保持统计有效性。框架包含两部分：(1)针对总体层面方向性预测的非对称Z检验，具有一致性-鲁棒性线性权衡保证；(2)针对个体层面预测的广义PPI++（GPPI），通过高维变换处理非线性预测误差。在四个真实数据集（MovieLens、Jester、Last.fm、Book-Crossing）上的实验验证了该方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统A/B测试成本高昂，需要大量样本和长时间。LLM基于角色的模拟虽可预测实验结果，但预测质量不确定，无法完全替代人类实验。如何在保持统计有效性的前提下，利用这些质量未知的预测来减少样本量，是核心问题。

Method: 方法分两部分：(1)对总体层面的二元方向性预测，采用非对称Z检验，通过参数λ控制预测方向的显著性水平分配，证明了一致性和鲁棒性的线性权衡；(2)对个体层面预测，提出广义PPI++（GPPI），对预测应用高维变换φ，通过贪心选择从候选变换集中选择最优变换；(3)使用三个Mistral模型（7B、24B、123B参数）在四个真实数据集上进行实验验证。

Result: 在四个数据集上，GPPI配合贪心变换选择一致优于PPI++，在98%的测试项目上实现更优的ESS增益，A/B测试中样本量减少高达30%。MovieLens上线性修正已足够；Last.fm上GPPI显著优于PPI++，后者在处理高偏态分布时表现下降。总体层面预测在预测准确时收益显著。

Conclusion: 该框架成功地将学习增强算法范式扩展到假设检验，在利用预测的同时保持了严格的统计有效性。基于LLM角色的模拟与统计框架结合，可显著降低实验成本，为A/B测试提供了实用工具。

Abstract: A/B testing requires large sample sizes, long timelines, and significant costs. When auxiliary predictions of experimental outcomes are available from machine learning models, uncertain prediction quality precludes replacing human experiments entirely, yet these predictions may still contain useful signal. We propose a principled framework for learning-augmented hypothesis testing that leverages predictions of unknown quality to reduce sample sizes while maintaining statistical validity. Predictions naturally vary in granularity, from coarse aggregate signals to fine-grained individual-level estimates, and our framework addresses both ends of this spectrum: (1) for population-level directional predictions, where only a binary signal on the treatment effect sign is available, we use an asymmetric test and prove consistency and robustness bounds within the learning-augmented algorithms paradigm; (2) for individual-level predictions, we introduce Generalized PPI++ (GPPI), extending Prediction-Powered Inference to handle nonlinear prediction errors through higher-dimensional transformations. Both methods benefit from accurate predictions while remaining robust to inaccurate or adversarial ones. We validate our framework using persona-based LLM simulations, where AI agents equipped with user personas predict individual behavior, as a natural prediction source spanning both granularity levels. Experiments on four real-world datasets demonstrate that our methods, combined with persona-based predictions, substantially reduce experimental costs while preserving rigorous statistical validity.

</details>


### [408] [iSDFT: Information-Proximal Self-Distillation for Continual Learning in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24646)
*Ahmed Khaled Khamis,Xiaotong Ji,Hassan Jaber,Rasul Tutunov,Matthieu Zimmer,Jun Wang,Haitham Bou-Ammar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 iSDFT（Information-Proximal Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning），通过信息约束的 KL I-投影控制教师影响，并结合冻结基模型锚点，在持续学习中同时改善任务获取与能力保留。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的 on-policy 自蒸馏微调（SDFT）在每个 token 都以完整的演示条件教师分布作为目标，固定了教师影响处于"全教师"端点，无法在每个预测状态灵活控制应传递多少演示信息，导致在稳定-塑性权衡中缺乏对教师信息的局部控制。

Method: iSDFT 将教师视为有预算的信息源，在每个 token 处求解一个信息约束投影问题：min KL(Q||P_t) s.t. I_t(Q) ≥ γ_t，得到闭式指数族目标 Q*_t ∝ P_t^{1-λ_t} · T_t^{λ_t}，其中 λ_t 由约束通过一维二分法确定；信息预算定义为 γ_t = ρ·KL(T_t||P_t)。此外引入 KL(P_base||P_t) 锚点项，以冻结的基模型策略控制累积漂移。最终损失为 KL(Q*_t||P_t) + μ·KL(P_base||P_t)。

Result: 在 4 种异构 LLM 骨干（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Qwen3-1.7B、Gemma-4-E2B-it、OLMo3-7B-Think）和两个专精任务（Tool Use、Science）上，iSDFT 在 8 组模型-任务设置中的 7 组优于 vanilla SDFT，1 组持平；在原始 SDFT 保留测试套件上 73% 的评估保持在基模型 0.5 分以内（最强基线仅 52%）；在 10 个额外数学、编码、竞赛数学基准上均取得最大平均增益。消融实验表明信息预算主要驱动可塑性增益，基模型锚点主要改善能力保留。

Conclusion: 将 on-policy 自蒸馏中的教师视为有预算的信息源而非需完全模仿的目标，并通过显式的冻结基模型锚点解耦局部可塑性与长期保留，可以在改善任务专精的同时更好地保持模型的广泛能力，为持续学习中可控的自蒸馏提供了新原则。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation fine-tuning (SDFT) learns new skills from demonstrations while reducing forgetting, but it always distils toward the full demonstration-conditioned teacher. This fixes teacher influence at the full-teacher endpoint, providing no control over how much demonstration information should be transferred at each prediction state. We introduce Information-Proximal SDFT (iSDFT), which instead treats the teacher as a budgeted source of information. At each token, iSDFT selects the distribution closest to the current student that satisfies a prescribed teacher-information constraint, yielding a closed-form exponential target with a locally determined tilt. To control cumulative drift, we further anchor the student to its frozen base policy. Across four heterogeneous LLM backbones and two specialisation tasks, iSDFT improves vanilla SDFT in 7 of 8 model-task settings and matches it in the remaining one. It also provides tighter retention on the original SDFT benchmark suite, with 73% of evaluations remaining within 0.5 points of the base model versus 52% for the strongest baseline, while achieving the largest mean improvement on all ten additional mathematics, coding, and competition-mathematics benchmarks. These results show that controlling how much and when teacher information is introduced improves specialisation while preserving broader capability.

</details>


### [409] [Corrective Forcing: Unified Post-Training for Diffusions and Flows in Generative Speech Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24651)
*Qing Yao,Lijian Gao,Qirong Mao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Corrective Forcing（CoF），一种统一的post-training范式，用于解决扩散模型和流匹配模型在生成式语音增强（SE）中的训练-推理不匹配问题（即exposure bias）。CoF通过动态rollout修正（DRC）在不同采样步数下的自生成状态上纠正clean speech预测，并通过反事实过渡一致性（CTC）利用EMA教师提供局部校正参考来规约化状态过渡。该方法通过共享clean-speech预测参数化，可同时应用于SB-VE和OT-CFM两种生成范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散和流匹配模型在生成式语音增强中存在训练-推理不匹配：训练时使用解析路径状态，而推理时在离散采样轨迹上递归评估模型于自生成rollout状态，导致预测和离散化误差累积（即exposure bias）。现有方法（RSB、CRP）仅在模拟或部分rollout状态上改善预测，误差仍会通过局部过渡传播，限制了对不同采样条件的泛化能力。

Method: 1. **动态Rollout修正（DRC）**：在动态采样步数N_d∈{1,…,N_max}下生成rollout状态，将SB-VE的data预测和OT-CFM的向量场预测统一参数化为clean-speech估计X̂_θ，通过复合重建损失ℓ_rec（幅度谱MSE+复数谱MSE+负SI-SDR，加权0.7/0.3/0.01）进行修正。2. **反事实过渡一致性（CTC）**：从同一rollout状态出发，构造factual transition（使用EMA教师）和counterfactual transition（使用ground truth干预），将factual预测与counterfactual教师预测对齐作为规约化。3. **统一目标**：L_CoF = L_DRC + λ_CTC·L_CTC，λ_CTC=0.1。

Result: 在VoiceBank+DEMAND、WSJ0+WHAM和WSJ0+REVERB数据集上的实验表明：1）CoF (SB-VE)在NFE=4时PESQ达3.21，超过SB-VE(3.07)、RSB(3.04)和CRP(3.08)，且SI-SDR在不同NFE下稳定保持19.4dB；2）CoF (OT-CFM)在NFE=4时将SI-SDR提升至19.8dB；3）在更具挑战性的WSJ0+WHAM/REVERB上，CoF在NFE=4处使PESQ提升0.2-0.4、SI-SDR提升1.0-1.1dB；4）消融实验验证了DRC和CTC的贡献，以及动态采样计划和复合ℓ_rec的必要性。

Conclusion: CoF通过将预训练模型适配于自生成采样轨迹，有效缓解了生成式语音增强中的训练-推理不匹配问题。DRC在rollout状态上修正预测，CTC通过反事实参考规约化局部过渡，二者协同提升了参考感知质量和重建保真度，尤其在多步采样下表现稳健。该方法为扩散和流匹配模型提供了统一的post-training框架。

Abstract: Diffusion and flow models, as promising generative paradigms for speech enhancement, face a training--inference mismatch: training uses analytical path states, whereas inference recursively evaluates models on self-generated rollout states along discretized sampling trajectories. This mismatch causes prediction and discretization errors to accumulate. To address it, we introduce Corrective Forcing (CoF), a post-training paradigm that forces diffusion and flow models to learn from self-generated rollouts and correct their predictions. CoF corrects clean-speech predictions on rollout states toward the ground truth under dynamic sampling schedules, exposing the model to varying inference conditions. It further regularizes local evolution using locally corrected counterfactual transitions as references for factual transitions. By expressing model outputs through a shared clean-speech prediction parameterization, CoF applies the same post-training objective across diffusion and flow formulations. Experiments with SB-VE and OT-CFM demonstrate improvements in perceptual quality and reconstruction fidelity, together with robust performance across different numbers of sampling steps.

</details>


### [410] [Enhancing Transformer Representations of Symbolic ODE Expressions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24746)
*Xiyue Fan,Adam Prugel-Bennett,Stuart E. Middleton*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了使用树形位置编码和对比学习增强Transformer在符号ODE求解中的结构化表示能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Transformer在处理符号微分方程时使用标准的序列位置编码，无法有效捕捉数学表达式的树形层次结构。此外，标准位置编码将数学等价的交换表达式视为不同，忽略了交换律性质。

Method: 1) 在编码器端引入树形位置编码（TPE），通过前缀遍历将表达式树序列化为二进制编码，通过bi-GRU融合结构信息到节点嵌入中；2) 使用SimCLR对比学习框架，通过交换加法/乘法操作符的左右子树生成正样本对，鼓励等价表达式在潜空间中靠近。

Result: 树形位置编码（TPE）在不同数据规模（500K-5M）下均优于绝对位置编码（APE），在早期训练epoch即表现出优势；对比学习在TPE基础上带来轻微提升（+0.3%），但直接对增广数据进行监督训练（Merge策略）效果更佳，Model_TPE_merge在IDD上达到62.4%准确率，OOD测试中也表现最优。

Conclusion: 树形位置编码能有效提升符号ODE求解性能并具有更好的数据效率；结构化表示是对比学习发挥作用的基础，但其效果不如直接监督增广数据；TPE的增益在分布外场景下依然稳健。

Abstract: Existing approaches to solving differential equations, such as symbolic regression, physics informed neural networks, and neural operators, typically focus on numerical approximations or blind symbolic search via fitting to numerical data. Less attention has been paid to learning structured representations of mathematical expressions that preserve commutative properties and could support mathematical reasoning in symbolic forms. Transformer models have shown strong capabilities in solving symbolic differential equations. However, standard positional embeddings in transformers are designed for sequence data. Symbolic differential equations are naturally represented by expression trees, so these positional embeddings may not efficiently capture their hierarchical structures. We investigate existing tree positional embeddings in symbolic ordinary differential equation (ODE) tasks. We systematically study their effectiveness under different settings. Our results show that tree positional embeddings aid learning in early epochs and continue to improve performance throughout, ultimately yielding consistent advantages across various data sizes and tasks. Based on learned structural representations, we apply contrastive learning to support the commutative property in mathematics. Ablation studies provide insight into how these methods interact in modelling symbolic mathematical structures.

</details>


### [411] [When Tomorrow Becomes Today: Self-Evolving Policies for Agentic Time-Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24862)
*Yifan Hu,Xilin Dai,Zhiyuan Qu,Yiding Liu,Zewei Dong,Jiang-ming Yang,Qiang Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 TimEvolve,一种冻结骨干的时间序列智能体,通过"预测-揭示-更新"循环将已实现结果转化为对专家信任、路径选择和干预强度的持续联合策略更新,在 8 个 Time-MMD 领域上 15 种方法中取得最优平均 MSE/MAE 排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列智能体主要通过预测精炼、反思或检索融入先验经验,但未能将部署中已实现的结果系统地转化为对后续预测的编排策略的持续更新,导致在机制演化的系统中,数值模型、推理策略与干预规则的相对有效性随时间变化时,协调规则仍相对静态。

Method: TimEvolve 采用三个协同模块:EvolveTrust 通过逆误差加权及多视图混合更新专家信任与数值先验;EvolveReason 通过滚动岭回归利用五维预揭示特征选择证据驱动的代理路径;EvolveIntervene 通过加权岭回归以揭示期解出的最优混合系数 α* 为监督信号学习干预强度,语言模型、专家骨干与提示词保持不变。在揭示前预先提交全部候选,使得揭示后可评估所有备选方案(包括未选中者),提供延迟反馈。

Result: 在 8 个 Time-MMD 领域的 15 种方法对比中,TimEvolve 在 MSE 与 MAE 上分别取得 1.250 与 1.375 的平均最优排名,8 个领域中有 7 个在两项指标上均最低;相对 TimEvolve-Stack(冻结策略)平均 MSE 降低 6.3%、MAE 降低 7.6%,所有 16 项领域-指标对比均改善;反馈覆盖度消融表明对全部预提交专家与候选提供反馈优于仅对选中路径反馈。

Conclusion: 在保持数值预测组件冻结的前提下,将已实现的部署结果转化为对编排策略的持续联合更新,能够系统性地提升时间序列智能体在演化机制下的预测精度,验证了从"明天变为今天"的过程中学习预测策略的价值。

Abstract: Agentic time series forecasting concerns systems whose underlying mechanisms evolve, making the relative effectiveness of numerical models, reasoning strategies, and intervention rules inherently time-varying. Consequently, a time series agent must adapt the forecasts it produces and the orchestration policy that determines which components to trust and how to coordinate them. The deployment process naturally provides supervision for this adaptation as forecast horizons elapse and realized targets reveal the effectiveness of earlier decisions. Committing all numerical expert forecasts and candidate agent paths before target observation allows each realized outcome to evaluate the entire alternative set, providing delayed feedback without additional annotation. However, existing time series agents primarily incorporate prior experience through forecast refinement, reflection, or retrieval, without systematically converting realized outcomes into persistent updates to the joint orchestration policy governing later origins. To exploit this delayed feedback systematically, we introduce TimEvolve, a frozen-backbone time series agent that converts each realized outcome into persistent joint updates of expert trust, agent path selection, and intervention strength. A temporally ordered predict, reveal, and update protocol applies this feedback to subsequent forecasts. Experiments across eight Time-MMD domains show that TimEvolve achieves the best average MSE and MAE ranks among fifteen methods and the lowest errors on both metrics in seven domains. These results demonstrate the value of learning forecasting policies from the futures encountered during deployment.

</details>


### [412] [Exactness at Inference: A Representational Criterion for Out-of-Distribution Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24942)
*Filipe Marinho Rocha,Inês Dutra,Vítor Santos Costa,Luís Paulo Reis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"推理精确性"（Exactness at Inference）作为分布外（OOD）泛化的表征准则：一个模型要能在训练分布外正确泛化，其推理时调用的表征必须在结构上等价于数据生成机制本身，而非仅在训练区域上拟合的近似。文章将深度网络的两类失败——连续域的分段仿射外推发散与关系域的变量绑定缺失——统一为"精确可表征性"的同一缺口的两个面向，并据此系统区分了多种神经-符号系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前深度学习在 OOD 泛化上的两大已知失败（分段仿射外推发散、无法绑定新实体）通常被当作彼此独立的病征，被分别归因于数据、规模或优化不足。本文认为这两类失败实为同一表征缺口的两个表现，并提出一个统一的、面向推理的判据来解释何时模型能够真正泛化、何时只是在校准区域内做了近似。

Method: 1) 将 ReLU 等分段线性网络的拟合误差与切比雪夫等振荡定理给出的解析下界做定量对照，区分"精确"与"准确"。2) 用三种激活函数（ReLU、Sigmoid、GELU）在 f(x)=x² 上做案例研究，展示单元级直觉与网络级行为的差异（GELU 在两侧都发散）。3) 用传递性亲属关系作为关系失败的标准案例，将 TransE/R-GCN 与 ESBN、Tensor Logic 对照。4) 给出"推理路径传播规则"：一个被计算量继承其推理路径上每个拟合估计器的表征边界。5) 在 radial chirp sin(x²+y²) 上比较抽象诱导、深网络集成与近邻距离不确定性度量对 56.3% 已确定查询的可识别性。6) 提出将逻辑编程（ILP）与符号回归作为分别在关系面与连续面上满足准则的成熟范式，并讨论程序合成与混合语言偏置。

Result: 1) 精确性是关于操作本身是否在结构上等价于生成机制，而非值域是否离散；精确求和-乘积张量收缩在 [0,1] 上连续却精确，拟合神经网络阈值化为硬标签则离散却不精确。2) 神经-符号系统按准则被重新分类：LTN 失败；∂ILP 通过训练时搜索、推理时抽取离散规则而通过；零温 Tensor Logic 在闭域上原位执行精确推理而通过；T>0 时回归到嵌入几何，关系限制重现。3) 任何含 MLP 的架构，其输出只在 MLP 处于其推理路径上时才继承其限制；ESBN 通过外部记忆间接使实体嵌入脱离控制器路径，Hamiltonian NN 中能量守恒与轨迹精度因此解耦。5) 在 radial chirp 上，诱导出的 sin(x²+y²) 隐含周期性使 56.3% 的远距离径向查询事实上由训练数据确定（误差 ~1e-16），而深网络集成在两类子集上同等失败，最近邻距离与探测器因果指标以递减或"反向"AUC（0.69、0.67）将这些查询判为最难。7) 所有已知能精确生成机制的结构——等变性群、辛形式、外部记忆间接——都由人事先注入而非模型自行发现，因此缩放只能扩大拟合部分而精确部分原地不动。

Conclusion: OOD 泛化的边界即"精确可表征性"的边界；准确拟合并不保证外推，因为拟合残差在训练域内也非零并在域外发散、在组合下累积。准则要求推理时执行与生成机制结构等价的操作，而非仅仅在码本意义上离散。该准则统一了连续与关系两面的失败，预言并解释了 ARC-AGI 上归纳与转导方法的分工、等变模型在特定轴上的失败、以及距离度量在"是否可答"上的反向排序。真正突破需要能自主诱导精确表征的架构，而非依赖人类注入结构。

Abstract: A model generalizes outside its training distribution only when it computes a representation structurally equivalent to the generating mechanism, not an approximation fitted to it. Such equivalence is necessary for exactness in and out of distribution, and extrapolation is governed by this exactness at inference, whatever its realization. Tensor Logic shows this: a zero-temperature contraction is equivalent to discrete logic, deducing in place with no artefact extracted, its tensors Boolean, its embeddings orthonormal, only its arithmetic continuous. Lacking infinite recursion it reaches Datalog, not Prolog, and though exact over closed domains it needs external memory to bind a novel entity. The criterion needs neither a discrete representation nor an extracted expression, and constrains inference, not training: an exact marginal in $[0,1]$ passes, a Neural Network thresholded to a hard label does not. Logic Tensor Networks fail it, while differentiable ILP and Tensor Logic at $T=0$ pass. Piecewise-affine extrapolation divergence and an inability to bind novel entities are two faces of a shortfall in exact representability. For hybrid architectures, a propagation rule follows: the output inherits the bounds of every fitted estimator on its path, explaining which axes fail in equivariant models and the ARC-AGI induction/transduction split. Only an exact hypothesis class certifies what the training data leave underdetermined: on a law-derived partition it finds the $56.3\%$ of distant queries that are answerable, which ensembles meet with false confidence and distance metrics rank backwards. Common inductive biases, from symmetries to memory, reach exactness only because humans inject them, an argument for inducing exact representations rather than fitting surrogates whose residuals, even at the arithmetic floor in training, diverge outside the data and compound under composition.

</details>


### [413] [Rare Event Estimation via Iterative Unalignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24969)
*Hanming Yang,Daksh Mittal,Jing Dong,Hongseok Namkoong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Iterative Unalignment (IU)，一种基于权重空间扰动的重要性采样方法，用于估计语言模型在自回归输出分布上的极小概率罕见事件概率。通过对预训练LM进行LoRA微调作为提议分布，结合可微代理信号放大罕见事件和逐token反向KL正则化控制重要性权重方差，在GPT-2和Gemma-2上验证了超过800倍的计算加权效率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着自主AI代理的部署规模扩大，模型输出轨迹中的罕见事件（如删除数据库、泄露敏感数据等）即使概率极低也可能在数十亿次部署中造成灾难性后果。安全部署取决于能否准确量化这些罕见失败事件的概率。传统蒙特卡洛方法在此概率下不可行，而为组合性大词汇量的序列空间构造有效的提议分布极具困难。

Method: 1) 将提议分布参数化为基础模型的权重扰动 q_δ = p_{θ+δ}（通过LoRA实现），从而将提议搜索转化为权重空间上的可微优化问题；2) 将事件定义（任意二元指示函数Φ）与搜索信号（可微代理S_δ）解耦；3) 使用密集的逐token反向KL散度作为正则化器 R_δ 来控制重要性权重的分散；4) 基于有效样本量比(ESSr)自适应调整正则化强度λ_t，平衡事件放大与权重稳定性；5) 使用基于首次完成概率的低方差参考估计器来验证估计精度。

Result: 在GPT-2 Small (~120M)和Gemma-2 (~2.6B)上评估300+个罕见事件（涵盖Token Presence、Compositional Token Presence和Profanity Classifier三类），跨越10^{-9}至10^{-3}的概率范围。对于Token Presence事件，当误差阈值为E*_{0.95}=1时，IU相比朴素蒙特卡洛实现超过800×的计算加权效率增益；GPT-2上仅需128样本/估计，平均95%分位数对数误差为1.17个数量级；最稀有的事件（μ≈10^{-9}）下，效率增益超过10^6×。

Conclusion: Iterative Unalignment框架证明了通过权重空间扰动构建语言模型重要性采样提议分布的可行性，为量化自主代理部署中的残余风险提供了实用方法。权重空间扰动的表达力优于激活或logit级别扰动；自适应正则化方案对控制重要性权重方差至关重要；当前方法在大型模型和复合事件上仍有改进空间，未来工作应聚焦于更好的代理设计和自适应正则化机制。

Abstract: As agents are deployed with increased autonomy, even extremely rare events along their stochastic output trajectories can occur and prove catastrophic. Safe deployment therefore does not depend on whether these events can occur, but on how often they might. We study the problem of estimating the probability of rare events that arise from stochastic variation in the agent's own actions. Estimating this type of risk requires searching over the combinatorially vast space of trajectories. Naive Monte Carlo is computationally prohibitive in this regime, and constructing effective importance sampling (IS) proposals requires coordinated changes to a context-dependent chain of conditional distributions. We develop a new IS method that perturbs the original model's weights to construct the proposal. The proposal is itself a differentiably parameterized language model, enabling gradient-based search over weight space. We formulate an objective that combines a differentiable surrogate for event amplification and an adaptive regularization scheme that dynamically balances amplification against estimator stability. We evaluate our approach on $\sim$120M and $\sim$2.6B models across three event families spanning 300+ rare events as rare as $10^{-9}$, with reference probabilities computed with $<10\%$ relative standard error. In our most verifiable settings, we observe that our IS estimator achieves over $800\times$ compute-weighted efficiency gains over naive Monte Carlo for events with probabilities lower than $10^{-7}$. Our implementation is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [414] [RRSI: Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24972)
*Peng Xia,Rujun Han,Zifeng Wang,Yanfei Chen,Yufan Zhang,Yoonho Lee,Chengsong Huang,Han Yu,Zhongying CuiZhu,Yifei Ming,Huaxiu Yao,Burak Gokturk,Tomas Pfister,Chen-Yu Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RRSI提出了一种正则化的递归自我改进框架，通过约束提案和选择两个阶段来防止LLM智能体harness进化过程中对训练任务的过拟合，从而提升在分布外基准上的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有harness自动化进化方法虽然能在演化集上获得大幅提升，但在未见过的基准上增益常常消失甚至为负，存在严重的过拟合问题（具体表现为benchmark-specific fitting、noise chasing和complexity accumulation三种行为）。

Method: 在提案端引入L0风格的退火编辑预算、基于历史证据的信用分配、结构化探索；在选择端引入leakage筛选（critic拒绝编码具体任务名的编辑）、noise-adjusted acceptance floor、L2风格的成本感知接受（gain-dependent cost rule）以及L1风格的结构剪枝（删除持续无产出的组件）。整体类比机器学习中L0/L1/L2正则化在更新基数、保留结构的稀疏化和整体资源足迹上的不同功能。

Result: 在三个领域八个基准测试上，RRSI在演化集上最高提升14.1分，在五个分布外基准上最高提升4.7分，policy token消耗比无正则化进化减少30%；消融实验证明两组正则器缺一不可，且其增益在不同骨干模型间可迁移（包括用更弱模型评估时仍有效）。

Conclusion: 递归式自我改进需要对"如何使用有限反馈"进行正则化，而非限制可编辑空间；RRSI通过同时约束提案和选择，使harness在保留通用机制的同时去除任务特定拟合和噪声带来的伪改进，实现了跨任务的稳定迁移。

Abstract: An LLM agent's capability is largely magnified by its harness, namely the prompts, control flow, tooling, memory, and context management surrounding the frozen backbone model. Recent methods increasingly automate this process by iteratively proposing and selecting component-wise edits of an agent harness, practically establishing a form of recursive self-improvement (RSI) at the agent-system level. However, such recursive evolution may overfit by memorizing the training tasks, showing large in-distribution gains that shrink or even vanish on out-of-distribution benchmarks. We introduce Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses (RRSI), which incorporates the principles of regularizations into harness self-improvement by constraining the evolution candidate proposal and selection. The proposer operates with a temporally annealed budget, limiting how many edits a candidate can bundle, and it encourages unexplored trajectories based on evolution history. The selector is equipped with a critic and a pruner: the critic screens benchmark-specific proposals, while the pruner, removes changes that are too small, too expensive, or no longer useful. Together these constraints favor reusable agent mechanisms over benchmark-specific ones or even noises. Across eight benchmarks spanning coding, agentic workspace and engineering design tasks, RRSI gains up to 14.1 points on the split it evolves against and up to 4.7 points on the five out-of-distribution benchmarks, while producing a harness that runs on 30% fewer policy tokens than the unregularized evolution. Code is available at this https URL and project page is this https URL .

</details>


### [415] [Adaptive Determinantal Client Scheduling in Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23843)
*Wen Xu,Ben Liang,Gary Boudreau,Hamza Sokun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ADCS（自适应行列式客户端调度）算法，将行列式点过程（DPP）引入联邦学习的客户端调度，通过在每轮基于梯度信息构建DPP核矩阵并执行快速MAP推断，实现质量与多样性的灵活权衡，显著提升异构环境下最差客户端的性能，同时给出梯度近似偏差的非凸收敛性分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习中存在数据和系统异构性，现有调度策略多只关注单一质量指标（如损失、梯度范数），倾向于选择同类高质量客户端，忽视多样性，导致最差客户端性能不佳。需要一种统一的质量-多样性调度框架。

Method: 1) 使用本地更新梯度的方向构建Gram矩阵作为多样性核；2) 通过质量分数的对角矩阵与多样性核相乘得到DPP的L-ensemble核，实现质量-多样性权衡；3) 利用Cholesky分解的贪心MAP推断（复杂度O(m²N)）选择m个客户端；4) 每R轮更新一次核以降低开销；5) 理论分析：在梯度聚类结构假设下量化ADCS偏差上界，并推导一般有偏客户端调度的非凸收敛界。

Result: 在Fashion-MNIST（30个客户端，10个非IID分组，m=18，T=20000）实验上，ADCS在θ=0.8时获得最高的worst-case测试准确率，同时保持具有竞争力的平均准确率。相较OCS、PowerOfChoice、DivFL、StaticDPP等基线均有提升；θ过小会退化为纯多样性，性能下降；R≤20时性能几乎不受核更新频率影响。TV距离分析显示ADCS选择偏差（0.1364）低于OCS（0.2241）和PowerOfChoice（0.1934）。额外客户端计算开销仅3.3%。

Conclusion: ADCS为联邦学习客户端调度提供了一种基于DPP的质量-多样性统一优化框架，能够显著改善异构数据下最差客户端的学习效果，同时保持平均性能，并具有严格的有偏调度非凸收敛保证，验证了多样性感知调度的重要性。

Abstract: Scheduling clients for model training is critical in federated learning due to both data and system heterogeneity. Most previous works focus on the quality of the scheduled clients to achieve faster convergence, shorter wall-clock convergence time, or better average model performance. They rarely consider the diversity of clients, which is important to counter heterogeneity and improve performance for the worst-off clients. In this work, we advocate the use of determinantal point processes (DPPs) to model and enhance the diversity in client scheduling. We first design the kernel matrices of DPPs using gradient information and quality scores, which inherently enables a flexible quality-diversity trade-off. Applying fast MAP inference over DPPs, we propose Adaptive Determinantal Client Scheduling (ADCS) in FL. We further quantify the gradient approximation error of ADCS and develop convergence analysis for general biased client selection in FL with non-convex loss functions. We conduct comparative numerical experiments showing that ADCS outperforms state-of-the-art client scheduling algorithms, including both quality-based and diversity-based ones.

</details>


### [416] [SafeTune: A Unified Faithful Library for Auditing and Repairing Safety Drift in Fine-Tuned LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22153)
*Pratinav Seth,Saisab Sadhu,Anshul Kaushal,Vinay Kumar Sankarapu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SafeTune 是一个源代码可获取的 Python 库，将四种 LLM 安全修复范式（后验权重恢复、安全约束微调、基于梯度的遗忘、推理时引导）以及共享的可解释性、评估和部署工具统一在同一个配置驱动的框架下，旨在解决安全修复方法因实现不兼容、生命周期阶段不同和评估协议不一致而难以比较和采用的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当指令调优的大语言模型经过领域（如医疗、法律、代码）微调后，即使微调数据完全无害，其拒绝有害请求的行为也会被削弱（"safety drift"）。现有修复方法虽然在大量文献中涌现，却分散在不同的实现、生命周期阶段和评估协议中，使得从业者难以判断哪种方法适用于自己的模型、数据和部署场景。SafeTune 旨在提供一个统一的底层平台（substrate），而非新方法，使不同修复方法能在同一条件下被实施和比较。

Method: SafeTune 采用三个组件组：(1) 干预注册中心（Intervention Registry），通过统一的 "构造-执行-评估" 模式托管四种范式——Recover（后验权重补丁，使用安全任务向量 τ_safe=θ_aligned−θ_base 进行闭式算术操作）、Harden（安全约束微调，在微调损失中加入对齐保持项）、Unlearn（基于梯度的遗忘，针对有害内容应用遗忘目标如 NPO）、Steer（推理时激活编辑，不修改权重）；(2) 共享仪器化层——Interpret 定位拒绝方向和安全电路，Evaluate 使用 7 个安全基准（HarmBench、WildJailbreak、AdvBench、SorryBench、HEx-PHI、OR-Bench toxic、AILuminate）计算平均拒绝率 RR̄ 并配合能力锚点；(3) 连接组件——漂移诱导测试床生成带有 ΔRR̄ 标签的特征化检查点，文档化的干预指南根据访问权限路由到可行范式，运行时保护栏负责部署。架构设计遵循五个目标：范式统一接口、文档化实现、单一评估平台、通过注册的可扩展性、构造可复现性。新方法只需通过 register_recover/register_harden/register_unlearn 函数注册一个遵循范式约定的 Trainer 类即可加入。

Result: SafeTune 在 16 个（模型，领域）对上进行了受控比较，涵盖 Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3.2-3B、Gemma-3-4B-it、Qwen3-4B 四种模型在 math、code、dolly、medical、legal 五个领域的微调结果。主要发现包括：(1) 安全漂移普遍存在但依赖模型和领域——15/16 的微调检查点低于其指令调优基线，dolly 数据造成 26-44pp 的下降，而 math 仅 0-5.6pp；同一检查点上七个基准可产生不同结论（如 L8/medical 上 HarmBench 为 0.795 而 AdvBench 为 0.221）；(2) 干预结果随漂移严重度和干预访问权限而变化——Recover 在轻度漂移（L8/math）下表现强劲（Task Arithmetic 达 RR̄=0.967），而 Harden 和 Unlearn 在中重度漂移下取得更高拒绝率（如 NPO 将 L3/code 从 0.136 提升至 0.991）；(3) 少数方法跨家族迁移更稳定，三个顶级 Recover 补丁在 8 个跨家族对上的点估计相差不超过 0.003，而多种 Harden 方法（LookAhead、TAR、LISA、SPPFT、AsFT、Surgery、SAP）在跨家族时几乎不超过未防御 SFT（RR̄≤0.22）；(4) 某些干预在保持能力锚点的同时提升拒绝率——SafeGrad/Vaccine 在 L8/math 上将 GSM8K 提升 +8.9pp、在 L8/legal 上将 MMLU-law 提升 +10.1pp。金融和医疗两个部署案例研究进一步展示了端到端流程：金融场景中恢复+推理时引导组合将有害拒绝从 87.5% 提升至 97.5%、偏差泄露从 95.8% 降至 83.3%；医疗场景中 Llama-3.2-3B 经 SafeMerge 恢复后在 5 秒内将 HarmBench 拒绝率从 57.5% 恢复至 72.0%（独立校准后），同时 MedMCQA 从 50.6% 提升至 53.1%。

Conclusion: SafeTune 表明安全修复方法不应追求单一最优解，而应让从业者根据自己的训练控制、权重编辑权限、参考模型可用性和计算资源来比较可行替代方案。测量漂移在模型和领域间变化显著，干预结果取决于从业者的访问权限、权重可编辑性、参考模型、数据和算力。SafeTune 通过将这些依赖关系呈现出来而非隐藏，提供了一个共享平台来评估可行替代方案。库、文档、评估平台、示例、配置和工件以 Lexsi Labs 源代码可用许可证（LSAL v1.1）发布，禁止商业利用和降低已部署模型安全性的使用。代码仓库共包含 118 个 API 入口点（26 Recover、27 Harden、19 Steer、6 Unlearn、6 Interpret、24 Evaluate、10 runtime guardrails）。

Abstract: Methods for addressing safety drift in fine-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs) are scattered across incompatible implementations, lifecycle stages, and evaluation protocols, making them difficult to adopt and compare. We introduce SafeTune, a source-available library that unifies four intervention paradigms: post-hoc weight recovery, safety-constrained fine-tuning, gradient-based unlearning, and inference-time steering, alongside shared interpretability, evaluation, and deployment utilities. SafeTune provides a consistent configuration-driven workflow while preserving the distinct inputs and intervention points each paradigm requires. Its modular registry supports new methods, benchmarks, judges, models, and fine-tuning domains without redesigning the surrounding pipeline. We demonstrate SafeTune through controlled comparisons and finance and medical deployment case studies, showing how it characterizes safety drift, evaluates feasible interventions on common refusal-behavior and capability evaluations, and supports calibrated or layered mitigation.

</details>


### [417] [PRQuant: Permutation Residual Quantization for Low-Overhead Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22106)
*Peiran Wang,Anqi Wang,Jiaying Zhao,Huiwen Yang,Zhenyu Ming,Rongqian Wang,Yiwu Yao,Kun Tian,Xin Yao,Gong Zhang,Fan Yang,Zhongyi Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PRQuant 提出了一种面向 W4A4/MXFP4 量化的训练免费、低开销 PTQ 框架，通过 AWQ 缩放 + 通道置换 + 离线权重残差补偿，将散乱的难量化权重列重排为连续尾部块，使补偿过程融合为单一规则的 MXFP4 增广 GEMM，避免在线 gather 和专用混合精度 kernel。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低比特（尤其 MXFP4 块尺度格式）量化中，少量异常值主导整体误差；现有平滑（SmoothQuant/AWQ）、旋转（QuaRot/BATQuant）和残差补偿（ARCQuant/SVDQuant）方法存在两类问题：1）在 W4A4 下将激活端难度迁移到权重端后形成新的权重瓶颈；2）多为在线实现，带来显著执行开销（gather、混合精度 kernel、额外分支），偏离标准低精度 GEMM 路径。

Method: 1) AWQ 风格逐通道缩放 Dα；2) 在缩放后的 W_down·Dα 上按列量化误差选 Top-k 难量化通道，用置换矩阵 Pα 将其移到连续尾部块，并将 Pα、Dα 离线融合到相邻 up/gate 投影权重；3) 离线计算尾部权重的 MXFP4 量化残差 R_W，并拼接到主权重形成增广权重；4) 推理时通过在线 contiguous slice 或离线 producer expansion 复制尾激活，与主激活拼接后做一次规则 MXFP4 增广 GEMM（C+k 维）。训练免费、无需在线 gather、无需构造激活残差、无需定制 kernel。

Result: 在 Ascend A2 NPU 上以 MXFP8(attention)+MXFP4(MoE) 混合精度评估 Qwen3-4B/30B：Qwen3-30B-A3B 五任务平均从 MXFP4 的 89.35 提升至 89.90（+0.55），恢复 MXFP4↔BF16 约 43.3% 精度差；Qwen3-4B 从 80.96 提升至 82.20（+1.24），恢复约 39.9% 精度差。均优于 ARCQuant、FlatQuant、QuaRot。层均值 y-NRMSE：MXFP4 0.1861 → 完整 PRQuant 0.1678；去掉 AWQ 升至 0.1791，去掉残差升至 0.1809，去掉置换仅微升至 0.1687，但置换带来关键的结构性收益（消除动态 gather）；加 E8M0 权重量化尺度搜索可进一步降至 0.1658。

Conclusion: W4A4 量化既是降低数值误差问题，也是将误差组织成硬件友好计算结构的问题。PRQuant 通过离线可融合的置换将散乱难量化权重集中到连续尾部块，使权重残差可预计算并融合进单一规则 MXFP4 GEMM，在几乎不增加在线开销的前提下同时提升精度与效率。未来工作拟将该思路推广至注意力输出投影、FFN up/gate 投影等更多 Transformer 层。

Abstract: Accuracy of Low-bit quantization of linear layers is often dominated by a small number of outliers. Although existing methods, such as smoothing, rotation, or residual-based approaches, may mitigate this problem, they often introduce new accuracy bottlenecks to weights. Besides, most of these techniques are implemented as online approaches, which can result in heavy execution overheads. To address the afore-mentioned issues, We propose PRQuant (Permutation Residual Quantization), a training-free and low-overhead framework that combines channel reorganization with static weight-side residual compensation. After AWQ-style scaling, PRQuant identifies the input channels that contribute most to weight quantization error, permutes them into contiguous tail blocks, and constructs their residual weight sub-tensors offline. During inference, this contiguous structure enables the activation side to use tail blocks seamlessly without the expensive online gathering operation, and turns scattered residual compensation into a regular tail-augmented GEMM, substantially reducing latency. Experiments demonstrate that PRQuant effectively reduces down-projection reconstruction error. Ablation studies confirm that smoothing and residual compensation are the primary drivers of numerical improvement, while permutation provides a consistent marginal numerical benefit and, more importantly, enables a hardware-friendly contiguous layout that eliminates dynamic gathering overhead. Overall, PRQuant outperforms default MXFP4 and the evaluated PTQ baselines in average accuracy across five downstream benchmarks, improving over MXFP4 by 1.24 and 0.55 on Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507, respectively.

</details>


### [418] [Generalized Multimodal Foundation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22107)
*Huizi Cui,Zongbo Han,Chenggong Ding,Naichuan Xiao,Jialong Yang,Jingdong Chen,Guangyu Wang,Qinghua Hu,Changqing Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出广义多模态基础模型（Generalized Multimodal Foundation Model），通过基于结构化因果模型（SMCM）的大规模合成多模态数据训练，学习可迁移的多模态关联模式，实现无需任务特定适应即可泛化到任意模态组合和预测任务的统一多模态学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有融合模型局限于预定义的模态组合和单一任务，无法快速适配新的下游应用。本文旨在回答：是否存在一个通用的多模态融合模型，能够应用于任意模态组合和任意预测任务，从而摆脱对特定模态和融合策略的依赖。

Method: 1. 结构化多模态因果模型（SMCM）：通过根节点、共享节点、私有节点和模态节点的层级生成过程，利用相关控制模块（CCM）调控共享与私有信息路径，产生多样化的跨模态关联模式；2. 基于SMCM生成大规模合成多模态数据集；3. 在TabPFN基础上引入统一token生成机制（门控多头变换+跨注意力聚合）、层级多模态注意力（模态级/跨模态/样本级）和多模态上下文学习目标，并采用LoRA进行参数高效扩展。

Result: 在覆盖12种模态、11个预测任务的18个真实数据集上，无需任务特定参数更新，平均ACC提升5.83%、AUC提升3.10%，与专用融合模型性能相当；在不同预训练编码器组合下平均提升9.61个百分点；性能随上下文示例增加而提升。

Conclusion: 广义多模态基础模型为构建超越预定义模态组合与任务设定的统一多模态预测模型提供了新范式，通过合成数据驱动的因果生成训练模型捕获通用关联模式，借助上下文学习激活任务相关模式，为未来探索超出现有范式的新模态提供了有前景的方向。

Abstract: Making prediction with multimodal data is widely used in diverse scenarios. Existing multimodal fusion models, once deployed, can only handle predefined modalities (e.g., vision, text and audio) and single tasks, making it difficult to quickly adapt to new downstream applications. Therefore, a natural yet rather aggressive question arises, whether there exists a general multimodal fusion model that can be applied to arbitrary modality combinations and arbitrary prediction tasks. We argue that a unified multimodal fusion model should not depend on specific modalities and instead encode transferable patterns of multimodal correlation. To this end, we propose a simple and effective learning paradigm based on training over the generation of large-scale synthetic multimodal datasets with diverse causal structures that formally characterize the generative processes of multimodal data in real world. Building on this framework, we propose the generalized multimodal foundation model, a unified foundation model for generalized multimodal learning. By constructing large-scale synthetic multimodal datasets with diverse correlation patterns, our model encodes transferable multimodal correlations during training and activates appropriate associations through in-context examples during inference. Extensive experiments on 18 real-world datasets spanning 12 modalities and 11 prediction tasks demonstrate that our model achieves competitive performance with specialized models without task-specific adaptation.

</details>


### [419] [Correcting Learning-based Perception for Safety](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22108)
*Yan Miao,Hussein Darir,Sayan Mitra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种两步法来在线纠正基于机器学习的感知模块在自动驾驶系统中的错误：离线构建感知契约的原像（PPC）以描述ML感知带来的状态估计不确定性，在线运行时使用风险启发式从不确定状态集中选择最具风险的状态驱动控制决策。该方法在基于视觉的自适应巡航控制（ACC）系统中进行了CARLA仿真验证，使用YOLO和LaneNet作为感知模块。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习感知模块（如YOLO和LaneNet）缺乏明确的错误边界规范，且其性能受光照、天气等环境因素影响显著，在安全关键场景中可能导致不安全或过度保守的控制行为。传统的鲁棒控制工具需要明确的误差界，无法直接应用于ML感知模块。

Method: 1. 离线构建感知契约原像（PPC）：使用贝叶斯神经网络（BNN）从数据中学习感知模块的逆映射 M^{-1}，给定观测y输出可能的状态集合；2. 在线运行时使用风险启发式 J(x)（定义为到不安全边界距离的加权逆的L∞范数）从 M^{-1}(y)∩R 中选择风险最大的状态，再结合完美观测器 h* 和控制器 g 产生控制输入。安全性通过定理1证明：当 h 符合 M 时，修正后的闭环系统保持控制不变集R。

Result: 在CARLA仿真平台上测试了54个ACC场景（3种道路×6种天气×3种控制器组合）。使用YOLO+LaneNet感知模块时，有45个场景出现安全违规；引入感知修正模块后，成功恢复了其中33个场景的安全（恢复率73%）；未能恢复的12个场景是由于从数据构建的PPC不完全符合契约假设。修正后场景的平均完成时间仅增加2.8%，干预措施较为温和。BNN构建的PPC在91.2%的测试数据上满足一致性要求。

Conclusion: 该方法通过感知契约原像和风险启发式有效缓解了学习型感知模块在自动驾驶安全关键场景中的脆弱性问题，在不显著牺牲系统效率的前提下恢复了多数不安全场景。局限性在于数据驱动的PPC构建无法保证100%一致性（Proposition 1未必成立），未来工作方向包括探索更优的PPC构建架构，以及利用PPC推断可能导致不安全的潜在环境变量以识别控制器弱点。

Abstract: Learning-enabled perception is important in many autonomous systems. Unlike traditional sensors, the boundary where ML perception does or does not work is poorly characterized. Incorrect perception can lead to unsafe or overtly conservative downstream control actions. In this paper, we propose a two-step strategy for correcting ML-based state estimation. First, an offline computation is used to characterize the uncertainties resulting from the ML module's state estimation, using preimages of perception contracts. Second, at runtime, a risk heuristic is used to choose particular states from the uncertain estimates to drive the control decisions. We perform extensive simulation-based evaluation of this runtime perception correction strategy on different vision-based adaptive cruise controllers (ACC modules), in different weather conditions, and road scenarios. Out of 45 ACC scenarios where the original perception-based control system using Yolo and LaneNet led to safety violations, in 73% of the scenarios, our runtime perception correction preserved safety; our method wouldn't be able to recover 27% of the scenarios where the construction of the preimages of perception contracts is not fully conformant. Further, our runtime perception correction strategy is not overly conservative---on the average only a 2.8% increase in completion time is experienced in the corrected scenarios, with mild interventions.

</details>


### [420] [A Shared Learning Rate Is Not a Neutral Control in Selective On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22109)
*Chencheng Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示选择性on-policy蒸馏文献中广泛使用的"共享学习率"控制并非中性：密集监督在8×学习率网格上统计平坦（摆动1.8 pp），而每个选择性臂都随学习率显著移动（最高达17.7 pp）。作者将此现象命名为"选择器-学习率纠缠"，并通过冻结评分消融证明其根源在于选择机制本身（即使随机5%子集也摆动5.4 pp），闭环评分环路加剧而非导致该现象。在文献实际使用的全微调速率下，模式更加放大（TV选择臂摆动49.5 pp，密集19.8 pp），导致密集vs选择的判定在+3.6 pp到+34 pp之间变化。作者建议报告arm×rate矩阵而非共享速率列。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 选择性on-policy蒸馏文献通过固定共享学习率来比较不同token选择器，但这一协议隐含了"学习率是中性控制"的假设。本文质疑这一假设：如果学习率真是中性的，所有臂应对其反应一致，臂间排名应在速率网格上保持稳定。作者旨在验证这一隐含假设是否成立。

Method: 实验设置：Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct学生从Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct蒸馏GSM8K，LoRA rank 32。三个refresh round，每轮512次rollout，选top-5%位置，512优化步。1）测量4个臂（Full/Random/TV-frozen/TV-live）在8×学习率网格上的表现；2）记录实际AdamW更新幅度以排除步长解释；3）冻结评分模型消融隔离闭环反馈效应（n=12/单元预注册）；4）用熵和可教性选择器复制；5）在MATH-500上复制；6）在文献实际使用的全微调速率（1e-6到1e-5）下复制。所有决策标准预注册并脚本化。

Result: 1）密集监督在LoRA上统计平坦（摆动1.8 pp, p=0.26），每个选择性臂均随速率移动（Random 5.4 pp, TV-live 6.7 pp, Teachability 11.7-17.7 pp）。2）密集vs选择的判定在lr=1e-4时为10.1 pp，在5e-5时为5.1 pp（差2.0×）。3）AdamW更新幅度/η在所有臂间一致至2.2%，排除步长解释。4）冻结评分vs实时评分交互效应3.79±1.69 pp（p=0.035, n=12），闭环环路加剧但不导致纠缠。5）选择漂移轨迹J_t在闭环下随学习率恢复，开环下单调漂移。6）熵选择器未复制交互效应（环路假说被证伪为通用声明）。7）MATH-500上纠缠未复制（限于GSM8K），但密集vs选择的~10 pp代价复制。8）全微调下TV臂摆动49.5 pp vs 密集19.8 pp，判定从+3.6 pp（不显著）到+34 pp（p=0.005）。9）4个选择器排名稳定但6对中有2对显著性结论随速率翻转。

Conclusion: 选择性蒸馏属于"测量其所移动变量"的训练程序家族。选择器不是静态数据透镜，而是学习率调节其稳定性的环路内组件。补救方法不是更好的选择器，而是将环路视为方法一部分的协议：每个臂单独调参，报告arm×rate矩阵而非共享速率列，报告选择漂移J_t与准确率并行。在单一共享速率下比较选择器并未控制学习率。

Abstract: Selective on-policy distillation trains a student only at the token positions a selector scores highest, and the literature compares selectors under a single shared learning rate--a control chosen to be neutral. We show it is not. Under LoRA on GSM8K (Qwen2.5-1.5B student, 7B teacher), across an 8x learning-rate grid, dense supervision is statistically flat (swing 1.8 pp, p=0.26) while every selective arm moves with the rate: 5.4 pp for a random 5% subset, 6.7 pp for a total-variation selector, up to 17.7 pp for a teachability selector. Consequently the dense-versus-selective verdict reads 10.1 pp at lr=1e-4 but 5.1 pp at 5e-5--a 2.0x difference decided by a parameter the protocol treats as scenery--and two of six pairwise significance calls between selectors flip between adjacent rates without any rank inversion. We call this selector-rate entanglement and trace it to selection itself rather than step size: AdamW update magnitudes track the rate to within 2.2% despite 15.5x gradient-norm differences across arms. A preregistered frozen-scoring ablation (selection scored by the initial student; criterion, budget, and on-policy rollouts unchanged; 12 seeds per cell) shows live scoring adds 3.79+/-1.69 pp of rate sensitivity (p=0.035) while the frozen arm remains significantly entangled (p=0.015): the feedback loop aggravates the phenomenon rather than causing it. Under full fine-tuning at the rates this literature actually uses (1e-6 to 1e-5) the pattern grows: dense itself swings 19.8 pp, the selective arm 49.5 pp, and the verdict ranges from a non-significant +3.6 pp at the published operating point to +34 pp (p=0.005) one notch hotter. On MATH-500 the rate dependence does not reproduce under LoRA, scoping that result, while the ~10 pp cost of selective training does. We prescribe reporting the arm x rate matrix, not a shared-rate column, as a precondition for selector comparisons.

</details>


### [421] [Toward Fairness in Machine Learning Models for Predicting Treatment Retention and Premature Discontinuation in Medication for Opioid Use Disorder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22113)
*Tongnian Wang,Carolina Vivas-Valencia,Cici Bauer,Yanmin Gong,Kim-Kwang Raymond Choo,Yuanxiong Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了用于预测阿片类药物使用障碍治疗(MOUD)中过早停药及治疗保留情况的算法公平性问题,并检验了偏见缓解技术的有效性。研究发现,即使整体预测性能可接受,ML模型仍可能存在显著的子群体性能差距;偏见缓解策略虽能缩小部分差距,但往往伴随权衡(其他子群体错误率上升或整体性能下降)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MOUD治疗中持续的低保留率和过早停药率推动了机器学习模型的应用,但这些模型在不同患者群体间的公平性尚未充分探索,可能影响临床决策支持中的公平性,因此亟需系统评估算法公平性和偏见缓解策略的有效性。

Method: 使用TEDS-D数据集(2015-2019年,366,825名患者),训练四种ML模型(LR、RF、GBDT、MLP)预测过早停药和180天以上治疗保留;按种族(White/Black)、族裔(非西班牙裔/西班牙裔)、性别、年龄(18-24/25-54/≥55)进行子群体分析;使用SHAP值进行模型解释;评估三种偏见缓解策略(预处理Reweighing、处理中EGR、后处理Threshold Optimizer);使用TPR、FPR、EOR、PER、EOD等公平性指标;并在2020-2023数据上进行稳健性验证。

Result: 1)整体AUROC适中(GBDT最佳:过早停药0.6892,保留>180天0.6836);2)显著的子群体性能差距:Black患者FPR/TPR比White患者高25-30%(过早停药)和13-24%(保留),≥55岁患者FPR/TPR比年轻子群体高33-57%(保留);3)SHAP显示种族和年龄是关键预测特征,其影响随子群体而异;4)三种偏见缓解方法均缩小了部分差距(如种族FPR差距从约25-30%降至最低0.56%),但常以一个子群体的错误率恶化或整体精度下降为代价;5)MLP与Threshold方法结合效果较差;6)2020-2023数据验证结果一致,差距略小。

Conclusion: MOUD结果预测的ML模型即使整体性能可接受,也可能存在显著的子群体性能差距;偏见缓解可以减少但无法完全消除这些差距,且总会带来权衡。建议采用公平性感知评估、透明报告子群体性能,并根据实施约束和组织能力选择适当的偏见缓解策略;未来的公平感知模型应作为临床判断和更广泛健康公平努力的补充,而非替代。

Abstract: Persistent low retention and completion rates in medications for opioid use disorder (MOUD) have driven the use of machine learning (ML) models to predict retention and identify patients at risk of premature discontinuation. However, the fairness of these models across patient populations remains largely unexplored, raising concerns about their application in treatment decision support. This study systematically assesses algorithmic fairness in ML models for predicting MOUD retention and premature discontinuation and investigates the effectiveness of bias mitigation techniques. Using the cross-sectional Treatment Episode Data Set-Discharges (TEDS-D), which includes treatment episodes for individuals in the U.S. discharged between 2015 and 2019, we trained four ML models to predict premature treatment discontinuation and retention beyond 180 days among individuals receiving outpatient MOUD. We evaluated overall performance and subgroup-level error rates across patient subgroups defined by race, ethnicity, age, and sex, complemented by model explanation analyses. We further assessed bias mitigation techniques and their effects on both fairness and predictive performance. Our findings demonstrate that ML models for MOUD outcome prediction can exhibit subgroup-level performance gaps even when overall predictive performance appears acceptable and that bias mitigation can reduce, but not fully eliminate, these gaps without trade-offs. By demonstrating the importance of fairness-aware evaluation and transparent reporting of subgroup performance, this study provides practical insights for the responsible and context-sensitive use of ML models for risk stratification and care prioritization in MOUD treatment settings.

</details>


### [422] [ZoAQ: Adaptive Zeroth-Order Querying via Query-Reuse Coupling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22115)
*Yangyang Feng,Yao Shu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ZoAQ提出了一种自适应零阶优化方法，通过查询复用耦合机制——利用同一组历史评估同时构建候选更新和决定是否需要更多查询——在合成任务、黑盒攻击和LLM微调中显著降低了查询开销，同时保持任务质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定预算的零阶优化方法在每步使用相同数量的扰动查询，存在浪费；现有的自适应控制器虽然能调整查询量，但常需额外的验证查询来评估估计可靠性，在低查询场景下这些验证开销可能抵消节省的收益。

Method: ZoAQ保留过去的查询-响应记录（包括可复现的扰动种子和对应的标量响应），将其与新获取的记录合并构建候选估计。引入动量一致性门控（momentum-consistency gate），通过比较候选估计与已接受估计的指数移动平均（EMA）的余弦相似度来决定是否接受当前预算或扩展查询。理论分析刻画了集中度（concentration）与陈旧度（staleness）的权衡，证明了首通候选保证支持下降方向。

Result: 在合成目标上减少43-48%的查询；在MNIST和CIFAR-10黑盒攻击中以平均320和625次查询达到100%成功率；在OPT-1.3B和OPT-13B的SST-2和COPA微调中节省43-46%的前向评估，任务精度变化范围为-0.018至+0.010。

Conclusion: ZoAQ通过将历史响应作为更新和分配决策的共同证据来源，实现了无需额外验证查询的自适应查询分配。理论保证和实证结果表明该方法在查询效率和任务质量间取得了良好平衡，查询复用的有效性取决于当前迭代移动速度而非固定历史长度。

Abstract: Zeroth-order optimization (ZOO) estimates updates from function evaluations, making perturbation queries a primary cost. Fixed budgets spend the same number of queries at every step, while adaptive controllers may offset their savings by using additional oracle calls to test estimator reliability.
