Detectors calibrated on the binomial scale are miscalibrated by $\sqrt{\eta\varphi(q_0)L}$, and correct calibration turns detection windows from quadratic to linear in the inverse fault speed. Third, any monitor required to tolerate a drift class $\mathcal{D}$ is blind, at any horizon and for any rule, to every fault in $\mathcal{D}-\mathcal{D}$; the proof is a deliberately elementary two-point argument and the contribution is the object it identifies: for speed-bounded classes the blind set is exactly the doubled-speed class, and the tracker absorbs a speed class fixed by its own gain, so that under a certification regime declaring absorbed drift normal, the monitor manufactures $\mathcal{D}$. An exact Gaussian projection bound, sharper than Pinsker and never vacuous, quantifies power outside it.

</details>


### [506] [CTRL: Control-Based Time Series Forecasting with LLM-Guided Residual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23257)
*Minkyoung Kim,Daeun Ji,Yohan Lee,Beomsoo Kim,Beakcheol Jang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CTRL（Control-based Time Series Forecasting）是一个将大语言模型（LLM）作为"控制器"而非"数值预测器"的时间序列预测框架。它通过冻结的骨干网络生成基础预测，再由三个专用LLM智能体分别分析趋势、季节性和不规则分量的预测误差，输出紧凑的控制信号，由轻量级残差解码器转化为预测修正。框架还包含无需标签的测试时自适应机制，可在分布漂移时调整控制信号，仅需3-24次LLM调用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的时间序列预测方法存在两个结构性缺陷：一是将LLM降级为Transformer式的数值预测器，未能利用其推理能力；二是让LLM直接生成数值输出，在非平稳场景下会破坏骨干网络的预测稳定性。论文的核心动机是将LLM的语义推理能力与定量预测解耦，使LLM专注于诊断而非数值生成。

Method: CTRL采用三阶段框架：(1) 控制信号生成——三个冻结LLM智能体（趋势、季节性、不规则）基于STL分解的对比诊断骨干网络预测误差，输出控制信号向量（scale, bias, gate, confidence）；(2) 残差解码器训练——仅约400K参数的轻量MLP解码器在保持骨干和LLM冻结的情况下，通过梯度下降学习将控制信号映射为残差修正；(3) 测试时自适应——通过z-score检测输入统计量的分布漂移（阈值τ=2.0），无需真实标签即可触发LLM重新调整控制信号。多尺度上下文（全局统计、TypiClust聚类的16个少样本示例、当前STL对比）支撑LLM的少样本推理。

Result: 在7个多元时间序列基准（ETTh1/h2、ETTm1/m2、Weather、ECL、Exchange）上的实验表明：CTRL在分布漂移较大的数据集（ETTh2、ETTm2）上MSE降幅高达12%；相比LLMTime（GPT-4直接预测），MSE降低19.6%-44.3%，仅需3-24次LLM调用（降低1000倍以上）；消融实验证实各组件均不可替代，随机控制信号性能等同于零信号，排除了模型容量增加的替代解释；敏感性分析显示框架对LLM选择（GPT-4o到Qwen 2.5 72B）具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: CTRL成功地将LLM重新定位为策略级控制器而非数值预测器，通过控制信号缓存实现高效的测试时自适应。该框架在非平稳动态下提升最大，在高度平稳数据集上保持竞争力。其与预训练数据的结构性隔离使其成为分布漂移不可预测且标签不可用场景下的实用即插即用方案。未来工作包括将CTRL作为基础模型（如TimesFM）的后置校正层。

Abstract: Time series forecasting underpins critical decision-making across diverse domains. While large language models (LLMs) offer promising reasoning capabilities, existing LLM-based time series forecasting approaches either reduce them to numerical predictors that bypass their strengths, or allow direct forecast generation that destabilizes predictions in non-stationary settings. We introduce CTRL, a framework that decouples semantic reasoning from quantitative prediction. A frozen backbone generates base forecasts, while specialized LLM agents function as controllers that analyze backbone prediction errors through decomposed trend, seasonal, and irregular components, grounding reasoning in interpretable temporal structure. Each agent outputs compact control signals that a lightweight residual decoder translates into forecast corrections. CTRL incorporates label-free test-time adaptation that detects distribution shift from input statistics alone and readapts control signals with only 3-24 LLM calls via caching. CTRL is explicitly designed to improve robustness under non-stationary temporal dynamics and distribution shift, while remaining competitive on highly stationary time series where adaptive correction provides limited additional benefit.

</details>


### [507] [Optimal No-Regret Learning for Repeated Prophet Inequality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23265)
*Kun Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了在前缀反馈下的重复先知不等式问题，针对n个未知[0,1]支撑分布的盒子，设计了高效算法达到Õ(√T)期望遗憾，匹配下界（对数因子内），同时消除了对盒子数n的多项式依赖，解决了Liu等人(2025)提出的开放问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法存在两难：Jin等人(2024)的探索-然后-提交策略得到与n无关但为T^{2/3}的遗憾界；Liu等人(2025)达到Õ(√(nT))的遗憾但含√n因子。Liu等人明确提出开放问题：能否同时获得Õ(√T)的遗憾且仅含n的对数依赖？此外，现有Õ(√(nT))算法中逐坐标的乐观性会导致过度探索（如确定性递减实例会产生Ω(n)量级的探索浪费），需要新的探索控制机制。

Method: 提出基于分阶段的算法框架：1) 在每个精度尺度ε上，固定当前行为策略B收集样本，通过经验反向归纳构建基线策略与带盒子特定到达奖励z的奖励策略；2) 基线混合：用权重w_{j,z}=a/(a+d_{j,z})将奖励策略与基线混合，限制经验奖励损失至a=6ε；3) 相对下降聚合：利用前缀嵌套结构，形成探索分数的非递增包络R_i=max{s_i, R_{i+1}}，通过α_i=(R_i-R_{i+1})/R_i加权聚合各盒子探索者，乘以全遍历策略F的ε分量；4) 在几何递减精度序列上分阶段执行，每阶段以M_ε=Õ(A⁴/ε²)轮迭代；5) 关键工具包括三角过程有限族集中不等式（基于Chernoff界与经验到达权重的求和分拆）和见证策略引理（任何阈值策略混合可由至多两个阈值策略表示）。

Result: 主要定理（定理3.1）：算法2实现期望遗憾Reg_T = O(√T [1+log(nT)]²)，同时达到最优T^{1/2}阶和n的对数依赖。算法在多项式时间内运行。具体结果包括：a) 不变传播性质（命题4.1）在每个阶段保持策略的次优性以因子2递减且覆盖比下降至G=64(1+log(nT/δ))；b) 局部精度定理（定理6.4）以高概率保证经验估计对所有相关混合的偏差在ε/16内；c) 通过Õ(log T)个阶段的几何求和得到最终遗憾界。

Conclusion: 本文肯定回答了Liu等人(2025)提出的开放问题：在前缀反馈下，重复先知不等式可被学习至Õ(√T)期望遗憾且仅对盒子数n含对数依赖。核心创新在于直接通过近最优策略进行探索（而非逐坐标乐观性），利用前缀嵌套结构与相对下降聚合规则以对数损失实现探索覆盖，从而突破了现有Õ(√(nT))界中n的多项式依赖。遗憾界匹配Gatmiry等人(2024)的Ω(√T)下界至对数因子。开放方向包括：是否能进一步精化对数因子，以及n的依赖是否本质上不可避免。

Abstract: We study repeated prophet inequalities under prefix feedback. In each of $T$ rounds, a learner encounters fresh values drawn independently from $n$ boxes with unknown $[0,1]$-supported distributions in a fixed order and must irrevocably accept one, observing only the prefix up to its stopping box. Regret is measured against the optimal stopping policy that knows the distributions. We give an efficient algorithm achieving $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})$ expected regret, matching the lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Our algorithm explores directly through near-optimal policies, combining empirical backward induction with box-specific reach bonuses. A relative-drop aggregation rule then exploits the nesting structure of observed prefixes to preserve exploration, thereby removing the polynomial dependence on the box number $n$. This resolves an open question posed by Liu et al. (2025).

</details>


### [508] [Optimal Multi-way Decision Trees for Stratified Sampling in Online Controlled Experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23308)
*Tomoka Takei,Shunnosuke Ikeda,Yuichi Takano*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出OMST（最优多路分层树）方法，通过将分层抽样构建为特征图上的路径选择问题，使用精确方差最小化的二进制优化框架，在连续比例分配和Neyman最优分配下选择可解释的多路决策树路径，以实现在线对照实验中无需增加样本量即可降低方差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线对照实验（A/B测试）需要在不增加样本量的前提下提高统计功效。分层抽样是经典方差缩减技术，但其效果高度依赖分层规则的构建方式。现有方法（如K-means聚类、CART二叉树）存在优化目标不对齐、规则嵌套深、可解释性差等问题，亟需一种直接以方差最小化为目标且生成浅层可解释分层规则的方法。

Method: OMST构建有向无环特征图，每条从Source到Sink的路径对应一个候选分层规则。通过监督式最优分箱（optimal binning）生成数值特征的候选切分点。将分层选择建模为二进制优化问题：在比例分配下目标为最小化加权和Σ NⱼSⱼ²zⱼ；在Neyman最优分配下目标为最小化 (1/n)(Σ NⱼSⱼzⱼ)² − Σ NⱼSⱼ²zⱼ。受约束于分配唯一性、人口覆盖率ρ和最大层数L。此外引入三项问题规模缩减策略：路径剪枝（按最小层大小N_min）、路径聚合（合并相同单元子集的路径）、单元聚合（合并相同分配向量的单元）。采用Gurobi求解二进制优化问题。

Result: 在两个数据集上对比CUPED、K-means、K-means-DT、SFS-KM-V、CART等方法：共享单车数据集上OMST(optb)达到30.9%（比例分配）和35.9%（最优分配）的RMSE缩减率，为所有分层方法中最佳；客户购买数据集上OMST(optb)达到63.1%-64.8%，与CART和SFS-KM-V相当，但略低于CUPED（68.4%）。问题规模缩减显著提升效率：单元聚合将约束数量从N=4,380降至G=483（共享单车），从N=50,000降至G=32（客户购买）；运行时间从69.3秒降至29.0秒。OMST在深度3时即饱和，表明浅层多路树即可实现强方差缩减。

Conclusion: OMST是一种基于优化的分层抽样方法，通过直接最小化分层估计器方差选择多路决策树路径，在保持浅层可解释性的同时实现与或优于现有方法的方差缩减。监督最优分箱优于普通分位数分箱，问题规模缩减有效提升计算可扩展性。局限性在于：仅在两个数据集验证、独立特征离散化可能遗漏交互效应、详尽路径枚举限制了高维可扩展性。未来工作包括更多真实数据验证、动态路径生成（如列生成）以及与现代ML回归调整方法的比较。

Abstract: Online controlled experiments, or A/B tests, are widely used to estimate causal effects on digital platforms. A central challenge is to improve experimental sensitivity, or statistical power, without increasing the experimental sample size. Stratified sampling is a classical variance reduction technique; however, its effectiveness depends critically on how the strata are constructed. We thus propose an optimization-based stratification framework for stratified sampling using optimal multi-way decision trees. Our method, called Optimal Multi-way Stratification Trees (OMST), formulates stratification as a path-selection problem over a feature graph. The selected paths define interpretable stratification rules and are optimized using an exact variance-minimizing binary optimization formulation under continuous proportional allocation and a Neyman-type optimal allocation. We incorporate supervised optimal binning to generate outcome-relevant candidate splits for numerical features. Furthermore, we introduce reduction procedures for redundant candidate paths and assignment constraints, substantially reducing the optimization problem size. Experiments on both a real-world and a simulated dataset demonstrate that OMST achieves comparable or superior variance reduction to existing methods while maintaining shallow and interpretable stratification trees.

</details>


### [509] [CSC: Calibrated Simplicity for Conflict-Aware Social Bot Detection in the LLM Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23320)
*Yipeng Qian,Pengjie Zhao,Chaoxi Niu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CSC框架，针对LLM时代社交机器人检测中"模态冲突"问题（即文本语义看似人类而图结构/属性/跨模态一致性仍可疑），通过"校准简化"取代一味增加图侧复杂度。框架包含三个组件——简化的原型引导图专家、仅在验证集上做Platt校准的单纯形约束融合、轻量级不一致性专家。在TwiBot-22、TwiBot-20、MGStBot-large三个基准上实验表明，CSC主要提升校准后操作点决策质量（特别是F1），而非全面提升阈值无关的排序指标（AUC）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM使社交机器人能以低成本生成类人文本，单纯语义线索变得不可靠，产生模态冲突：同一账号在文本上像人类，在图结构、profile属性或跨模态一致性上仍可能暴露bot特征。已有图基检测器通过增加稀疏原型选择、自适应门控、特定架构控制逻辑等"图侧复杂度"来应对，但作者实验显示复杂度本身并非解决模态冲突的最可靠方式。

Method: 1) 简化原型引导图专家**——保留双视图编码（GraphSAGE邻居聚合 + MLP自特征）、密集多原型判别（正负原型集K×d，温度缩放余弦相似度+log-sum-exp聚合）、固定强度残差修正（η₀为固定系数），去掉稀疏top-r原型选择与逐样本门控。2) 校准单纯形融合**——各专家（G/P/T/D）原始输出经验证集Platt scaling对齐到可比置信空间，再做单纯形约束线性融合，权重与阈值τ在验证集上联合搜索。3) 不一致专家**——基于校准后分数、跨分支差异统计（方差、极差、|q^G−q^T|等）和profile-行为一致性特征ϕ_c训练轻量级分类器h_ψ，输出原始r_i后再做Platt校准，扩展专家集M⁺=M∪{C}再做单纯形融合。训练推理全程仅在验证集上做校准/权重/阈值选择，禁止使用测试标签。

Result: 在TwiBot-22（主模态冲突场景）上，CSC最终模型ACC=0.7248、F1=0.5956、AUC=0.7809，均为报告行最佳；TwiBot-20上F1=0.8828、AUC=0.9334亦最佳；MGStBot-large上F1=0.8532最佳（LightGBM AUC最高0.9681）。诊断：Platt校准大幅降低ECE/Brier/NLL但AUC变化小；S5（验证集阈值）vs S6（固定0.5）对比表明阈值选择对F1至关重要。语义伪装压力测试：替换bot文本为人文本使文本专家F1从0.9217降至0.6780，但图专家与融合系统保持稳定。不一致专家在高冲突区带来+0.0006 F1的局部修正。

Conclusion: CSC验证了一个核心观点：在LLM时代社交机器人检测中，稳健决策应将跨模态冲突视为中心决策问题——保留可靠的结构偏置、对齐异构置信分数、把跨模态不一致作为局部修正信号，比持续增加图侧复杂度更有效。主要贡献是校准后的操作点决策质量提升，而非全面排序指标的优势。

Abstract: Social bot detection is essential for protecting online platforms from misinformation amplification, coordinated manipulation, and distorted public discourse. However, large language models have made social bots much harder to detect from text alone because semantic camouflage is now cheap, fluent, and scalable. The resulting challenge is modality conflict: an account may look human-like in semantics while remaining suspicious in graph structure, profile attributes, or cross-modal consistency. Recent graph-based detectors tackle this limitation by adding graph-side complexity, such as sparse prototype selection, adaptive gating, or architecture-specific control logic, yet our experiments suggest that complexity alone is not the most reliable way to resolve such conflict. We therefore propose CSC, a calibrated-simplicity framework for conflict-aware LLM-era social bot detection. The framework combines three design choices: a simplified prototype-guided graph expert that retains useful structural biases while removing unstable graph-side heuristics, calibrated simplex-constrained fusion that aligns heterogeneous confidence spaces before late fusion, and a lightweight inconsistency expert that models cross-modal disagreement. Experiments on TwiBot-22, TwiBot-20, and MGStBot-large show that \textsc{CSC} improves calibrated operating-point decision quality while remaining competitive across external benchmarks. Further analyses show that calibration improves confidence reliability, the inconsistency expert mainly provides localized corrections in high-conflict or near-threshold regions, and simplified graph-side control yields a better stability-cost trade-off. A targeted semantic-camouflage stress test further shows that replacing selected bot text with matched human text sharply degrades the standalone text expert while leaving graph and fused evidence stable on a balanced challenge set.

</details>


### [510] [Rethinking Class Imbalance for Single-Cell Foundation Models: A Systematic Benchmark Across Architectures and Long-Tail Loss Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23325)
*Zeyu Dong,Jiahui Zhong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对单细胞基础模型（scGPT、scBERT、Geneformer）在稀有细胞类型上系统性失败的问题，构建了一个包含3个骨干网络×3个数据集×6种长尾损失函数×3个随机种子共162次受控训练运行的系统性基准，揭示了稀有类失败可分为"可恢复"与"严重纠缠"两种诊断模式，并提出基于嵌入几何的实用指导方针。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单细胞基础模型虽然在标准基准上报告90%以上的总体准确率，但该聚合指标由常见细胞类型主导，往往掩盖了在罕见但疾病相关的细胞群体上的系统性失败。现有研究主要从采样策略层面缓解类不平衡，而损失函数层面的系统比较在多种架构间尚未被充分研究。

Method: 构建了一个全因子实验设计：在三种主流单细胞基础模型（scGPT、scBERT、Geneformer）上评估六种通用长尾损失函数（CE、加权CE、类平衡损失、focal loss、LDAM、logit调整softmax），跨三个数据集（多发性硬化症MS、Zheng68K、人类胰腺），共54种（骨干网络，数据集，损失）组合，每组3个随机种子，总计162次训练运行；采用每个骨干网络的推荐微调协议和默认超参数；通过UMAP可视化、神经塌缩NC1迹比率、最近邻混淆模式分析和冻结嵌入上的线性探测来诊断失败机制。

Result: 研究发现：(1) 所有九种（架构，数据集）组合下，准确率、Macro-F1和稀有类召回率之间的差距一致存在，由数据集结构而非预训练驱动；(2) 稀有类失败分为两种诊断模式——"可恢复"（损失敏感型）和"严重纠缠"（在任何损失下都失败），后者在所有评估的损失和架构下都被吸收到不相关类别的邻域中；(3) 可恢复类中，加权收益由类别的绝对训练集样本数预测，而非其在数据集中的占比或数据集整体不平衡比；(4) 类平衡损失和LDAM在所有九种设置中表现最一致，而logit调整以稀有类精度为代价换取召回率，并非同时改进两者；(5) 线性探测显示严重纠缠类在冻结嵌入中仍保留可线性分离的判别信号，表明部分瓶颈在于损失设计而非纯粹的数据稀缺。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个可复用的基准和机制驱动的实用指南：默认使用类平衡损失，将logit调整视为精度-召回率的权衡机制而非默认选择，并通过嵌入几何检查（NC1迹比率和最近邻模式）在选择任何损失之前识别注定失败的稀有类——这些类需要更多数据采集而非进一步的损失工程。论文强调了在临床和发现流程中，报告强聚合准确率的基础模型在疾病相关亚群体上可能仍然不可靠。

Abstract: Single-cell foundation models (scGPT, scBERT, Geneformer) achieve cell-type classification accuracy up to 97.5% in our experiments, yet this aggregate accuracy can mask systematic failure on rare, often disease-relevant cell populations that long-tail loss functions are widely assumed to address. We present a systematic benchmark of six long-tail loss functions (cross-entropy, weighted CE, class-balanced loss, focal loss, LDAM, logit-adjusted softmax) across three architectures and three datasets (Multiple Sclerosis, Zheng68K, human Pancreas), totaling 162 controlled training runs (3 backbones x 3 datasets x 6 losses x 3 seeds). The gap between overall accuracy, Macro-F1, and rare-class recall under plain cross-entropy is consistent across all nine (architecture, dataset) settings, driven by dataset structure rather than pretraining. Rare-class failure itself splits into two regimes with distinct embedding-geometry signatures, visible before any loss is chosen: some classes are recoverable by the right loss, while others retain linear separability yet are absorbed into unrelated classes' neighborhoods under every evaluated loss and architecture. Among the recoverable classes, the efficacy of reweighting is predicted by a class's absolute training-set size, rather than its share of the dataset or the dataset's overall imbalance ratio. Class-balanced loss and LDAM are the most consistent choices across all nine settings, while logit adjustment trades rare-class precision for recall rather than improving both. Our results give both a reusable benchmark and mechanism-grounded practical guidelines for combining foundation models with imbalanced biological data.

</details>


### [511] [What Can a Recurrent State Safely Forget?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23366)
*Linzhe Zhang,Changming Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了"预测纤维"（predictive fiber）的几何框架，刻画循环神经网络隐状态可安全遗忘的精确边界：可在预测纤维内收缩噪声，但沿未来区分方向必须保持恒等。通过预测商约束给出可修正方向的上界，并建立离散-连续边界。进一步提出基于部署子集W与审计全集U的可审计有限未来认证框架，利用有限随机展开给出PAC下界证书，其样本复杂度为Õ(MΩ^(-(k+2)))，并证明该极小极大下界是最优的。提出PF-CEGIS算法自适应扩展部署探针集。在MuJoCo、UCI HAR和数字流等实验上验证了认证边界与缩放规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环模型同时面临两个相互冲突的目标：保留改变未来行为的信息（记忆稳定性）与抑制隐藏状态噪声（数值稳定性）。全局收缩虽能抑制噪声，却可能沿未来区分方向破坏记忆。现有文献缺乏对"哪些方向可安全收缩"的明确安全准则，亟需一个可审计、可验证的形式化框架来区分可遗忘信息与必须保留信息。

Method: 1. 建立预测商空间S=H/~，两个隐藏状态预测等价当且仅当它们诱导相同的完整条件未来；等价类构成预测纤维F_s。2. 证明语义保持修正器Q在预测商上诱导恒等映射，在正则点（隐藏维d、预测维k）至多消除d-k个独立方向（定理2）。3. 证明离散-连续边界：离散预测态允许正半径精确修正盆地，预测连续统在有限维欧氏空间中不允许正半径精确解码器（定理3），并给出度量熵填充下界（定理4）。4. 构建审计认证框架：部署子集W⊆审计全集U，在预声明修正域D上定义审计间隔裕度Ω_{W|U}^D(δ)；通过锚点η-网和条件重置oracle进行有限随机展开，利用Hoeffding不等式和并集界给出PAC下界证书（定理8）。5. 证明样本复杂度上界Õ(MΩ^{-(k+2)})（定理10）及匹配的极小极大下界（定理11，局部化凸包构造+KL散度+Pinsker+Le Cam二点法）。6. 通过完备模ρ_U将有限审计保证延拓至完整连续未来。7. 提出PF-CEGIS算法，从固定完全采样的审计银行中迭代选择最具区分度的探针，直到ξ+2τ<Ω下界。8. 覆盖必要性命题12证明无重置的被动观测无法获得全域分布无关证书。9. 在DFA离散系统、模拟积分器、混合离散-连续系统、MuJoCo InvertedPendulum/DoublePendulum（GRU/LSTM/SSM）、UCI HAR（按受试者划分）和8×8数字流POMDP上进行实验验证。

Result: 几何基础验证：八态DFA硬快照误差0.187，显著优于未修正0.670和噪声训练软基线0.254；连续积分器纤维修正保持z轴使语义RMSE保持0.108（全局收缩升至0.574）；混合态模式精确恢复且z RMSE 0.118。统计认证：实验样本复杂度经验指数k=1时3.14、k=2时4.18，吻合理论k+2极小极大率；PF-CEGIS在仅增加探针数下将认证下界裕度从-0.055单调提升至0.066，同时校正器语义失真从0.267降至0.008；再锚定经验稳态误差与理论Hb/(1-κ)预测最大相对偏差0.000。物理动力学：MuJoCo InvertedPendulum在B=337500字面结果下获得下界裕度Ω=0.396，GRU/LSTM/SSM三种架构全部通过安全门ξ+2τ<Ω下界，PF接口失真≤8.33e-16、正常方向收缩0.220；PF-CEGIS将3探针接口（-0.202）扩展为9探针（0.398）；DoublePendulum在4D非线性下保持严格正裕度。真实数据：UCI HAR按受试者划分下PF保持6路活动头部精度约10^{-15}（全局收缩至少0.107）；数字流POMDP PF误差0.101±0.014，显著优于全局收缩0.863±0.003与稳定收缩基线0.121。离线成本：第四维充分调度需约10^{10}字面结果；InvertedPendulum审计84,375→337,500结果耗时10.8–44.3秒；PF-CEGIS后审计子集选择<0.2毫秒。

Conclusion: 预测商刻画了循环表征可安全遗忘的基本几何极限：收缩在预测纤维内是允许的，但沿未来区分坐标严格禁止。有限随机展开可在声明的审计族上给出统计认证的间隔裕度，样本复杂度匹配Lipschitz正则性下的最优极小极大速率。核心原则：循环模型仅可安全遗忘那些无法改变其未来的信息。基础性边界包括：离散预测码允许正半径盆地快照而预测连续统不允许；完备模ρ_U使有限审计保证可延拓至完整连续未来；被动观测无法获得全域分布无关证书（覆盖必要性）。PF-CEGIS提供以反例引导的原理化机制合成紧凑可认证部署接口。该框架为自主系统、机器人和序列决策提供透明、可审计、可解释的安全准则，但在实际部署中必须谨慎验证运营假设（探针覆盖、校准界限、域对齐），并明确区分主动生成认证与被动经验审计。

Abstract: Recurrent models must preserve information that changes future behavior while suppressing hidden-state error. These objectives conflict: contraction improves stability, but contraction along a future-distinguishing direction destroys memory. We formalize this boundary through the predictive quotient of a recurrent state space. Two hidden states are equivalent when they induce the same conditional future; their equivalence classes form predictive fibers. Every exact semantics-preserving corrector acts as the identity on this quotient. At a regular point with hidden dimension d and predictive dimension k, it can eliminate at most d - k independent directions. This establishes a discrete-continuous boundary: finite predictive states admit positive-radius exact correction basins, whereas an uncountable continuum of future-distinguishable states cannot be decoded after arbitrary positive-radius perturbations in finite-dimensional Euclidean space. To operationalize this principle, we develop an auditable finite-future framework. A compact deployment bank W is evaluated against an independent audit bank A (W subseteq A) on a declared correction domain. Under generative probe access and audit-metric coverage, finite stochastic rollouts furnish a high-probability certificate for the separation margin Omega_{W|A}(delta). Preserving learned W-predictions within this certified margin guarantees bounded audit-semantic distortion. For intrinsic audit dimension k, the required probe outcomes scale as O(M * Omega^{-(k+2)}), where M = |A|; a matching minimax lower bound proves this exponent is optimal. Extending guarantees to continuous futures is achieved via an explicit completeness modulus. Controlled experiments validate the certified margins, scaling laws, and automated probe refinement under a safety-first evaluation paradigm.

</details>


### [512] [The Evidence Ladder for Reinforcement Learning in Healthcare: From Retrospective Policies to Trusted Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23374)
*Yunfan Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"证据阶梯"框架,将医疗强化学习(RL)的评估与部署过程系统化为六个递进层级:问题形式化、回顾性识别、策略估计、压力测试、前瞻性评估和生命周期监测。该综述跨临床治疗、患者参与和医疗系统运营三大决策领域,揭示了"历史数据集上得分高"与"实际改善医疗"之间的鸿沟,并提出结构化"证据卡"报告规范以促进累积性评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医疗RL综述多按算法或临床应用分类,但该领域面临的核心问题是:从历史数据中学习到的策略如何获得可信医疗干预所需的证据?大多数报告的进展仍远离常规临床干预,而对历史奖励的优化并不等于对真实医疗的改善。因此,亟需一个以证据需求为中心的统一框架,跨越临床治疗、患者参与和医疗系统运营三大决策领域。

Method: 采用目标导向的叙述性综述方法(narrative review):以先前的医疗RL综述和指南为核心,沿其基础性和代表性应用参考文献追溯至2025年。优先纳入关于临床策略学习、离线评估、自适应干预、安全性、公平性和部署的同行评审工作。该综述提出"证据阶梯"(Evidence Ladder)作为组织框架,包含六个递进层级,并提出配套的"证据卡"(Evidence Card)报告标准。还分析了策略泛化(与预测泛化的区别)、奖励规范的规范性瓶颈、跨环境迁移性等跨领域模式。

Result: 1. 提出六层证据阶梯框架,明确各层核心问题、典型证据及失败模式;2. 识别出"回溯性成功丰富但干预证据贫乏"的领域现状——急症护理提供临床意义强的结果、数字干预提供实验变异、运营研究提供显式资源约束,但三者优势未能融合;3. 揭示奖励规范既是经验问题也是规范性瓶颈,复合奖励的权重嵌入价值判断;4. 指出策略泛化(policy generalization)比预测泛化更困难,因为策略改变后访问的状态分布也随之变化;5. 提出证据卡应包含决策上下文、目标与约束、数据来源与识别、策略学习与比较、评估与不确定性、稳健性/公平性/失败分析、前瞻性状态与治理七个维度。

Conclusion: RL与医疗的时序结构天然契合,但从历史数据到有益干预的路径远长于一个优化流水线。证据阶梯框架补充了现有算法中心和应用中心的综述,围绕"每个阶段能证明什么"组织该领域。最重要的前沿不是更高的估计回报,而是建立连接临床有意义问题、可识别比较、可靠评估、稳健行为、前瞻性收益和负责任监测的累积证据链。未来研究应在基准测试中纳入行为策略信息和时间/站点划分,将决策质量与工作流结果挂钩,并使负面证据也可累积。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) offers a natural language for healthcare decisions whose conse- quences unfold over time, yet most reported progress remains far from routine intervention. Ex- isting surveys organize the field by algorithm or clinical application. We instead review healthcare RL through an evidence ladder: problem formulation, retrospective identification, policy estima- tion, stress testing, prospective evaluation, and lifecycle monitoring. This view connects clinical treatment, patient engagement, and health-system operations while exposing a recurring gap: evi- dence that a policy scores well in a historical dataset is not evidence that it will improve care. We synthesize the assumptions and failure modes at each rung, identify what evidence can and can- not transfer across settings, and propose reporting practices for cumulative evaluation. Restless bandits are included as one special case, not as the organizing framework. The central lesson is that healthcare RL should be evaluated as an intervention embedded in a changing sociotechnical system, rather than only as an optimizer of a retrospective reward.

</details>


### [513] [Tool-Augmented On-Policy Distillation for LLM Domain Adaptation in Sequence-Based Omics Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23435)
*Jie Ying,Zhefan Wang,Zihong Chen,Zhengqing Li,Jinzhe Li,Gang Li,Jian Liu,Fang Hu,Tao Luo,Zhonghang Yuan,Wanli Ouyang,Stan Z. Li,Fan Yang,Nanqing Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出OmicsBench（首个多组学序列推理基准，含1,160个专家验证问题，涵盖6项任务）与TA-OPD（工具增强的在线策略蒸馏后训练方法），揭示科学LLM存在"推理退化"现象（高分类精度但无法提供有效生物学证据），并通过蒸馏生物医学智能体的工具证据来同时提升预测准确性与证据基础推理能力，在Qwen3.5系列（0.8B–27B）上一致改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM在多组学序列任务上的评测仅依赖分类/回归等结果指标，无法判断其是否真正掌握支撑预测的生物学证据；主流"长序列到短文本"训练范式鼓励模型记忆映射而非学习机制，导致潜在的"捷径学习"问题。

Method: 1) OmicsBench构建：从Biology-Instructions筛选序列，经核心集选择与分层采样得到5,537候选问题；采用基于Biomni的智能体合成框架（Bio-Agent + Verifier + Summarizer）自动生成可追溯推理链；通过机器检查与三位专家评审两级验证筛选1,160题；采用"Define-Decompose-Scale-Verify"流程构建包含3,745维度、11,392条原子证据的实例特定评分量表；引入Rubric Recall（RR）指标。2) TA-OPD：在OPSD基础上，将工具增强的生物医学智能体（BLAST、ViennaRNA、JASPAR、PubMed等）产生的答案与生物学证据作为教师端的特权信息，通过token级log-ratio估计器计算蒸馏信号，仅更新学生权重，应用于五个尺寸的Qwen3.5模型。

Result: 评估17个LLM揭示：科学LLM在常规指标上往往最优（如ChatNT在EMP达86.86% MCC），但RR极低（ChatNT的RR为0%）；科学LLM与通用LLM在RR与预测排名上的Pearr相关分别为r=-0.29与r=+0.26；科学LLM平均仅生成47 token，而通用LLM为857 token。TA-OPD在0.8B–27B全部规模上一致提升Avg Recall（0.8B: +0.14pp至27B: +16.02pp），并在9B/27B上六项任务的平均预测分数均提升；TA-OPD-27B在五项任务上超越未适配的Qwen3.5-397B参考模型。

Conclusion: OmicsBench为多组学LLM推理评估提供可扩展蓝图与诊断工具，揭示科学LLM"推理退化"现象；TA-OPD作为后训练方法可在不增加推理时工具依赖的前提下，将生物医学智能体的证据推理能力蒸馏到LLM中，同时提升预测准确性与证据覆盖率，挑战纯规模扩展路径，为训练更具解释力的科学LLM提供方向。

Abstract: Multi-omics sequences contain complex biological patterns, yet deciphering their mechanisms for automated scientific discovery remains challenging. As large language models (LLMs) interpret these sequences, evaluating both predictions and scientific reasoning is critical. However, existing benchmarks for multi-omics sequence tasks rely on classification and regression metrics, neglecting whether models grasp the underlying biological evidence. We introduce OmicsBench, the first reasoning benchmark for multi-omics sequences, comprising 1,160 expert-validated questions across six tasks spanning DNA regulation, RNA processing, and protein function. OmicsBench requires traceable evidence chains, evaluated using instance-specific rubrics developed with domain experts. Evaluating 17 LLMs reveals an inverse relationship: while scientific LLMs outperform general-purpose LLMs in sequence classification accuracy, they fail to provide valid evidence to support their predictions. One plausible interpretation is shortcut learning: specialized models may rely on statistical patterns rather than the biological mechanisms needed for scientific discovery. Motivated by this finding, we introduce tool-augmented on-policy distillation (TA-OPD), a post-training method to align sequence prediction with evidence-grounded biological reasoning. Across five Qwen3.5 models spanning 0.8B to 27B parameters, TA-OPD consistently strengthens biological evidence grounding while improving predictive performance on most tasks. These gains persist across model scales, indicating that stronger sequence reasoning does not arise solely from increased model capacity, but can be improved through evidence-aware training. Together, OmicsBench and TA-OPD provide a framework for diagnosing reasoning failures in multi-omics LLMs and a path toward models whose predictions are better grounded in biologically meaningful evidence.

</details>


### [514] [TRACE: Tractable Routing Autoencoder for Clinical ECG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23460)
*Shunbo Jia,Runze Ma,Haonan Lyu,Haijin Zhang,Qiang Yang,Caizhi Liao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TRACE是一个针对临床心电图(ECG)诊断的可解释自编码器，通过将32维临床潜空间预先划分为灌注(perfusion)、结构(structure)、传导(conduction)三个子空间，并采用硬路由策略将每个诊断头连接到指定的子空间。该模型在PTB-XL和Georgia数据集上以约八分之一的参数量超越了无约束分类器和ECG基础模型，并通过探测(probe)、擦除(erasure)和扰动(perturbation)三重分析证明了路由契约的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习在ECG诊断中取得了显著进展，但当前最准确的模型（如在数百万记录上预训练的基础模型）缺乏决策路径可审计性：临床医生无法追溯某个诊断到具体的生理通路，也无法干预特定通路。TRACE旨在解决这一透明性问题，通过将临床领域知识预先编码到模型架构中，而非依赖优化发现。

Method: TRACE采用知识驱动的结构化自编码器架构：(1)感知主干为1D残差网络，提取全局时序特征h；(2)通过摊销变分推断获得128维患者级表征U_sys；(3)临床潜空间Z_1(32维)被预定义为三个子空间——灌注(16维)、结构(8维)、传导(8维)；(4)各诊断头硬路由至其指定子空间，无梯度路径连接非指定子空间；(5)正交性惩罚R_topo减少子空间间互信息；(6)电生理分解：去极化与复极化双通路合成QRS与ST-T波形；(7)解码器重构ECG信号，允许潜空间扰动。训练目标包含重构损失、KL散度、任务损失和拓扑正交惩罚。

Result: 在PTB-XL数据集上，TRACE达到91.97% macro AUC和72.59% macro F1，超过ECGFounder(91.43/71.23)且参数量仅为其八分之一；在Georgia数据集上达到87.31% AUC和67.40% F1；在CPSC2018(无结构类)上通过将结构子空间替换为节律子空间，框架以仅重新指定路由表的方式成功迁移。路由契约验证显示：每个子空间对其目标标签的探测AUC超过90%(如Z_cond→LBBB达99.95%)，擦除实验证实零化对应子空间后目标头坍缩至50%随机水平。容量匹配的置换控制表明：任意路由分配在AUC上与本体路由相差不超过0.34点，macro F1统计上无显著差异(p=0.619)。重构保真度Pearson r=0.905。扰动去极化通路使QRS能量变化-0.9%±3.1%，复极化通路扰动使ST-T能量变化+7.7%±1.3%。在电极噪声和导联掩码条件下展现出良好鲁棒性。

Conclusion: TRACE证明了临床知识可以被预先编码进模型架构中而非仅通过优化发现，其核心论点是程序性的：在可靠的领域知识存在但学习所需监督不存在时，可将该知识指定进模型骨架并显式验证。路由级透明度源于架构构造，而表征级证据则需通过探测、擦除与扰动分析的联合验证。该方法为ECG诊断提供了一种可审计的、决策路径可追溯的深度学习范式，下一步工作将聚焦于从子空间语义扩展到特征级因果解释。

Abstract: Deep learning has advanced automated electrocardiogram (ECG) diagnosis, but the field's most accurate models, foundation models pretrained on millions of recordings, are not decision-pathway auditable: a clinician cannot trace a diagnosis to a physiological pathway or intervene on one. We propose TRACE, a Tractable Routing Autoencoder for Clinical ECG, whose 32-dimensional clinical latent space is specified in advance from domain knowledge rather than discovered by optimization. TRACE partitions this space into perfusion, structure, and conduction subspaces, routes each to its own diagnostic head by design, regularizes the partition with an orthogonality penalty, and reconstructs the ECG through a decoder that permits latent perturbation. On PTB-XL and Georgia, TRACE exceeds unconstrained classifiers and stays ahead of an ECG foundation model pretrained on ten million recordings, evaluated by linear probe on frozen features, at roughly an eighth of the parameter count. On the nine-label CPSC2018 cohort, which carries no structural class, the framework transfers with only the routing table re-specified to a perfusion/rhythm/conduction partition. Joint probe, erasure, and perturbation analyses verify the routing contract, and perturbing the depolarization and repolarization pathways modulates the reconstructed waveform. Removing the specified partition and its orthogonality penalty costs 1.70 AUC and 11.30 macro-F1 points on PTB-XL, and 2.76 AUC and 16.92 macro-F1 points on Georgia. A capacity-matched permutation control places arbitrary assignments within 0.34 AUC points of the ontology routing and leaves macro-F1 statistically level (p=0.619): the ontology supplies decision-pathway auditability at no macro-F1 cost.

</details>


### [515] [ITSY: Causal Discovery From Irregular Time-Series Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23516)
*Wenbo Xu,Yue He,Yunhai Wang,Yueguo Chen,Kun Kuang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 ITSY，一种基于连续优化的方法，用于从不规则（缺失值）时间序列数据中联合恢复因果图（即同时学习即时效应与滞后效应）和填补缺失值。其核心思想是在一阶线性 SVAR 模型下，将结构方程改写为依赖"最近可用历史"而非可能缺失的当前切片的形式，并通过加权重建目标修正由此产生的噪声变换。在合成数据和半合成 fMRI 基准上均稳定优于代表性 SCM 因果发现基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于结构因果模型（SCM）的时间序列因果发现方法（如 DYNOTEARS、NTS-NOTEARS、Rhino 等）通常假设时间序列在完整观测窗口下均匀采样；而现实场景中传感器故障、异步采集、传输丢失等会导致数据缺失（不规则采样）。直接删除或使用通用插补方法填补缺失值会破坏结构性残差，使即时图与滞后图的估计产生偏差。作者通过一个玩具示例（DYNOTEARS 在逐步缺失下产生伪边、漏边）系统刻画了这种模型误设问题。

Method: 1. 模型设定：一阶线性 SVAR，X(t) = A X(t) + B X(t−1) + e(t)，A 为即时权重矩阵（需 DAG），B 为滞后权重矩阵；缺数据使用掩码矩阵 M 表示。
2. SVAR 重写：由 (I−A) 可逆（DAG 的邻接矩阵幂零）得到转移算子 P_θ = (I−A)^{-1} B；预测形式由 X̂(t) = P_θ X(t−i)（i 为到最近观测的距离），即跨缺失步重复施加同一因果转移。
3. 联合补全与图学习：通过前向扫描 X̃_θ(t) = M(t)⊙X(t) + (1−M(t))⊙X̂_θ(t)，缺失值由所学机制隐式生成而非独立插补；梯度同时通过补全值反传。
4. 加权最小二乘（WLS）：因重写后残差变为 u(t) = (I−A)^{-1} e(t)，协方差不再是各向同性；用 (I−A) 加权残差可恢复原噪声结构，使 OLS 在新形式下仍为 BLUE。
5. 总目标：加权重建损失 + ℓ1 稀疏惩罚（A 与 B）+ NOTEARS 增广 Lagrangian DAG 约束（A）。使用 L-BFGS-B 求解。
6. 计算复杂度：单次扫描 O(d³ + Tnd²) 时间、O(Tnd) 内存；假设包括因果充分性、因果平稳性、MCAR 缺失。

Result: 在合成数据（Erdős–Rényi 图、d∈{5,10,15}、缺失率 0–70%、高斯噪声、稀疏与稠密图）上，ITSY 在 F1 和 SHD 两项指标上均稳定优于 DYNOTEARS、NTS-NOTEARS、Rhino、PCMCI+ 等 SCM 基线；在完整观测下与最优基线相当，缺失率上升时优势扩大。在半合成 fMRI 基准（5/10 脑区）上，ITSY 取得最高 F1（0.62/0.58/0.61/0.48），SHD 接近最佳基线 PCMCI+；缺失率与变量维度增大时仍保持鲁棒。复杂度随缺失率线性增长，无组合爆炸。

Conclusion: ITSY 为线性一阶 SVAR 在不规则采样下提供了一个聚焦、可证明的因果发现方案：机制级耦合补全与图学习、加权重建纠正噪声变换。该方法在合成和半合成实验中一致改善图恢复，明确了适用边界（线性、一阶、平稳、因果充分、MCAR）。未来工作将扩展到非线性机制、高阶 SVAR 以及 MAR/MNAR 缺失过程与潜变量情形。

Abstract: Structural causal models for time series recover contemporaneous and lagged effects, but most methods require complete observation windows and become misspecified when samples are missing. We introduce ITSY, the first continuous-optimization method for causal discovery from irregular time series under a linear model. ITSY reformulates the structural equation so that prediction uses the nearest available history rather than the possibly missing current slice, and jointly imputes missing values while learning both graphs. A weighted reconstruction objective corrects the noise transformation induced by this reformulation. Across synthetic regimes varying missingness, scale, graph density, and noise, and on a real world benchmark, ITSY consistently improves graph recovery over representative SCM-based baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed method. The results establish a focused solution for irregular linear first-order dynamics and clarify the assumptions required for nonlinear or higher-order extensions.

</details>


### [516] [Feature Suppression and Differential Privacy for Residential Traffic Classification: A Two-Home Federated Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23521)
*Márton Pál Lipcsey-Magyar,Adrian Pekar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在模拟两客户端联邦学习场景下，比较特征抑制（FS）与差分隐私随机梯度下降（DP-SGD）在住宅流量分类中的效用与隐私权衡。基于两户家庭网关采集的162万条流记录，研究发现FS-mild（去除4个时序特征）在所有种子和模型容量下均优于固定配置的DP-SGD，但成员推断攻击未能有效区分各配置，FS并非形式化隐私机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 住宅流量分类需跨家庭协作学习，但面临数据异质性和隐私约束。隐私感知训练对不同流量类别可能产生不均衡的效用损失，尤其是少数类别。该研究旨在量化特征抑制与差分隐私在小型非IID联邦中的运营成本权衡，为服务运营商提供部署指导。

Method: 使用两台OpenWrt网关的nDPI流量采集数据，构建两客户端FedAvg联邦学习。比较三种主配置：全特征基线FL、FS-mild（去除4个PIAT特征，16→12输入）、DP-SGD（Opacus实现，ε=8，C=1.0，记录级隐私）。评估指标包括macro-F1、最差类别F1（worst-group F1），采用分层和时间划分、5个种子、两种MLP容量（小[16,16]/中[128,64]）。辅以FS-aggressive、等权聚合、FedDPA适配和基于损失/阴影模型的成员推断攻击探测。

Result: FS-mild在所有5个种子、两种模型容量、分层与时间划分下，组合macro-F1和最差组F1均优于测试的DP-SGD配置（配对95%CI排除零）。DP-SGD在Home B少数类别（Media、SocialNetwork）损失严重，worst-group F1接近零。FS-mild相较全特征基线并非一致改善。成员推断攻击在三种主配置上聚合AUC均接近随机（.500–.503），低FPR结果方向不一致。DP-SGD运行时约为FS-mild的3.4倍。

Conclusion: FS-mild作为输入最小化基线具有实用价值，但FS不提供形式化隐私保证，不能替代差分隐私。DP-SGD的效用成本是类别依赖的，对少数类别尤为严重。成员推断探测结果有限，不能证明隐私等价。研究局限在于两户家庭、固定DP配置、无DP调优、非IID专用聚合器评估。

Abstract: Residential traffic classification supports service management, but learning across homes must account for heterogeneous traffic and privacy constraints. Privacy-aware training may impose uneven costs across traffic categories. We study this tradeoff in simulated two-client federated learning using 1.62 million preprocessed gateway-collected flows across six categories. We compare a full-feature baseline, feature suppression (FS), and differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) under one fixed record-level privacy setting. FS-mild excludes four timing features from 16 model inputs; it provides no formal privacy guarantee. With size-proportional aggregation, FS-mild achieves higher combined macro-F1 and worst-group F1 (the minimum per-class F1 across homes) than DP-SGD in all five seeds at both model capacities under stratified and temporal splits. The tested DP-SGD configuration incurs pronounced minority-category losses, especially in the smaller home, but FS-mild does not uniformly improve on the full-feature baseline. On stratified-split models, loss-based and shadow-model membership probes show near-chance aggregate discrimination without a consistent ranking across probes; this does not establish equivalent privacy. These findings support FS as an input-minimization baseline, not a substitute for formal privacy.

</details>


### [517] [Decoupled Causal Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23535)
*Zhengkang Guan,Fei Wu,Kun Kuang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出解耦因果发现(DCD)，一种通过加权函数解耦非目标变量分布来直接识别马尔可夫边界(MB)的新框架，并基于MB构建CPDAG。该方法独立于条件独立性检验、结构评分和函数因果模型三大经典范式，在噪声鲁棒性方面表现尤为突出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果发现方法主要依赖条件独立性检验(CIT)、结构评分或限制性函数假设，在复杂观测数据场景下面临挑战。尤其是在高噪声条件下，许多代表性基线方法性能急剧下降，亟需一种不依赖这些传统范式的新视角来提升因果发现的鲁棒性。

Method: 1) **MB可识别性理论**：定义加权函数和解耦分布(DCD)，证明在解耦分布下，变量与目标变量的依赖关系当且仅当其属于MB(定理1)；2) **全局CPDAG构建(DCD-C算法)**：利用MB中邻居与配偶的结构不对称性，通过迭代子集遍历区分真邻居与配偶，构建骨架并识别v-结构，再结合Meek规则完成定向；3) **实用估计**：用softmax参数化样本权重，通过最小化加权HSIC实现解耦，再以加权Pearson相关性检验完成MB识别。

Result: 在功能机制和MLP机制下，跨图规模d∈{5,10,20}，DCD在几乎所有设置下取得最低SHD_c和最佳Recall/F1分数；在噪声标准差从0.1增至5.0的实验中，DCD在高噪声下F1保持约0.4，而基线方法接近零；在Scale-Free图和样本效率方面亦全面优于PC、GES、ICALiNGAM、DirectLiNGAM、NOTEARS、GraNDAG、GOLEM等基线。

Conclusion: DCD作为一种正交于CIT、结构评分和FCM假设的解耦范式，扩展了因果发现的方法论边界。其理论保证了MB的可识别性以及DCD-C算法在CPDAG恢复上的健全性与完备性。未来工作包括改进高维场景下的解耦权重学习、与CIT策略结合以及探索解耦权重学习与噪声水平的关系。

Abstract: Causal discovery from observational data is a fundamental yet challenging task in scientific research. While existing approaches are primarily based on conditional independence tests, structure scores, or restrictive functional assumptions, we propose Decoupled Causal Discovery (DCD), a novel decoupling-based perspective that does not rely on these methodologies. DCD directly identifies the Markov boundary (MB) by decoupling non-target variables via weighting functions, such that only variables within the MB preserve dependence with the target under the decoupled distribution. Building on this, DCD iteratively constructs the Completed Partially Directed Acyclic Graph (CPDAG) by exploiting structural asymmetries within the MBs. We establish the theoretical identifiability, soundness, and completeness of DCD. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that DCD achieves strong performance, particularly excelling in challenging noise regimes.

</details>


### [518] [Preserving Geometric Integrity in Graph Prompting via Measure-Constrained Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23547)
*Xiangyu Wang,Shuo Wang,Ruiyi Fang,Zhao Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MINT框架，通过固定边际熵正则化最优传输解决图提示学习中节点到提示分配在全图范围内的集中问题，并辅以k-NN拓扑增强分支处理结构失配。理论贡献包括精确方差分解和冻结编码器的前向稳定性界。在引用网络和异质图上的少样本实验中具有竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着图提示路由变得日益节点自适应，独立的局部决策可能在共享提示库上聚集分配质量，即使单个节点-提示匹配在局部有意义。作者将这种图范围内的分配集中视为与局部相关性正交的设计维度，区别于表示崩溃和离散路由优化难题。

Method: MINT将节点到提示的适配构建为熵正则化最优传输问题：传输代价偏好局部几何兼容性，预设的提示端边际显式控制图范围内的提示利用率（默认采用均匀边际ν=1/M·1_M），通过20次Sinkhorn迭代实现可微路由。辅以基于特征的k-NN动态加权拓扑增强分支修改传播图。二者通过不同对象协作：OT控制提示空间分配，拓扑增强修改节点间传播。理论方面给出了精确方差分解V_P(ρ)=V_{ΔX_P}+(1/N)∑∑R_ij‖p_j-Δx_{P,i}‖²、协方差集集中界，以及冻结编码器映射的前向稳定性界‖F_θ(X+αΔX_P,G')-F_θ(X+α1_Np_{j*}⊤,G')‖_F≤L_F|α|·diam(P)·√(1-ρ_{j*})。

Result: 在Cora/CiteSeer/PubMed同质网络及Cornell/Texas/Wisconsin/Chameleon/Squirrel/Actor异质网络上，使用GraphMAE、GraphMAE2和MaskGAE三个预训练骨干进行1/3/5-shot节点分类实验，30次试验。在Texas/Wisconsin等异质图上取得最大提升；拓扑增强在异质图上效果显著但在同质图上几乎无影响。移除OT在Cora 1-shot下降21.54个百分点，在Cora/Texas/Wisconsin上移除k-NN分支分别下降2.45/0.20（变化）/30.23/39.85个百分点。在极端扰动（噪声边、边丢弃、特征掩码）下保持稳定。在OGBN-Arxiv（169,343节点）上具有计算可行性（11.066 GiB峰值内存，0.201–0.234 s/epoch）。

Conclusion: 该工作将图范围内的提示利用率确立为图提示学习的一个独立设计维度。MINT通过固定边际OT将节点-提示分配全局耦合，同时通过独立的拓扑增强分支处理结构失配，二者表现出互补的、依赖图机制的贡献。精确方差分解刻画了提示诱导的特征更新，条件前向分析在单提示集中下限定了冻结编码器偏差。实验表明在少样本适配中具有竞争力，固定边际路由在引用网络设置上具有可测量的端到端效应，拓扑增强具有互补的、依赖图的效应。这些结果促使在提示库和实例条件路由日益丰富的背景下，将图范围内的提示利用率与局部相关性一并考虑。

Abstract: Graph prompt learning enables parameter-efficient adaptation of frozen Graph Neural Networks to downstream tasks through lightweight prompt parameters. As routing becomes increasingly node-adaptive, however, independently optimized local decisions can collectively concentrate assignment mass on a small subset of a finite shared prompt bank, even when individual node--prompt matches remain locally meaningful. We propose MINT (Measure-INtegrity Transport), an entropically regularized optimal transport framework that formulates node-to-prompt adaptation as a globally coupled allocation problem. The transport cost favors local geometric compatibility, while a prescribed prompt-side marginal explicitly controls graph-wide prompt utilization. We further derive an exact variance decomposition that separates prompt-side geometric variance into retained prompt-update variation and within-node barycentric dispersion, together with a conditional stability bound for the frozen-encoder forward map. Across standard citation networks and additional heterophilic graphs, MINT remains competitive in few-shot adaptation. Controlled and end-to-end experiments further distinguish the roles of routing and topology: fixed-marginal routing controls graph-wide prompt utilization and has measurable end-to-end effects on citation networks, while topology augmentation provides a complementary, graph-dependent mechanism for addressing structural mismatch. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [519] [Global Ranks Survive, Selected Heads Shift: BOS-Sink Topology under 4-bit Weight-Only Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23585)
*Kuanlin Chen,Chen-Wei Kuo,Cheng-En Ou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究 4-bit NF4 权重量化对小语言模型 BOS-sink（首词元注意力汇）拓扑结构的影响。提出 Sink Topology Consistency (STC) 指标族，在三个小模型上发现：全局排序（Spearman ρ≥0.980）可迁移，但离散 top-k 集合仅有 76.5–88.5% 成员保留率；Qwen 终端层存在 6.2–7.9× 模型均值的局部漂移；跨域校准比精度变化更影响 overlap。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘部署中常先在工作站识别 sink-aware 推理所需的 BOS-sink head 映射，再量化压缩后在边缘端复用。这一"捷径"在 4-bit NF4 权重量化下是否仍安全，是工程上未经验证的问题。量化引入的非均匀权重舍入误差叠加 softmax 非线性，可能改变 head 是否跨越 sink 主导阈值，理论上是开放的实证问题。

Method: 1) 操作定义：token 索引 0 处的 sink score s_{l,h}(x)，跨样本取均值；2) STC 指标族分为 Sample-STC（逐输入敏感性：Jaccard、Spearman、JS 层移）和 Cal-STC（校准图迁移）；3) 量化协议：bitsandbytes NF4 + fp16 计算，eager attention，前向钩子仅累积 BOS 列避免 OOM；4) 模型：Qwen2.5-0.5B/1.5B、Llama-3.2-1B（k=34/34/52，占总 head 槽 10%）；5) 数据：C4 500 样本×多种上下文长度，LongBench v1 multifieldqa_en 75 样本作跨域探针；6) Jetson Orin NX 8GB 部署验证。

Result: Qwen2.5-0.5B/1.5B/Llama-3.2-1B 在 4096 tokens 下 Cal-STC-Rank 分别为 0.980/0.990/0.983，但 Cal-STC-Set@k 仅 0.619/0.789/0.793（Jaccard，远高于 0.053 零基线）。Qwen 终端层出现尖峰：Qwen2.5-0.5B layer 22（JS=0.276，ρ_s=0.033，几近秩崩塌），Qwen2.5-1.5B layer 27（JS=0.234）；Llama-3.2-1B 则均匀低漂移。C4→LongBench 跨域对比：Qwen 两个模型的语料对比（+0.212/+0.529）大于精度对比（+0.099/0），Llama-3.2-1B 则相反。全量 4-bit 重校准在 n=8（Qwen）或 n=32（Llama）即达 split-half 稳定平台 90%，但仅更新高移层永远达不到该阈值。Jetson 上 Qwen2.5-0.5B 和 Llama-3.2-1B 的 16 样本重校准分别耗时 2.9s/5.7s；Qwen2.5-1.5B 因 arm64 兼容性问题 on-device 测量无效。

Conclusion: 4-bit NF4 保留全局连续排序（ρ_s≥0.980），但离散 top-k 集、层局部策略和跨域校准都需在部署精度下重新验证。Qwen 终端层存在被全局统计掩盖的局部失效，量化后这些层的 sink 排序几乎无信息量。三个模型无法区分架构族与规模效应；STC 度量拓扑而非任务精度，结论限于 bitsandbytes NF4 单精度对比（fp16 计算 vs bf16 基线）。

Abstract: Sink-aware deployment may identify important first-token attention heads before a model is quantized, then reuse that map at the edge. We test when this shortcut is safe for 4-bit NF4 weight-only post-training quantization (PTQ). Our Sink Topology Consistency (STC) metrics separate global rank preservation, top-$k$ set overlap, and layerwise sink-mass shift, and distinguish per-input sensitivity from calibration-map transfer. Across Qwen2.5-0.5B, Qwen2.5-1.5B, and Llama-3.2-1B, global bf16-to-4-bit ranks remain high at 4,096 tokens ($\rho_s \geq 0.980$), yet top-$k$ Jaccard overlap is only 0.619-0.793, corresponding to 76.5-88.5% membership retention. The global statistic also masks local failures: terminal Qwen layers shift by 6.2-7.9x their model means, whereas Llama-3.2-1B shows low, nearly uniform drift. Under a C4-to-LongBench shift, cross-domain overlap degrades more than the within-domain precision comparison for both Qwen models, but not for Llama-3.2-1B. Matched-domain 4-bit recalibration reaches 90% of a split-half stability plateau at the smallest tested $n=8$ for both Qwen models and $n=32$ for Llama-3.2-1B, though not as a sharp threshold; for the two Qwen models, updating only selected layers does not reach the full-map stability criterion. On Jetson Orin NX, the 16-sample workload takes seconds for the two models with valid on-device sink measurements. The practical message is precise: global rankings often transfer, but discrete head sets, layer-local policies, and cross-domain calibration should be revalidated after quantization.

</details>


### [520] [Bilinear Optimization Divergence: Diagnosing Factor-Constrained LoRA Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23594)
*YongShun Wang,JianLin Su,Yong Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Bilinear Optimization Divergence (BOD) 作为LoRA持续学习中因子约束有效性的诊断工具，区分共享适配器与累积块两种参数化形式下应施加的约束类型，并提出SFOR与硬保护两种架构条件化的干预方法以及Weight Residual Projection (WRP) 后处理机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA因子上的正交约束在有限优化步后是否真正保护了组合更新尚不明确；不同参数化形式（共享适配器 vs 累积块）对应的锚点状态不同，因此需要架构条件化的约束选择规则来避免错误的保护假设。

Method: 形式化BOD作为锚点相对的历史特征响应诊断指标ρ_BOD；推导共享适配器中学习锚点留有伴生因子路径ΔB·A₀·V_core，累积O-LoRA块中零输出初始化允许可行状态约束；提出SFOR（冻结B+梯度投影+WRP）、O-LoRA硬保护（任务起始回缩+梯度投影+WRP）以及作用于优化器后实际位移的WRP；Qwen3-8B/Mistral-7B上进行二任务轨迹与四任务持续学习基准验证。

Result: 双任务轨迹中ρ_BOD从Projected-LoRA的19.12%和O-LoRA的7.72%降至SFOR的0.005%和硬保护的0.002%；Qwen3-8B四任务三序平均下SFOR将BWT从-2.47改善至-0.86且AA基本不变（80.45 vs 80.38），硬保护将AA从80.27%提升至81.30%、FM从2.20降至0.43；Mistral-7B Order-1上SFOR较Projected-LoRA AA提升6.63点；WRP与Freeze-B作为互补组件；更严格的可行性约束并不必然改善最终任务表现。

Conclusion: BOD将因子级约束与组合更新级约束之间的差距形式化；约束选择取决于锚点状态——学习锚点要求控制伴生因子路径，零输出新块允许可行状态初始化；SFOR与硬保护分别在两种架构下实现对应条件，WRP统一执行实际优化器位移的可行性保证；研究将约束执行问题与任务效用问题分离，提供了架构条件化的持续学习LoRA设计指南。

Abstract: Orthogonality in a LoRA factor does not by itself specify what the composed update protects: the answer depends on the task-start state, the parameterization, and the realized optimizer displacement. We formalize this question through Bilinear Optimization Divergence (BOD), an anchor-relative diagnostic of effective-update response on selected historical features. The finite-step analysis distinguishes two cases. In a shared adapter, protecting the routing displacement leaves a learned-anchor residual through the changing companion factor. In a fresh zero-output block, a feasible routing state can protect the composed update while both current factors remain trainable. These conditions yield Semi-Frozen Orthogonal Routing (SFOR) for shared adapters and current-block hard protection for cumulative O-LoRA; Weight Residual Projection (WRP) enforces the required displacement after the optimizer step. Controlled two-task traces verify the predicted residual paths, reducing normalized historical response from 19.12% to 0.005% in the shared family and from 7.72% to 0.002% in the cumulative family. Four-task experiments on Qwen3-8B characterize the resulting trade-offs: SFOR improves backward transfer (BWT) from -2.47 to -0.86 with nearly unchanged average accuracy (AA), while O-LoRA hard protection improves three-order mean AA from 80.27% to 81.30% and forgetting measure (FM) from 2.20 to 0.43. Component controls also show that stricter feasibility need not improve final task performance. Together, the analysis and evidence provide an architecture-conditioned account of which constraint to enforce, how to enforce it, and how to interpret its empirical value.

</details>


### [521] [ETH-TraceBench: A Large-Scale Event-Stream Benchmark for Ethereum DeFi under Temporal, Protocol, and Contract Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23659)
*Kemal Kirtac,Carsten Maple*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ETH-TraceBench是一个大规模以太坊DeFi事件流基准测试，旨在评估在时间、协议、池/基础设施和符号偏移下的表示学习可靠性。该基准覆盖2021-2025年的13.5亿笔交易和50.1亿条原始日志记录，强调协议迁移和受控输入条件作为核心评估目标，而非单一聚合时间分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以太坊DeFi提供了公共的、可观察的交易级事件流，但相同的公共符号也会造成强大的机器学习捷径。模型在常规未来时段测试中表现优异，但面对新的协议机制或符号结构时可能很脆弱。这与现实世界偏移和捷径学习的更广泛文献相关。论文旨在构建一个基准，明确将分布偏移作为评估对象，揭示高聚合分数可能掩盖真实的表示学习失败。

Method: 核心方法包括：(1) 基于以太坊主网2021年1月至2025年12月的原始日志构建账本规模基准；(2) DEX交易分类和清算检测两个任务；(3) 五种评估设置：时间测试、协议迁移、池留存、符号新颖性、发射器/主题掩码；(4) 固定时间分区（训练2021-2024，验证2025H1，测试2025H2）；(5) 多种基线模型（TraceStats-GB、TopicEmitterTrace-SGD、TopicEmitterHashMLP、有序/乱序Transformer）；(6) 配对交易自助法不确定性估计；(7) 400笔交易的确定性源一致性和事件签名审计。

Result: 关键发现：(1) 简单模型在时间测试上表现强劲，TopicEmitterHashMLP在DEX测试集上达到0.959宏F1；(2) 严格未见过协议下宏F1显著下降至0.794、0.743、0.766；(3) 严格未见过池性能保持在0.927、0.897、0.935，表明协议新颖性比池新颖性更难；(4) Uniswap v4和Ekubo v1明显比完整测试更难；(5) 单独掩码发射器合约身份不降低DEX性能，联合掩码发射器和主题身份将DEX宏F1降至0.916，清算宏F1降至0.774；(6) 有序Transformer相比相同事件的乱序版本没有一致优势，表明高分数主要反映事件组成和符号结构而非复杂时序建模；(7) 400/400源一致性和原始日志存在性审计通过。

Conclusion: ETH-TraceBench提供了一个账本规模的以太坊DeFi原始日志事件流基准，在时间和基础设施变化下进行评估。基准难度由硬迁移条件决定，而非仅由聚合时间分数决定。简单模型在规范时间测试上表现非常强，但严格未见过协议评估产生大幅退化，而严格未见过池评估则容易得多。捷径控制实验表明，发射器合约单独掩码不降低DEX性能，而联合移除发射器和主题身份会导致有意义的损失并严重降低清算性能。标准有序Transformer相对相同保留事件的确定性乱序不提供一致优势。基准主要贡献是评估目标和协议，用于区分高分布内可预测性与可迁移事件流表示。未来模型应在相同实例上比较，并报告协议迁移、池留存、符号新颖性、掩码、硬负样本行为和不确定性以及聚合时间性能。

Abstract: Ethereum decentralized finance (DeFi) provides a public, time-stamped record of transaction-level event streams, but the same public symbols can create strong machine-learning shortcuts. We introduce ETH-TraceBench, a benchmark for evaluating Ethereum DeFi representations under temporal, protocol, pool/infrastructure, and symbolic shift. The raw event universe covers January 2021-December 2025 and contains 1.35 billion transactions with logs and 5.01 billion raw log rows. Model evaluation uses a fixed 911,267-instance supervised sample, training on 2021-2024, selecting models on 2025H1, and testing on 2025H2. Simple models perform strongly on the aggregate temporal test: TraceStats-GB reaches 0.953 macro-F1 and TopicEmitterHashMLP 0.959 on the canonical DEX test set. Performance drops sharply under protocol novelty, with macro-F1 of 0.794, 0.743, and 0.766 for TraceStats-GB, TopicEmitterTrace-SGD, and TopicEmitterHashMLP, while strict unseen-pool scores remain 0.927, 0.897, and 0.935. Uniswap v4 and Ekubo v1, both absent from supervised training, are materially harder than the full test. Jointly masking emitter and topic identity reduces DEX macro-F1 to 0.916 and liquidation macro-F1 to 0.774 for TopicEmitterTrace-SGD. A standard Transformer over log-index-ordered events provides no consistent advantage over a deterministic shuffle of the same events, indicating that high aggregate scores can arise without sophisticated chronological modeling. A natural-prevalence audit estimates 2025H2 DEX prevalence among logged Ethereum transactions at about 22.5%, and a deterministic 400-transaction audit finds complete agreement with task label sources and independently re-queried raw-log counts. ETH-TraceBench therefore treats difficult transfer and controlled-input conditions, rather than a single aggregate score, as the main evaluation target.

</details>


### [522] [One Patch, Three Roles: What Is Actually Coupled in Autoregressive Time-Series Forecasting?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23686)
*Ziang Li,Yue Huang,Guoxu Zhou,Na Han,Jie Wen,Lunke Fei,Xiaozhao Fang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文挑战了时间序列自回归(AR)预测中patch长度同时绑定表征、学习转换和递归执行三项功能的传统假设。作者通过原子编码、ATD轨迹蒸馏和Spectrum Tangent周期校正三个组件，将这三个角色解耦，并揭示了执行效率与误差修正之间的内在矛盾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在patch-based自回归时间序列预测中，单个patch长度通常同时承担输入表征粒度、监督目标和递归回写跨度三种角色。这种耦合使得模型无法独立调整表征、转换学习和执行效率，限制了在异构数据和长推理任务中的灵活部署。理解这三项角色是否真正必须耦合，对于设计更灵活的AR预测接口至关重要。

Method: 本文提出三项解耦组件：(1) 原子编码——使用12点原子和共享线性映射将输入patch与下游模型宽度D解耦，在保持原始线性投影类别的同时比较m=P/12与D的灵敏度；(2) 自回归轨迹蒸馏(ATD)——冻结经验证选择的单步AR父模型，通过轻量级并行残差MLP出口拟合其递归部署轨迹Q_j而非真实未来，从而支持可选的ATD-1/2/4/8执行宽度（ATD-1精确恢复父模型）；(3) Spectrum Tangent——在冻结父模型外部沿一个训练选定的周期性历史模板方向进行一维非负系数校正，不增加神经参数或Transformer调用。实验基于七个ETT/ECL/Traffic/Weather数据集，lookback W=672，四个滚动预测视野(96/192/336/720)，三种种子，并在AutoTimes-GPT2、Timer-base-84m、TimesFM-2.5-200M三个公开AR父模型上验证迁移性。

Result: 原子编码方面：与下游模型宽度D(5.08%/4.16%)相比，原子分组m的灵敏度(2.85%/2.03%)较低，最优D因数据集而异。ATD方面：冻结父模型的递归轨迹比真实未来更易拟合(局部父模型未解释分数0.109 vs 0.845，42/42种子运行)，ATD-8在四个数据集配对比较中达到5.54×端到端加速，H720 MSE波动仅0.00056。保真度-精度失配：ATD在全部21/21种子运行中提升轨迹保真度，但仅在15/21中提升预测精度（ETTm2和Traffic为反例）。Spectrum Tangent方面：H720下MSE和MAE在七个数据集和两个宽度上分别降低2.54%和2.33%，42/42种子全部改善，但仅143/168时序块改善；Exchange弱季节性应力测试中恶化+2.82%/+1.22%（Tangent-4）。诊断层面ECL/Traffic呈水平负相关、ETTh2呈形状负相关，但完整方向在42/42运行中均为正对齐。跨父模型迁移：全部36/36 ATD-1精确恢复，Tangent在36/36 ATD-8运行中改善0.84%–15.66%。

Conclusion: 本文成功将patch-based AR预测中的表征、学习转换和每调用执行三项角色解耦为独立的设计轴。原子编码揭示了模型宽度比原子分组更需关注；ATD证明冻结父模型的递归轨迹是一个高度可压缩的编译目标，可实现宽输出块的近常数预测质量加速，但更少的调用不会自动消除父模型固有的预测误差（保真度提升不保证精度提升）；Spectrum Tangent证明长视野残差在周期历史方向上存在可校正分量，但水平与形状分量方向可能不一致。这些发现表明高效的执行与误差修正是两个独立的目标，并澄清了AR patch中各角色的可分离性边界。

Abstract: Patch-based autoregressive time-series forecasting often ties input representation, learned transitions, and recursive execution to one patch length. We ask which of these roles can be adjusted separately. A supporting atomic-encoding study finds greater sensitivity to model width than to atom grouping on the evaluated grid. Our main finding is that a frozen parent's recursive trajectory is easier to fit than the observed future with lightweight parallel exits. Autoregressive Trajectory Distillation (ATD) turns this into selectable ATD-1/2/4/8 execution, with ATD-1 exactly recovering the parent. On a paired four-data-set comparison, ATD-8 reaches $5.54\times$ end-to-end speedup with stable quality across widths. Fewer calls do not automatically remove the parent's existing forecast error: ATD improves trajectory fidelity in all 21 seed runs but forecast accuracy in only 15 against matched clean-future supervision. We further find a correctable residual projection along a train-selected periodic history direction. Spectrum Tangent applies this correction without adding neural parameters or Transformer calls. At horizon 720, it reduces mean squared error (MSE) and mean absolute error (MAE) by 2.54% and 2.33% over seven data sets and two output widths, while remaining $3.24\times$ faster than recursive inference. Level and shape projections sometimes disagree. Trajectory compressibility, the fidelity-accuracy mismatch, and the correction recur across three public AR parents. Together these results separate representation, transition, and execution as AR design axes. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [523] [GenVoid: Uncertainty-Aware Learning of Subsurface Material Defects with an Experimentally Validated Physics-Informed Generative Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23761)
*Trishit Mondal,Prajwal Bharadwaj,Nikhil Karanjgaokar,Ameya D. Jagtap*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GenVoid是一个物理信息生成模型框架，通过表面位移测量识别复杂二维和三维固体中的内部孔洞。该框架融合控制方程的物理约束与生成式变分推断，可处理线性弹性、超弹性和塑性材料行为，并显式量化测量不确定性以产生概率性孔洞几何重建。此外，引入了基于伴随法的可观测性度量来表征边界测量对内部扰动的灵敏度，为传感器配置和检测可靠性提供定量基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内部孔洞作为制造结构中的常见缺陷，其几何信息难以直接获取，只能通过边界测量间接推断。这是一个严重不适定的几何辨识逆问题：映射具有强平滑性，深处孔洞在边界产生的响应微弱，且测量噪声会使不同孔洞配置产生相似响应。传统方法（水平集、深度学习监督分类、PINNs等）存在依赖初始猜测、缺乏物理约束或需要大量标注数据等局限，亟需一种能够融合物理先验、量化不确定性并适用于复杂几何与多种材料行为的统一框架。

Method: 方法包含三大核心组件：(1) 参数化水平集表示——采用紧致支撑Wendland C² RBF核表示水平集函数，通过Ersatz材料插值映射为有限元节点上的有效杨氏模量，利用平滑Heaviside函数实现材料-孔洞过渡区的可微正则化；(2) 神经架构——采用两阶段训练策略：第一阶段以自解码器方式训练解码器（4层MLP，宽度512→1024→1024→N_R）将变分潜变量映射为RBF系数，配以KL散度正则化；第二阶段冻结解码器，训练置换不变的集合编码器（通过max+mean对称池化聚合各测点的空间坐标与多工况位移特征）将边界测量映射为潜变量后验分布；此外引入MLP修正头对解码输出施加局部边界细化（初始化为零）；(3) 优化与不确定性量化——以编码器预测为初值，通过FEniCS有限元前向求解器和Levenberg-Marquardt算法联合优化潜变量与修正头权重Θ={z,θ̃}以最小化多工况多测点的位移匹配损失加Tikhonov正则化；通过蒙特卡洛采样潜变量后验产生孔洞概率场p_ω(x)；(4) 可观测性度量——定义为O(x)=(Σ_l ‖∂u_h,l/∂E(x)‖²)^{1/2}，通过伴随法高效计算，表征局部刚度扰动对边界响应的灵敏度。物理前向求解覆盖线弹性（一次稀疏LU分解）、超弹性（基于体积-偏差能量分解的近不可压Neo-Hookean，κ/μ=50）和塑性（Ramberg-Osgood幂律硬化变形塑性）三种本构模型。

Result: 二维识别：16种几何（含齿轮、L形件、C形槽、T形件、台阶等），IoU范围0.797–0.992，圆形/椭圆形孔洞精度最高（>0.98），复杂凹形星状孔洞0.911–0.966。三维识别：球体IoU最高0.958，复杂非凸结构（环面0.855、新月形0.863）也获得良好重建；含四个独立孔洞的配置IoU=0.808为最低。收敛性：典型情况下二维在10次迭代内IoU超0.8、20次内接近0.97，三维约30次迭代收敛。传感器数量影响：测点从256降至32时IoU显著下降（如双孔洞二维从0.845降至0.476）。噪声鲁棒性：5%噪声下典型IoU_p降至0.5左右，10%噪声下约0.36–0.37；三维对噪声更敏感。非线性材料：超弹性和塑性模型在洁净面IoU_p≈0.65，但噪声增大时性能快速下降（塑性在5%噪声时IoU_p仅0.148）。实验验证：PMMA线弹性体T形孔IoU_p=0.596、L形+新月形双孔IoU_p=0.763；弹性塑性下T形孔IoU_p=0.789、双孔IoU_p=0.634。可观测性分析显示：单工况下存在方向性盲区（零敏度线），10工况使最小可观测性提高约一个数量级；既有孔洞周围出现应力阴影区，可能导致相邻缺陷被误识别为单一异常。

Conclusion: GenVoid框架成功实现了复杂几何（2D/3D、凸/非凸、多孔洞）下基于表面位移的隐藏孔洞识别，跨越线性弹性、超弹性和塑性材料行为。两阶段训练策略解耦了几何表示学习与逆问题求解，避免了表征空间被优化初期的困难所破坏。概率性潜变量公式将测量不确定性传播为重建几何的不确定性场，配合蒙特卡洛采样提供了可量化的重建置信度。可观测性度量建立了缺陷位置、传感器配置与重建精度之间的定量联系，可用于指导检测方案设计。实验验证表明，该方法能够直接从DIC实测位移场推断出T形、L形和新月形等任意形状孔洞。然而，当前框架假设宿主材料本构行为和属性已知，限制了在异质材料系统中的应用；未来可扩展为联合推断缺陷几何与材料属性，并结合更丰富传感模态和自适应加载/传感器布置策略。

Abstract: Internal voids are ubiquitous defects in manufactured structures, yet their characterization remains challenging because their geometry is hidden and can only be inferred indirectly from accessible measurements. Here we introduce \textit{GenVoid}, a physics-informed generative model-based framework for identifying internal voids in complex two- and three-dimensional solids from surface displacement measurements alone. By incorporating the governing mechanics into a generative inference framework, \textit{GenVoid} enables void identification across linear elastic, hyperelastic and plastic material behaviours and accommodates complex two- and three-dimensional structural geometries. Importantly, the framework explicitly accounts for uncertainty and noise in displacement measurements, producing probabilistic reconstructions of internal void geometry rather than a single deterministic estimate. We demonstrate the approach using high-fidelity synthetic datasets and experimentally measured displacement fields obtained from in-situ mechanical experiments, establishing its ability to infer hidden voids from realistic displacement measurements. To quantify the fundamental limits of such inference, we further introduce an observability measure that characterizes the sensitivity of boundary measurements to localized stiffness perturbations within the interior under an ensemble of applied loads. This framework provides a direct connection between defect location, sensor configuration and reconstruction fidelity, enabling systematic assessment of how the number and spatial distribution of boundary measurements govern void-identification accuracy. To this end, these results establish a physics-informed and uncertainty-aware approach for non-invasive characterization of hidden defects and provide a quantitative basis for designing measurement strategies for inverse problems in solid mechanics.

</details>


### [524] [Statistical Convergence of Transformer Encoder-Accelerated Robust Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23775)
*Suman Banerjee,Hiroyasu Tsukamoto*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Transformer编码器(BERT)预热初始化的鲁棒强化学习框架，结合R-污染模型刻画转移核不确定性，并利用保形预测(conformal prediction)对Q函数收敛误差提供有限样本、分布无关的高概率界限，实现预认证的停机规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在大规模状态-动作空间中，鲁棒Q学习因随机初始化而样本效率低、收敛缓慢。自然语言任务描述中蕴含丰富的结构信息，但传统RL算法未加以利用，亟需一种理论严格且非保守的方法来量化Transformer预热对收敛加速的收益。

Method: (1) 使用预训练BERT+LoRA微调，以自然语言任务描述为输入，监督回归预测最优动作-价值函数Q*，得到Q_θ；(2) 采用R-污染不确定性集与鲁棒Bellman算子；(4) 基于保形预测，构造以收缩Bellman残差为非一致性分数的轨迹级置信界限；(5) 通过定理1-3分别证明收敛上界、时间一致(step-wise)统计收敛界及sim-to-real鲁棒性界。

Result: 在9×9、11×11、13×13扰动迷宫环境(污染率R∈{0.2,0.4,0.5})上的数值实验表明：(a) BERT预热显著降低初始误差并加速收敛(图4)；(b) 提出的保形界限比现有理论界限更紧且能紧密跟踪真实误差轨迹(图5)；(c) 非一致性分数分布呈重尾特征，90%分位数阈值可有效刻画系统行为(图6)。

Conclusion: 本文成功将Transformer表示学习与鲁棒Q学习融合，提供了首个对Transformer加速鲁棒Q学习的统计严格收敛分析，保形预测给出的预认证停机规则仅需少量真实转移核知识，适用于未知、安全关键且数据稀疏的环境。

Abstract: Obtaining the optimal action-value function in Markov decision processes is computationally intensive in large state--action spaces. In this study, we present statistically rigorous convergence results for a robust reinforcement learning algorithm warm-started by a transformer-based action-value function prediction, where natural language prompts encode task specifications. Our framework adopts the R-contamination model to characterize uncertainty in the state transition kernel, and employs conformal prediction to certify convergence via trajectory-level nonconformity scores constructed from the contracting Bellman residual. The resulting conformal quantile bounds the gap between the running and optimal action-value functions simultaneously over all iterations, thereby yielding a pre-certified stopping rule that requires little knowledge of the true transition kernel. Numerical case studies on perturbed maze environments of varying size and contamination level confirm that the transformer-based warm start measurably reduces the initial error and accelerates convergence, while the proposed conformal bounds track the true error trajectory more tightly than existing guarantees.

</details>


### [525] [Falling Trees: A Model Class for Interpretable Risk Prioritization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23780)
*Varun Babbar,Zachery Boner,Margo Seltzer,Cynthia Rudin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的可解释机器学习模型类——"Falling Trees"（下落树），通过将"风险单调递减"的约束从规则列表推广到决策树结构，允许在高风险任务中进行优先级排序。同时，作者提出了GRAVITree算法，基于动态规划与边界剪枝来高效学习该模型类的Rashomon集合（近似最优解集），并通过21个数据集验证其在预测性能、稀疏性和风险排序上的平衡优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中许多高风险决策任务需要优先处理高风险样本（如临床患者优先级、欺诈检测等）。现有的Falling Rule Lists (FRLs) 虽然具有可解释性和风险排序能力，但严格的单路径结构限制了模型表达能力，且现有优化算法无法保证全局最优、依赖预挖掘规则、存在"交互瓶颈"问题。作者希望扩展风险单调约束到树结构，解决上述问题。

Method: 1. 提出"Falling Trees"模型类：将FRL的"风险单调递减"约束推广到决策树（沿任意根到叶路径，叶子节点的阳性类别概率单调递减）。2. 引入"分支代价"（branching cost）H(T)：惩罚两个子节点均为内部节点的数量，可平滑插值于规则列表和完全决策树之间。3. 提出GRAVITree算法：结合动态规划与边界剪枝（dynamic-programming-with-bounds），通过两个关键定理（定理4.1充要条件和定理4.2剪枝条件）有效缩减搜索空间，并使用量化缓存策略加速。4. 输出满足最小叶子支持、深度约束和falling约束的Rashomon集合。

Result: 在21个公开数据集及一个新临床数据集（MIMIC-III ICU患者死亡率预测）上的实验表明：(1) GRAVITree在正类决策稀疏性上显著优于TreeFARMS/未约束树；(2) 当μ=0.01时（允许适度分支）比μ=1（强制为规则列表）有更好的测试损失和FNR；(3) 与FRL基线FRAME相比，测试损失相当或更优；(4) 相比无falling约束版本，Rashomon集合大小更小、运行时更短；(5) GRAVITree运行速度通常优于TreeFARMS；(6) 通过调整μ可在完全决策树与规则列表间平滑插值。

Conclusion: 论文提出了一种新的可解释模型类——下落树（Falling Trees），扩展了Falling Rule Lists以允许树形分支结构，并通过GRAVITree算法在风险单调性、最优性和可解释性之间实现了实用平衡。实验证明该方法在高风险决策场景下具有优越性能，是高风险领域（如医疗）中手工评估模型的良好选择。

Abstract: Many real-world decisions require prioritizing high-risk cases, such as clinicians prioritizing high-risk patients before lower-risk ones. Falling rule lists (FRLs), which are ordered if--then rules with monotonically decreasing risks, provide an interpretable framework for such tasks; however, their single-path structure yields a highly restricted model class. We introduce falling trees, a new family of interpretable models that enforces the same monotonic risk constraint while permitting tree-structured branching. We present GRAVITree, a novel dynamic-programming-with-bounds algorithm for learning the Rashomon set of falling trees under depth and branching constraints. Our formulation can interpolate between rule lists and full decision trees, enabling user-desired model expressivity. In a new clinical dataset and in many public classification benchmarks, falling trees match or outperform FRLs and other interpretable baselines, often producing more sparse decisions for high-risk instances. Our results show that falling trees strike a practical balance between interpretability, expressiveness, and risk prioritization for high-stakes settings.

</details>


### [526] [Iterative Atom Refinement: A Monotonicity Principle for Dictionary Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23812)
*Alexander Christie,Miguel Moscoso,Alexei Novikov,George Papanicolaou,Chrysoula Tsogka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出迭代原子精化（IAR）算法，用于从随机初始化恢复字典学习中的原子。其核心贡献是发现了一个关于原子选择频率的单调性原理：在完全组合数据模型下，原子选择频率的排序在精化迭代中得以保持，且微小初始优势会被逐步放大。在正交字典与完全组合数据的理论设定下，IAR仅需三次精化步骤即可识别生成原子。通过独立随机初始化的coupon collector方法，可恢复整个字典，复杂度为 R ~ K log K。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准交替字典学习方法（如MOD、K-SVD）的收敛保证均为局部的，需要足够接近真实字典的初始化。而实践中从随机初始化出发并通过多次重启与聚类恢复字典的现象缺乏理论解释。本文试图为这一现象提供严格的理论基础。

Method: 1) 提出IAR算法：从单位球面随机初始化的单位向量出发，每步选取与当前迭代方向相关性最强的 L = M/K 个样本，取平均并归一化得到下一步迭代。2) 引入"原子选择频率" p_k^(r) 作为分析工具。3) 利用高维概率论和组合论证，证明完全组合数据模型下 p_k 的排序单调性。4) 利用高斯序统计量的极值理论和Mills比率，证明首步选择频率的分离（Lemma 3.1）。5) 证明三次迭代后 p_1^(r)=1。6) 结合coupon collector论证给出完整字典恢复保证。7) 数值实验验证理论并扩展至非正交字典和部分数据情形。

Result: 主要理论结果：(1) 单调性原理——若初始原子选择频率满足 p_k^(1) ≥ p_{k+1}^(1)，则该排序在所有后续迭代中保持。(2) 首步分离——以高概率，p_2^(1) ≤ c·p_1^(1)，且对某 κ，p_κ^(1) ≤ ε·p_1^(1)。(3) 有限步收敛——在理论假设下 p_1^(r)=1 对 r ≥ 3 成立。(4) 完整字典恢复——R ≥ K(log K + t) 次独立随机初始化以至少 1 - e^{-t} 的概率恢复完整字典。数值实验验证了理论预测，包括对齐分数在2-3步内达到0.9876，覆盖率与coupon collector曲线吻合，且在0.05%极端稀疏数据下仍能完全恢复；同时与标准MOD、贪婪MOD对比表明IAR速度更快且恢复更稳定。

Conclusion: 本文的核心贡献是发现了字典学习中一个新颖的单调性原理，该原理揭示了原子选择频率的排序在迭代中保持，且微小初始优势被逐步放大。这一原理将字典恢复问题转化为一维排序动力学研究。在正交完全数据模型下，从随机初始化经三次精化即可识别单个原子，整体字典恢复以coupon collector复杂度完成。数值实验表明该机制在更一般设置（部分数据、非正交字典）中依然成立，并为先前神经网络方法从随机初始化恢复字典的实验现象提供了可能的理论解释机制。

Abstract: Dictionary learning seeks to recover an unknown dictionary $A$ from observations ${\bf y}_i = A{\bf x}_i$ with sparse coefficient vectors ${\bf x}_i$. We introduce the \emph{Iterative Atom Refinement} (IAR) algorithm, a simple procedure for recovering individual dictionary atoms. Starting from a random direction, IAR repeatedly selects the observations most strongly correlated with the current iterate and updates the direction by averaging the selected data. Our main contribution is a rigorous convergence theory of IAR. Using high-dimensional probabilistic estimates and a novel monotonicity principle for atom-selection probabilities, we show that a small initial advantage of one atom is amplified until that atom is isolated. Under our model assumptions, IAR identifies a generating atom after only three refinement steps. Numerical experiments support the theory and show that the resulting dynamics accurately capture the behavior observed in dictionary refinement.

</details>


### [527] [Real-time Generalizable Heart Valve Mechanics for Clinical Disease Assessment via a Physics-Conditioned Neural Operator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23826)
*Shawn Koohy,Wensi Wu,Matthew A Jolley,Paris Perdikaris*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer的物理条件神经算子（PCNO），用于快速预测心脏瓣膜（二尖瓣和三尖瓣）的位移、应变和应力场，替代传统有限元仿真，实现最高15,260倍的加速，并在分布外泛化条件下仍能保持3.5%以内的诊断指标误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二尖瓣反流是最常见的心脏瓣膜疾病，影响全球超2%人口，但因传统有限元仿真计算耗时过长，仅少数重症患者获得手术干预，亟需实时可用的瓣膜力学评估工具。

Method: 提出PCNO架构：基于Transformer的神经算子，采用Rank-Augmented Linear Attention（RALA）降低复杂度；通过shift-scale-gate条件调制机制融合物理参数（收缩压、Lee-Sacks材料参数）和全局几何描述符；以k近邻结构张量提取局部几何特征；单一编码器同时输出位移/应变/应力场及病理分类标签。

Result: 在331,777个基础仿真和41,054个病变仿真上，PCNO对粗网格实现2,261倍加速、细网格实现15,260倍加速；在SBP泛化、单元/双元/三元材料参数泛化及联合泛化测试中，位移场相对L²误差在4.48%以内；在分布外条件下，所有临床诊断指标（帐篷高、帐篷体积、脱垂高/体积、AP/IC直径比）相对误差均低于3.5%，病理分类准确率100%。

Conclusion: PCNO通过数据驱动的参数条件调制策略，实现了跨异构几何、边界条件和材料本构的快速泛化心脏瓣膜力学预测，为临床实时瓣膜疾病评估和参数空间探索提供了可行路径；但仍受限于合成数据、各向同性材料、缺乏不确定性量化及对真实患者几何的验证。

Abstract: Mitral regurgitation is the most common heart valve disorder worldwide, affecting over 2% of the global population, rising to at least 10% in adults over 75, and causing approximately 15% of valvular heart disease-related deaths. Yet only a minority of patients with severe disease undergo corrective surgery. Rapid assessment of valve mechanics could enable earlier, more precise intervention, but traditional finite element simulations remain too slow for clinical timelines and parameter sweeps. We introduce the Physics-Conditioned Neural Operator (PCNO), a transformer-based surrogate that predicts leaflet displacement, strain, and stress fields across mitral and tricuspid geometries, conditioned on systolic blood pressure and tissue properties. Trained on functional, regurgitated, and pathological valves, including tethering, P2 prolapse, and annular dilation, PCNO achieves up to a 15,260x speedup over fine mesh finite element simulations with comparable accuracy, identifies pathology class, and resolves diagnostic metrics within 3.5% error under out-of-distribution extrapolation.

</details>


### [528] [Actionable Insights from Observational Data: The Case of Advanced Classes in K-12 Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23836)
*Nabit Bajwa,Seth B. Hunter,Sanmay Das*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了美国一个学区在2023-24学年引入开放式、自选参加的强化型（advanced）ELA（英语语言艺术）中学课程的效果。利用一项由学区政策变化产生的独特观测数据集，结合教育经济学中传统的增值（value-added）回归模型与现代因果机器学习方法（双重机器学习DML、因果森林Causal Forest），估计了选课对学业成绩的平均处理效应（ATE）、异质处理效应（CATE）以及不同学生群体的选课行为。核心发现：选修强化ELA课程对学业成绩有正向但温和的提升（约0.06–0.09个标准差，相当于约2–3个月的额外学习）；但在历史上面临不公平待遇的群体（黑人学生、低SES学生）中，选课率显著低于预测受益程度——即存在"预测收益"与"实际参与"之间的错配，揭示了自选参加政策在公平性方面的局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在K-12教育中，先进课程对学业成绩的因果效应是一个核心但困难的问题。原因在于选课是学生（或家长）自愿选择的，而非随机分配，导致简单的对比因学生能力、动机、支持等混杂因素而失真。与此同时，既有研究多关注基于分数门槛或教师推荐等"准入式"机制的先进课程效果，对"开放式、自选参加"政策的研究不足，也无法同时考察"谁受益"与"谁选课"两者之间的匹配关系。该研究的动机正是利用一个真实学区政策变化所产生的自然实验性观测数据，填补这一研究空白，并展示因果机器学习方法如何从大型观测数据集中提取可操作的见解。

Method: 研究采用三阶段互补方法体系：(1) **增值回归模型**——以OLS回归为基线，控制前一年ELA成绩、当前数学成绩、数学学习路径及路径×成绩交互项，分四种设定逐步加入人口学控制变量；(2) **双重机器学习（DML）**——用随机森林建模结果方程、用逻辑回归建模处理分配方程，使用五折交叉拟合与0.02–0.98的倾向得分修剪保留89%样本，估计ATE；(3) **因果森林（Causal Forest DML）**——用1000棵树、最小叶大小20，按ELA教师分组交叉拟合，估计条件平均处理效应（CATE）以刻画异质性；(4) **选课行为描述分析**——按先前成绩、SES、种族交叉划分学生群体，比较预测收益与实际选课率的差距。所有分析依赖"可观测变量选择"（selection on observables）假设，并通过倾向得分修剪检验共同支撑条件。

Result: **平均效应**：增值回归得出选课效应为0.063–0.086 SD（p<0.01–0.05），DML估计为0.071 SD（95% CI [0.003, 0.140]），因果森林平均为0.064 SD，三种方法结果一致且稳健，相当于约2–3个月的额外学习。**异质效应**：先前成绩中等偏上（z分0–0.5 SD）的学生获益最大（~0.08 SD）；黑人、西班牙裔、低SES、英语学习者、特殊需要学生的预测收益较低；被认定为资优的学生收益较高。**选课行为错配**：选课率随先前成绩上升而提高，但即使是学业上"有条件受益"的学生中，黑人/西班牙裔低收入学生的选课率仍显著低于白人/亚裔学生（例如高能力组：白人/亚裔高SES选课率约80%，黑人/西班牙裔低SES仅约44%；中等能力组：白人/亚裔高SES约46.6%，黑人/西班牙裔低SES仅约27.7%）。这一"预测收益与实际参与"的错配表明，开放式选课不足以确保公平参与，单纯取消入学限制并不能消除入学差距。

Conclusion: 本文得出三个核心结论：(1) 强化ELA课程对学业成绩有正向且教育意义上重要的影响（~0.06–0.09 SD），该结论在传统计量经济方法和现代因果机器学习方法下均稳健成立；(2) 平均效应掩盖了显著的异质性——先前学业准备较好的学生从中获益更多，历史上代表性不足的群体获益相对较少；(3) 选课决策与预测收益之间存在系统性错配，揭示了开放式自选参加政策的公平性局限：仅仅取消正式入学限制并不足以确保历史上弱势群体平等参与。文章的更广泛贡献在于方法论层面——展示了将因果机器学习与经典政策评估方法相结合，可以从观测数据中提取具有可操作性的见解，识别"看似能从先进课程中受益但实际未选课"的学生群体，从而为有针对性的招生策略、家庭沟通与支持项目提供政策依据。文章最后建议，未来推进先进课程普及应配套针对性干预，如更清晰的个性化家庭沟通、通用筛查或"opt-out"机制、增强归属感与代表性等。

Abstract: A fundamentally challenging question in K-12 education is about the effects of taking more advanced or challenging classes. It is particularly complex because students (and/or their parents) choose whether to enroll in these classes, making causal analysis challenging. In this paper, we begin to tackle this question by taking advantage of a novel dataset from a public school system in the US. This dataset records students' course enrollment decisions, prior academic histories, demographics, and subsequent outcomes around the time of a district-wide change that introduced optional open-enrollment advanced middle-school courses in subject areas. This is a rich observational dataset, but enrollment in advanced classes is driven by student characteristics and choices rather than random assignment. This creates a core identification challenge: the same factors that influence enrollment in advanced courses are also predictive of academic outcomes. As a result, simple comparisons between enrolled and non-enrolled students are confounded, and naive estimates may reflect underlying differences in student ability, motivation, or support rather than the impact of coursework itself. Our analysis shows that enrolling in advanced English courses has a net positive but modest effect on student achievement outcomes. However, these benefits are unevenly distributed: some students with relatively large predicted gains ("middle achievers" in prior years) are less likely to enroll than others. Some other groups (e.g. Black students and those with lower socio-economic status) also demonstrate significantly lower propensity to enroll. This gap between predicted benefit and observed enrollment illustrates how careful data analysis can extract actionable insights from large observational datasets, including identifying students who appear well-positioned to benefit but do not select into advanced options.

</details>


### [529] [From Regional to Global: Transfer Learning for Atmospheric Transport Emulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23838)
*Jeff Clark,Elena Fillola,Nawid Keshtmand,Raul Santos-Rodriguez,Matthew Rigby*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究基于图神经网络的大气传输仿真器（GATES）从区域尺度（南美）向全球尺度扩展时的空间可迁移性。通过在四个世界区域（南美、东亚、南亚、北非）训练区域专属模型、多区域模型和留一区域（LOSO）实验，定量与定性地评估了跨区域泛化能力，旨在为温室气体排放估算构建高效、可扩展的全球大气传输仿真器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 温室气体排放的精确量化对气候目标至关重要。传统拉格朗日粒子扩散模型（LPDM）计算成本高昂，无法适应现代卫星高分辨率数据。作者前期开发的GATES仿真器虽可在南美实现约1000倍加速，但大气传输存在显著的区域异质性（如地形、风场、土地利用差异），从区域扩展至全球面临域迁移（domain shift）挑战，亟需系统性评估模型的空间可迁移性。

Method: 基于GATES（图神经网络大气传输仿真系统），使用UK Met Office NAME LPDM生成的GOSAT甲烷观测footprint数据（2012年1月–2015年8月），覆盖东亚、南亚、南美、北非四个区域（footprint为50×50网格，约0.35°×0.23°分辨率）。输入为Met Office统一模型的7个垂直高度（100 m–18 km）和3个时间步（0、-6、-12小时）的气象变量，以及地形与土地利用静态特征。在数据时间划分后，对每区域进行子采样，训练了：4个区域专属模型、2个多区域模型（MRM"large"使用全部26,449样本；MRM"small"使用约7,302样本以匹配单区域数据量）、以及4个留一区域（LOSO）模型。使用MSE（幅度精度）和IoU（结构相似性）作为定量指标，并结合可视化定性分析。所有模型训练250个epoch，使用相同超参数。

Result: 定量结果显示：每个测试区域的最佳性能通常由该区域专属模型或MRM"large"实现；MRM"large"在所有区域表现与单区域模型相当或更优，且训练成本仅为分别训练4个区域模型的约2.3倍（48h vs 21h）；MRM"small"以10小时训练提供了有竞争力的性能；LOSO实验表明在未见目标区域上仍能取得合理性能，且与MRM"small"相比仅有略微下降，South Asia例外（LOSO表现与训练数据含South Asia的模型相当甚至略优）。定性分析显示：北美非区域专属模型与MRM"large"在视觉上最接近LPDM ground truth；使用东亚模型预测南美时误差显著，与风场差异相符；所有模型在山区均表现较差，因山区大气传输机制复杂。整体表明：单区域模型在其本区域内最佳，跨区域性能下降；多区域训练提高了跨域鲁棒性；小规模多区域模型和LOSO实验表明谨慎的采样策略可实现稳健的全球仿真器，无需大幅增加训练数据。

Conclusion: 大气传输仿真具有区域依赖性，受地形、气象和footprint分布差异影响。多区域训练提高了跨域鲁棒性，证明地理多样化数据集对可扩展传输仿真的价值。MRM"large"的性能证明开发全球适用的大气传输仿真器具有可行性；MRM"small"的强性能表明高效采样策略可降低成本并保持泛化能力；LOSO实验初步表明使用多区域小数据训练的模型可部署于未见区域。该工作揭示了地球物理机器学习中域迁移的挑战。未来工作将探索改进采样方法、适用性地图、更多区域、新区域训练的实用指南、细粒度区域模型（如国家或子区域级别）的权衡，以及显式迁移学习策略（如微调、域自适应）的应用，以支持全球温室气体排放估算的高效逆向建模系统发展。

Abstract: Greenhouse gas emissions estimates can be derived using inverse methods by combining atmospheric concentration observations with chemical transport models. The latter traditionally use physics-driven simulators such as Lagrangian Particle Dispersion Models (LPDMs), which are expensive to run and do not scale well to modern satellites' high resolution data. Previously we developed a performant atmospheric transport emulator that approximates LPDM outputs ("footprints") over South America ~1,000X faster than the UK Met Office's LPDM. Expanding towards global emulation is not straightforward, as atmospheric transport is regionally heterogeneous. This paper evaluates spatial transferability capabilities of models across four world regions: South America, East Asia, South Asia, North Africa using both region-specific and multi-region models, and leave-one-region-out experiments. Regional differences are characterised in the context of input variable and output footprint distributions. This work builds intuition in cross-region generalisation and transfer learning, aiding regional performance towards efficient global emissions estimates.

</details>


### [530] [PROSE: A Theory of Optimal Stopping with Perishable Evidence for Peer Selection in Intermittently Connected Decentralised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23845)
*Christos Anagnostopoulos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PROSE理论，针对间歇连接去中心化联邦学习中"证据易腐"的点选择问题，建立了有限期Markov最优停止框架，证明了保留值结构、置信安全认证规则、移动感知信息价值停止规则、泊松到达等待期权闭式解及单步规则的近视最优性定理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在移动/间歇连接环境中，去中心化联邦学习无可信聚合服务器，节点需自主选择临时可用对等方进行模型交换；但评估一个候选对等方会消耗宝贵的接触时间（链路随时可能断开），而对等方模型在断开期间持续漂移，使得采集到的证据因"机会时钟"和"漂移时钟"双重作用而腐化，经典静态点选择理论不再适用。

Method: 1) 将接收方在接触窗口内的决策建模为有限期Markov最优停止问题，动作集为{Exchange, Probe, Wait, Random}，含代价性信息获取和未来到达外部期权；2) 证明Snell包络/保留值结构存在；3) 用Hoeffding不等式+局部漂移包络推导出阶段一致、漂移感知的置信界，进而构造maximin认证规则；4) 推导移动感知信息价值停止规则及关于链路危险率的比较静态；5) 在标记泊松接触到达下给出等待期权闭式值与搜索论保留值；6) 证明在"单调"(单调移动) 体制下单步前瞻规则的近视最优性。

Result: 主要定理结果：(1) Theorem 1 证明最优策略存在并由Bellman反向归纳唯一刻画；(2) Theorem 2 给出认证规则的正确性（高概率≥1−δ−δS）；(3) Theorem 3 给出有限样本识别复杂度上界 n>8S²_max/Δ²_v · log(2Kn_max/δ)；(4) Theorem 5 给出充分停止条件 VPI^ub ≤ c_p+Ω_b；(5) Theorem 6 证明链接危险率升高降低探测继续值并扩大停止区；(6) Theorem 7 给出搜索论保留值 ρ*，作为 λT(ρ*)=c_w 的唯一解；(7) Theorem 8 证明单调体制下OSLA最优且PROSE永不提前停止；(8) 静态接触+无漂移极限下退化为经典固定置信最优臂识别。

Conclusion: 本文建立了机会式去中心化学习中"何时、与谁、是否"进行模型交换的完整理论，揭示不确定性具有双重时钟（统计采样与机会生存），最优策略为保留值阈值规则；在高度易失移动场景下，轻量级单步规则在单调性条件下即为最优，且始终不会过早停止；PROSE策略完全本地化，在静态无漂移极限下可恢复经典序列分析与最优臂识别结果，贡献为纯分析性的决策理论。

Abstract: Decentralised federated learning removes the aggregation server but makes collaboration dependent on transient peer availability. In mobile and intermittently connected systems, evaluating a promising peer consumes contact time and may cause the exchange opportunity itself to vanish, so that the evidence a learner gathers about a peer is perishable: it decays because links expire and because peer models drift while old measurements age. This paper develops a self-contained theory of optimal stopping for the resulting peer-selection problem. We formalise a receiver's within-contact decision as a finite-horizon Markov optimal-stopping problem with costly information acquisition and a future-arrival outside option, and prove that it admits an optimal policy characterised by a reservation value (Snell-envelope structure). Around this formulation we prove: (i) stage-uniform, drift-aware concentration and a maximin certification rule that is correct with high probability together with a finite-sample identification bound; (ii) a mobility-aware value of-information stopping rule and comparative statics showing that higher link hazard lowers the value of continued probing and enlarges the stopping region; (iii) a closed-form value of waiting under marked-Poisson contact arrivals, together with a search-theoretic reservation value whose comparative statics we characterise; and (iv) a myopic-optimality theorem establishing that, in sufficiently volatile (monotone) mobility regimes, the one-step confidence-safe rule is a sound surrogate for the optimal policy and never stops prematurely. We instantiate the theory as PROSE (Perishable-evidence Reservation-value Optimal Stopping for Exchange), a lightweight, fully local policy, and delineate the static contact and drift-free limits in which classical sequential decision problems are recovered. The development is entirely analytical.

</details>


### [531] [Collaborative Streaming Anomaly Detection with Interactive Explanations and Ensemble Consensus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23883)
*Diogo Risca,Afonso Lourenço,Ricardo Martins,Goreti Marreiros*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于高速数据流的协作式流式异常检测系统，将人类分析员显式集成到决策循环中。该系统通过四模块流水线（异构检测→共识集成→基于规则的代理建模→人机交互）实现AI在环的交互式学习范式，并在工业Jacquard织机数据流上验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实工业数据流中异常检测面临标签缺失、检测器可靠性不一、结果难以解释等挑战。现有流式机器学习方法多依赖完全监督适应，难以在真实部署中落地。本文旨在构建一个支持人机协作的流式异常检测技术栈，通过将领域专家知识融入检测全流程，提升监督效率与系统可信度。

Method: 系统采用四阶段模块化流水线：(1) 异构异常检测——集成xStream、RSHash、HST、RRCF四种基于不同结构假设的流式检测器；(2) 共识集成——通过增量Z-Score归一化、实例级过滤、真相发现（Full/DivE/ULARA）和检测器级过滤构成12种可选策略；(3) 基于规则的代理建模——采用AMRules规则学习器近似共识行为，并使用ChebyOS过采样策略缓解不平衡问题，同时识别不一致的分数向量；(4) 人机交互——分析员可过滤虚假异常、调整聚合权重、选择检测器子集、修正代理规则，形成人机协同优化的集成模型。

Result: 在260 000事件、含3个异常片段的Jacquard织机工业数据流上评估：单个检测器ROC-AUC从7.64（xStream）到97.71（HST）不等；加入检测器级过滤后集成ROC-AUC达99.08；进一步增加实例级过滤后达99.46。代理模型识别出PhaseVoltage、PowerFactor、ReactivePower为关键特征，并提炼出两条可解释规则R₁（电压崩溃型）和R₂（波形畸变型），可解释3个异常片段的所有模式。专家干预后规则集可表征全部异常：片段1由R₁主导（约89%），片段2和3由R₁和R₂混合触发。计算开销方面，代理建模为主要瓶颈（约1600秒）。

Conclusion: 该协作式流式异常检测框架将检测性能从最佳单检测器的97.71 ROC-AUC提升至99.46，并通过原始数据代理将集成决策提炼为两条物理可解释的规则，分别对应电压崩溃与波形畸变故障。该架构为人机交互提供了可审计、可重新校准的领域锚定阈值，为流式环境中的可操作人机协同建立了可推广的流水线。未来工作将聚焦于从分析员反馈中进行自动化偏好学习。

Abstract: We present a collaborative streaming anomaly detection system for high-speed data streams that explicitly integrates human analysts into the decision loop. The system combines heterogeneous detectors and aggregates their outputs through a normalization-based weighted consensus, complemented by artifact-aware rules to stabilize anomaly scoring under deployment. To improve interpretability, it derives surrogate models that approximate the ensemble consensus and expose human-readable sensor conditions associated with anomalous behavior. Analysts can actively intervene by reviewing anomaly episodes, adjusting consensus behavior, and refining surrogate rules used for anomaly prediction, producing a human-adjusted ensemble. We evaluate the approach on an industrial stream with 260\,000 events and 3 anomalous episodes, showing robust detection and actionable human-AI interaction.

</details>


### [532] [GDN Tree-Scan: Served Tree Verification for Recurrent-Hybrid Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23900)
*Zhiyuan Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GDN Tree-Scan 提出了一种服务于 Gated-DeltaNet 混合语言模型的树形推测解码验证器，集成于 vLLM。该工作解决了混合模型中循环状态验证的关键问题：在 softmax 注意力路径掩码正确的同时，仍需保证候选节点携带其根到节点路径上原生顺序解码应产生的循环状态。系统通过 FlashAttention-2 树偏置注意力、分支局部 GDN 扫描/重放、设备端多草稿提交以及仅接受链状态发布四个核心机制实现。在 Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 上，cat6root（六节点根分支树）在 batch=1、温度 0.6 的 SWE/Codex 解码场景下，相对原生五步 MTP 实现 27.0% 的 token 加权解码吞吐量提升，提交令牌/事件提升 17.2%，且验证前向时间几乎不变。等价性证据限于循环 oracle p-rescore 在原生翻转底线内的闭合，并非完整分布距离证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 树形推测解码在纯注意力 Transformer 中主要依赖祖先掩码即可验证多条候选延续路径，但 Qwen3.6 等循环-注意力混合架构打破了这一假设：GDN 循环层需要携带状态，若共享打包的循环累加器，正确注意力掩码下仍可能基于不可能的循环历史进行条件化（如图 1 所示的最小污染案例）。已有相关工作（如 STree、SpecMamba、组件感知自推测）从理论层面识别了 SSM/混合模型验证问题，但缺乏在 vLLM + FlashAttention-2 + GDN 实际服务栈中的实现闭合。

Method: 系统设计包含四个核心机制：(1) FA2 树偏置注意力分叉——保留原生 varlen_fwd 不变，新增 varlen_fwd_tree_bias 解码入口，在 QK 分数后、softmax 前注入 fp32 祖先偏置矩阵，prefix 列对所有行可见；(2) 分支局部 GDN 扫描/重放 Triton 内核——按拓扑顺序遍历，每个节点从父节点 h_cache 加载状态执行 GDNStep，避免打包顺序污染；(3) 设备端多草稿提交器——在设备上执行 SpecInfer 风格的残差混合采样规则，min(1, p/q_mix) 接受，规避主机端 N×|V| softmax 传输；(4) 仅接受链状态发布——按原生顺序重放已接受路径，gather-before-scatter 重映射 GDN/卷积状态，拒绝分支状态非持久。验证器契约以树描述符为跨层契约：父索引、候选 ID、可见性掩码、接受路径行，与草稿器解耦。GDN 扫描几何参数 BV=16, num_warps=8, n_pad≤16，在 pad8（cat6root）或 pad16（cat9）下零溢出；超过此边界时需切换至从脊柱重计算的扫描变体。

Result: 在 Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B-FP8（48 层 GDN + 16 层 softmax 注意力）上，vLLM 0.19.2rc1 + 分叉 FA2 的 B=1 服务部署门控下，四个 SWE/Codex 任务、温度 0.6：(1) 速度结果：cat9（九节点毛毛虫树）token 加权解码 22.63 tok/s（+20.4%），cat6root（六节点根分支树）23.88 tok/s（+27.0%），相比原生 E5 五步 MTP 的 18.80 tok/s；cat6root 提交令牌/事件从 4.11 升至 4.82（+17.2%），每请求视角 +4.0%，验证前向时间 0.138s vs 0.137s 几乎不变；预填充占比非对称（native 0.65, cat9 0.74, cat6root 0.98）。(2) 等价性结果：40 轮 B=1 p-rescore 显示 native E5 翻转率 12.90%，cat9 为 13.28%，cat6root 为 13.09%；两者均落在原生底线内，差距小于单位置标准误差。机制层面证据为：根兄弟作为深度-0 替代可恢复原生 MTP 因首个脊柱令牌被拒而丢失的事件。

Conclusion: GDN Tree-Scan 证明了混合循环模型中推测解码的服务级实现等价性是可行的——通过将循环状态纳入树契约、FA2 树偏置注意力、分支局部 GDN 扫描和接受链状态发布实现。但结论需附条件阅读：token 加权解码专用度量（27.0% 非端到端任务墙提速）、B=1 批量、非对称预填充部署分母、40 轮 p-rescore 样本、未做请求级 bootstrap、无完整分布距离估计、预填充密集型负载，且 B=4 共驻与 Stage D 分阶段计时仍为开放门控。论文明确区分三类主张边界——验证器契约正确性、清洁 B=1 解码吞吐量、经验等价门控——并以负结果库和威胁有效性章节界定哪些路径不构成等价性证据。

Abstract: Tree speculative decoding verifies multiple candidate continuations in one target forward pass. For attention-only transformers, the verifier mainly needs an ancestry mask. Recurrent-hybrid language models break this assumption: a candidate row must also carry the recurrent state that native sequential decode would have produced along its root-to-node path.
