### [623] [A Governance-Aware Large Language Model Orchestrated Agentic Digital Twin for Transmission System Operator Control Room Decision Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22476)
*Costas Mylonas,Magda Foti,Emmanouel Varvarigos*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向输电系统运营商（TSO）控制室的"治理感知"智能体数字孪生架构，其中LLM仅作为受限的编排器，其所有动作必须经过一个模型无法绕过的运行时治理层。该层强制执行四项不变式（白名单工具、步骤预算、副作用操作需操作员审批、所有呈现数字来源于后端），并在希腊输电网数字孪生上的118任务基准（含12类对抗输入）的590次主运行和跨四个LLM模型的1416次运行中验证四条规则无一例外地成立，工具选型率达96.5%，任务成功率93.7%，治理开销仅12–16毫秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着可再生能源渗透率提高、系统惯量降低和安全裕度收紧，TSO控制室面临日益复杂的运行决策压力。LLM虽能提供自然语言交互，但其幻觉、工具使用不可控和数值不可追溯等问题与控制室安全要求严重冲突。如何在保持LLM自然语言优势的同时确保其行为满足安全关键系统的治理、可追溯性和人机协同要求。

Method: 系统采用四层架构：操作员接口层、JSON受限的LLM编排层、治理与执行控制层（白名单/模式验证/副作用门控/有界循环/审计日志）、输电网数字孪生层（确定性后端服务）。LLM被限制为只能选择和参数化白名单分析工具，并通过严格的JSON动作契约与系统交互；治理层作为参考监视器，所有模型输出作为数据而非代码被解析。四个不变式在持久审计轨迹上逐次运行验证，而非依赖模型自报告。评估方法包括：118任务基准（涵盖分析、仿真、多步工作流、对抗输入）、四项不变式逐运行验证、两个基线（B1移除治理层、B2用规则路由器替换LLM）、四项消融实验（模式验证、白名单、审批门、步骤预算分别关闭）、2×2数值阶段消融（确定性摘要与输出验证）、四模型三温度跨模型研究、以及90秒推理延迟（L40S GPU+256GB RAM+128GB Workspace）。

Result: 主配置590次运行中：工具选型率96.5%（299/310），保守任务成功率93.7%（553/590），裁定成功率94.4%；四个不变式在全部590次运行中无一例外成立。跨四个模型1416次运行中：四个不变式再次全部成立，合并单侧95%下限约99.79%。移除治理层（B1）后：所有45次需审批运行均未授权执行，数值支撑率仅39.2%（107/273），8次超步骤预算。B2（规则路由器）保持所有不变式但能力下降至77.4%。消融实验显示：每关闭一个执行控制，其对应的不变式立即崩溃而其他保持完整。治理开销稳定在12–16毫秒/请求，比LLM推理（约1887毫秒）低约两个数量级。

Conclusion: 四条治理规则是架构而非模型的属性：将LLM视为治理层后不可信但有用的组件，提升模型可提高能力而不触及规则。审计轨迹使交付证据和操作历史均可追溯。完整框架、基准、提示和电网模型已公开发布，使评估协议可在其他系统上重复。这是在测试条件下将LLM交互的合法性建立在运行时约束而非模型可靠性之上的具体一步，使此类助手能够增强而非替代人类操作员。

Abstract: Transmission system operators face rising complexity from renewable integration, reduced inertia, and tighter security margins. Large language models offer natural-language decision support, but their hallucinations, uncontrolled tool use, and weak traceability conflict with control room requirements. This paper presents a governance-aware agentic digital twin for transmission grid control rooms. The large language model only selects and parameterizes whitelisted analysis tools, and every proposed action passes through a governance layer that the model cannot bypass. The layer enforces four rules on every run. Only whitelisted tools execute. No run exceeds its step budget. No action with side effects executes without explicit operator approval. Every number in an answer is rendered by the layer from backend results with its unit, variable, and time. The rules are checked on a persistent audit trail for every run of a released 118-task benchmark, which covers analytics, simulation, multi-step workflows, and twelve families of adversarial inputs on a digital twin of the Greek transmission network. Across 590 runs of the primary model, tool selection reaches 96.5% and task success 93.7%, and all four rules hold without exception. In a separate three-repetition study across four large language models, 1416 runs in total, the rules again hold on every run, with an approximate 95% lower bound of 99.8%. Removing the layer makes the same model execute all 45 approval-requiring runs without authorization and leaves only 39.2% of its answers with backend-supported numbers. Enforcement costs 12 to 16 milliseconds per request.

</details>


### [624] [From Code to Requirements: Agentic Reverse Engineering of Business Rules at Enterprise Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22719)
*Garima Agrawal,Prasun Das,Priyanka L,Minisha N,Akshay Sarvade,Hemath Manivanan,Sravani Joshna,Prasad Kalyansundaram*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一个由七个专业化智能体组成的多智能体框架，用于从无文档化的企业级软件中自动逆向生成业务需求文档(bRD)。该框架整合代码、测试套件、配置文件和文档等多源证据，采用静态分析为主、LLM推理为辅的策略，将资深业务分析师、QA工程师等专家的认知模型编码为智能体级能力。在实际企业环境部署评估中，平均每个服务8.78分钟生成完整bRD，相较建模的手工基线实现超过98%的成本降低与99.4%的时间减少；提取的业务规则通过独立的生产缺陷记录得到验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业系统的业务逻辑通常仅存在于代码、配置文件与人员经验中，缺乏结构化的业务需求文档(bRD)，导致迁移、合规审计等场景需要昂贵且易丢失知识的逆向工程工作。现有方法存在单数据源依赖、过度依赖LLM导致幻觉风险、缺乏领域专家认知建模三大局限。

Method: 1) 设计七智能体认知流水线（Discovery & Scoping、Journey Mapping、Business Rules Extraction、Gap Analysis、Synthesis & Conflict Resolution、Acceptance Criteria、Risk & Dependency），通过LangGraph编排；2) 每个智能体携带"Agent DNA"六块结构（身份、技能、领域知识、认知模型、内部规则、流水线位置），编码多源集成、静态优先提取、嵌入式领域专长；3) 采用确定性静态分析工具（AST解析、Semgrep模式匹配、schema diff、测试套件挖掘），仅在合成与冲突解决时调用LLM；4) 共享状态存储（滚动上下文摘要+追加式不可变事件日志）支撑全审计追踪；5) 知识层以知识图谱管理组件、旅程、规则、参与者等节点，支持冷启动与跨运行增量复用；6) 受控人工升级机制在冲突无法自动解决时介入。

Result: 在39个代码库、18个服务的真实企业Java部署中评估：14个被测服务共发现280条业务旅程、1612条业务规则、映射327条测试用例，平均生成时间8.78分钟/服务，平均LLM推理成本约$0.07/服务；项目级总成本降低>98%、时间缩短99.4%。在5个抽样服务上，通过LLM-as-judge将提取规则与生产缺陷分类记录中工程师独立引用的业务规则进行比对，超过100条缺陷被审查，115条独立bRD规则得到独立缺陷记录佐证，证明生成内容忠实于系统实际行为而非合理但无依据的文本。

Conclusion: 本文证明大规模自动化的需求逆向工程在保持产物质量的同时切实可行，使得bRD生成可在迁移生命周期内作为持续活动而不仅仅是一次性任务。框架作为完全代理化SDLC流水线的基础，使后续设计、开发、测试与部署代理可基于知识层维护的机器可读规约共同工作。局限性：手工基线未经直接观测、双方成本未对称核算、研究仅覆盖单一Java代码库与单遗留试点、静态优先设计无法覆盖反射/存储过程等纯运行时行为、当前部署仍需人工监督。

Abstract: Business requirements for enterprise software systems are rarely captured in structured form; the logic resides instead in source code, configuration files, and institutional memory. When these systems must be migrated, extended, or audited, the absence of formal requirements artifacts forces teams into expensive, knowledge-losing manual reverse engineering. This paper presents an agentic framework that autonomously generates Business Requirements Documents (bRDs) through reverse engineering of undocumented enterprise software. Seven specialized agents collaborate to discover user journeys, extract business rules, and synthesize a locked bRD from code, test suites, configuration, and available documentation, supported by static analysis tools, guided by embedded expert practitioner cognitive models, and overseen by human reviewers at controlled escalation points. Measured on actual execution traces across a real enterprise deployment, the framework generates comprehensive bRDs in under nine minutes per service, with extracted rules independently corroborated against real production defect records. In a comparable prior migration to the same target architecture, delivery required over two years; on the present programme the framework achieves a cost reduction exceeding 98% against a baseline derived from actual repository metrics using IFPUG complexity models and industry benchmark labor rates.

</details>


### [625] [NostrAgent: A Decentralized Identity and Delegation Architecture for Sovereign Agentic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22944)
*Oliver Aleksander Larsen,Mahyar Tourchi Moghaddam*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: NostrAgent是一种基于Nostr中继的去中心化架构，通过三种自定义事件类型（Kind 38100身份声明、Kind 38101委派链、Kind 38102对等证明）结合Lightning HTTP 402（L402）支付机制，统一解决自主AI代理跨组织部署所需的五项核心能力：持久身份、范围委派、对等信任、无注册中心发现与身份绑定支付。该架构实现操作员主权的身份管理，无需中央注册机构，中继仅作为可替换传输层，所有授权决策可离线从签名事件重放验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前自主AI代理在跨组织边界执行任务时，需要调用第三方服务、委派子任务给其他代理并支付计量资源，这要求持久身份、范围委派、对等信任、发现与支付五项能力。然而现有方案要么依赖中央权威机构（如OAuth、SAGA），要么仅覆盖部分能力（如W3C DID、UCAN、KERI/ACDC），导致当密钥轮换或委派撤销时，授权、信任与支付在最需要连续性的自治环节出现断裂。本文旨在填补这一空白，提出G1-G5五个具体差距（密钥连续性、衰减委派、对等信任证明、无注册中心发现、身份绑定支付），并在单一基质上统一解决。

Method: 方法采用混合方法评估设计：（1）轻量级ATAM架构权衡分析方法，结合两轮mini-Delphi专家小组（3位匿名专家）对12个质量属性叶子进行重要性与难度评级（Krippendorff α=0.94，Fleiss κ=0.78）；（2）跨三个信任边界（TB1代理-委托TB3代理-服务）的协议适配 SWEAFTORM (S/T/R/I/D/E) 威胁建模；（3）11项基准测试（B1-B11），涵盖离线加密微基准（1000次运行，前100次预热）与Docker实时测试台（6个Compose容器：3个strfry Nostr中继、2个LND Lightning节点、1个regtest bitcoind节点），配对比较采用双侧Mann-Whitney U检验与Cliff's delta效应量；（4）19种失败模式测试；（5）Python 3.11原型实现，使用nostr-sdk（BIP340签名）、pymacaroons（L402）与LND on regtest，包含359个测试函数。信任计算采用深度优先搜索遍历锚点配置的信任路径，通过noisy-OR门组合独立证据，深度限制D_max=4，衰减因子d=0.5，剪枝阈值ε=0.01。预轮换机制通过SHA256哈希承诺后续公钥，旋转证明为新密钥对SHA256(old_pk∥new_pk∥timestamp)的签名。

Result: 主要结果包括：（1）离线验证亚毫秒级，深度4委派链验证中位数0.0619 ms（约15 μs/跳）；（2）委派链验证呈线性扩展（B3：深度1-4分别为0.0155/0.0308/0.0460/0.0619 ms）；（3）Lightning结算的L402全流程中位数157.4 ms（regtest环境）；（4）密钥轮换中位数235.8 ms，撤销传播至三个中继中位数336.8 ms；（5）信任查询在500节点Erdős-Rényi图（边概率0.15）下中位数2422.4 ms，D_max从4降至3时延迟降低6.8倍；（6）19种失败模式中17种经验性通过，FM-3（多中继冗余分析界）为分析性证明（3个独立中继p=0.99时数据不可恢复概率≤10⁻⁶），FM-15（多中继子集上的拜占庭含糊性无法检测）被披露为架构限制；（7）Sybil威慑：3桥接衰减d=0.5时诚实信任与Sybil信任比值为1.0:0.714（降低28.6%），L402身份成本底线使每单位伪造信任成本达10,000-20,000聪；（8）STRIDE残余风险中，信息披露为TB1/TB2主导残余（4/5级），源于中继公开图模型本身的权衡（TP-2）；（9）所有配对扫描比较在p<0.001时显著，效应量|δ|≥0.94。

Conclusion: 该论文证明操作员主权的代理身份、范围委派、对等证明信任、无注册中心发现与Lightning门控支付可在仅依赖中继的基质上统一实现，无需注册机构。NostrAgent填补了第一节所列五个差距：密钥轮换保留身份、委派与信任（G1，236 ms中位数）；每跳可验证地缩小授权能力范围，撤销通过单一事件级联（G2）；对等证明通过有价身份底线威慑Sybil伪造（G3，每单位伪造信任最高约20,000聪）；发现无需注册中心（G4，1.4-2.3 ms）；支付凭证绑定支付代理，被盗macaroon不可重放（G5，regtest上157 ms结算）。核心贡献在于组合效应：每个原语单独存在时已成熟，但单一密钥类型、单一事件日志、单一撤销原语共同实现了整个授权元组的离线验证、频带内级联撤销与单次Lightning往返的身份绑定支付。系统在商品中继上运行，17/19失败模式通过对抗测试，FM-3有分析界限，FM-15是仅依赖中继模型的诚实局限。未来工作包括：主网L402验证、大规模信任模拟中noisy-OR偏差的经验测量、衰减不变式的形式化验证、以及NKind 38100-38102的NIP标准化。架构局限性在于：（1）单一预轮换无法应对活跃密钥与后继密钥同时被攻陷；（2）多中继子集上的拜占庭含糊性无法检测（需见证人共识，与KERI相同）；（3）无限制中间跳导致资源/动作限制无法端到端传递（仅能力可传递）；（4）信任路径独立假设导致共享子路径被重复计数的向上偏差（两跳对共享一跳最多高估1/16）。该架构与MCP和A2A协议互补而非竞争，Kind 38100身份声明可携带MCP与A2A端点URL。

Abstract: Autonomous AI agents increasingly act across organizational boundaries on behalf of human operators: they invoke third-party services, delegate subtasks to other agents, and pay for metered resources. Deploying such agents safely requires five capabilities that today live in separate systems: persistent identity, scoped delegation, peer trust, discovery, and payment. Existing approaches root these in centralized authorities or cover only subsets, so authority, trust, and payment fracture exactly where autonomy needs continuity: when a key rotates or a delegation must be revoked. We present NostrAgent, a decentralized architecture that unifies all five over Nostr relays using three custom event kinds: Kind 38100 identity declarations authenticated by BIP340 Schnorr signatures with pre-rotation commitments, Kind 38101 scoped delegation chains whose every hop verifiably narrows granted capabilities, and Kind 38102 peer attestations forming a Sybil-deterrent trust graph, with Lightning HTTP 402 (L402) binding payment to agent identity. Identity remains operator-sovereign without any registration authority; relays are substitutable transport rather than a trust root; and every authorization decision is replayable offline from signed events. We evaluate a Python prototype with a mixed-method design: ATAM quality analysis with a two-round mini-Delphi panel, STRIDE threat modeling across three trust boundaries, eleven benchmarks with non-parametric statistics, and 19 failure modes. Results show sub-millisecond offline verification, linear delegation-chain scaling, and Lightning-settled L402 at 157 ms median on regtest. 17 of 19 failure modes pass empirically, one is bounded analytically, and one is disclosed as an architectural limitation. NostrAgent demonstrates an auditable prototype substrate for trustworthy agentic systems without centralized trust roots.

</details>


### [626] [MCPGen: Benchmarking LLMs on Executable MCPWorkflow Development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23925)
*Yingxuan Yang,Jiaqi Liu,Lirui Guan,Jiaye Gao,Weiwen Liu,Weinan Zhang,Ying Wen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: MCPGen是一个基于Model Context Protocol (MCP)的可执行基准测试，包含100个自包含MCP项目，涵盖16个应用领域。它通过三个诊断任务（工作流重建、工具创建、向后兼容的工作流扩展）评估大语言模型生成端到端可执行工作流制品的能力。评测11个LLM后发现，虽然工作流重建最高达88.5%，但端到端执行成功率不超过57%，项目级集成成功率不超过45%，表明集成仍是主要瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工具使用基准（如ToolBench、API-Bank、τ-bench等）通常孤立评估各项能力（工具选择、API调用、多步轨迹、DAG规划），或依赖轨迹级代理指标（如步骤准确率、工具调用成功率）。这些基准通常假设工具已存在、工作流结构已给出，或将正确性近似为轨迹级信号，未直接检验生成的工作流图、工具代码、模式绑定和执行器是否能组合为端到端可执行的项目。随着LLM越来越多地作为自动化系统的构建者（而非仅仅是工具使用者），评估项目级组合正确性（workflow graph、tool implementations、schema bindings和runner wiring的联合正确性）变得至关重要。

Method: 1) 形式化项目级组合正确性：将MCP工作流项目表示为元组P=(T, W*, E)，其中T是带类型化输入/输出模式的工具集，W*是金标准工作流图，E是包含测试和运行时约束的执行环境。2) 设计三个诊断任务：Task 1工作流重建（从打乱的、匿名化步骤ID中恢复执行顺序、依赖关系和分支结构）；Task 2工具创建（在现有类型化输入/输出模式、工作流上下文和项目接口下实现缺失的工具）；Task 3工作流扩展（在保留不可变基线子图的约束下，扩展已验证工作流的后续步骤并生成可执行运行器）。3) 构建数据集：从公共n8n社区模板派生100个工作流，平均使用9.1个MCP工具，按结构复杂度分为三级（3-5步Easy、6-10步Medium、11+步Hard），外部服务用确定性mock替换。4) 评估协议：采用静态分析、工具级单元测试、项目级集成测试、结构指标和进程隔离的端到端执行。所有任务采用确定性推理（temperature=0）。Task 1使用Order、Dependency、Path Robustness三个互补指标（权重0.4/0.2/0.4）；Task 2使用Indiv. Pass和Collective Pass；Task 3使用Tool Chain、Data Ref、Edge F1和E2E Success。5) 评测11个代表性LLM（Gemini-Flash/Pro、Claude-Sonnet/Haiku、o3、GPT-5.2/5.1/4o-mini、Qwen3-Coder-30B、Qwen3-Next-80B、Minimax-M21）。

Result: 主要结果：1) Task 1工作流重建相对可行：Gemini-Flash最佳达88.5%，Gemini-Pro 86.7%，Claude-Sonnet 85.9%。所有模型Order得分高于Path Robustness 14-22个百分点，表明局部排序恢复较好但错误仍沿下游传播。2) Task 2工具创建存在单元-集成差距：Claude-Sonnet个体通过率最高(63.8%)但集成仅41%；Claude-Haiku集成最佳(45%)。个体通过率普遍比集成高15-30个百分点。3) Task 3工作流扩展E2E成功最低：Gemini-Pro最佳57%，o3 46%，Qwen3-Next-80B 44%，GPT-4o-mini仅6%。辅助指标与E2E Success脱节（如GPT-4o-mini Tool Chain 67.3%但E2E仅6%）。4) 失败分析：743个可诊断失败中，MCP框架错误(31.9%)、语法/导入错误(24.8%)、类型安全问题(16.0%)、逻辑控制流错误(13.5%)为主。不同模型失败模式差异显著：GPT-5.2和Claude-Sonnet以语法错误为主，Claude-Haiku和GPT-4o-mini以MCP框架错误为主。5) 消融实验：Task 1权重敏感性Spearman ρ≥0.991，排名稳健；Task 3前缀比率30%/50%/70%对辅助指标影响不一致。

Conclusion: MCPGen揭示了LLM在可执行工作流开发中的关键瓶颈：虽然模型在结构推理（工作流重建最高88.5%）和孤立工具测试（个体通过率最高63.8%）上表现尚可，但在端到端执行（最高57%）和项目级集成（最高45%）上显著失败。核心瓶颈在于制品级集成：模式一致性、数据流连接、运行器正确性以及跨工作流边界的类型安全组合。不同任务的最优模型不同（Gemini擅长Task 1和3，Anthropic擅长Task 2），且辅助指标与E2E Success常不一致，表明结构推理、工具级代码生成和可执行组合应分别评估而非合并为单一工具使用分数。这为未来工作指明了方向：集成感知的训练与评估信号、基于工作流级反馈的改进，而非仅依赖单工具使用信号。

Abstract: We study whether LLMs can produce executable workflow artifacts that remain consistent across graph structure, tool implementation, schema bindings, and runtime wiring. In this setting, correctness depends on cross-layer consistency: a workflow may be structurally plausible, yet still fail because tool implementations, schema bindings, or runtime execution do not align. Existing benchmarks largely evaluate these capabilities in isolation or rely on trajectory-level proxies, leaving open whether generated workflow artifacts execute end-to-end. We introduce \textbf{MCPGen}, an executable benchmark for Model Context Protocol (MCP) workflow development. MCPGen contains 100 self-contained MCP projects across 16 application domains and evaluates three diagnostic tasks: workflow reconstruction, tool creation, and backward-compatible workflow extension. We evaluate 11 representative LLMs in a single-turn foundation-model setting, assessing generated artifacts through static analysis, unit and integration tests, and process-isolated end-to-end execution. Models reach 88.5\% on workflow reconstruction, but no model exceeds 57\% end-to-end execution success. Per-tool unit-test pass rates reach 63.8\%, while project-level integration success does not exceed 45\%, suggesting that integration remains a major bottleneck even when isolated tool tests pass.

</details>


### [627] [A Lean and Spec-Driven AI-Assisted Software Development Lifecycle for Applied AI Education: The AI-SDLC Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24348)
*Andreas Martin,Sandro Schwander*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出并评估了一种轻量级、规范驱动的AI辅助软件开发生命周期（AI-SDLC），通过仓库本地的specifications、SKILL文件与AGENTS.md引导AI编码代理在明确、可审查、以测试为导向的流程中工作，并在FHNW课程中通过学生问卷评估其教育与实践适用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI编码代理虽已广泛用于规划、实现、测试与仓库级任务执行，但其实践使用与传统软件工程实践之间存在弱连接；学生在使用过程中出现需求、架构、测试与实现之间的漂移，亟需一种轻量级流程结构来在不过度增加负担的前提下维持工程纪律。

Method: AI-SDLC整合TDD、测试金字塔、Clean Architecture、CI/CD、DevOps、看板、SAFe等既有实践与规范驱动开发，划分为Bootstrap、Specify、Design、Develop、Validate、Deploy六个阶段；通过AGENTS.md提供通用规则，按阶段SKILL.md提供具体行为指导；评价方法为单一课程队列的横断面在线问卷调查（n=13，回收率38%），结合封闭式评分项与开放式问题进行描述性分析。

Result: AI-SDLC总体获得积极评价：所有13名受访者认同Specify阶段在AI实现前明确了需求；12/13认同该流程结构化了与AI代理的协作；10/13认为结构化流程提升了项目质量；11/12会自愿在未来项目中再次使用；推荐意愿中位数为8。仓库本地指令文件被广泛认为有效（11/12认同其帮助代理遵守项目约定）。主要发现的问题包括：受访者对生成代码的信心建立在测试而非理解之上，11/13描述过未充分理解即采纳代码的情形；流程在小任务上被感知为负担；ADRs实际使用率极低；本地指令需持续维护且在团队协作中可能失效。

Conclusion: AI-SDLC在教学情境中具有可行性与教育价值，可作为AI代理在受治理框架内运作的轻量级生命周期；但需在测试结构、对生成代码的理解支持、轻量化小任务路径与ADRs的明确化等方面加强；未来工作应在后续课程中重复调查并引入独立于自报告的指标（代码质量、测试覆盖率、生命周期遵循度等）以弥补当前描述性研究的局限。

Abstract: AI coding agents increasingly support software development beyond code completion, including planning, implementation, testing, and repository-level task execution. Their practical use, however, often remains only weakly connected to established software engineering practices. The aim of this work is to develop and evaluate a lightweight, spec-driven lifecycle for governed agentic software engineering. The lifecycle combines established software engineering practices with repository-local guidance through specifications, this http URL , and phase-specific agent skill files. The approach was developed in the context of the FHNW course AI-assisted Software Development and applied by students to business-oriented software use cases. Its educational and practical applicability is explored through a student survey combining closed rating items with open-ended questions. The contribution of this work is a process-oriented framework that enables AI coding agents to operate with bounded autonomy within an explicit, reviewable, and test-oriented software development lifecycle.

</details>


### [628] [When Who You Are Can Change the Code You Get: A Study of Persona-Induced Bias in LLM Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22102)
*Anubhav Gupta,Mayara Costa Figueiredo,Leticia Santos Machado,Tanner Wright,Ivan Beschastnikh,Cleidson R. B. de Souza,Gema Rodríguez-Pérez*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对两款大语言模型（Gemini 2.5 Pro 和 GPT-OSS-120B）在纯技术性编程任务中因用户人口统计信息（国家、性别、经验级别）引入的偏见进行了大规模实证研究。通过18种人物角色与中性基线对比，分析了超过35,000个生成程序的推理痕迹、回复中的身份标记泄露以及代码的功能正确性、可维护性、风格和安全性差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然已有研究探讨了LLM在涉及敏感社会属性任务中的偏见，但对其在纯技术性编程任务中是否因用户人口统计信息而产生输出差异尚缺乏系统性研究。这种差异可能导致不同人群获得质量不均的技术辅助，进而加剧软件工程领域的不平等问题。

Method: 研究采用控制性人物角色分配策略，构建了18种人口统计人物角色（3个国家×3种性别×2个经验级别），加上1个中性基线。使用LiveCodeBench（release_v6版本）的1,055个编程问题，对两款推理型LLM（Gemini 2.5 Pro和GPT-OSS-120B）进行测试。通过人工编码与自动化分类相结合的方式识别五类人口统计标记（国籍引用、问候语、性别引用、经验引用、母语文本），并使用pass@1、Maintainability Index、Radon、PyLint、Bandit等工具评估代码的功能正确性、可维护性、风格和安全性。统计方法包括McNemar检验、Kruskal-Wallis检验、Mann-Whitney U检验以及Bonferroni等多种校正方法。

Result: 研究发现：(1) 人口统计标记在65%的回复和70%的推理痕迹中出现，其中语言类标记（如问候语）从推理到输出被放大，而身份类标记（如国籍引用）则被抑制；(2) Gemini模型在所有18种人物角色下功能正确性平均下降1.54个百分点，其中"印度非二元初级"角色显著下降3.6%（OR=0.51），而GPT-OSS-120B模型则相反，所有角色下正确性提升3.4-5.7%（OR=1.8-3.0）；(3) 可维护性指数方面，所有角色均显著低于中性基线，初级角色影响更大（最大δ=-0.52）；(4) 代码风格效应可忽略不计（|δ|<0.15），安全性无系统性模式；(5) 巴西和西班牙角色泄露率高于印度角色，非二元性别泄露率低于二元性别，难度增加时泄露率降低。

Conclusion: 研究证明，用户人口统计信息即使在纯技术性编程任务中也会影响LLM的推理过程和代码输出质量，效应在专有模型和开源模型中均存在。这揭示了LLM辅助软件开发中一个被忽视的风险，建议工具设计者应隔离技术生成与用户人口统计元数据，对核心代码生成默认使用中性人物角色，并审计输出中的人物角色引起的变化。未来的偏见评估应在不同难度级别上进行，仅使用困难基准可能低估人物角色效应。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely used as programming assistants, yet it remains unclear whether and how user's demographic information impacts the technical quality of generated code. We conduct a large-scale empirical study of persona-induced bias in LLM-based code generation, focusing a proprietary model (Gemini 2.5 Pro) and an open-weight model (GPT-OSS-120B). Using 18 demographic personas spanning nationality, gender, and experience level, we compare persona-induced prompts against a neutral baseline. Across 35,000+ generated programs, we analyze demographic marker leakage in reasoning and responses, as well as differences in functional correctness, maintainability, code style, and security. Our results show that demographic cues are frequently reflected in LLM reasoning and outputs. Demographic markers appear in up to 65% of responses and 70% of reasoning traces, despite being semantically irrelevant to the tasks. On LiveCodeBench, persona prompting were associated with lower correctness scores of the Gemini model by an average of 1.54 percentage points, with one persona exhibiting a decrease of 3.6% (odds ratio = 0.51). In contrast, the accuracy of the GPT-OSS model improved by 3.4 - 5.7% across all personas (odds ratios = 1.8 - 3.0). Maintainability and code style metrics show statistically significant but negligible effect sizes (all Cliff's {\delta} < 0.15), and security vulnerabilities exhibit no systematic persona-specific patterns. Overall, our results show that the presence of demographic information about users is associated with measurable variation in LLM reasoning and code quality even in purely technical tasks, and that these effects hold across models. Our work highlights an under-examined risk in LLM-assisted software development.

</details>


### [629] [Identity or Prompt Noise? A Calibrated Invariance Audit of LLM Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22511)
*Maksim E. Eren,Ryan Barron,Eric Michalak,Charles Nicholas,Manish Bhattarai*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文对大语言模型代码生成在性别、国家、职业等任务无关身份线索下的不变性进行了校准审计，基于3070万次Python执行结果发现：经过标签可交换性零假设校准后，职业维度是最一致可复现的结构性轴，但其绝对效应极小（中位数超出量仅0.141个CodeBLEU分）；国家维度的原始差异在校准后消失（中位数比值为1.0）；性别效应无法与提示措辞分离。研究未发现对命名身份的稳定劣势或可证明的下游危害。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 功能正确性不足以证明代码生成器对任务无关上下文具有不变性。改变性别、国家或职业等模型分配的身份线索不应影响正确性或实现形式，但样本不均衡和措辞差异可能产生虚假差异。论文旨在通过校准审计区分真正的身份效应与采样噪声/提示噪声。

Method: 使用7个模型检查点（Llama-3.2-3B、Mistral-7B、Llama-3-8B、Nemotron-3-Nano-30B、Gemma-4-31B、gpt-oss-120B、Nemotron-3-Super-120B）在HumanEval+和MBPP+上执行3070万次生成，采用任务内随机化检验（标签交换性零假设，1000次置换），通过Benjamini-Hochberg方法控制FDR（q<0.05），并使用中性人格名词和性别内名词作为措辞对照。主要结果指标为CodeBLEU结构相似度，辅以5个探索性结构指标和通过率。

Result: 职业维度CodeBLEU离散度在10/14个主单元格和8/12个全覆盖单元格中通过FDR校正，在14个单元格中均超过国家维度，但中位数超出量仅0.141分。国家维度在校准前12/14单元格中原始离散度最大，但中位数校准比值为1.0（即校准后消失）。性别相关变异性无法与提示措辞分离（措辞对照发现6/14 vs 性别7/14，p=0.358）。在6个高通过率单元格中，职业离散度在token相似度、长度、注释、参考相似度和复杂度上均可复现，通过率离散度则无一显著。职业排名在不同检查点间不稳定（中位数Spearman ρ=0.067）。

Conclusion: 证据支持职业维度对代码形式存在小且可复现的条件性影响，但不构成对命名身份的稳定劣势或可证明的下游危害。校准改变了原始结论（国家别似乎最大）的解释，强调了未校准审计可能误导。论文呼吁未来工作应测试重复精确提示、完全交叉的释义变体、更长对话上下文以及软件安全、维护和教育等场景中的下游结果。

Abstract: Identity cues are irrelevant to a fixed programming specification, but raw counterfactual differences can arise from unequal samples and prompt wording. We audit 30.73 million executed Python generations from seven checkpoints on HumanEval+ and MBPP+, supplemented by an exploratory 550B slice, under model-assigned gender, country, and occupation personas. Within-task randomization and false-discovery-rate control identify occupation as the most consistent structural axis: CodeBLEU dispersion exceeds its exchangeability null in 10/14 model--benchmark cells, remains significant in 8/12 full-coverage cells, and exceeds the country ratio in every paired cell, although the median excess is only 0.141 points. In six high-pass-rate cells, occupation dispersion replicates across token similarity, length, comments, reference similarity, and complexity, while pass-rate dispersion is significant in none. Country leads raw dispersion in 12/14 cells but has a median calibrated ratio of 1.00. Gender-associated variation cannot be separated from persona wording in this design. Thus, the evidence supports small, reproducible occupation-conditioned changes in code form, not stable disadvantage to named identities or demonstrated downstream harm. We use this finding to motivate a broader commentary on the potential impacts of bias in code generation, including the possibility that models may condition their outputs on identity information available from prior conversational context.

</details>


### [630] [Does Order Matter? An Empirical Investigation into the Impact of File Ordering on Code Review Effectiveness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22610)
*Md Shamimur Rahman,Zadia Codabux,Chanchal K. Roy*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文通过大规模GitHub仓库挖掘（330,343个多文件PR，756,814个文件实例，182个项目，5种编程语言），实证研究了代码审查工具默认的字母顺序文件排序对审查有效性的影响。研究发现：文件位置与潜在缺陷呈显著但微弱的正相关（位置1为56.7%，位置30为61.5%）；PR规模与潜在缺陷呈非线性关系（中等规模约10个文件的PR风险最低）；审查注意力随PR规模增加而被稀释（每增加一个文件使该文件获得评论的几率降低约8.7%）。研究提出了"注意力-有效性差距"（attention-effectiveness gap）概念，揭示可见的审查活动并不等同于缺陷预防效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代代码审查中，GitHub、Gerrit等平台默认按字母顺序展示修改文件，但开发者普遍认为这种排序方式与理解多文件PR的认知方式不一致。已有研究证实了位置偏差（positional bias）的存在，但缺乏大规模实证证据证明这种排序相关的注意力模式是否与可衡量的审查结果相关联。本研究旨在弥合这一空白，从项目历史角度检验文件排序对审查有效性的实际影响。

Method: 采用大规模历史软件仓库挖掘与统计分析方法。从182个GitHub项目（涵盖Java、Python、C、C++、JavaScript五种语言）中收集330,343个多文件PR和756,814个文件实例。通过基于关键词的启发式方法识别缺陷修复PR（使用'bug'、'fix'等关键词），并采用连续PR分析方法标记"潜在缺陷文件"（latent bug files）。使用t检验、Mann-Whitney U检验、Pearson/Spearman相关分析、卡方检验、趋势检验等方法分析文件位置与潜在缺陷的关系，并使用双栏障碍模型（hurdle models）分析PR规模对审查评论的影响。

Result: 主要发现包括：（1）文件位置与潜在缺陷呈显著但微弱的正相关（位置1的缺陷率56.7%升至位置30的61.5%）；（2）PR规模与潜在缺陷呈非线性关系——非常小（2-3个文件）和非常大（20+）的PR风险较高，中等规模PR（约10个文件）风险最低；（3）障碍模型显示每增加一个修改文件使该文件获得评论的几率降低约8.7%，表明审查注意力被稀释；（4）暴露"注意力-有效性差距"：获得更多评论的文件并未在后续缺陷修复中表现更少。

Conclusion: 字母顺序排序不应被视为中立界面默认，而应被视为塑造注意力分配、审查覆盖和审查结果信心的结构性特征。研究提出四项工具设计建议：上下文感知文件排序、依赖感知分组、风险感知优先级排序、每文件覆盖指标。同时强调PR规模应作为共享质量关切而非单纯依赖评论数量。本研究将文件排序定位为代码审查有效性的社会技术因素，连接工具设计、审查者认知、开发者体验与下游软件质量。

Abstract: Modern code review is central to software quality, but its effectiveness depends on reviewer expertise, change characteristics, and how tools present changes. Most platforms display modified files alphabetically by default, although our prior work shows that developers find this ordering cognitively misaligned with how they understand multi-file pull requests. Whether these ordering-related attention patterns affect outcomes at scale remains unclear. We present a large-scale study of file ordering and review effectiveness, mining 330,343 multi-file pull requests and 756,814 file instances from 182 GitHub projects in five programming languages. We examine whether file position is associated with later bug-fixing changes, whether pull request size moderates this relationship, and whether reviewer attention, proxied by comments, aligns with latent bug outcomes. Results show statistically significant but modest associations among file position, pull request size, review activity, and latent bug likelihood. Latent bug rates rise from 56.7% at position 1 to 61.5% at position 30. Pull request size has a non-linear relationship with latent bug likelihood: pull requests of about ten files have the lowest risk, while very small and very large ones have elevated rates. Hurdle models show that attention is diluted as pull request size grows: each additional modified file reduces the odds of receiving any review comment by about 8.7%. These findings reveal an attention-effectiveness gap: visible review activity does not necessarily prevent defects. Alphabetical ordering is therefore not a neutral interface default, but a structural feature shaping attention allocation, review coverage, and confidence in review outcomes. We propose context-aware file ordering, dependency-aware grouping, risk-aware prioritization, and per-file coverage indicators to make review attention more visible and actionable.

</details>


### [631] [Why Do Pull Requests Go Silent? Uncovering the Barriers to Contribution Completion in Open-Source Code Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22625)
*Md Shamimur Rahman,Farhana Akter,Md Mustakim Billah,Zadia Codabux,Chanchal K. Roy*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文研究GitHub开源项目中停滞Pull Request（PR）的类型分布、停滞成因及后果。基于19个使用Stale Bot的流行仓库的14,234个停滞PR和164,562条审查评论，采用LLM投票分类器对PR按贡献类型分类，并对通用与内联审查评论进行定性编码。研究发现功能增强和缺陷修复类PR占停滞PR的77%以上，停滞主因是沟通与协调失败，且许多PR因技术/依赖问题而非脱离而停滞，仅39.56%的贡献者会再次提交PR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开源项目中大量PR在合并前变为停滞状态，造成贡献者与维护者精力的浪费。已有研究多关注PR废弃的高层因素，缺乏对停滞PR的贡献类型、讨论层面的细粒度障碍以及停滞后协作模式的系统分析。Stale Bot虽被广泛采用，但其有效性存在争议，且基于时间的简单干预忽视了停滞的异质性原因。本研究旨在填补这些空白，为减少开源协作中的贡献浪费提供实证依据。

Method: 混合方法研究设计：(1)基于Khatoonabadi等人先前研究的19个使用Stale Bot的GitHub仓库，通过GitHub API采集14,234个停滞PR及164,562条审查评论（含通用评论114,184条、内联评论50,378条）；(2)采用三模型投票分类策略（Llama 3.3:70B、Qwen2:7B-Instruct、DeepSeek R1:14B）将PR分为7类（含3轮分歧时人工裁决），最终12,817个PR参与分类；(3)对通用评论和内联评论进行分层抽样（375条通用、363条内联，95%置信度、5%误差），由三位具有软件开发经验的编码员进行开放编码与主题分析，使用Cohen's Kappa评估评分者间信度（κ=0.74）；(4)追踪每个贡献者在停滞事件后的10个后续PR，分析作者留存率与评审者再参与率。

Result: RQ1（停滞PR类型）：功能增强与升级占54.04%，缺陷修复占23.63%，合计超过77%；卡方检验证实分布显著偏离均匀（χ²=19,357.79, p<0.001）。RQ2（停滞成因）：通用评论中协作与可用性问题占76.60%（无互动17.80%、作者无响应15.40%、评审者无响应14.93%等），技术测试问题7.33%；内联评论中审查流程与沟通问题占47.31%，技术依赖问题22.45%，代码质量问题17.49%。RQ3（归因与后果）：通用评论中共享作者-评审者责任占35.07%，评审者侧占32.86%，作者侧占20.27%；内联评论中三方归因更均衡；仅39.56%的贡献者再次提交PR，评审者与同一作者再参与率约20.99%，项目间差异显著。

Conclusion: PR停滞是一种涉及沟通、技术就绪度、评审所有权和自动化实践的社会-技术协调问题。基于时间的Stale Bot干预不足以应对停滞的异质性原因。研究提出七项操作指南：明确贡献期望与评审所有权、采用类型感知与主动分诊、明确下一步行动、改善评审反馈与瓶颈处理、区分技术阻塞与社会脱离、优化PR范围与早期质量门禁、设计原因感知的自动化而非仅基于时间的干预。未来工作应通过比较停滞与非停滞PR估计类型特异性停滞概率，并在真实项目中评估原因感知干预措施的有效性。

Abstract: Pull requests (PRs) underpin pull-based software development by enabling distributed code review and collaborative contribution in open-source projects. Yet many become inactive before integration and are eventually abandoned or closed, wasting contributor and maintainer effort. Although prior work has examined PR abandonment and review delays, less is known about the contribution types, discussion-level barriers, and post-stalling collaboration patterns associated with inactivity. We investigate which PR types most often stall, why inactivity occurs from authors' and reviewers' perspectives, and how stalling relates to later contributor and reviewer engagement. We analyzed 14,234 stalled PRs and 164,562 review comments from 19 popular GitHub repositories using stale-bot workflows. An LLM-based voting classifier categorized PRs by contribution type, while quantitative analysis was combined with qualitative coding of general and inline review discussions. Feature-enhancement and issue-fixing PRs formed the largest share, together exceeding 77% of classified stalled PRs. General comments linked stalling mainly to communication and coordination breakdowns, including missing interaction, delayed feedback, and unclear follow-up. Inline comments showed that inactivity does not always reflect disengagement: many PRs were blocked by technical or dependency issues, including failing checks, configuration problems, compatibility concerns, and environment mismatches. Only 39.56% of contributors later submitted another PR, and reviewer re-engagement with the same contributors was approximately 21%. PR inactivity is a socio-technical coordination problem involving communication, technical readiness, review ownership, and automation practices. We recommend type-aware triage, clearer review feedback, explicit ownership of next actions, CI blocker management, and cause-aware stale-bot interventions.

</details>


### [632] [Towards the Generalizability of Leveraging ChatGPT in APR via Self-enhancing: An Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22844)
*Qingyuan Li,Chuanyi Li,Yaopeng Yang,Ziwen Ge,Jidong Ge,Bin Luo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文对三种ChatGPT增强的自动程序修复（APR）方法（SRepair、FixAgent、RefinedTRP）在Defects4J、HumanEval-Java和BugsInPy三个基准上进行了系统性经验研究，发现增强收益在不同基准、模型配置和外部信息设置下存在显著差异，部分情况下甚至为负，强调需要使用多基准和多重指标评估APR增强方法的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ChatGPT增强APR方法（如SRepair、FixAgent等）虽然在Defects4J、SWE-bench等挑战性基准上报告了强劲结果，但这些评估通常仅限于一两个基准，且缺乏对不同基准、模型和外部信息条件下增强收益稳定性的系统考察。此外，基准数据可能因训练数据泄漏而被LLM记忆，导致评估结果的可靠性存疑。因此，需要研究ChatGPT增强APR方法在不同基准间的泛化能力及其背后的影响因素。

Method: 研究围绕四个研究问题展开：（1）RQ1：在Defects4J、HumanEval-Java和BugsInPy三个基准上，使用GPT-3.5-Turbo和GPT-5.4-mini评估三种ChatGPT增强APR方法（SRepair、FixAgent、RefinedTRP）及其无外部信息变体的修复性能，采用修复率（RR）、绝对增益（AG）、净空间增益（NHG）和性能比（PIR）四个指标；（2）RQ2：采用Prompt-Conditioned Generation方法，通过ATCC、ATCH、AP和RAP四个指标量化ChatGPT对各基准的记忆程度；（3）RQ3：通过代码变换（RC、VR、US三种变换算子）和基准特定监督微调（BIP4sft数据集）探索增强收益变化；（4）RQ4：在低记忆的BugsInPy上直接向ChatGPT提供错误信息和触发测试等外部信息，评估其修复效果。

Result: （1）增强收益因基准、模型和外部信息而异：GPT-3.5-Turbo下SRepair在HumanEval-Java的绝对增益（38.65pp）大于Defects4J（10.06pp），而在BugsInPy上无外部信息的SRepair和FixAgent出现负收益；GPT-5.4-mini下方法在Defects4J上的绝对增益大于HumanEval-Java，BugsInPy上的增益有限；（2）ChatGPT对不同基准的记忆程度不同，Defects4J在克隆匹配指标上信号更强，而HumanEval-Java在置信度指标上表现更低（可能源于HumanEval的训练记忆）；（3）代码变换降低了Defects4J上的增强收益（AG从6.11pp降至1.26-1.47pp等）；基准特定微调使BugsInPy上的直接修复从7个提升至15个，增强方法也获得正收益；（4）在BugsInPy上直接提供错误信息和触发测试比增强方法产生更多正确修复（10个 vs 最多9个）。

Conclusion: 研究强调需要使用多个基准和多重指标（包括绝对指标和基线相对指标）评估ChatGPT增强APR的泛化能力，并明确报告模型和信息设置。基准特定适应会影响通用修复能力，应使用记忆指标辅助分析。当增强方法收益有限时，直接提供适合的修复特定外部信息可能比依赖增强方法更有效。未来研究方向包括：在多基准上使用修复率和互补增益指标进行评估；研究哪些修复特定信息对各工作流有益；评估基准特定适应如何影响通用修复能力。

Abstract: Automated Program Repair (APR) increasingly relies on Large Language Models (LLMs). ChatGPT-enhanced APR uses techniques such as self-correction and autonomous agents to improve repair without modifying model parameters. Although these approaches report strong results on Defects4J and SWE-bench, the stability of enhancement gains across benchmarks remains under-explored. We evaluate three ChatGPT-enhanced APR methods on three representative, long-standing benchmarks. With GPT-3.5-Turbo, SRepair achieves a larger absolute gain on HumanEval-Java than on Defects4J, while SRepair and FixAgent without extrinsic information yield negative gains on BugsInPy. With GPT-5.4-mini, the evaluated methods achieve larger absolute gains on Defects4J than on HumanEval-Java, while gains on BugsInPy are non-negative but limited. We investigate benchmark-related factors through code transformations and benchmark-specific fine-tuning. Code transformations reduce enhancement gains on Defects4J, while benchmark-specific fine-tuning increases gains on BugsInPy. Directly supplying GPT-3.5-Turbo with error messages and triggering tests yields more correct repairs than the evaluated ChatGPT-enhanced APR methods on BugsInPy. These findings highlight the need to evaluate generalizability across benchmarks and models using multiple metrics, and suggest that directly providing repair-specific extrinsic information may be more effective than enhancement methods when their gains are limited.

</details>


### [633] ["It Comes in Notebooks": Changes and Challenges when Operationalizing ML Prototypes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22903)
*Arumoy Shome,Luís Cruz,Diomidis Spinellis,Arie van Deursen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文是一项定性研究，通过对13位机器学习从业者的半结构化访谈，探究了从计算笔记本原型到自动化生产系统的过渡过程中涉及的工程工作和软件质量关注点。作者识别出23种工程变更（归为5个主题）和20种软件质量属性，并提出"监督债务"（oversight debt）概念来描述笔记本原型在运营化时所需偿还的技术债务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管从计算笔记本原型过渡到自动化生产系统在机器学习实践中非常普遍，但这一过渡涉及的具体工程工作以及驱动该过渡的软件质量关注点在现有研究中尚未得到充分描述和理解。

Method: 基于对来自工业界和学术界的13位机器学习实践者的半结构化访谈，采用反思性主题分析（reflexive thematic analysis）方法进行定性研究。

Result: 识别出23种工程变更，归纳为5个主题：代码重构、数据管道开发、测试与验证、管道自动化、监控与可观测性。识别出20种软件质量属性，并将其映射到工程变更。发现反复出现的模式是计算笔记本将监督责任外化给人类从业者，并将成本推迟到运营化阶段。提出"监督债务"（oversight debt）概念，并展示了7个质量权衡关系。

Conclusion: 研究发现构建了运营化工作的结构框架，建立了工程变更与软件质量关注点之间的经验联系，为从业者、工具设计者和从事机器学习软件系统研究的学者提供了启示。

Abstract: Machine learning practitioners commonly prototype models in computational notebooks before transitioning them to automated production systems. Despite its prevalence, the concrete engineering work involved in this transition and the software quality concerns that motivate it remain insufficiently characterized. We report on a qualitative study based on semi-structured interviews with 13 ML practitioners from industry and academia. Using reflexive thematic analysis, we identify 23 engineering changes organized into five themes: code restructuring, data pipeline development, testing & validation, pipeline automation, and monitoring & observability. We also identify 20 software quality attributes across the ML development lifecycle and map them to the engineering changes. A recurring pattern in our findings is that computational notebooks externalize oversight to the human practitioner, and defer costs that become obligatory at operationalization time. Operationalization constitutes the repayment of this technical debt accumulated during prototyping, which we refer to as oversight debt. Practitioners do not merely restructure notebook code, but repay this debt by constructing automated substitutes for the interactive oversight that notebooks provide. We further present seven quality trade-offs showing that these tensions are properties of the notebook-to-production transition, rather than symptoms of poor engineering practice. Our findings structure operationalization effort, establish empirical links between engineering changes and software quality concerns, and provide implications for practitioners, tool designers, and researchers working on ML-enabled software systems.

</details>


### [634] [Characterizing Feedback Statements in Machine Learning Jupyter Notebooks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22912)
*Arumoy Shome,Lu\is Cruz,Diomidis Spinellis,Arie van Deursen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对机器学习 Jupyter Notebook 中的"反馈语句"（feedback statements）进行了大规模实证分析，提出了一个新的反馈分类法（taxonomy），揭示了实践者用以捕捉静默失败（silent failures）的防御性实践，弥补了现有基于崩溃（crash-based）分析的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对 ML Jupyter Notebook 的实证研究主要基于崩溃/异常分析，但 ML 系统中许多失败不会以异常形式暴露（如数据漂移、特征损坏等静默失败）。作者关注实践者主动编写的反馈语句（exploratory 与 validation），以理解他们如何编码心智模型来捕获这些静默失败。

Method: 从 GitHub 与 Kaggle 挖掘 297,851 个公开 Python Jupyter Notebook，得到 1,092,780 条反馈语句。使用 CodeBERT 嵌入 + UMAP + HDBSCAN 进行语义聚类，分层抽样 816 条样本（GitHub 383 + Kaggle 433）。采用扎根理论（grounded theory）与开放编码，沿"意图（intent）"与"ML 流水线阶段（pipeline stage）"两个维度手工标注，使用卡方/Fisher 检验及 Cramér's V 进行统计分析，并映射至 Wang 等人的崩溃分类法。

Result: 1) 探索性反馈占 85%，验证性反馈（assert）占 15%，后者几乎全部集中在 GitHub；2) 探索性以"inspect/compute/probe structure"为主，验证性以"shape/equality/boolean invariants"为主；3) Kaggle 58% 反馈集中在数据准备阶段，GitHub 则在数据摄取、模型构建、训练与评估阶段均匀分布；4) 反馈分类法与崩溃分类法在数据准备上收敛，但额外捕获了对静默失败的防御性实践。代码间一致性 Cohen's κ：意图维度 0.93，阶段维度 0.89。

Conclusion: Notebook 来源（GitHub vs Kaggle）应作为 ML 开发者实践研究中的混杂变量；存在构建 Notebook 工具的机会（基于实践者已编写的反馈模式）；并呼吁对崩溃分析无法观测的静默 ML 失败进行更深入的实证研究。作者发布了 1M+ 条反馈语句语料库与编码手册以支持复现与工具研究。

Abstract: Machine learning development in Jupyter notebooks is iterative and feedback-driven. Practitioners author statements that reveal information about program execution and use it to decide what to do next. We call these feedback statements and identify two forms: exploratory statements that display values for visual inspection, and validation statements that enforce conditions programmatically through assertions. Many ML failures do not surface as exceptions and thus escape the crash-based analyses that dominate prior work on ML notebooks. This study examines what practitioners check to catch failures that would otherwise pass silently, by characterizing feedback statements that encode the practitioner's mental model of what the code should do and what could go wrong. We mine 297,851 public Python Jupyter notebooks from GitHub and Kaggle and extract 1,092,780 feedback statements. We sample 816 statements through proportional stratified sampling from semantic clusters obtained from CodeBERT embeddings, and apply grounded theory and open coding to label and analyze each one. We contribute a taxonomy of feedback statements in ML notebooks, organized along the functional intent of the statement and the ML pipeline stage in which it appears. The taxonomy reveals that feedback is overwhelmingly exploratory, and that the two platforms host qualitatively different modes of ML work. Mapping our taxonomy to an existing crash taxonomy shows that it captures defensive practices against silent failures that crash analysis cannot observe. Our findings indicate that notebook source should be treated as a confounder in studies of ML developer practice, surface opportunities for notebook tooling, and motivate empirical study of silent ML failures. We release the corpus of 1,092,780 feedback statements and the codebook to support replication and tooling research.

</details>


### [635] [Diversity-Guided Search-Based Testing of Large Language Model Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23209)
*Lev Sorokin,Ivan Vasilev,Ken E. Friedl,Andrea Stocco*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出STELLAR-D框架，将失败多样性作为显式优化目标，用于搜索式测试基于大语言模型(LLM)的应用。通过维护已生成测试集合并奖励与集合的距离，同时引入基于贪心距离最大化的补充种群算子，在三个案例研究（LLM安全、车载导航、车载功能控制）中评估，发现引导式搜索在大多数配置中检测到的失败显著多于随机和组合搜索，且多样化方法覆盖了更广泛的失败类型，贪心补充种群在失败检测与多样性之间提供了最佳平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于大语言模型的应用在客户服务、教育、出行等领域广泛部署，但容易产生不准确、虚构或有害的响应，且其高维输入空间使系统化测试具有挑战性。现有静态基准数据集面临数据污染和难以穷尽覆盖自然语言多样输入的局限性。先前的搜索式测试方法（如STELLAR）仅优化失败检测，导致搜索集中在已有失败的输入空间区域，暴露的失败模式狭窄。作者因此提出将失败多样性作为一等优化目标，以更全面地揭示LLM应用中的各类故障。

Method: STELLAR-D建立在先前STELLAR框架基础上，将文本输入空间离散化为风格(ℱ_S)、内容(ℱ_C)和扰动(ℱ_P)特征，并采用进化算法（NSGA-II）进行数值优化。核心创新包括：(1) 维护已发现失败测试的存档(Archive)，通过嵌入距离量化多样性，并将其作为额外的适应度函数；(2) 引入补充种群(repopulation)算子，定期替换种群中不失败的测试以维持探索性；(3) 提出两种采样策略：均匀随机采样(STELLAR-D)和贪心距离最大化采样(STELLAR-DS)，后者在每批采样n_greedy个候选后选择距离存档最远的个体；(4) 使用RAG检索相关示例增强测试生成提示；(5) 采用LLM-as-a-Judge进行适应度评估，使用GPT-4o-Mini作为评判模型。

Result: 在三个案例研究(SafeQA、NaviQA-I/II、CarQA-I/II)、5个被测系统、8个LLM和18个测试配置上执行超过100万次测试。主要发现：(1) 所有引导式变体在几乎所有配置中检测到的失败数量显著多于随机搜索(RS)和组合搜索(ASTRAL/T-wise)；(2) STELLAR检测失败最多，但STELLAR-D和STELLAR-DS检测失败略少但显著拓宽了失败类型覆盖；(3) STELLAR-DS在覆盖率和熵上通常优于STELLAR-D，在NaviQA-I上覆盖率提升11个百分点；(4) STELLAR-DS总体平均覆盖率达78%，与随机采样持平但同时检测更多失败；(5) GPT-4o-Mini被选为评判模型，在SafeQA、NaviQA、CarQA上F1得分分别为0.79、0.71、0.96。失败检测与多样性之间存在权衡，STELLAR-DS在帕累托前沿上提供最佳平衡。定性分析在CarQA中识别出六种现实失败类型，包括部分忽略请求、开关偏好偏差、不必要的澄清询问、未请求的执行、不正确的确认和过度安全防护。

Conclusion: 研究表明，将失败多样性作为显式优化目标的搜索式测试框架STELLAR-D能够为基于LLM的应用生成多样化且能揭示失败的测试用例。引导式多样化搜索在维持高失败检测率的同时显著拓宽了所发现失败的范围。贪心补充种群策略在失败检测与多样性之间提供了最佳权衡。该方法首次将多样性作为LLM应用测试的一等目标。未来工作将扩展到多模态LLM系统和多轮对话场景的测试。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based applications are increasingly deployed across domains including customer service, education, and mobility. These systems are prone to inaccurate, fictitious, or harmful responses, and their vast, high-dimensional input space makes systematic testing particularly challenging. In this paper, we present a search-based testing framework for LLM-based applications that incorporates failure diversity as an explicit optimization objective. Building on a discretization along stylistic, content-related, and perturbation dimensions, our framework maintains an archive of generated tests and rewards distance from that archive, while a repopulation operator periodically replaces non-failing tests in the population to sustain exploration. The repopulation operator is parameterized by its sampling strategy: replacement candidates are drawn either uniformly or by greedy distance maximization, two settings we compare empirically. We evaluate both against several baselines across three case studies---LLM safety, in-car navigation, and in-vehicle function control---covering five systems under test, eight LLMs, and 18 distinct test configurations, with over one million executed tests. Our results show that all guided variants detect substantially more failures than random and combinatorial search in nearly all configurations. Among them, diversified search detects fewer failures, but covers a broader range of failure types in all case studies, with greedy repopulation offering the best tradeoff.

</details>


### [636] [Specification Before Generation: A Pre-Registered, Five-Model Paired Evaluation of a Specification Frame for LLM-Generated Code in Money, Time, Idempotency, and Access Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23270)
*Sandeep Dhuri*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种"规范优先"（Specification Before Generation）方法，通过在LLM生成代码前添加一个固定的267词规范框架（Specification Frame），来减少受监管后端系统中金钱、时间、幂等性和访问控制类缺陷。作者在5个厂商的前沿模型上对50个任务进行了预注册配对评估，发现该框架在所有5个模型上都显著降低了缺陷数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM生成代码的安全通过率多年未有改善（Veracode报告显示约56%），且指令文件（instruction files）的最大对照研究表明它们对任务成功无帮助甚至有害。作者认为原因是提示中缺少规范（specification），即对结果"必须为真"的明确声明。

Method: 1. 预注册实验：固定假设、反驳条件、分析代码和一次性生成规则；2. 使用267词的固定规范框架；3. 50个受监管领域后端任务（金融、医疗、保险）；4. 5个前沿模型（Anthropic Claude、OpenAI GPT、Google Gemini、DeepSeek、Alibaba Qwen）；5. 每个任务两次生成（裸提示 vs 带框架）；6. 9个确定性AST检查器评分；7. Bandit安全扫描器独立验证；8. 配对差异分析（符号检验、Wilcoxon检验、自举置信区间、Holm-Bonferroni校正）。

Result: 1. 所有5个模型中框架组缺陷均减少（均值Δ范围0.16-0.70）；2. 95/100的差异配对中框架组更优；3. 框架组在任何模型任何领域均未变差；4. Bandit扫描器发现裸组53个中高严重性问题，框架组仅34个；5. 效果与模型无提示基线纪律性呈单调关系——基线最差的模型获益最大；6. 金钱和幂等性领域效果最显著。

Conclusion: 一个简短、任务无关的规范前置框架能够持续减少LLM生成代码中受监管后端领域的缺陷，且效果在模型越弱时越明显。该框架可作为团队可拥有的工程纪律底线，不受模型路由变化影响。实践建议：在模型生成涉及金钱、时间、重试或访问的代码前，应将规范置于提示之前。

Abstract: Code generated by large language models passes security checks at a rate that has barely moved in four years. In regulated backends, the defect classes that matter most are money arithmetic, time handling, retry safety, and access control. Teams answer with instruction files, yet the largest controlled study of instruction files to date found no benefit. This paper tests a narrower idea: generated code improves when the prompt carries a specification, a fixed preamble stating what must be true of the result. We pre-registered hypotheses, refuters, analysis code, and a one-shot generation rule, then ran 50 realistic backend tasks from finance, healthcare, and insurance practice through five frontier models from five vendor lineages, each task twice: bare, and preceded by a 267-word filled specification frame. Nine deterministic AST-based checkers scored the outputs. The Bandit security scanner, which knows nothing of the frame, scored them independently. The frame reduced defects in all five models (mean reduction 0.16 to 0.70 findings per task, every Holm-adjusted sign test significant, every bootstrap confidence interval excluding zero). Where the arms differed, the frame arm won 95 of 100 times. It never made any model worse in any domain. Bandit found 53 medium-or-high issues in the bare arm and 11 in the frame arm, in the same direction for every model. The effect was largest where a model's unprompted defaults were weakest: the frame supplies the discipline a model lacks. All 500 outputs, prompts, checkers, scoring code, and the pre-registration are published with a DOI, so any team can re-derive the result without trusting the author.

</details>


### [637] [One to More, More to One: Category-Aware Iterative Expert Training for Software Engineering Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23377)
*Jie Zhao,Ziyu Jiang,Suhang Zheng,Minghui Shan,Xiaoxiao Xu,Lin Qu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向仓库级软件工程（SW...

该框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 可执行任务构建与 SWE Labeler 多轴标注系统，用于组织训练池；(2) 基于同源基座模型的 Refresh–Repair–Expand (RRE) 迭代训练循环，让三个类别专家交替进行长程 Agentic-miniRL 与自身成功轨迹的 Repair SFT；(3) 标签路由的多教师在策略蒸馏（MOPD），配合 ReLU 门控的奖励外推，将专家整合为单一可部署策略。关键创新在于：类别分离本身不足以产生强专家，需通过刷新掌握度、重放自验证成功轨迹、扩展学习前沿来迭代开发专家；整个过程无需外部模型提供解题轨迹。最终 MOPD 策略在 Pro-618 上达到 58.04% 平均解决率（较基座提升 5.39 个百分点），在 SWE-bench Multilingual 上达到 59.00%（提升 2.78 个百分点），在所有三个类别上均超越 Pooled RL 和 Balanced RL 基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在仓库级软件工程任务中，使用联合智能体强化学习时存在"类别跷跷板"现象——某些类别的增益伴随着其他类别的回归，而总体解决率掩盖了这些内部变化。这一异质性问题使得分类决策（即哪些类别上的进步是真实进步、哪些是虚假权衡）难以回答。同时，类别分离本身并不保证产生更强的专家：初始的类别专属 RL 虽然提升了平均训练成功率，但实例层面仍存在不均衡的进步，部分留存受损，这表明需要专门的整合与数据选择机制。

Method: 该框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 可执行任务构建与 SWE Labeler 多轴标注系统，用于组织训练池；(2) 基于同源基座模型的 Refresh–Repair–Expand (RRE) 迭代训练循环，让三个类别专家交替进行长程 Agentic-miniRL 与自身成功轨迹的 Repair SFT；(3) 标签路由的多教师在策略蒸馏（MOPD），配合 ReLU 门控的奖励外推，将专家整合为单一可部署策略。关键创新在于：类别分离本身不足以产生强专家，需通过刷新掌握度、重放自验证成功轨迹、扩展学习前沿来迭代开发专家；整个过程无需外部模型提供解题轨迹。

Result: 最终 MOPD 策略在 Pro-618 上达到 58.04% 平均解决率（较基座提升 5.39 个百分点），在 SWE-bench Multilingual 上达到 59.00%（提升 2.78 个百分点），在所有三个类别上均超越 Pooled RL 和 Balanced RL 基线。RRE 四阶段训练使专家在各自类别上分别超越基座 7.84、4.48、5.61 个百分点；MOPD 整合后保留了 A/B/C 类别专家增益的 80.8%、111.1%、84.8%。Pro-618 上 Pooled RL、B

alanced RL、MOPD 的最小类别增益分别为 2.32、2.65、4.76 个百分点。

Conclusion: 该框架将任务类别视为组织后训练的单位，目标是保留类别专家的增益于单一软件工程智能体中。类别分解应被视为待验证的假设：当池化训练表现出持久差异且总体分数无法揭示时，分解值得尝试。类别分离改变了策略学习的任务分布，但专家发展还需应对类别内不断变化的掌握度问题。单模型整合应同时通过其相对于联合 RL 基线的增益以及每个专家增益的保留程度来评估。限制包括任务跨类别重叠、硬路由配置、额外计算开销、基准通过率无法完全衡量补丁质量、Pro-618 结果无法外推到完整 Pro 集合等。

Abstract: Repository-level software engineering (SWE) comprises heterogeneous task categories, whose progress under pooled agentic reinforcement learning can be uneven: gains in some categories coincide with regressions in others, while aggregate resolution obscures these changes. Motivated by this category see-saw, we develop a category-aware expert-training and policy-integration framework. Executable task construction and SWE Labeler, an evidence-grounded multi-axis labeling system, organize the training pools. Initial category-specific RL improves average training success while leaving uneven instance-level progress, motivating explicit consolidation of successful behavior and policy-adaptive task selection. Same-origin category experts alternate long-horizon Agentic-miniRL with Refresh-Repair-Expand (RRE): the updated policy refreshes instance mastery, reuses its own verified successful trajectories for Repair SFT, and reselects tasks for further RL. Label-routed multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) consolidates the experts into one deployable student, with ReLU-gated reward extrapolation keeping only each teacher's improving direction over the reference. Expert training and policy integration require no external model to provide solution trajectories or action targets. We evaluate Pooled RL and Balanced RL, expert development, and single-model integration through aggregate and per-category resolution, the minimum category lift over each joint-RL baseline, and expert-gain recovery. The final MOPD policy achieves mean resolution of 58.04% on Pro-618 and 59.00% on SWE-bench Multilingual, improving over the base model by 5.39 and 2.78 percentage points, respectively.

</details>


### [638] [Omni2Web: Benchmarking Audiovisual Website Development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23417)
*Minghao Han,Zhenghao Xing,Xize Cheng,Yuxuan Wang,Junming Lin,Ling Wang,Yinsong Yan,Yunfei Chu,Qize Yang,Jin Xu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Omni2Web 是一个针对屏幕录制弱指示性网页编辑请求的双语基准测试，包含918个实例和13,907个编辑步骤，通过直接编辑、指令恢复和指令效用三条互补轨道评估17个模型，揭示多模态意图恢复与代码执行之间存在显著性能差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的网页编辑基准通常假设用户请求具有明确的文本规范，但实际屏幕录制中的编辑请求常包含"这个"、"那里"等弱指示性表达，其指代需结合语音、光标轨迹、页面状态和编辑历史共同解析。该差异使得现有基准无法评估模型在真实多模态情境下的意图恢复能力。

Method: 构建包含918个实例、129个源网页、13,907个编辑步骤和12种操作类型的双语基准；设计三条评估轨道（Track A直接编辑、Track B指令恢复、Track C固定执行器下的指令效用），分别使用Edit Fidelity Score (EFS)和Instruction Recovery Score (IRS)度量；通过文本恢复探针划分Hard/Medium/Easy三档难度；进行模态消融（转录/无声视频/音视频）和时间对齐消融（音频偏移±5秒、添加时间戳）实验；使用17个开源与闭源模型进行评测，并测试评分器的稳健性。

Result: 最佳模型在直接编辑轨道仅达到51.17 EFS，指令恢复轨道为49.14 IRS，固定执行器下恢复指令达到51.08 EFS，远低于神谕指令的89.69 EFS；步骤级分析显示正确的目标定位并不保证成功编辑，而部分Omni模型恢复的指令经固定代码模型执行后效果显著优于其直接编辑；Omni模型在Hard实例上优势最明显；同步音视频输入对两个测试Omni模型均为最佳，音频偏移±5秒使IRS降低11.65-13.73点；评分器替换后榜首与整体排序保持稳定。

Conclusion: Omni2Web 将网页编辑评估从完整规范转向不完整、情境化的用户意图；多模态意图恢复与代码执行均存在显著提升空间；同步语音-视觉上下文对解析用户意图至关重要；将Omni改写器与专用编码模型配对是处理弱指示性编辑请求的有效策略；执行能力瓶颈比定位瓶颈更为突出。

Abstract: Screen-recorded web editing requests contain weak deictic expressions such as ``this'' and ``there,'' whose referents depend on speech, cursor trajectories, page state, and edit history. Such requests require intent recovery beyond the explicit specifications assumed by many existing web-editing benchmarks. We introduce Omni2Web, a bilingual benchmark of 918 instances spanning 13,907 edit steps. It defines three complementary tracks: Direct Editing evaluates webpage editing from recordings, Instruction Recovery measures explicit intent recovery, and Instruction Utility tests whether recovered instructions can drive a fixed code executor. We evaluate 17 open- and closed-source models. The best models attain 51.17 on the Edit Fidelity Score (EFS) for Direct Editing and 49.14 on the Instruction Recovery Score (IRS); under the fixed executor, the strongest recovered instructions reach 51.08 EFS, still far below the 89.69 EFS obtained with oracle instructions. Step-level analyses show that correct grounding does not guarantee successful edits, while some Omni models recover instructions that the fixed coding model executes substantially better than their direct edits. Controlled ablations further demonstrate the value of temporally aligned audiovisual evidence, while alternative judges preserve the leader and broad ordering. Together, these findings reveal substantial headroom in multimodal intent recovery and code execution and highlight the promise of pairing Omni rewriters with coding models.

</details>


### [639] [VSpector: Specification-Driven Bug Detection for RISC-V CPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23517)
*Tianyu Jia,Zhaoyang Yu,Yuanliang Chen,Wei You,Jianjun Huang,Bin Liang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: VSpector 是一款基于规范驱动的 RISC-V CPU 漏洞检测流水线，直接对照官方自然语言 RISC-V 规范检查 RTL 实现，无需依赖参考模型、形式化属性或自定义漏洞模式。其采用四阶段逐步上下文细化流水线（规则提取、实现定位、候选识别、违规审计），并通过大语言模型完成跨领域语义对齐。在 CVA6 和 XiangShan 两款工业级 RISC-V CPU 上实现了 68.2% 的检测精度，发现 73 个独立 Bug，其中 42 个为先前未知，且无法被 SOTA CPU 模糊测试工具 DiveFuzz 在 24 小时内检出，已获开发者修复或确认 30 个。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 RISC-V CPU 漏洞检测方法（模糊测试、形式化验证、静态分析）严重依赖预定义工件（参考模型、属性、模式），存在固有不完备性，且参考模型（如 NEMU、Spike）自身的实现缺陷也会导致漏检。作者探索能否直接利用 RISC-V 官方规范文本作为高质量信息源，将规范违规作为漏洞检测的判定依据。

Method: VSpector 采用四阶段流水线：(1) 规则提取——按节段切分规范文档，逐节段提取独立规则；(2) 实现定位——利用基于 ReAct 的 LLM 代理在代码库中以 grep 模式搜索种子代码，并通过 LLM 文件切片提取信号依赖；(3) 候选识别——对规则与代码上下文进行三态判定（违规/不违规/信息不足），信息不足时启动检索子代理动态补充 RTL 代码；(4) 违规审计——通过规范侧审查（将候选放回完整规范上下文中验证）和代码侧审查（独立验证 RTL 解读及可观测性）两阶段顺序复查以消除误报。整个流程通过 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 模型实现。

Result: 在 CVA6（SystemVerilog，约 91,000 行）与 XiangShan（Chisel，约 122,000 行）两款 CPU 上共检查 5,685 条规则，产生 217 个审计候选，人工核查确认 148 个为真实违规（精度 68.2%），对应 73 个独立 Bug，其中 42 个为首次报告的未知漏洞。DiveFuzz 模糊器 24 小时未发现任何这 42 个新 Bug，而 VSpector 还发现了 2 个 DiveFuzz 已找到的 Bug。所有 42 个新 Bug 已上报上游，开发者已修复 19 个并确认 11 个（共 30 个）。审计使精度从 13.7% 提升至 68.2%，逐条规则检查比整节检查多发现 39 个 Bug。整个过程共花费约 909 美元，平均每条规则约 0.16 美元，平均每条规则处理耗时约 20.5 分钟。

Conclusion: 直接对照 RISC-V 官方规范检查 RTL 实现是一种实用且有效的 CPU 漏洞检测策略，能够发现现有模糊测试和静态分析方法难以发现的深层规范违规，对 CPU 漏洞检测方法具有重要互补价值。VSpector 证明了无需专业构建检测前置条件，仅以官方规范作为唯一信息源即可大规模发现真实 CPU 漏洞。

Abstract: Detecting RTL design bugs in open-source RISC-V CPU implementations is critical for ensuring system reliability. Traditional detection approaches inherently rely on predefined artifacts. In this paper, we leverage the official,natural-language RISC-V specifications as an effective information source for bug detection. We present VSpector, a specification-driven bug detection pipeline that directly checks whether CPU register-transfer level (RTL) implementations adhere to official specification rules, without requiring specialized construction of reference models, formal properties, or custom bug patterns. To resolve the key technical trade-off between broad context scope and model reasoning accuracy when using Large Language Models (LLMs), VSpector employs a stepwise context refinement scheme across a four-stage pipeline: rule extraction, implementation localization, candidate identification, and sequential violation auditing. We evaluate VSpector on two industrial-strength RISC-V CPUs, CVA6 and XiangShan. Out of 217 reported candidates, manual inspection confirmed 148 true violations, representing a 68.2% precision. These violations correspond to 73 distinct bugs, including 42 previously unknown bugs. In our comparative experiments, DiveFuzz, a state-of-the-art CPU fuzzer, detected none of these new bugs during 24-hour runs per CPU. All 42 new bugs have been reported upstream, with developers already fixing 19 and confirming an additional 11 (30 in total), demonstrating that specification-driven auditing is a practical and complementary strategy for CPU bug detection.

</details>


### [640] [VibeMemBench: Evaluating Memory Systems for Coding Agents on Real Repository Coding Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23570)
*Liyang Fan,Yingcheng Shi,Yongbin Li,Chenghao Sun,Xin Chen,Xander Xu,Hu Wei,Shiwen Ni,Min Yang,Jieping Ye*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: VibeMemBench是一个用于评估编码智能体持久记忆系统的新基准，包含111个真实代码库任务。其核心发现是：尽管仓库历史中存在有用的经验，但现有记忆系统（Mem0、SimpleMem、MemoryOS、A-MEM）几乎无法将这些经验转化为对编码任务有帮助的上下文——12对求解器与系统组合中有11对未能超越关闭记忆的基线。主要瓶颈在于记忆系统输出的"记录形式"（record form），而非检索覆盖能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估存在两个盲点：仓库级基准测试（如SWE-bench）衡量可执行代码修复却未隔离记忆变量的作用；记忆基准测试衡量召回率却不验证下游编码效果。本文旨在填补"匹配的记忆开关"+"可执行编码结果"这一双重缺失的评估维度。

Method: 构建四阶段SIEVE筛选管线：(1)源验证——用金标补丁执行测试；(2)补丁模式筛选——基于共享文件、目录、标识符的确定性评分及LLM判断，控制泄漏；(3)历史执行与经验蒸馏——执行MiniSWEAgent轨迹，生成包含bug类别、根因、修复模式、可复用教训的target-aware经验；(4)按参考设置的uplift保留——仅保留在deepseek-v4-flash参考设置下注入经验后解析率提升的目标。评估采用配对干预协议，固定所有智能体配置（模型、提示、工具、沙箱、预算），仅切换记忆条件。设置两层评估：frozen验证经验传输层（5个解冻沿器）和现有记忆系统检索层（Mem0、SimpleMem、MemoryOS、A-MEM×3个解冻沿器）。

Result: 基准含111个目标、90个仓库、3634条历史轨迹。Frozen验证经验使4/5解冻沿器Resolved提升1.1-4.5个百分点（glm-5: +2.4, glm-5.2: +3.6, kimi-k2.7-code: +4.5, qwen3.8-max: +1.1, deepseek-v4-pro: +0.0），且降低所有解冻沿器的智能体步数。但12对记忆系统与解冻沿器组合中仅1对（MemoryOS×glm-5: +2.0）超越基线，其余11对均失败。失败归因于231对失败配对中69.3%为"形式退化"（form degradation），其中指令污染和过度泛化的修复模式占58.1%。剥离消融表明损害源于转录文本体积而非指令语义。同一记录在不同解冻沿器上常产生相反方向效应，61/64次反向移动中记忆关闭时较弱的解冻沿器获益——记忆效用取决于解冻沿器余量（headroom）而非记录本身的内在属性。

Conclusion: VibeMemBench揭示了仓库历史中可用经验与现有记忆系统实际交付经验之间的巨大差距。该差距源于记录形式而非检索覆盖：转录系统（MemoryOS、A-MEM）原样存储对话产生指令污染；原子系统（Mem0、SimpleMem）的提取模式针对对话事实导致修复模式被泛化。设计启示：(1)注入应基于解冻沿器预期余量门控而非统一应用；(2)系统应压缩检索到的轨迹至声明修复的span；(3)提取模式必须保留令修复schema锚定目标的约束。

Abstract: Coding agents operate on real repository coding tasks, and persistent memory systems promise to reuse experience across tasks. Yet existing evaluations do not show whether those systems improve executable repository work. Repository benchmarks test code changes but do not isolate memory, while memory benchmarks score recall without measuring downstream coding outcomes. We introduce VibeMemBench, a benchmark for evaluating memory systems on 111 coding targets from 90 SWE-rebench V2 repositories and 3,634 history trajectories from the target repositories. The targets follow the SWE benchmark style and cover bug fixes, feature requests, interface changes, and configuration work. An agent edits each target codebase under a declared memory condition. Executable tests decide task resolution. Each target is retained only when injected history experience improves its executable outcome in a reference setting, so every target carries a prior experience whose usefulness is verified by execution in that setting. The frozen verified experience is then transferred to five held-out solvers. Direct injection raises observed task resolution on four of them by 1.1 to 4.5 percentage points while lowering agent steps on all five. Yet when four existing memory systems must construct and retrieve experience from the same history, eleven of twelve solver and system pairings fail to exceed the matched memory-off baseline. VibeMemBench exposes the gap between the useful experience that repository history holds and the experience existing memory systems deliver for repository coding tasks.

</details>


### [641] [Packaged, But Not Portable: Why Conforming to the Agent Plugin Standard Is Rare, and Why Conforming Would Not Be Enough](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23809)
*Tezan Sahu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文对编码智能体（coding agent）插件生态对 Agent Plugins v1.0.0 标准的采纳情况进行了大规模实证研究，构建了包含 68,072 个插件包的语料库 AgentPluginZoo。研究发现：尽管标准仅发布两个月，但只有 6.2% 的插件符合规范，且更关键的问题是——即使全部合规，81% 的能力导出插件仍会因命名冲突而无法确定由谁响应，因为规范未定义命名空间或优先级规则。作者主张应从"打包格式"升级到"组合模型"，并提出四个核心概念。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体的扩展生态已从各自为政走向标准化（Agent Plugins v1.0.0 发布于 2026 年 7 月），但实践中存在两个未知：(1) 生态系统是否真的在采纳该标准；(2) 即便完全合规，是否足以保证多插件共存时的可预测行为。作者旨在用实证数据回答这两个实践者最关心的问题。

Method: 构建 AgentPluginZoo 语料库：通过多条独立发现路径（代码搜索、市场索引、递归仓库树展开）在 GitHub 公开仓库收集 68,072 个插件包，覆盖 30,655 个仓库。采用四重防护措施对抗自测量偏差（如递归扩展而非搜索、按顺序运行供应商中性路由、对超出上限的查询分区、对每个制品记录发现来源以便重算）。用 Draft 2020-12 验证器对清单（manifest）进行评分，并区分"致命违规"（拒绝加载）与"非致命违规"（静默丢弃字段）。进一步提取所有能力名称进行碰撞分析。

Result: 主要发现：(1) 合规率仅 6.2%，但 96.6% 只需添加缺失的 $schema 字段即可加载——失败是浅层而非结构性的；(2) 40.2% 的清单包含规范要求的客户端静默丢弃的字段，主要是 skills、mcpServers 等声明；(3) 仅 19.7% 将清单放在规范要求的中性根目录，14.5% 存在多份清单且 95.6% 已发生语义漂移；(4) 标准发布后合规率从 3.2% 升至 19.9%（六倍增长），但活跃维护项目中仍仅 10.4%；(5) 81% 的能力导出插件与至少一个其他插件共享能力名称，最严重的 `code-reviewer` 被 300 个独立仓库主声明，但规范未规定命名空间或优先级规则。

Conclusion: 社区标准化了"打包格式"但实际需要的是"组合模型"。论文提出 v1.1 应增补的四个核心概念：(1) 限定能力身份（plugin:capability）；(2) 声明的能力表面；(3) 优先级与冲突规则；(4) 插件间组合关系（依赖、不兼容性、版本约束）。所有这些都可作为附加性 profile 纳入同一规范而非竞争标准。对实践者的建议包括：将清单放在根目录并声明 $schema、将客户端特定数据放入 extensions 对象、为能力名称添加前缀、若需多份清单则自动生成。核心呼吁：合规性必须先可观察，然后才能变得普遍。

Abstract: Coding agents are extended by plugins: installable bundles that ship skills, sub-agents, commands, hooks, and tool servers. On 24 July 2026, an open specification (Agent Plugins v1.0.0) standardised how such a bundle is laid out and described, so that one plugin could run on any agent. We ask the two questions a practitioner would ask of it: is the ecosystem adopting the standard, and if a plugin did conform, would that be enough to make it work alongside the other plugins a user has installed? We answer both by building AgentPluginZoo, a provenance-tracked corpus of 68,072 plugin bundles across 30,655 repositories, released with its discovery ledger, scoring code, and analysis. Only 6.2% validate, but the gap is shallow rather than structural: 96.6% would load after adding one missing boilerplate field. The real cost lands elsewhere. 40.2% would load while the specification obliges the client to discard fields their authors wrote, mostly declarations of what the plugin ships. Moreover, conformance settles nothing for the second question: 81% of capability-exporting bundles share a name with another plugin, with no namespace or precedence rule to decide which one answers. This paper argues the community standardised a packaging format when composition needs a model, names the four concepts such a model must add - qualified capability identity, a declared capability surface, a precedence rule, and inter-plugin relations - and shows they fit an additive v1.1 profile of the same specification rather than a competing standard. Recommendations follow for practitioners packaging extensions today and for the people evolving the standard, chief among them that conformance must be made observable before it can become common. The corpus and code are available at this https URL

</details>


### [642] [A Carbon-Aware Quantum Computing Framework for LCA-Driven Sustainability in Quantum Cloud Services](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24224)
*Muhammad Umar,Nauman Arshad,Azeem Akbar,Arif Ali Khan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文将碳感知量子计算（CQC）框架从平台级扩展至服务级，基于一台100逻辑量子比特超导量子计算机的全生命周期评估（LCA）数据，为量子云服务（QCS）提供商提供可持续性决策指导。研究发现超导量子计算机的碳足迹以隐含碳为主导（77.3%-85.2%），五年足迹为583–10,570 t CO₂e，运行-隐含碳平衡需17.0–28.7年，远超经典对比组的2.7年。这颠覆了经典云服务的可持续性直觉：利用率提升带来最大杠杆（19.7×），其次是延长服务寿命（59.9%）和电力供应选择（6.5×），而运营效率提升和可再生能源采购作用有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子计算的环境足迹相对于经典基础设施仍缺乏充分理解，且随着量子计算向云端交付模式转型，量子云服务（QCS）提供商缺乏超越平台级碳核算框架的可操作指导。现有量子计算LCA研究虽量化了子系统层面的环境影响，但未能将这些发现转化为面向云服务的可持续性决策框架。此外，经典云服务"运营效率优先"的可持续性直觉未必适用于量子硬件，亟需基于实证数据的QCS专用指导。

Method: 方法分为两部分：(1) 对一台基于Bluefors第一代低温恒温系统的超导量子计算平台进行摇篮到坟墓的生命周期评估（LCA），建模对象涵盖低温恒温器、气体处理系统（GHS）、压缩机和控制单元四大子系统，功能单元为一个平台小时（100逻辑量子比特配置），使用ecoinvent 3.9数据库和IMPACT World+方法学，气候变化指标采用IPCC 2021 GWP100特征因子，在SimaPro 9中完成计算；(2) 在Arora和Kumar（2025）提出的CQC框架基础上沿三个维度扩展为服务级模型——①基于αⱼ=τⱼ/T_life的服务级隐含碳分摊；②将运营碳分解为负载无关基础功率（P_base）与负载比例边际功率（P_marg），并保留时变电网碳强度I(t)以支持碳感知调度；③将应用偏移项按工作负载类别i进行加权分解（设为0作为保守上界）。同时设置Scenario A（GKP码，175×缩放）与Scenario A′（表面码，2500×缩放）进行敏感性分析，并与经典HPC和TOP500级别对比组进行比较。

Result: 五年足迹为583 t CO₂e（GKP）和10,570 t（表面码），隐含碳占比77.3%-85.2%（生产阶段贡献最大，低温恒温器为主导）；运营-隐含碳平衡时间在量子场景下为17.0–28.7年，而经典对比组仅2.7年。负载功率比P_base:P_marg在量子场景下为12.1:1（GKP）至4.5:1（表面码），经典对比组反转为0.67:1，证实量子平台运营碳由"制冷时间"主导而非计算量。各杠杆效应量排序：利用率（5%→100%带来19.7×碳强度下降，261.9→13.3 kg CO₂e/QPU-小时）、服务寿命延长（3→10年降低59.9%，40.1→16.1 kg CO₂e/QPU-小时）、电力供应（最差情况下6.5×），而运营效率和可再生能源采购杠杆有限。两个量子场景在整个评估范围内碳足迹均低于经典对比组Scenario B（五年分别低32,506 t和22,520 t），因此无需应用偏移项即可成立比较。

Conclusion: 纠错后超导量子计算机在结构上以隐含碳为主导，完全颠覆了经典云服务的可持续性直觉——"提高利用率"和"延长设备寿命"成为最强杠杆，而非"提升运营效率"或"采购可再生能源"。这要求QCS提供商重新排序其可持续性优先事项：队列管理、批处理和工作负载整合（利用率）以及模块化硬件设计和组件级更新（寿命延长）比单纯的运营脱碳更为有效。主要局限性包括：负荷比例因子φ基于物理推断而非实测、平台小时功能单元无法实现与经典基础设施的逐计算比较、以及仅针对超导架构。未来工作应优先开展直接功率测量、利用提供商特定工作负载数据填充应用偏移项，并将评估扩展至光子、囚禁离子和中性原子架构以检验隐含碳主导性是否具有跨架构普适性。

Abstract: Quantum computing's environmental footprint remains poorly understood relative to classical infrastructure, and as quantum computing moves toward cloud delivery, Quantum Cloud Service (QCS) providers lack actionable guidance beyond platform-level carbon-accounting frameworks. Objective: This study extends the carbon-aware quantum computing (CQC) framework from a platform-level to a service-level model that translates empirical life cycle assessment (LCA) findings of a superconducting quantum computer into guidance for QCS providers. Method: We modeled the CQC framework via service-level embodied-carbon allocation, load-independent and load-proportional operational decomposition, and a workload-resolved application offset on the basis of results acquired through a cradle-to-grave LCA of a superconducting quantum platform. Results: The five-year footprint is 583 t CO2e (GKP) and 10,570 t (surface-code), dominated by embodied carbon (77.3-85.2%), with operational-embodied parity not reached until 17.0-28.7 years versus 2.7 years for classical comparators. This reorders provider levers: utilisation yields the largest gain (19.7x), followed by service life extension (59.9%) and electricity supply (6.5x), while operational efficiency and renewable procurement offer limited leverage. Conclusion: Superconducting quantum computers are structurally embodied-carbon-dominated, inverting classical sustainability intuition and motivating direct power measurement and cross-architecture validation as quantum infrastructure scales.

</details>


### [643] [Fault-Class-Matched Test Oracles for Output-Invisible Quantum Transpiler Regressions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24230)
*Furqan Nasir,Arif Shah,Iftikhar Alam*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文针对量子编译器（transpiler）的测试预言机（oracle）盲区问题，提出了一族与故障类别匹配、考虑布局（layout）、按宽度分级的oracle机制，可有效检测输出等价oracle无法发现的布局元数据、全局相位及运行可复现性故障。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有量子编译器测试多采用输出等价（黑盒）oracle，但约28%（95% Wilson CI 19-40%）已合并的Qiskit transpiler修复修复了不影响输出正确性而破坏布局元数据、全局相位或可复现性的故障，说明黑盒oracle存在结构性盲区。

Method: 提出四类针对性oracle：(1) 布局/置换契约检查器，(2) 元数据通道的契约级蜕变关系MR-1，(3) 全局相位跟踪器，(4) 可复现性运行器。在9个真实Qiskit transpiler回归案例（每通道3个）上验证，并进行675组配置扫描和合成变异株测试，同时将全局相位机制移植到pytket/tket进行跨平台验证。

Result: 输出等价oracle在全部案例中失明，而匹配机制全部触发；675组配置扫描无误报；契约/元数据与全局相位通道在36个合成变异株上灵敏度与特异度均为1.00；可复现性通道在3个可构造电路上的灵敏度为1.00（95% CI 0.44-1.00）；契约检查器比纯输出检查便宜2至6个数量级；pytket/tket上的全局相位机制同样达到1.00/1.00精度，并恢复至双精度精度。

Conclusion: 输出等价oracle在量子编译器测试中存在系统性盲区；所提故障类别匹配的oracle家族能可靠检测被忽视的三类故障，具有高灵敏度/特异度、显著更低成本，且关键机制（全局相位）可跨平台移植，证明结果非Qiskit特异性。

Abstract: Test oracles for quantum transpilers typically judge correctness by comparing compiled output against a reference: a statevector, a sampled distribution, or a unitary compared modulo global phase. A companion empirical study measures how often that choice fails. Roughly 28% of merged Qiskit transpiler bug-fixes (95% Wilson CI 19-40%) repair a fault that corrupts layout metadata, global phase, or run-to-run reproducibility while output stays correct: invisible to a black-box output-equivalence oracle by construction. This paper closes that gap with a fault-class-matched, layout-aware, width-tiered oracle family: a layout/permutation contract checker and a contract-level metamorphic relation (MR-1) for the metadata channel, a global-phase tracker for the phase channel, and a determinism runner for reproducibility. Verified from source on nine real, merged Qiskit transpiler regressions (three per channel), the output-equivalence oracle is blind throughout and the matched mechanism fires on every case. A 675-configuration sweep of the contract/metadata invariant finds no false positive. Synthetic mutant families confirm reliability at scale: 1.00 sensitivity and specificity across 36 mutants apiece for the contract/metadata and global-phase channels, and 1.00 sensitivity (95% CI 0.44-1.00) for reproducibility on the three circuits where the mutation is constructible. The contract checker costs two to six orders of magnitude less than a plain output check, the global-phase tracker is comparably cheap within its exact tier, and only the metamorphic relation carries a bounded cost. Ported natively to pytket/tket, the global-phase mechanism transfers cleanly, an identical 1.00/1.00 result with phases recovered to double-precision accuracy, evidence against a Qiskit-specific artifact.

</details>


### [644] [Evaluating the effectiveness of class-level LLM-generated test suites in Python](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24341)
*Bilal Al-Ahmad,M. Harshvardhan,Khaled El-Fakih,Anas AlSobeh*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文针对LLM生成Python类级单元测试的评估问题，通过对比四种提示策略与十种LLM配置在ClassEval基准上的表现，提出以可执行性为门槛、结合结构覆盖率、变异测试分数和测试质量指标的综合评估框架。研究发现结构覆盖率在所有配置中均接近天花板而失去区分力；模型选择对变异分数的影响约为提示选择的3.9倍；提示策略虽存在小但显著的影响，但其效果依赖于具体模型，没有通用最优提示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM生成测试的评估工作过度依赖结构覆盖率（行/分支覆盖），而高覆盖率并不能证明测试能够可靠执行或有效检测缺陷。此外，提示策略与模型选择在变异测试层面的交互效应尚未得到系统研究。实践者面临的关键问题是：相比精心设计提示，选择更好的模型是否更能提升测试质量？

Method: 研究采用4×10析因设计，在ClassEval基准（100个Python类）上交叉评估四种提示策略（自研77行零样本CoT提示 + 三种文献基线：Wang等30行、Chudic & Çalıklı 29行、Ouédraogo等18行）与十种LLM配置（GPT-5.2、Gemini 3 Flash、DeepSeek Chat/Reasoner、Claude Opus/Sonnet 4.6各含推理开关）。使用pytest执行、coverage.py测量覆盖率、Cosmic Ray进行变异测试、radon计算圈复杂度。以可执行性为门槛（仅保留Cosmic Ray运行成功的类），采用Wilcoxon符号秩检验（Holm-Bonferroni校正）与Type-II双因素ANOVA进行统计推断，共生成4000个测试套件与100个人工基线。

Result: 结构覆盖率：所有40个单元的覆盖率中位数均为100%，均值在89.3%-99.95%之间，无法区分配置；GPT-5.2 medium reasoning可执行性最高（77.8%），DeepSeek最低（7%-23%）；变异测试中，所提提案在7/10配置中表现最佳，但优势微弱（同一模型内通常<4个百分点），Claude Opus除外（达10个百分点）；模型效应（η²=0.0216）约为提示效应（η²=0.0056）的3.9倍，交互效应显著；人类基线在82个可执行类上杀死88.3%变异体，LLM在自身可执行子集上为90.2%-96.2%，但分母不等不能直接比较；测试质量方面，LLM测试套件在圈复杂度上为人类的2-3倍，套件规模与变异分数呈负相关（r=-0.31至-0.39）。

Conclusion: 可靠评估LLM生成的测试必须将可执行性作为门槛，并结合变异测试与结构质量指标，单纯依靠覆盖率会得出误导性结论。实践中应先选模型再调提示，因为模型选择对测试质量的决定性远大于提示设计；不同LLM的可执行性与变异检测能力呈现互补性短板（如DeepSeek可执行性低但条件变异分数高，GPT-5.2则相反）。建议报告可执行性作为首要结果，使用变异测试评估有效测试，并将测试套件体积与质量区分开来。该研究是首个在类级Python代码上跨多提示多LLM进行变异评估的工作。

Abstract: Context: Large language models (LLMs) can generate unit tests quickly, but high structural coverage does not establish that those tests execute reliably or detect faults. Existing evidence often treats coverage as the principal outcome and rarely compares prompt strategies and models through mutation testing at class level. Objective: This study examines how prompt strategy and model choice shape the executability, structural coverage, fault-detection effectiveness, and structural quality of LLM-generated Python test suites relative to human-written suites. Method: We evaluate multiple prompt strategies across a diverse set of current LLM configurations on the ClassEval benchmark. The evaluation combines execution outcomes, line and branch coverage, Cosmic Ray mutation scores, and structural quality indicators. Primary analyses treat successful execution as a prerequisite; paired comparisons use only classes shared by the relevant executable subsets. Results: Structural coverage is consistently near its ceiling and offers little discrimination among configurations. Executability varies substantially. The proposed prompt performs strongly for mutation score, but no prompt dominates across models. Model choice explains more variation than prompt choice, and their interaction shows that prompt effectiveness depends on the selected model. Human and LLM suites are evaluated on unequal executable subsets, so their relative mutation scores do not establish superiority. Conclusion: Reliable assessment of LLM-generated tests should treat executability as a gate and combine coverage with mutation testing and structural quality indicators. In practice, model selection should precede prompt tuning.

</details>


### [645] [Trajectory-Aware Benchmark Subset Selection for Cost-Efficient Software Engineering Agent Regression Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24928)
*Mahmoud Ayyad,Zehao Wang,Jiho Shin,Ying Zou,Bram Adams*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种面向软件工程智能体（SWE-agent）回归测试的轨迹感知（trajectory-aware）基准子集选择方法，通过结合历史通过/失败结果分组与基于轨迹嵌入的几何选择，将基准评估成本降低约90%同时保持中位估计误差低于5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SWE-agent每次模型、提示或框架更新后重新运行完整基准（如SWE-Bench Verified含500个实例）成本高达数亿LLM token，评估成为开发瓶颈。现有方案（随机抽样、固定种子采样、基于结果分层抽样）在小子集尺寸下方差高，无法保证子集代表性。传统的基于执行轨迹的测试用例优先级排序技术尚未被应用于SWE-agent场景。

Method: 提出轨迹感知子集选择流程：(1) 解析五种agent框架的异构轨迹为统一JSON schema；(2) 四阶段清洗管线（去噪→检测结果泄漏→屏蔽→验证）移除结果泄漏词（如"passed"、"exit code 0"）和仓库标识；(3) 使用Nomic Embed v1.5将清洗后轨迹嵌入为向量（池化变体含均值、标准差、首/中/尾步拼接共3840维）；(4) 按历史通过次数分组后在嵌入空间内进行几何选择（最佳方法为Centroid：选择每组最接近质心的实例），算法包括Centroid、Facility Location、Medoid、Kennard-Stone、Core/Edge。实验评估76种配置，跨三种回归场景（单配置重跑、模型变更、框架变更），共31,779条轨迹。

Result: 最佳方法Centroid Pooled在5%和10%子集尺寸下：(1) 平均RMSE较最强基线Consist-Strat降低3-11%（最高11.4%，p<0.001，δ=0.492大效应量）；(2) 最坏情况误差（MaxErr）较典型抽签降低4-11%，较95%分位抽签降低38-46%；(3) 10%子集保持中位误差<5%，token成本从3.44B降至约345M（节省90%）。消融实验证实结果分组与几何选择均不可或缺：去除分组使RMSE上升30-37%，用聚类替代分组上升9-16%，用嵌入缩小候选池后再随机抽样上升21-26%。成本分析证实k%子集平均消耗k%的token成本，方法无成本偏差。

Conclusion: 轨迹感知子集选择是SWE-agent回归测试中全量评估的实用替代方案。结论组分层控制难度组成，几何选择控制行为代表性，二者缺一不可。该方法建议在完整运行之间作为快速回归检查使用，需至少一次历史运行（≥3次为佳），架构变更后可考虑Core/Edge变体。清洗管线需逐数据集校准，未来工作可探索自动泄漏检测、时序嵌入改进、跨领域泛化及增量子集更新。

Abstract: Autonomous software engineering agents (SWE-agents) automate coding tasks. Each agent update may require re-running the full benchmark to detect regressions and improvements, at a cost of hundreds of millions of LLM tokens per run, which makes evaluation a bottleneck. One solution is to evaluate only a subset of benchmark instances. Yet, simple approaches, such as random sampling or stratified random sampling based on past pass/fail outcomes, risk producing high variance and unrepresentative subsets. We turn to agent trajectories, the step-by-step record of the actions an agent took. We propose a trajectory-aware subset selection approach that replaces random sampling with deterministic selection based on trajectory embeddings. We first group test set instances by their test outcome in a recent full test run to preserve the historical pass/fail rate, then select the subset using the trajectory's embedding space. We evaluate 76 subset selection configurations, including random sampling, embedding-based selection, clustering-based selection, and hybrid shortlist-then-subsample strategies, across three regression scenarios: same-configuration reruns, model and configuration changes, and agent framework changes. Our best trajectory-aware method is the one selecting benchmark instances closest to the centroid of each outcome group in the embedding space. It achieves the lowest estimation error among all methods we evaluate. For instance, when evaluating a given agent version on a selected subset of 5% or 10% of the test instances, our approach reduces the average estimation error by 3--11% and the worst-case error by 4--11% relative to the typical draw and 38--46% relative to the 95th-percentile draw of the strongest baseline. Our results show that a 10% trajectory-aware subset keeps the median estimation error below 5% while cutting token cost by roughly 90%.

</details>
